namespace Dada.Assignment

open Shared

abbrev Store := List (VariableId × Slot)

structure Frame where
  variables : Store
  body : Body
  destination : Option VariableId
  deriving Repr

structure Configuration where
  objects : List (ObjectId × Object)
  nextId : Nat
  frames : List Frame
  deriving Repr

def Configuration.running (state : State) (body : Body)
    (frames : List Frame := []) (destination : Option VariableId := none) : Configuration :=
  ⟨state.objects, state.nextId, ⟨state.variables, body, destination⟩ :: frames⟩

def Configuration.initial (program : Program) : Configuration :=
  .running State.empty ⟨program.main, none⟩

def Configuration.finished (configuration : Configuration) : Prop :=
  configuration.frames = []

-- Flattening is only for reachability; evaluation uses the top frame alone.
def Configuration.rootState (configuration : Configuration) : State :=
  ⟨configuration.objects, configuration.frames.flatMap Frame.variables, configuration.nextId⟩

def Configuration.roots (configuration : Configuration) : List Reference :=
  configuration.rootState.variables.filterMap Prod.snd

-- A mathematical collector, not an executable graph-traversal algorithm.
def Configuration.collect (configuration : Configuration) : Configuration := by
  exact { configuration with objects := configuration.rootState.collect.objects }

theorem Configuration.collect_frames (configuration : Configuration) :
    configuration.collect.frames = configuration.frames := rfl

theorem Configuration.collect_nextId (configuration : Configuration) :
    configuration.collect.nextId = configuration.nextId := rfl

theorem Configuration.collect_eq_self (configuration : Configuration)
    (rooted : ∀ id data, (id, data) ∈ configuration.objects → Live configuration.rootState id) :
    configuration.collect = configuration := by
  classical
  have same : configuration.objects.filter (fun entry => decide (Live configuration.rootState entry.1)) =
      configuration.objects := List.filter_eq_self.mpr (by
    intro entry member
    simpa using rooted entry.1 entry.2 member)
  change { configuration with objects := (configuration.objects.filter
    (fun entry => decide (Live configuration.rootState entry.1))) } = configuration
  rw [same]

theorem live_has_root (live : Live state object) : ∃ name reference,
    (name, some reference) ∈ state.variables := by
  induction live with
  | «variable» member => exact ⟨_, _, member⟩
  | field _ _ _ ih => exact ih

theorem no_roots_not_live (objects : List (ObjectId × Object)) (nextId : Nat) (object : ObjectId) :
    ¬ Live ⟨objects, [], nextId⟩ object := by
  intro live
  obtain ⟨_, _, member⟩ := live_has_root live
  simp at member

theorem Configuration.collect_empty_frames (objects : List (ObjectId × Object)) (nextId : Nat) :
    (Configuration.mk objects nextId []).collect = ⟨[], nextId, []⟩ := by
  simp [Configuration.collect, State.collect, Configuration.rootState, no_roots_not_live]

theorem Configuration.collect_empty_heap (nextId : Nat) (frames : List Frame) :
    (Configuration.mk [] nextId frames).collect = ⟨[], nextId, frames⟩ := by
  simp [Configuration.collect, State.collect, Configuration.rootState]

def parameterStore (parameters : List Parameter) (references : List Reference) : Store :=
  (parameters.map Functions.Parameter.name).zip (references.map some)

inductive ResultEval (classes : Classes) : State → Option Value → State → Option Reference → Prop where
  | none (state : State) : ResultEval classes state none state none
  | some {before after value reference} :
      Eval classes before value after reference →
      ResultEval classes before (some value) after (some reference)

inductive Deliver : Store → Option VariableId → Option Reference → Store → Prop where
  | none (variables : Store) : Deliver variables none none variables
  | some {variables name reference} :
      name ∉ variables.map Prod.fst →
      Deliver variables (some name) (some reference) ((name, some reference) :: variables)

def DestinationMatches (destination : Option VariableId)
    (result : Option Shared.Typing.FieldType) : Prop :=
  destination.isSome = result.isSome

-- Frame completion is a runtime check of roots, not a view-based test.
def StoreFinished (classes : Classes) (state : State) : Prop :=
  ∀ name reference, (name, some reference) ∈ state.variables →
    StructReference classes state reference

-- Raw transitions transfer all temporary values before collection.
inductive RawStep (classes : Classes) (declarations : Declarations) : Configuration → Configuration → Prop where
  | local {before after statement rest result frames destination} :
      Unpacking.Step classes ⟨before, [statement]⟩ ⟨after, []⟩ →
      RawStep classes declarations
        (.running before ⟨.local statement :: rest, result⟩ frames destination)
        (.running after ⟨rest, result⟩ frames destination)
  | call {before evaluated destination name arguments rest result frames returnTo
      declaration references} :
      (name, declaration) ∈ declarations →
      DestinationMatches destination declaration.signature.result →
      (∀ x ∈ destination, x ∉ before.variables.map Prod.fst) →
      EvalArgs classes before arguments evaluated references →
      references.length = declaration.signature.parameters.length →
      RawStep classes declarations
        (.running before ⟨.call destination name arguments :: rest, result⟩ frames returnTo)
        (.running { evaluated with variables := parameterStore declaration.signature.parameters references }
          declaration.body (⟨evaluated.variables, ⟨rest, result⟩, returnTo⟩ :: frames) destination)
  | dropStruct {before evaluated place reference rest result frames destination} :
      Eval classes before (.give place) evaluated reference →
      StructReference classes evaluated reference →
      RawStep classes declarations
        (.running before ⟨.dropStruct place :: rest, result⟩ frames destination)
        (.running evaluated ⟨rest, result⟩ frames destination)
  | store {before evaluated after place value reference target previous rest result frames destination} :
      Eval classes before value evaluated reference →
      Writable evaluated place target previous →
      Replaceable classes evaluated previous →
      Write evaluated target reference after →
      RawStep classes declarations
        (.running before ⟨.store place value :: rest, result⟩ frames destination)
        (.running after ⟨rest, result⟩ frames destination)
  | «return» {before evaluated result reference caller frames destination variables} :
      ResultEval classes before result evaluated reference →
      Deliver caller.variables destination reference variables →
      StoreFinished classes evaluated →
      RawStep classes declarations
        (.running before ⟨[], result⟩ (caller :: frames) destination)
        (.running { evaluated with variables := variables } caller.body frames caller.destination)
  | exit {objects nextId variables} :
      StoreFinished classes ⟨objects, variables, nextId⟩ →
      RawStep classes declarations
        (.running ⟨objects, variables, nextId⟩ ⟨[], none⟩) ⟨objects, nextId, []⟩

inductive Step (classes : Classes) (declarations : Declarations) : Configuration → Configuration → Prop where
  | collect {before raw} : RawStep classes declarations before raw →
      Step classes declarations before raw.collect

inductive Steps (classes : Classes) (declarations : Declarations) : Configuration → Configuration → Prop where
  | refl (configuration : Configuration) : Steps classes declarations configuration configuration
  | step {before middle after} :
      Step classes declarations before middle → Steps classes declarations middle after →
      Steps classes declarations before after

def Stuck (classes : Classes) (declarations : Declarations) (configuration : Configuration) : Prop :=
  ¬ configuration.finished ∧ ¬ ∃ after, Step classes declarations configuration after

theorem finished_no_step (finished : configuration.finished) :
    ¬ Step classes declarations configuration after := by
  intro step
  cases step with
  | collect raw => cases raw <;> simp_all [Configuration.finished, Configuration.running]

theorem terminal_heap_empty (step : Step classes declarations before after)
    (finished : after.finished) : after.objects = [] := by
  cases step with
  | collect raw =>
    cases raw <;> simp_all [Configuration.finished, Configuration.running,
      Configuration.collect_frames, Configuration.collect_empty_frames]

theorem Steps.trans (first : Steps classes declarations before middle)
    (second : Steps classes declarations middle after) : Steps classes declarations before after := by
  induction first with
  | refl => exact second
  | step step _ ih => exact .step step (ih second)

end Dada.Assignment

attribute [simp] Dada.Assignment.Configuration.collect_frames
  Dada.Assignment.Configuration.collect_nextId Dada.Assignment.no_roots_not_live
  Dada.Assignment.Configuration.collect_empty_frames Dada.Assignment.Configuration.collect_empty_heap

end

namespace Dada.Assignment
open Shared Shared.Typing

-- A stable typing constraint, not an ABI: given/shared have the same layout
-- for a given nominal type, but this layer conservatively fixes permission too.
abbrev StorageType := FieldType

def storageType (ty : ValueType) : StorageType := ⟨ty.permission, ty.base⟩
def layoutKey (ty : StorageType) : ClassName := ty.className

structure Context where
  bindings : List (VariableId × StorageType)
  current : Environment
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

def Context.WellFormed (context : Context) (classes : ClassTable) : Prop :=
  context.current.WellFormed classes ∧
  context.bindings.map Prod.fst = context.current.map Prod.fst ∧
  (∀ entry ∈ context.bindings, Admissible classes entry.2.toType) ∧
  (∀ entry ∈ context.current, ∀ ty ∈ entry.2,
    context.bindings.lookup entry.1 = some (storageType ty))

instance (context : Context) (classes : ClassTable) : Decidable (context.WellFormed classes) := by
  unfold Context.WellFormed
  infer_instance

def Context.empty : Context := ⟨[],[]⟩
def Context.withCurrent (context : Context) (current : Environment) : Context :=
  { context with current := current }

def replaceable (classes : ClassTable) : SlotDescription → Bool
  | none => true
  | some ty => decide (StructType classes ty)

-- Expand only the overwritten path. Keep siblings, replace the entire target
-- subtree with the incoming view, and normalize; negatives are not positives.
def replaceView (classes : ClassTable) (source incoming : ValueType) (path : Path) : ValueType :=
  let retained := source.nominal.entries.flatMap fun entry =>
    if path.isPrefixOf entry.path then []
    else match entry with
    | .negative _ => [entry]
    | .positive initialPath =>
      if initialPath.isPrefixOf path then
        match Unique.Typing.classAt classes.nominal source.base initialPath with
        | none => []
        | some target =>
          (Unique.Typing.remainingAfterMove classes.nominal target (path.drop initialPath.length)).map
            (Unique.Typing.Entry.prepend initialPath)
      else [entry]
  normalize classes ⟨source.permission, ⟨source.base,
    retained ++ incoming.nominal.entries.map (Unique.Typing.Entry.prepend path)⟩⟩

-- This is applied after RHS evaluation. An ancestor moved by that evaluation
-- is no longer available as the parent of a field destination.
def storeCurrent (classes : ClassTable) (context : Context) (place : Place) (incoming : ValueType) : Option Environment := do
  if !decide (context.WellFormed classes) || !decide (Admissible classes incoming) then none else do
    let (root,path) := splitPlace place
    let fixed ← context.bindings.lookup root
    let slot ← context.current.lookup root
    let result ← if path.isEmpty then do
      if storageType incoming != fixed || !replaceable classes slot then none
      else some (context.current.replace root (some incoming))
    else do
      let source ← slot
      let parentPath := path.take (path.length - 1)
      let field ← path.getLast?
      let parent ← focus classes source parentPath
      if parent.permission != .given then none else do
        let declaration ← classes.lookup parent.base
        let fieldType ← declaration.fields.lookup field
        let previous ← fieldDescription classes parent field
        if storageType incoming != fieldType || !replaceable classes previous then none
        else some (context.current.replace root (some (replaceView classes source incoming path)))
    some result

def store (classes : ClassTable) (context : Context) (place : Place)
    (incoming : ValueType) : Option Context := do
  let current ← storeCurrent classes context place incoming
  let after := context.withCurrent current
  if decide (after.WellFormed classes) then some after else none

theorem store_preserves_bindings (stored : store classes before place ty = some after) :
    after.bindings = before.bindings := by
  unfold store at stored
  cases h : storeCurrent classes before place ty <;> simp [h] at stored
  rw [← stored.2]
  rfl

theorem store_wellFormed (stored : store classes before place ty = some after) :
    after.WellFormed classes := by
  unfold store at stored
  cases h : storeCurrent classes before place ty <;> simp [h] at stored
  exact stored.2 ▸ stored.1

end Dada.Assignment

-- Assemble the local environment and all pending roots after a field update.
-- The displaced struct is retained as garbage until the statement collects it.
theorem store_field_preserves_core
    {classes : ClassTable} {environment : Environment} {state result : State}
    {incoming sourceReference : Reference} {ty replacement : ValueType}
    {pending : PendingValues} {root : VariableId} {parent : ObjectId} {field : FieldName}
    {place : Place} {previous : Slot}
    (realized : Realizes classes environment state ((incoming, ty) :: pending))
    (sourceStored : (root, some sourceReference) ∈ state.variables)
    (afterWf : (environment.replace root (some replacement)).WellFormed classes)
    (writable : Writable state place (.field parent field) previous)
    (written : Write state (.field parent field) incoming result)
    (fields : FieldsMatchClasses classes result)
    (sourceAfter : Satisfies classes result sourceReference replacement)
    (otherAfter : ∀ name reference view, name ≠ root →
      (name, some reference) ∈ state.variables →
      Satisfies classes state reference view → Satisfies classes result reference view)
    (pendingAfter : ∀ reference view, (reference, view) ∈ pending →
      Satisfies classes result reference view)
    (displacedTypes : ∀ reference, previous = some reference →
      ∃ view, Admissible classes view ∧ StructType classes view ∧
        Satisfies classes state reference view)
    (displacedAfter : ∀ reference view, previous = some reference →
      Satisfies classes state reference view → Satisfies classes result reference view) :
    ∃ garbage, (∀ reference view, (reference, view) ∈ garbage → StructType classes view) ∧
      Realizes classes (environment.replace root (some replacement)) result (pending ++ garbage) := by
  obtain ⟨garbage, roots, structs, types, values⟩ :
      ∃ garbage : PendingValues,
        garbage.map Prod.fst = previous.toList ∧
        (∀ reference view, (reference, view) ∈ garbage → StructType classes view) ∧
        (∀ reference view, (reference, view) ∈ garbage → Admissible classes view) ∧
        (∀ reference view, (reference, view) ∈ garbage → Satisfies classes result reference view) := by
    cases previous with
    | none => exact ⟨[], rfl, by simp, by simp, by simp⟩
    | some previous =>
      obtain ⟨view, admissible, structTy, satisfied⟩ := displacedTypes previous rfl
      refine ⟨[(previous, view)], rfl, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro reference ty member
        have equal : (reference, ty) = (previous, view) := by simpa using member
        cases equal
        exact structTy
      · intro reference ty member
        have equal : (reference, ty) = (previous, view) := by simpa using member
        cases equal
        exact admissible
      · intro reference ty member
        have equal : (reference, ty) = (previous, view) := by simpa using member
        cases equal
        exact displacedAfter previous view rfl satisfied
  refine ⟨garbage, structs, ?_⟩
  have ownership := written.preserves_pending realized.ownership writable
  constructor
  · exact realized.classesWellFormed
  · exact afterWf
  · intro reference view member
    rcases List.mem_append.mp member with member | member
    · exact realized.pendingTypes reference view (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ member)
    · exact types reference view member
  · simpa only [List.map_append, roots] using ownership.perm List.perm_append_comm
  · exact fields
  · intro name
    rw [Environment.replace_keys, written.variableKeys]
    exact realized.variableDomain name
  · intro name member
    rcases Environment.replace_member member with ⟨_, impossible⟩ | ⟨_, old⟩
    · cases impossible
    · exact written.stored_unchanged (place := .variable name) (by simp)
        (realized.emptyVariables name old)
  · intro name view member
    rcases Environment.replace_member member with ⟨rfl, same⟩ | ⟨different, old⟩
    · cases same
      exact ⟨sourceReference, written.stored_unchanged (place := .variable name) (by simp) sourceStored,
        sourceAfter⟩
    · obtain ⟨reference, stored, satisfied⟩ := realized.initializedVariables name view old
      exact ⟨reference, written.stored_unchanged (place := .variable name) (by simp) stored,
        otherAfter name reference view different stored satisfied⟩
  · intro reference view member
    rcases List.mem_append.mp member with member | member
    · exact pendingAfter reference view member
    · exact values reference view member

theorem store_field_preserves
    {classes : ClassTable} {environment : Environment} {state result : State}
    {incoming sourceReference : Reference} {ty sourceType parentType : ValueType}
    {pending : PendingValues} {root : VariableId} {parent : ObjectId} {field : FieldName}
    {place : Place} {previous : Slot} {cutPath : Path}
    {declaration : TypedClass} {fieldType : FieldType}
    (realized : Realizes classes environment state ((incoming, ty) :: pending))
    (sourceMember : (root, some sourceType) ∈ environment)
    (sourceStored : (root, some sourceReference) ∈ state.variables)
    (focused : focus classes sourceType cutPath = some parentType)
    (parentGiven : parentType.permission = .given)
    (parentSatisfied : Satisfies classes state (.owned parent) parentType)
    (declared : classes.lookup parentType.base = some declaration)
    (fieldDeclared : declaration.fields.lookup field = some fieldType)
    (sameType : storageType ty = fieldType)
    (afterWf : (environment.replace root
      (some (replaceView classes sourceType ty (cutPath ++ [field])))).WellFormed classes)
    (writable : Writable state place (.field parent field) previous)
    (written : Write state (.field parent field) incoming result)
    (cut : Route state (incoming :: pending.map Prod.fst) (.variable root) cutPath (.owned parent))
    (replaceable : Replaceable classes.erase state previous) :
    ∃ garbage, (∀ reference view, (reference, view) ∈ garbage → StructType classes view) ∧
      Realizes classes (environment.replace root
        (some (replaceView classes sourceType ty (cutPath ++ [field])))) result (pending ++ garbage) := by
  have beforeWF := realized.ownership
  have afterWF := written.preserves_pending beforeWF writable
  have incomingSatisfied := realized.pendingValues incoming ty (by simp)
  obtain ⟨sourceRef, atSource, sourceSatisfied⟩ := realized.initializedVariables root sourceType sourceMember
  have sameSource := Option.some.inj (member_value_unique beforeWF.variableKeys atSource sourceStored)
  subst sourceRef
  have normal := (Environment.admissible realized.environmentWellFormed sourceMember).2
  have facts := storePathFacts realized.classesWellFormed normal focused parentGiven declared fieldDeclared sameType
  have incomingAfter := write_satisfies_incoming beforeWF afterWF written cut (by simp) incomingSatisfied
  have sourceAfter : Satisfies classes result sourceReference
      (replaceView classes sourceType ty (cutPath ++ [field])) := by
    apply satisfies_replaceView realized.classesWellFormed facts (by simp) sourceSatisfied incomingAfter
      afterWF written.old_object_data
    · intro path slot outside read
      exact (write_readPath_outside beforeWF afterWF written cut sourceStored outside).trans read
    · intro path reference outside read
      exact (write_readPath_outside beforeWF afterWF written cut sourceStored outside).symm.trans read
    · exact write_readPath_installed beforeWF afterWF written cut sourceStored
  apply store_field_preserves_core realized sourceStored afterWf writable written
    (fieldsMatchClasses_write_field beforeWF realized.fields written parentSatisfied incomingSatisfied
      declared fieldDeclared sameType) sourceAfter
  · intro name reference view different member satisfied
    exact write_satisfies_other_variable beforeWF afterWF written cut member different satisfied
  · intro reference view member
    have inPending : reference ∈ pending.map Prod.fst := List.mem_map.mpr ⟨(reference, view), member, rfl⟩
    exact write_satisfies_pending beforeWF afterWF written cut (by simp [inPending])
      (List.mem_append_right _ inPending) (realized.pendingValues reference view (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ member))
  · intro reference same
    have stored : Stored state (.field parent field) (some reference) := same ▸ writable.stored
    obtain ⟨data, dataStored, fieldStored⟩ := stored
    exact field_garbage_type realized parentSatisfied dataStored fieldStored declared fieldDeclared
      (same ▸ replaceable)
  · intro reference view same satisfied
    have stored : Stored state (.field parent field) (some reference) := same ▸ writable.stored
    exact write_satisfies_displaced beforeWF afterWF written cut stored (by simp [same]) satisfied

end Dada.Assignment

theorem fieldsMatchClasses_write_variable
    (fields : FieldsMatchClasses classes before)
    (written : Write before (.variable name) incoming after) :
    FieldsMatchClasses classes after := by
  cases written
  exact fields

theorem fieldsMatchClasses_write_field
    {classes : ClassTable} {before after : State} {pending : List Reference}
    {parent : ObjectId} {name : FieldName} {incoming : Reference}
    {parentType incomingType : ValueType} {declaration : TypedClass} {fieldType : FieldType}
    (wf : WellFormedWith classes.erase before pending)
    (fields : FieldsMatchClasses classes before)
    (written : Write before (.field parent name) incoming after)
    (parentSatisfied : Satisfies classes before (.owned parent) parentType)
    (incomingSatisfied : Satisfies classes before incoming incomingType)
    (declared : classes.lookup parentType.base = some declaration)
    (fieldDeclared : declaration.fields.lookup name = some fieldType)
    (sameType : storageType incomingType = fieldType) :
    FieldsMatchClasses classes after := by
  have transfer : ∀ object data field child, (object, data) ∈ before.objects →
      (field, some child) ∈ data.fields →
      ∃ decl type childData,
        (data.className, decl) ∈ classes ∧ (field, type) ∈ decl.fields ∧
        (child.object, childData) ∈ after.objects ∧ childData.className = type.className := by
    intro object data field child stored fieldStored
    obtain ⟨decl, type, childData, declMember, fieldMember, childMember, same⟩ :=
      fields object data field child stored fieldStored
    obtain ⟨newData, newMember, newClass⟩ := written.old_object_data _ _ childMember
    exact ⟨decl, type, newData, declMember, fieldMember, newMember, newClass.trans same⟩
  obtain ⟨parentData, parentStored, parentNamed⟩ := parentSatisfied.root
  obtain ⟨incomingData, incomingStored, incomingNamed⟩ := incomingSatisfied.root
  obtain ⟨newIncomingData, newIncomingStored, sameIncoming⟩ :=
    written.old_object_data _ _ incomingStored
  have correctIncoming : newIncomingData.className = fieldType.className := by
    have sameClass := congrArg FieldType.className sameType
    exact sameIncoming.trans (incomingNamed.trans sameClass)
  cases written with
  | field variables nextId leading trailing parent className beforeFields afterFields name previous incoming =>
    have actualParent : (parent, (⟨className, beforeFields ++ (name, previous) :: afterFields⟩ : Object)) ∈
        (leading ++ (parent, ⟨className, beforeFields ++ (name, previous) :: afterFields⟩) :: trailing) := by simp
    have parentEq := member_value_unique wf.objectKeys parentStored actualParent
    have sameParent : className = parentType.base := by simpa only [parentEq, ValueType.base] using parentNamed
    have declaredMember : (className, declaration) ∈ classes := sameParent ▸ lookup_member declared
    intro object data field child stored fieldStored
    simp only [List.mem_append, List.mem_cons] at stored
    rcases stored with earlier | same | later
    · exact transfer object data field child (List.mem_append_left _ earlier) fieldStored
    · cases same
      simp only [List.mem_append, List.mem_cons] at fieldStored
      rcases fieldStored with earlier | same | later
      · exact transfer parent ⟨className, beforeFields ++ (name, previous) :: afterFields⟩ field child actualParent (List.mem_append_left _ earlier)
      · cases same
        exact ⟨declaration, fieldType, newIncomingData, declaredMember, lookup_member fieldDeclared,
          newIncomingStored, correctIncoming⟩
      · exact transfer parent ⟨className, beforeFields ++ (name, previous) :: afterFields⟩ field child actualParent (List.mem_append_right _ (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ later))
    · exact transfer object data field child (List.mem_append_right _ (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ later)) fieldStored

end Dada.Assignment

namespace Dada.Assignment
open Shared Shared.Typing

-- The displaced struct needs a type while it is a temporary GC root. Its
-- nominal identity and permission suffice; none of its fields remain visible.
private def garbageType (field : FieldType) (declaration : TypedClass) : ValueType :=
  ⟨field.permission,
    if declaration.fields.isEmpty then .whole field.className else ⟨field.className, []⟩⟩

private theorem garbageType_permission (field : FieldType) (declaration : TypedClass) :
    (garbageType field declaration).permission = field.permission := rfl

private theorem garbageType_base (field : FieldType) (declaration : TypedClass) :
    (garbageType field declaration).base = field.className := by
  unfold garbageType ValueType.base
  split <;> rfl

private theorem garbageType_admissible
    (declared : classes.lookup field.className = some declaration)
    (kind : KindValid classes field.toType) :
    Admissible classes (garbageType field declaration) := by
  have nominalDeclared := ClassTable.nominal_lookup classes field.className
  rw [declared] at nominalDeclared
  simp only [Option.map_some] at nominalDeclared
  constructor
  · constructor
    · unfold garbageType
      split <;> simp [Unique.Typing.ViewType.WellFormed,
        Unique.Typing.ViewType.whole, Unique.Typing.Entry.valid,
        Unique.Typing.Entry.path, Unique.Typing.classAt,
        Unique.Typing.entriesDisjoint, nominalDeclared]
    · unfold KindValid
      rw [garbageType_base, garbageType_permission]
      exact kind
  · unfold Normalized Unique.Typing.Normalized garbageType
    split
    · exact Unique.Typing.normalize_whole _ _
    next nonempty =>
      cases fieldsEq : declaration.fields with
      | nil => simp [fieldsEq] at nonempty
      | cons first rest =>
        have flatEmpty (values : List (FieldName × ClassName)) :
            values.flatMap (fun _ => ([] : List Entry)) = [] :=
          List.flatMap_eq_nil_iff.mpr (by simp)
        simp [Unique.Typing.normalize, Unique.Typing.normalizeEntries,
          nominalDeclared, flatEmpty, fieldsEq]

private theorem garbageType_positive
    (declared : classes.lookup field.className = some declaration)
    (positive : Pos classes (garbageType field declaration) path) : path = [] := by
  unfold Pos Unique.Typing.Pos Unique.Typing.positive garbageType at positive
  split at positive
  next empty =>
    have empty := List.isEmpty_iff.mp empty
    cases path with
    | nil => rfl
    | cons name rest =>
      simp [Unique.Typing.ViewType.whole, Unique.Typing.classAt,
        ClassTable.nominal_lookup, declared, empty] at positive
  next =>
    simpa using (Bool.and_eq_true_iff.mp positive).2

private theorem garbageType_negative
    (negative : Shared.Typing.Neg (garbageType field declaration) path) : False := by
  unfold Shared.Typing.Neg Unique.Typing.Neg Unique.Typing.negative garbageType at negative
  split at negative <;> simp [Unique.Typing.ViewType.whole] at negative

theorem field_garbage_type
    (realized : Realizes classes environment state pending)
    (satisfied : Satisfies classes state (.owned parent) parentTy)
    (dataStored : (parent, data) ∈ state.objects)
    (fieldStored : (name, some previous) ∈ data.fields)
    (declared : classes.lookup parentTy.base = some declaration)
    (fieldDeclared : declaration.fields.lookup name = some fieldType)
    (replaceable : Replaceable classes.erase state (some previous)) :
    ∃ previousTy, Admissible classes previousTy ∧ StructType classes previousTy ∧
      Satisfies classes state previous previousTy := by
  obtain ⟨rootData, rootStored, rootClass⟩ := satisfied.root
  have sameData : rootData = data :=
    member_value_unique realized.ownership.objectKeys rootStored dataStored
  subst rootData
  change data.className = parentTy.base at rootClass
  obtain ⟨actualDeclaration, actualField, childData, actualDeclared, actualFieldDeclared,
    childStored, childClass⟩ := realized.fields _ _ _ _ dataStored fieldStored
  have sameDeclaration : actualDeclaration = declaration :=
    member_value_unique realized.classesWellFormed.1
      (rootClass ▸ actualDeclared) (lookup_member declared)
  subst actualDeclaration
  have sameField : actualField = fieldType :=
    member_value_unique (realized.classesWellFormed.2 _ (lookup_member declared)).1
      actualFieldDeclared (lookup_member fieldDeclared)
  subst actualField
  have fieldWellFormed := (realized.classesWellFormed.2 _ (lookup_member declared)).2
    _ (lookup_member fieldDeclared)
  obtain ⟨⟨childName, childDeclaration⟩, childDeclared, childNameEq⟩ :=
    List.mem_map.mp fieldWellFormed.1
  dsimp at childNameEq
  subst childName
  have childLookup := lookup_of_member realized.classesWellFormed.1 childDeclared
  have childType := garbageType_admissible childLookup fieldWellFormed.2.1
  have parentGiven : parentTy.permission = .given := by
    have mode := satisfied.mode
    cases permEq : parentTy.permission <;> simp_all [Perm.toMode, Reference.owned]
  have read : readPath state (.owned parent) [name] = some (some previous) := by
    have dataLookup := lookup_of_member realized.ownership.objectKeys dataStored
    obtain ⟨_, _, shape, fieldsDistinct⟩ := realized.ownership.shapes _ _ dataStored
    have fieldLookup := lookup_of_member (shape ▸ fieldsDistinct) fieldStored
    simp [readPath, dataLookup, fieldLookup, Reference.owned]
  have fieldPermission : declaredPermission classes parentTy.base [name] =
      some fieldType.permission := by
    simp [declaredPermission, declared, fieldDeclared, Perm.comp_given_right]
  have childMode : previous.mode = fieldType.permission.toMode := by
    simpa [parentGiven, Perm.comp_given_left] using
      satisfied.modes [name] previous fieldType.permission fieldPermission read
  refine ⟨garbageType fieldType childDeclaration, childType, ?_, ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨structData, structDeclaration, structStored, structDeclared, structKind⟩ := replaceable
    have sameStructData : structData = childData :=
      member_value_unique realized.ownership.objectKeys structStored childStored
    subst structData
    have erasedDeclared : (childData.className,
        ⟨childDeclaration.fields.map Prod.fst, childDeclaration.kind⟩) ∈ classes.erase :=
      List.mem_map.mpr ⟨(fieldType.className, childDeclaration), childDeclared,
        by simp [childClass]⟩
    have sameStructDeclaration : structDeclaration =
        ⟨childDeclaration.fields.map Prod.fst, childDeclaration.kind⟩ :=
      member_value_unique realized.classesWellFormed.erase.1 structDeclared erasedDeclared
    unfold StructType
    rw [garbageType_base, childLookup]
    simpa [sameStructDeclaration] using structKind
  · constructor
    · exact childMode
    · refine ⟨childData, childStored, ?_⟩
      change childData.className = (garbageType fieldType childDeclaration).base
      rw [garbageType_base]
      exact childClass
    · intro path positive
      have empty := garbageType_positive childLookup positive
      subst path
      refine ⟨previous, childData, ?_, childStored, ?_⟩
      · simp [readPath, lookup_of_member realized.ownership.objectKeys childStored]
      · change some (garbageType fieldType childDeclaration).base = some childData.className
        rw [garbageType_base, childClass]
    · intro path negative
      exact False.elim (garbageType_negative negative)
    · intro path target permission permissionDeclared tailRead
      have completeDeclared : declaredPermission classes parentTy.base ([name] ++ path) =
          some (fieldType.permission.comp permission) := by
        change declaredPermission classes (garbageType fieldType childDeclaration).base path =
          some permission at permissionDeclared
        rw [garbageType_base] at permissionDeclared
        simp [declaredPermission, declared, fieldDeclared, permissionDeclared]
      have completeRead := (readPath_append realized.ownership read path).trans tailRead
      simpa [parentGiven, Perm.comp_given_left, garbageType_permission] using
        satisfied.modes ([name] ++ path) target _ completeDeclared completeRead

end Dada.Assignment

theorem Write.variable_objects (written : Write before (.variable name) incoming after) :
    before.objects = after.objects := by
  cases written
  rfl

-- Replacing a local changes no heap paths. Its old struct reference remains a
-- temporary root until the statement's collection step discards that root.
theorem store_local_preserves {environment : Environment} {previous : Slot}
    (realized : Realizes classes environment state ((incoming, ty) :: pending))
    (found : environment.lookup name = some description)
    (permitted : replaceable classes description = true)
    (afterWf : (environment.replace name (some ty)).WellFormed classes)
    (writable : Writable state (.variable name) (.variable name) previous)
    (written : Write state (.variable name) incoming result) :
    ∃ garbage, (∀ reference view, (reference, view) ∈ garbage → StructType classes view) ∧
      Realizes classes (environment.replace name (some ty)) result (pending ++ garbage) := by
  have atDescription := Environment.lookup_member found
  obtain ⟨garbage, roots, structs, types, values⟩ :
      ∃ garbage : PendingValues,
        garbage.map Prod.fst = previous.toList ∧
        (∀ reference view, (reference, view) ∈ garbage → StructType classes view) ∧
        (∀ reference view, (reference, view) ∈ garbage → Admissible classes view) ∧
        (∀ reference view, (reference, view) ∈ garbage → Satisfies classes state reference view) := by
    cases description with
    | none =>
      have empty := realized.emptyVariables name atDescription
      have same := stored_value_unique realized.ownership writable.stored
        (show Stored state (.variable name) none from empty)
      subst previous
      exact ⟨[], rfl, by simp, by simp, by simp⟩
    | some oldType =>
      obtain ⟨oldReference, stored, satisfied⟩ := realized.initializedVariables name oldType atDescription
      have same := stored_value_unique realized.ownership writable.stored
        (show Stored state (.variable name) (some oldReference) from stored)
      subst previous
      refine ⟨[(oldReference, oldType)], rfl, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro reference view member
        have equal : (reference, view) = (oldReference, oldType) := by simpa using member
        cases equal
        simpa [replaceable] using permitted
      · intro reference view member
        have equal : (reference, view) = (oldReference, oldType) := by simpa using member
        cases equal
        exact Environment.admissible realized.environmentWellFormed atDescription
      · intro reference view member
        have equal : (reference, view) = (oldReference, oldType) := by simpa using member
        cases equal
        exact satisfied
  refine ⟨garbage, structs, ?_⟩
  have sameObjects := written.variable_objects
  have ownership := written.preserves_pending realized.ownership writable
  constructor
  · exact realized.classesWellFormed
  · exact afterWf
  · intro reference view member
    rcases List.mem_append.mp member with member | member
    · exact realized.pendingTypes reference view (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ member)
    · exact types reference view member
  · simpa only [List.map_append, roots] using ownership.perm List.perm_append_comm
  · intro parent data field target stored atField
    obtain ⟨declaration, fieldType, targetData, declared, declaredField, targetStored, correct⟩ :=
      realized.fields parent data field target (sameObjects ▸ stored) atField
    exact ⟨declaration, fieldType, targetData, declared, declaredField, sameObjects ▸ targetStored, correct⟩
  · intro localName
    rw [Environment.replace_keys, written.variableKeys]
    exact realized.variableDomain localName
  · intro localName member
    rcases Environment.replace_member member with ⟨_, impossible⟩ | ⟨different, old⟩
    · cases impossible
    · exact written.stored_unchanged (place := .variable localName)
        (by intro same; exact different (StoragePlace.variable.inj same))
        (realized.emptyVariables localName old)
  · intro localName view member
    rcases Environment.replace_member member with ⟨rfl, same⟩ | ⟨different, old⟩
    · cases same
      exact ⟨incoming, written.installed,
        (realized.pendingValues incoming ty (List.mem_cons_self ..)).same_objects sameObjects⟩
    · obtain ⟨reference, stored, satisfied⟩ := realized.initializedVariables localName view old
      exact ⟨reference, written.stored_unchanged (place := .variable localName)
        (by intro same; exact different (StoragePlace.variable.inj same)) stored,
        satisfied.same_objects sameObjects⟩
  · intro reference view member
    rcases List.mem_append.mp member with member | member
    · exact (realized.pendingValues reference view (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ member)).same_objects sameObjects
    · exact (values reference view member).same_objects sameObjects

end Dada.Assignment

inductive StoreFacts (classes : ClassTable) (before : Context) (incoming : ValueType)
    (after : Context) : Place → Prop where
  | variable {name fixed previous} :
      before.bindings.lookup name = some fixed →
      before.current.lookup name = some previous →
      storageType incoming = fixed → replaceable classes previous = true →
      after = before.withCurrent (before.current.replace name (some incoming)) →
      StoreFacts classes before incoming after (.variable name)
  | field {base name fixed source parent declaration fieldType previous} :
      before.bindings.lookup (splitPlace base).1 = some fixed →
      before.current.lookup (splitPlace base).1 = some (some source) →
      focus classes source (splitPlace base).2 = some parent →
      parent.permission = .given →
      classes.lookup parent.base = some declaration →
      declaration.fields.lookup name = some fieldType →
      fieldDescription classes parent name = some previous →
      storageType incoming = fieldType → replaceable classes previous = true →
      after = before.withCurrent (before.current.replace (splitPlace base).1
        (some (replaceView classes source incoming ((splitPlace base).2 ++ [name])))) →
      StoreFacts classes before incoming after (.field base name)

theorem store_facts (stored : store classes before place incoming = some after) :
    before.WellFormed classes ∧ Admissible classes incoming ∧
      StoreFacts classes before incoming after place := by
  unfold store at stored
  obtain ⟨current, updated, checked⟩ := Option.bind_eq_some_iff.mp stored
  simp only [decide_eq_true_eq] at checked
  split at checked <;> simp_all only [Option.some.injEq, reduceCtorEq]
  subst after
  unfold storeCurrent at updated
  split at updated
  · contradiction
  next accepted =>
    have wf : before.WellFormed classes ∧ Admissible classes incoming := by simpa using accepted
    refine ⟨wf.1, wf.2, ?_⟩
    cases place with
    | «variable» name =>
      simp only [splitPlace, List.isEmpty_nil, ↓reduceIte] at updated
      obtain ⟨fixed, declared, rest⟩ := Option.bind_eq_some_iff.mp updated
      obtain ⟨previous, found, rest⟩ := Option.bind_eq_some_iff.mp rest
      split at rest
      · simp at rest
      next permitted =>
        have conditions : storageType incoming = fixed ∧ replaceable classes previous = true := by
          simpa using permitted
        change some (before.current.replace name (some incoming)) = some current at rest
        injection rest with equal
        subst current
        exact .variable declared found conditions.1 conditions.2 rfl
    | field base name =>
      have nonempty : ((splitPlace base).2 ++ [name]).isEmpty = false := by simp
      simp only [splitPlace, List.length_append, List.length_singleton, Nat.add_sub_cancel,
        List.take_left, List.getLast?_append, List.getLast?_singleton,
        Option.some_or, nonempty, Bool.false_eq_true,
        ↓reduceIte] at updated
      obtain ⟨fixed, declared, afterFixed⟩ := Option.bind_eq_some_iff.mp updated
      obtain ⟨slot, found, afterSlot⟩ := Option.bind_eq_some_iff.mp afterFixed
      obtain ⟨source, present, afterSource⟩ := Option.bind_eq_some_iff.mp afterSlot
      rw [present] at found
      dsimp only [Bind.bind, Option.bind] at afterSource
      obtain ⟨parent, focused, rest⟩ := Option.bind_eq_some_iff.mp afterSource
      split at rest
      · simp at rest
      next unique =>
        have unique : parent.permission = .given := by simpa using unique
        obtain ⟨declaration, parentDeclared, rest⟩ := Option.bind_eq_some_iff.mp rest
        obtain ⟨fieldType, fieldDeclared, rest⟩ := Option.bind_eq_some_iff.mp rest
        obtain ⟨previous, described, rest⟩ := Option.bind_eq_some_iff.mp rest
        split at rest
        · simp at rest
        next permitted =>
          have conditions : storageType incoming = fieldType ∧ replaceable classes previous = true := by
            simpa using permitted
          change some (before.current.replace (splitPlace base).1
            (some (replaceView classes source incoming ((splitPlace base).2 ++ [name])))) = some current at rest
          injection rest with equal
          subst current
          exact .field declared found focused unique parentDeclared fieldDeclared described
            conditions.1 conditions.2 rfl

theorem write_exists (stored : Stored state target previous) (incoming : Reference) :
    ∃ result, Write state target incoming result := by
  rcases state with ⟨objects, variables, nextId⟩
  cases target with
  | «variable» name =>
    obtain ⟨leading, suffix, equality⟩ := List.mem_iff_append.mp stored
    dsimp at equality
    subst variables
    exact ⟨_, .variable ..⟩
  | field parent name =>
    obtain ⟨⟨className, fields⟩, objectStored, fieldStored⟩ := stored
    obtain ⟨before, after, equality⟩ := List.mem_iff_append.mp objectStored
    obtain ⟨leading, suffix, fieldsEquality⟩ := List.mem_iff_append.mp fieldStored
    dsimp at equality fieldsEquality
    subst objects fields
    exact ⟨_, .field ..⟩

theorem slot_replaceable (matched : SlotMatches classes state slot description)
    (permitted : replaceable classes description = true) :
    Replaceable classes.erase state slot := by
  cases slot <;> cases description <;> try contradiction
  · trivial
  · exact Destructors.Satisfies_struct matched (by simpa [replaceable] using permitted)

private theorem focus_class (focused : focus classes ty path = some result) :
    Unique.Typing.classAt classes.nominal ty.base path = some result.base := by
  have nominal := focus_nominal focused
  unfold Unique.Typing.focus at nominal
  split at nominal
  · contradiction
  dsimp only at nominal
  split at nominal
  · contradiction
  obtain ⟨target, atClass, rest⟩ := Option.bind_eq_some_iff.mp nominal
  change Unique.Typing.classAt classes.nominal ty.base path = some target at atClass
  split at rest
  next empty =>
    have empty := List.isEmpty_iff.mp empty
    subst path
    injection rest with equal
    simpa [ValueType.base, Unique.Typing.classAt, Unique.Typing.normalize_className] using
      congrArg (fun t : Unique.Typing.ViewType => some t.className) equal
  next =>
    split at rest <;> injection rest with equal <;>
      simpa [ValueType.base, ← equal, Unique.Typing.ViewType.whole,
        Unique.Typing.normalize_className] using atClass

private theorem focus_field_class (declared : classes.lookup ty.base = some declaration)
    (fieldDeclared : declaration.fields.lookup field = some fieldType)
    (focused : focus classes ty [field] = some child) : child.base = fieldType.className := by
  have atClass := focus_class focused
  simpa [Unique.Typing.classAt, ClassTable.nominal_lookup,
    nominal_field_lookup, declared, fieldDeclared] using atClass.symm

private theorem field_replaceable
    (realized : Realizes classes environment state pending)
    (satisfied : Satisfies classes state reference ty)
    (unique : reference.mode = .unique)
    (dataStored : (reference.object, data) ∈ state.objects)
    (dataClass : data.className = ty.base)
    (fieldStored : (field, slot) ∈ data.fields)
    (declared : classes.lookup ty.base = some declaration)
    (fieldDeclared : declaration.fields.lookup field = some fieldType)
    (described : fieldDescription classes ty field = some description)
    (permitted : replaceable classes description = true) :
    Replaceable classes.erase state slot := by
  cases slot with
  | none => trivial
  | some child =>
    have read : readPath state reference [field] = some (some child) := by
      have dataLookup := lookup_of_member realized.ownership.objectKeys dataStored
      obtain ⟨_, _, shape, fieldsDistinct⟩ := realized.ownership.shapes _ _ dataStored
      have fieldLookup := lookup_of_member (shape ▸ fieldsDistinct) fieldStored
      simp [readPath, dataLookup, fieldLookup, unique]
    unfold fieldDescription at described
    split at described
    next empty =>
      have impossible := (satisfied.negative [field] empty).symm.trans read
      simp at impossible
    next occupied =>
      obtain ⟨previous, focused, same⟩ := Option.map_eq_some_iff.mp described
      subst description
      have structPrevious : StructType classes previous := by simpa [replaceable] using permitted
      have sameClass := focus_field_class declared fieldDeclared focused
      obtain ⟨actualDeclaration, actualField, childData, actualDeclared, actualFieldDeclared,
        childStored, childClass⟩ := realized.fields _ _ _ _ dataStored fieldStored
      have sameDeclaration : actualDeclaration = declaration :=
        member_value_unique realized.classesWellFormed.1
          (dataClass ▸ actualDeclared) (lookup_member declared)
      subst actualDeclaration
      have sameField : actualField = fieldType :=
        member_value_unique (realized.classesWellFormed.2 _ (lookup_member declared)).1
          actualFieldDeclared (lookup_member fieldDeclared)
      subst actualField
      obtain ⟨childDeclaration, childDeclared, kind⟩ := structPrevious.declaration
      refine ⟨childData, ⟨childDeclaration.fields.map Prod.fst, childDeclaration.kind⟩,
        childStored, ?_, kind⟩
      apply List.mem_map.mpr
      exact ⟨(previous.base, childDeclaration), lookup_member childDeclared,
        by simp [childClass, sameClass]⟩

theorem store_writable (stored : store classes before place incoming = some after)
    (realized : Realizes classes before.current state pending) :
    ∃ target previous, Writable state place target previous ∧
      Replaceable classes.erase state previous := by
  cases (store_facts stored).2.2 with
  | @«variable» name fixed previous _ found _ permitted _ =>
    have member := Environment.lookup_member found
    cases previous with
    | none => exact ⟨_, _, .variable (realized.emptyVariables _ member), trivial⟩
    | some ty =>
      obtain ⟨reference, stored, satisfied⟩ := realized.initializedVariables _ _ member
      exact ⟨_, _, .variable stored,
        slot_replaceable (description := some ty) satisfied permitted⟩
  | @field base name fixed source parent declaration fieldType previous
      _ found focused given declared fieldDeclared described _ permitted _ =>
    have member := Environment.lookup_member found
    have admissible := Environment.admissible realized.environmentWellFormed member
    obtain ⟨root, rootStored, sourceSatisfied⟩ := realized.initializedVariables _ _ member
    have observations := focus_observations realized.classesWellFormed admissible.2 focused
    obtain ⟨reference, _, read, _, _⟩ := sourceSatisfied.positive _ observations.positive
    have satisfied := sourceSatisfied.focus realized.classesWellFormed realized.ownership
      admissible.2 focused read
    have unique : reference.mode = .unique := by rw [satisfied.mode, given]; rfl
    obtain ⟨target, resolved⟩ := resolve_from_readPath rootStored read
    change Resolve state (placeFrom (splitPlace base).1 (splitPlace base).2) _ _ _ at resolved
    rw [placeFrom_splitPlace, unique] at resolved
    obtain ⟨data, dataStored, dataClass⟩ := satisfied.root
    change data.className = parent.base at dataClass
    obtain ⟨untypedDeclaration, untypedDeclared, shape, _⟩ := realized.ownership.shapes _ _ dataStored
    have erasedDeclared :
        (parent.base, ⟨declaration.fields.map Prod.fst, declaration.kind⟩) ∈ classes.erase :=
      List.mem_map.mpr ⟨(parent.base, declaration), lookup_member declared, rfl⟩
    have sameDeclaration : untypedDeclaration =
        ⟨declaration.fields.map Prod.fst, declaration.kind⟩ :=
      member_value_unique realized.classesWellFormed.erase.1
        (dataClass ▸ untypedDeclared) erasedDeclared
    have actualFields : data.fields.map Prod.fst = declaration.fields.map Prod.fst := by
      simpa [sameDeclaration] using shape
    have namePresent : name ∈ data.fields.map Prod.fst := by
      rw [actualFields]
      exact List.mem_map.mpr ⟨(name, fieldType), lookup_member fieldDeclared, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨⟨actual, slot⟩, fieldStored, equality⟩ := List.mem_map.mp namePresent
    dsimp at equality
    subst actual
    exact ⟨_, _, .field resolved dataStored fieldStored,
      field_replaceable realized satisfied unique dataStored dataClass fieldStored
        declared fieldDeclared described permitted⟩

theorem store_exists (stored : store classes before place ty = some after)
    (realized : Realizes classes before.current state ((incoming, ty) :: pending)) :
    ∃ target previous result, Writable state place target previous ∧
      Replaceable classes.erase state previous ∧ Write state target incoming result := by
  obtain ⟨target, previous, writable, replaceable⟩ := store_writable stored realized
  obtain ⟨result, written⟩ := write_exists writable.stored incoming
  exact ⟨target, previous, result, writable, replaceable, written⟩

end Dada.Assignment

-- A store exchanges the incoming pending owner with the displaced slot. The
-- latter, if present, is a struct root that the statement collector may discard.
theorem store_preserves
    (stored : store classes before place ty = some after)
    (realized : Realizes classes before.current state ((reference, ty) :: pending))
    (writable : Writable state place target previous)
    (replaceable : Replaceable classes.erase state previous)
    (written : Write state target reference result) :
    ∃ garbage, (∀ ref ty, (ref, ty) ∈ garbage → StructType classes ty) ∧
      Realizes classes after.current result (pending ++ garbage) := by
  have afterWf := (store_wellFormed stored).1
  cases (store_facts stored).2.2 with
  | @«variable» name fixed old _ found _ permitted afterEq =>
    subst after
    cases writable with
    | «variable» member =>
      exact store_local_preserves realized found permitted afterWf (.variable member) written
  | @field base name fixed source parentType declaration fieldType old
      _ found focused given declared fieldDeclared _ sameType _ afterEq =>
    subst after
    cases writable with
    | @field _ sourcePlace parent data _ previous resolved dataStored fieldStored =>
      have sourceMember := Environment.lookup_member found
      have admissible := Environment.admissible realized.environmentWellFormed sourceMember
      obtain ⟨rootRef, atRoot, sourceSatisfied⟩ := realized.initializedVariables _ _ sourceMember
      obtain ⟨actualRoot, actualStored, read⟩ := resolve_readPath realized.ownership resolved
      have sameRoot := Option.some.inj
        (member_value_unique realized.ownership.variableKeys actualStored atRoot)
      subst actualRoot
      have parentSatisfied : Satisfies classes state (.owned parent) parentType :=
        sourceSatisfied.focus realized.classesWellFormed realized.ownership admissible.2 focused read
      exact store_field_preserves realized sourceMember atRoot focused given parentSatisfied declared
        fieldDeclared sameType afterWf (.field resolved dataStored fieldStored) written
        (route_of_resolve resolved) replaceable

-- Both operational existence and preservation quantify over the ordinary
-- checker and runtime relations; no success condition is added to typing.
theorem store_sound
    {classes : ClassTable} {before after : Context} {place : Place}
    {ty : ValueType} {state : State} {reference : Reference} {pending : PendingValues}
    (stored : store classes before place ty = some after)
    (realized : Realizes classes before.current state ((reference, ty) :: pending)) :
    (∃ target previous result, Writable state place target previous ∧
      Replaceable classes.erase state previous ∧ Write state target reference result) ∧
    (∀ target previous result, Writable state place target previous →
      Replaceable classes.erase state previous → Write state target reference result →
      ∃ garbage, (∀ ref ty, (ref, ty) ∈ garbage → StructType classes ty) ∧
        Realizes classes after.current result (pending ++ garbage)) := by
  refine ⟨store_exists stored realized, ?_⟩
  intro target previous result writable replaceable written
  exact store_preserves stored realized writable replaceable written

end Dada.Assignment

namespace Dada.Assignment
open Shared Shared.Typing

-- Facts about the statically selected field, independent of any heap update.
structure StorePathFacts (classes : ClassTable) (source incoming : ValueType)
    (target : Path) : Prop where
  sourceGiven : source.permission = .given
  atClass : Unique.Typing.classAt classes.nominal source.base target = some incoming.base
  atPermission : declaredPermission classes source.base target = some incoming.permission
  properPositive : ∀ path, path <+: target → path.length < target.length → Pos classes source path

theorem storePathFacts {classes : ClassTable} (classesWF : classes.WellFormed)
    {source incoming parent : ValueType} {parentPath : Path} {field : FieldName}
    {declaration : TypedClass} {fieldType : FieldType}
    (normal : Normalized classes source)
    (focused : focus classes source parentPath = some parent)
    (givenParent : parent.permission = .given)
    (classFound : classes.lookup parent.base = some declaration)
    (fieldFound : declaration.fields.lookup field = some fieldType)
    (sameType : storageType incoming = fieldType) :
    StorePathFacts classes source incoming (parentPath ++ [field]) := by
  have observations := focus_observations classesWF normal focused
  obtain ⟨permission, declared, composed⟩ := focus_permission focused
  obtain ⟨sourceGiven, pathGiven⟩ := (Perm.comp_eq_given_iff _ _).mp (composed.symm.trans givenParent)
  have fieldClass : fieldType.className = incoming.base := by
    simpa [storageType] using (congrArg FieldType.className sameType).symm
  have fieldPerm : fieldType.permission = incoming.permission := by
    simpa [storageType] using (congrArg FieldType.permission sameType).symm
  have parentClass : Unique.Typing.classAt classes.nominal source.base parentPath = some parent.base := observations.className
  constructor
  · exact sourceGiven
  · rw [Unique.Typing.classAt_append, parentClass]
    simp [Unique.Typing.classAt, ClassTable.nominal_lookup, nominal_field_lookup,
      classFound, fieldFound, fieldClass]
  · rw [declaredPermission_append parentClass]
    simp [declared, pathGiven, declaredPermission, classFound, fieldFound,
      fieldPerm, Perm.comp_given_right, Perm.comp_given_left]
  · intro path pre short
    have parentPrefix : path <+: parentPath := by
      have length : path.length ≤ parentPath.length := by
        simp only [List.length_append, List.length_singleton] at short
        omega
      exact List.prefix_of_prefix_length_le pre (List.prefix_append _ _) length
    exact observations.positive.prefix parentPrefix

theorem StorePathFacts.classAt_append (facts : StorePathFacts classes source incoming target)
    (suffix : Path) :
    Unique.Typing.classAt classes.nominal source.base (target ++ suffix) =
      Unique.Typing.classAt classes.nominal incoming.base suffix := by
  rw [Unique.Typing.classAt_append, facts.atClass]
  rfl

theorem StorePathFacts.permission_append (facts : StorePathFacts classes source incoming target)
    (suffix : Path) :
    declaredPermission classes source.base (target ++ suffix) =
      (declaredPermission classes incoming.base suffix).map (incoming.permission.comp) := by
  rw [declaredPermission_append facts.atClass, facts.atPermission]
  cases declaredPermission classes incoming.base suffix <;> rfl

theorem satisfies_preserved
    {classes : ClassTable} {before after : State} {ty : ValueType} {reference : Reference}
    (satisfied : Satisfies classes before reference ty)
    (preserveClasses : ∀ object data, (object, data) ∈ before.objects →
      ∃ newData, (object, newData) ∈ after.objects ∧ newData.className = data.className)
    (forward : ∀ path slot,
      readPath before reference path = some slot → readPath after reference path = some slot)
    (backward : ∀ path reached,
      readPath after reference path = some (some reached) →
      readPath before reference path = some (some reached)) :
    Satisfies classes after reference ty := by
  constructor
  · exact satisfied.mode
  · obtain ⟨data, member, named⟩ := satisfied.root
    obtain ⟨newData, member, same⟩ := preserveClasses _ _ member
    exact ⟨newData, member, same.trans named⟩
  · intro path known
    obtain ⟨reached, data, read, member, named⟩ := satisfied.positive path known
    obtain ⟨newData, member, same⟩ := preserveClasses _ _ member
    exact ⟨reached, newData, forward path _ read, member, by simpa only [same] using named⟩
  · intro path known
    exact forward path _ (satisfied.negative path known)
  · intro path reached permission declared read
    exact satisfied.modes path reached permission declared (backward path reached read)

-- Heap effects are supplied separately from the static replacement calculation.
-- The reverse observation premise is needed for the modes of every readable path,
-- including paths hidden by the current view.
theorem satisfies_replaceView
    {classes : ClassTable} {before after : State} {source incoming : ValueType}
    {reference value : Reference} {target : Path} {pending : List Reference}
    (classesWF : classes.WellFormed)
    (facts : StorePathFacts classes source incoming target)
    (nonempty : target ≠ [])
    (sourceSatisfied : Satisfies classes before reference source)
    (incomingSatisfied : Satisfies classes after value incoming)
    (afterWF : WellFormedWith classes.erase after pending)
    (preserveClasses : ∀ object data, (object, data) ∈ before.objects →
      ∃ newData, (object, newData) ∈ after.objects ∧ newData.className = data.className)
    (forward : ∀ path slot, ¬target <+: path →
      readPath before reference path = some slot → readPath after reference path = some slot)
    (backward : ∀ path reached, ¬target <+: path →
      readPath after reference path = some (some reached) →
      readPath before reference path = some (some reached))
    (installed : readPath after reference target = some (some value)) :
    Satisfies classes after reference (replaceView classes source incoming target) := by
  constructor
  · exact sourceSatisfied.mode
  · obtain ⟨data, member, named⟩ := sourceSatisfied.root
    obtain ⟨newData, member, same⟩ := preserveClasses _ _ member
    exact ⟨newData, member, same.trans named⟩
  · intro path known
    rcases replaceView_positive classesWF nonempty facts.atClass facts.properPositive known with
      ⟨oldKnown, outside⟩ | ⟨suffix, rfl, incomingKnown⟩
    · obtain ⟨reached, data, read, member, named⟩ := sourceSatisfied.positive path oldKnown
      obtain ⟨newData, member, same⟩ := preserveClasses _ _ member
      refine ⟨reached, newData, forward path _ outside read, member, ?_⟩
      change Unique.Typing.classAt classes.nominal source.nominal.className path = some newData.className
      simpa only [same] using named
    · obtain ⟨reached, data, read, member, named⟩ := incomingSatisfied.positive suffix incomingKnown
      refine ⟨reached, data, (readPath_append afterWF installed suffix).trans read, member, ?_⟩
      change Unique.Typing.classAt classes.nominal source.base (target ++ suffix) = some data.className
      rw [facts.classAt_append]
      exact named
  · intro path known
    rcases replaceView_negative known with ⟨oldKnown, outside⟩ | ⟨suffix, rfl, incomingKnown⟩
    · exact forward path _ outside (sourceSatisfied.negative path oldKnown)
    · exact (readPath_append afterWF installed suffix).trans
        (incomingSatisfied.negative suffix incomingKnown)
  · intro path reached permission declared read
    change declaredPermission classes source.base path = some permission at declared
    change reached.mode = (source.permission.comp permission).toMode
    by_cases inside : target <+: path
    · obtain ⟨suffix, rfl⟩ := inside
      rw [facts.permission_append] at declared
      obtain ⟨tailPermission, tailDeclared, same⟩ := Option.map_eq_some_iff.mp declared
      have tailRead := (readPath_append afterWF installed suffix).symm.trans read
      have mode := incomingSatisfied.modes suffix reached tailPermission tailDeclared tailRead
      rw [facts.sourceGiven, Perm.comp_given_left, ←same]
      exact mode
    · exact sourceSatisfied.modes path reached permission declared (backward path reached inside read)

end Dada.Assignment

import Destructors.Syntax

namespace Dada.Assignment

open Shared Shared.Typing

-- Call-free values and nominal storage are the explicitly inherited Shared
-- sublanguage. Calls have their own syntax, machine, and typing judgments.
abbrev Name := Destructors.Name
abbrev Parameter := Destructors.Parameter
abbrev Signature := Destructors.Signature
abbrev receiver := Destructors.receiver

inductive Statement where
  | local (statement : Unpacking.Statement)
  | call (destination : Option VariableId) (name : Name) (arguments : List Value)
  | store (place : Place) (value : Value)
  | dropStruct (place : Place)
  deriving Repr

-- Class drops are calls to a distinct namespace, never a user method named drop.
def Statement.dropClass (owner : ClassName) (place : Place) : Statement :=
  .call none (.destructor owner) [.give place]

structure Body where
  statements : List Statement
  result : Option Value
  deriving Repr

structure Declaration where
  signature : Signature
  body : Body
  deriving Repr

abbrev Declarations := List (Name × Declaration)

structure Program where
  classes : ClassTable
  declarations : Declarations
  main : List Statement
  deriving Repr

end Dada.Assignment

import Assignment.Step
import Assignment.StorageTypes

namespace Dada.Assignment

open Shared Shared.Typing

-- Parameters and new bindings carry fixed types even when currently empty.
def initialContext (signature : Signature) : Context :=
  ⟨signature.parameters.map (fun p => (p.name, p.type)), signature.environment⟩

def bindingTypes (classes : ClassTable) (pattern : Unpacking.Pattern)
    (ty : ValueType) : Option (List (VariableId × StorageType)) := do
  match pattern with
  | .variable name => some [(name, storageType ty)]
  | .unpack name fields =>
    let declaration ← classes.lookup name
    fields.mapM fun (field, destination) => do
      let fixed ← declaration.fields.lookup field
      some (destination, fixed)

inductive ExprTyped (classes : ClassTable) : Context → Value → ValueType → Context → Prop where
  | lift {before after value ty} :
      before.WellFormed classes →
      Shared.Typing.ExprTyped classes before.current value ty after →
      (before.withCurrent after).WellFormed classes →
      ExprTyped classes before value ty (before.withCurrent after)

inductive ArgsTyped (classes : ClassTable) : Context → List Value → List FieldType → Context → Prop where
  | lift {before after values types} :
      before.WellFormed classes →
      Shared.Typing.ArgsTyped classes before.current values types after →
      (before.withCurrent after).WellFormed classes →
      ArgsTyped classes before values types (before.withCurrent after)

inductive BindingTyped (classes : ClassTable) : Context → Unpacking.Pattern → ValueType → Context → Prop where
  | lift {before after pattern ty fixed} :
      before.WellFormed classes →
      Shared.Typing.BindingTyped classes before.current pattern ty after →
      bindingTypes classes pattern ty = some fixed →
      (Context.mk (fixed ++ before.bindings) after).WellFormed classes →
      BindingTyped classes before pattern ty ⟨fixed ++ before.bindings, after⟩

inductive LocalTyped (classes : ClassTable) : Context → Unpacking.Statement → Context → Prop where
  | letValue {before middle after pattern value ty} :
      ExprTyped classes before value ty middle →
      BindingTyped classes middle pattern ty after →
      LocalTyped classes before ⟨pattern, value⟩ after

inductive ResultTyped (classes : ClassTable) : Context → Option Value → Option FieldType → Context → Prop where
  | none {environment} :
      environment.WellFormed classes → ResultTyped classes environment none none environment
  | some {before after value type} :
      ExprTyped classes before value type.toType after →
      ResultTyped classes before (some value) (some type) after

inductive DestinationTyped (classes : ClassTable) : Context → Option VariableId → Option FieldType → Context → Prop where
  | none {environment} :
      environment.WellFormed classes → DestinationTyped classes environment none none environment
  | some {before after name type} :
      BindingTyped classes before (.variable name) type.toType after →
      DestinationTyped classes before (some name) (some type) after

def Finished (classes : ClassTable) (context : Context) : Prop :=
  Destructors.Finished classes context.current

inductive StatementTyped (classes : ClassTable) (declarations : Declarations) : Context → Statement → Context → Prop where
  | local {before after statement} :
      LocalTyped classes before statement after →
      StatementTyped classes declarations before (.local statement) after
  | call {before middle after destination name arguments declaration} :
      (name, declaration) ∈ declarations →
      (∀ x ∈ destination, x ∉ before.current.map Prod.fst) →
      ArgsTyped classes before arguments (declaration.signature.parameters.map Functions.Parameter.type) middle →
      DestinationTyped classes middle destination declaration.signature.result after →
      StatementTyped classes declarations before (.call destination name arguments) after

  | store {before middle after place value ty} :
      ExprTyped classes before value ty middle →
      store classes middle place ty = some after →
      StatementTyped classes declarations before (.store place value) after
  | dropStruct {before after place ty} :
      ExprTyped classes before (.give place) ty after → StructType classes ty →
      StatementTyped classes declarations before (.dropStruct place) after

-- Elaboration of the single surface form `drop p`. The resolved class name
-- is carried by the core call, so execution needs no dynamic method lookup.
inductive DropTyped (classes : ClassTable) (declarations : Declarations) : Context → Place → Statement → Context → Prop where
  | struct {before after place ty} :
      ExprTyped classes before (.give place) ty after → StructType classes ty →
      DropTyped classes declarations before place (.dropStruct place) after
  | class {before after place owner declaration} :
      ExprTyped classes before (.give place) (.whole owner .given) after →
      (Destructors.Name.destructor owner, declaration) ∈ declarations →
      declaration.signature = ⟨[receiver owner .given], none⟩ →
      DropTyped classes declarations before place (.dropClass owner place) after

inductive SequenceTyped (classes : ClassTable) (declarations : Declarations) : Context → List Statement → Context → Prop where
  | nil {environment} :
      environment.WellFormed classes → SequenceTyped classes declarations environment [] environment
  | cons {before middle after statement rest} :
      StatementTyped classes declarations before statement middle →
      SequenceTyped classes declarations middle rest after →
      SequenceTyped classes declarations before (statement :: rest) after

def BodyTyped (classes : ClassTable) (declarations : Declarations) (signature : Signature)
    (body : Body) : Prop :=
  ∃ middle after,
    SequenceTyped classes declarations (initialContext signature) body.statements middle ∧
    ResultTyped classes middle body.result signature.result after ∧ Finished classes after

def DeclarationsTyped (classes : ClassTable) (declarations : Declarations) : Prop :=
  (declarations.map Prod.fst).Nodup ∧
    ∀ entry ∈ declarations,
      Destructors.Signature.WellFormed classes entry.1 entry.2.signature ∧
      BodyTyped classes declarations entry.2.signature entry.2.body

def ProgramTyped (program : Program) : Prop :=
  program.classes.WellFormed ∧ DeclarationsTyped program.classes program.declarations ∧
    ∃ finalEnvironment,
      SequenceTyped program.classes program.declarations Context.empty program.main finalEnvironment ∧
      Finished program.classes finalEnvironment

end Dada.Assignment

import Assignment.StorageTypes
