namespace Dada.Assignment.View
open Unique.Typing

def retained (classes : ClassTable) (ty : ViewType) (path : Path) : List Entry :=
  ty.entries.flatMap fun entry =>
    if path.isPrefixOf entry.path then []
    else match entry with
    | .negative _ => [entry]
    | .positive initialPath =>
      if initialPath.isPrefixOf path then
        match classAt classes ty.className initialPath with
        | none => []
        | some target =>
          (remainingAfterMove classes target (path.drop initialPath.length)).map
            (Entry.prepend initialPath)
      else [entry]

theorem covers_avoids {entry : Entry} {target path : Path}
    (cover : Covers [entry] path)
    (left : ¬target <+: entry.path)
    (right : ∀ initialPath, entry = .positive initialPath → ¬initialPath <+: target) :
    ¬target <+: path := by
  obtain ⟨other, member, covered⟩ := cover
  have eq := List.mem_singleton.mp member
  subst other
  intro pre
  rcases covered with ⟨entryPrefix, _⟩ | ⟨initialPath, eq, entryPrefix⟩
  · exact left (pre.trans entryPrefix)
  · rcases List.prefix_or_prefix_of_prefix pre entryPrefix with h | h
    · exact left (by simpa [eq, Entry.path] using h)
    · exact right initialPath eq h

theorem retained_covers {classes : ClassTable} {ty : ViewType} {target path : Path}
    (valid : (classAt classes ty.className path).isSome = true)
    (cover : Covers (retained classes ty target) path) :
    Pos classes ty path ∧ ¬target <+: path := by
  obtain ⟨entry, member, covered⟩ := cover
  obtain ⟨source, sourceMember, member⟩ := List.mem_flatMap.mp member
  split at member
  · simp at member
  next notBelow =>
    have notBelow := fun h => notBelow (List.isPrefixOf_iff_prefix.mpr h)
    cases source with
    | negative negativePath =>
      have eq := List.mem_singleton.mp member
      subst entry
      exact ⟨pos_iff.mpr ⟨valid, Or.inr ⟨_, sourceMember, covered⟩⟩,
        covers_avoids ⟨_, by simp, covered⟩ notBelow (by simp)⟩
    | positive initialPath =>
      dsimp only at member
      split at member
      next above =>
        have above := List.isPrefixOf_iff_prefix.mp above
        have targetEq := List.prefix_iff_eq_append.mp above
        split at member
        · simp at member
        next name found =>
          obtain ⟨sibling, siblingMember, eq⟩ := List.mem_map.mp member
          subst entry
          obtain ⟨siblingPath, rfl, left, right⟩ := remainingAfterMove_entries siblingMember
          have sourcePositive : Pos classes ty path := by
            apply positive_entry_related sourceMember _ valid
            rcases covered with ⟨pre, _⟩ | ⟨p, eq, pre⟩
            · have initPre : initialPath <+: initialPath ++ siblingPath := ⟨_, rfl⟩
              exact List.prefix_or_prefix_of_prefix initPre (by simpa [Entry.prepend, Entry.path] using pre)
            · simp only [Entry.prepend, Entry.positive.injEq] at eq
              subst p
              exact Or.inl ((show initialPath <+: initialPath ++ siblingPath from ⟨_, rfl⟩).trans pre)
          refine ⟨sourcePositive, covers_avoids (entry := .positive (initialPath ++ siblingPath))
            ⟨_, by simp [Entry.prepend], covered⟩ ?_ ?_⟩
          · change ¬target <+: initialPath ++ siblingPath
            rw [←targetEq]
            simpa using left
          · intro p eq
            simp only [Entry.positive.injEq] at eq
            subst p
            rw [←targetEq]
            simpa using right
      next notAbove =>
        have eq := List.mem_singleton.mp member
        subst entry
        refine ⟨pos_iff.mpr ⟨valid, Or.inr ⟨_, sourceMember, covered⟩⟩,
          covers_avoids ⟨_, by simp, covered⟩ notBelow ?_⟩
        intro p eq
        have eq := Entry.positive.inj eq
        subst p
        exact fun h => notAbove (List.isPrefixOf_iff_prefix.mpr h)

theorem retained_negative {classes : ClassTable} {ty : ViewType} {target path : Path}
    (member : Entry.negative path ∈ retained classes ty target) :
    Neg ty path ∧ ¬target <+: path := by
  obtain ⟨entry, sourceMember, member⟩ := List.mem_flatMap.mp member
  split at member
  · simp at member
  next notBelow =>
    cases entry with
    | negative p =>
      have eq := List.mem_singleton.mp member
      cases eq
      exact ⟨List.contains_iff_mem.mpr sourceMember, fun h =>
        notBelow (List.isPrefixOf_iff_prefix.mpr h)⟩
    | positive p =>
      dsimp only at member
      split at member
      · split at member
        · simp at member
        · obtain ⟨entry, entryMember, eq⟩ := List.mem_map.mp member
          obtain ⟨path, rfl, _, _⟩ := remainingAfterMove_entries entryMember
          simp [Entry.prepend] at eq
      · simp at member


theorem covers_prepend_general (entries : List Entry) (target query : Path) :
    Covers (entries.map (Entry.prepend target)) (target ++ query) ↔ Covers entries query := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨entry, member, covered⟩
    obtain ⟨source, sourceMember, eq⟩ := List.mem_map.mp member
    subst entry
    refine ⟨source, sourceMember, ?_⟩
    rcases covered with ⟨pre, length⟩ | ⟨initial, same, pre⟩
    · exact .inl ⟨by simpa using pre, by simpa using length⟩
    · cases source with
      | positive path =>
        simp only [Entry.prepend, Entry.positive.injEq] at same
        subst initial
        exact .inr ⟨path, rfl, by simpa using pre⟩
      | negative path => simp [Entry.prepend] at same
  · rintro ⟨entry, member, covered⟩
    refine ⟨entry.prepend target, List.mem_map.mpr ⟨entry, member, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    rcases covered with ⟨pre, length⟩ | ⟨path, rfl, pre⟩
    · exact .inl ⟨by simpa using pre, by simpa using length⟩
    · exact .inr ⟨target ++ path, rfl, by simpa using pre⟩

theorem prefixed_positive {classes : ClassTable} {source incoming : ViewType} {target query : Path}
    (atClass : classAt classes source.className target = some incoming.className)
    (parentKnown : ∀ path, path <+: target → path.length < target.length → Pos classes source path)
    (valid : (classAt classes source.className query).isSome = true)
    (cover : Covers (incoming.entries.map (Entry.prepend target)) query) :
    (Pos classes source query ∧ ¬target <+: query) ∨
      ∃ suffix, query = target ++ suffix ∧ Pos classes incoming suffix := by
  by_cases inside : target <+: query
  · obtain ⟨suffix, rfl⟩ := inside
    right
    refine ⟨suffix, rfl, pos_iff.mpr ⟨?_, .inr ((covers_prepend_general _ _ _).mp cover)⟩⟩
    simpa [classAt_append, atClass] using valid
  · left
    refine ⟨?_, inside⟩
    obtain ⟨entry, member, covered⟩ := cover
    obtain ⟨sourceEntry, member, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp member
    have before : query <+: target := by
      rcases covered with ⟨pre, _⟩ | ⟨initial, same, pre⟩
      · have targetPrefix : target <+: (sourceEntry.prepend target).path := by simp
        exact (List.prefix_or_prefix_of_prefix pre targetPrefix).resolve_right inside
      · cases sourceEntry with
        | positive path =>
          simp only [Entry.prepend, Entry.positive.injEq] at same
          subst initial
          exact False.elim (inside ((show target <+: target ++ path from ⟨path,rfl⟩).trans pre))
        | negative path => simp [Entry.prepend] at same
    exact parentKnown query before (Nat.lt_of_le_of_ne before.length_le (by
      intro same
      have eq := before.eq_of_length same
      subst query
      exact inside (by simp)))

theorem prefixed_negative {entries : List Entry} {target query : Path}
    (member : Entry.negative query ∈ entries.map (Entry.prepend target)) :
    ∃ suffix, query = target ++ suffix ∧ Entry.negative suffix ∈ entries := by
  obtain ⟨entry, member, same⟩ := List.mem_map.mp member
  cases entry with
  | positive path => simp [Entry.prepend] at same
  | negative path =>
    simp only [Entry.prepend, Entry.negative.injEq] at same
    exact ⟨path, same.symm, member⟩

theorem replacement_positive {classes : ClassTable} (classesWF : classes.WellFormed)
    {source incoming : ViewType} {target query : Path}
    (nonempty : target ≠ [])
    (atClass : classAt classes source.className target = some incoming.className)
    (parentKnown : ∀ path, path <+: target → path.length < target.length → Pos classes source path)
    (known : Pos classes (normalize classes ⟨source.className,
      retained classes source target ++ incoming.entries.map (Entry.prepend target)⟩) query) :
    (Pos classes source query ∧ ¬target <+: query) ∨
      ∃ suffix, query = target ++ suffix ∧ Pos classes incoming suffix := by
  obtain ⟨valid, root | ⟨entry, member, covered⟩⟩ := pos_iff.mp (normalize_pos classesWF known)
  · subst query
    exact .inl ⟨pos_iff.mpr ⟨valid, .inl rfl⟩, by simpa using nonempty⟩
  · rcases List.mem_append.mp member with retainedMember | incomingMember
    · exact .inl (retained_covers valid ⟨entry, retainedMember, covered⟩)
    · exact prefixed_positive atClass parentKnown valid ⟨entry, incomingMember, covered⟩

theorem replacement_negative {classes : ClassTable} {source incoming : ViewType} {target query : Path}
    (known : Neg (normalize classes ⟨source.className,
      retained classes source target ++ incoming.entries.map (Entry.prepend target)⟩) query) :
    (Neg source query ∧ ¬target <+: query) ∨
      ∃ suffix, query = target ++ suffix ∧ Neg incoming suffix := by
  have member := List.contains_iff_mem.mp (normalize_neg known)
  rcases List.mem_append.mp member with retainedMember | incomingMember
  · exact .inl (retained_negative retainedMember)
  · obtain ⟨suffix, same, member⟩ := prefixed_negative incomingMember
    exact .inr ⟨suffix, same, List.contains_iff_mem.mpr member⟩

end Dada.Assignment.View

namespace Dada.Assignment
open Shared Shared.Typing

@[simp] theorem replaceView_permission (classes : ClassTable) (source incoming : ValueType) (path : Path) :
    (replaceView classes source incoming path).permission = source.permission := rfl

@[simp] theorem replaceView_base (classes : ClassTable) (source incoming : ValueType) (path : Path) :
    (replaceView classes source incoming path).base = source.base := rfl

theorem replaceView_positive {classes : ClassTable} (classesWF : classes.WellFormed)
    {source incoming : ValueType} {target query : Path}
    (nonempty : target ≠ [])
    (atClass : Unique.Typing.classAt classes.nominal source.base target = some incoming.base)
    (parentKnown : ∀ path, path <+: target → path.length < target.length → Pos classes source path)
    (known : Pos classes (replaceView classes source incoming target) query) :
    (Pos classes source query ∧ ¬target <+: query) ∨
      ∃ suffix, query = target ++ suffix ∧ Pos classes incoming suffix := by
  exact View.replacement_positive classesWF.nominal nonempty atClass parentKnown known

theorem replaceView_negative {classes : ClassTable} {source incoming : ValueType} {target query : Path}
    (known : Neg (replaceView classes source incoming target) query) :
    (Neg source query ∧ ¬target <+: query) ∨
      ∃ suffix, query = target ++ suffix ∧ Neg incoming suffix := by
  exact View.replacement_negative known

end Dada.Assignment

import Shared.Step

namespace Dada.Assignment
open Shared

-- Resolve the slot, not its contents. Empty slots have no reference to resolve.
inductive Writable (state : State) : Place → StoragePlace → Slot → Prop where
  | variable {name slot} :
      (name, slot) ∈ state.variables →
      Writable state (.variable name) (.variable name) slot
  | field {base source parent data name slot} :
      Resolve state base source parent .unique →
      (parent, data) ∈ state.objects →
      (name, slot) ∈ data.fields →
      Writable state (.field base name) (.field parent name) slot

def Replaceable (classes : Classes) (state : State) : Slot → Prop
  | none => True
  | some reference => StructReference classes state reference

-- Changing a slot preserves all allocation identities, including its parent.
inductive Write : State → StoragePlace → Reference → State → Prop where
  | variable (objects : List (ObjectId × Object)) (nextId : Nat)
      (leading suffix : List (VariableId × Slot)) (name : VariableId)
      (previous : Slot) (reference : Reference) :
      Write ⟨objects, leading ++ (name, previous) :: suffix, nextId⟩
        (.variable name) reference
        ⟨objects, leading ++ (name, some reference) :: suffix, nextId⟩
  | field (variables : List (VariableId × Slot)) (nextId : Nat)
      (before after : List (ObjectId × Object)) (parent : ObjectId) (className : ClassName)
      (leading suffix : List (FieldName × Slot)) (name : FieldName)
      (previous : Slot) (reference : Reference) :
      Write ⟨before ++ (parent, ⟨className, leading ++ (name, previous) :: suffix⟩) :: after,
          variables, nextId⟩
        (.field parent name) reference
        ⟨before ++ (parent, ⟨className, leading ++ (name, some reference) :: suffix⟩) :: after,
          variables, nextId⟩

theorem Write.nextId (written : Write before place reference after) :
    after.nextId = before.nextId := by cases written <;> rfl

theorem Write.objectKeys (written : Write before place reference after) :
    after.objects.map Prod.fst = before.objects.map Prod.fst := by
  cases written <;> simp

end Dada.Assignment

theorem Write.stored_unchanged (taken : Write before source reference after)
    (different : place ≠ source) (stored : Stored before place slot) :
    Stored after place slot := by
  cases taken with
  | «variable» objects nextId leading trailing name previous reference =>
    cases place with
    | «variable» other =>
      simp only [Stored, List.mem_append, List.mem_cons] at stored ⊢
      rcases stored with member | same | member
      · exact Or.inl member
      · cases same
        exact False.elim (different rfl)
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inr member)
    | field parent fieldName => exact stored
  | field variables nextId leading trailing parent className beforeFields afterFields name previous reference =>
    cases place with
    | «variable» other => exact stored
    | field other otherField =>
      obtain ⟨data, atObject, atField⟩ := stored
      simp only [List.mem_append, List.mem_cons] at atObject
      rcases atObject with member | same | member
      · exact ⟨data, List.mem_append_left _ member, atField⟩
      · cases same
        refine ⟨⟨className, beforeFields ++ (name, some reference) :: afterFields⟩, by simp, ?_⟩
        simp only [List.mem_append, List.mem_cons] at atField ⊢
        rcases atField with member | same | member
        · exact Or.inl member
        · cases same
          exact False.elim (different rfl)
        · exact Or.inr (Or.inr member)
      · exact ⟨data, List.mem_append_right _ (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ member), atField⟩

theorem Write.stored_back_unchanged (taken : Write before source reference after)
    (different : place ≠ source) (stored : Stored after place slot) :
    Stored before place slot := by
  cases taken with
  | «variable» objects nextId leading trailing name previous reference =>
    cases place with
    | «variable» other =>
      simp only [Stored, List.mem_append, List.mem_cons] at stored ⊢
      rcases stored with member | same | member
      · exact Or.inl member
      · cases same
        exact False.elim (different rfl)
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inr member)
    | field parent fieldName => exact stored
  | field variables nextId leading trailing parent className beforeFields afterFields name previous reference =>
    cases place with
    | «variable» other => exact stored
    | field other otherField =>
      obtain ⟨data, atObject, atField⟩ := stored
      simp only [List.mem_append, List.mem_cons] at atObject
      rcases atObject with member | same | member
      · exact ⟨data, List.mem_append_left _ member, atField⟩
      · cases same
        refine ⟨⟨className, beforeFields ++ (name, previous) :: afterFields⟩, by simp, ?_⟩
        simp only [List.mem_append, List.mem_cons] at atField ⊢
        rcases atField with member | same | member
        · exact Or.inl member
        · cases same
          exact False.elim (different rfl)
        · exact Or.inr (Or.inr member)
      · exact ⟨data, List.mem_append_right _ (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ member), atField⟩

theorem Write.old_object_data (taken : Write before place reference after)
    (id : ObjectId) (data : Object) (stored : (id, data) ∈ before.objects) :
    ∃ newData, (id, newData) ∈ after.objects ∧ newData.className = data.className := by
  cases taken with
  | «variable» => exact ⟨data, stored, rfl⟩
  | field variables nextId leading trailing parent className beforeFields afterFields name previous reference =>
    simp only [List.mem_append, List.mem_cons] at stored
    rcases stored with member | same | member
    · exact ⟨data, List.mem_append_left _ member, rfl⟩
    · cases same
      exact ⟨⟨className, beforeFields ++ (name, some reference) :: afterFields⟩, by simp, rfl⟩
    · exact ⟨data, List.mem_append_right _ (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ member), rfl⟩

theorem Write.variableKeys (written : Write before place reference after) :
    after.variables.map Prod.fst = before.variables.map Prod.fst := by
  cases written <;> simp

theorem Write.installed (written : Write before place reference after) :
    Stored after place (some reference) := by
  cases written with
  | «variable» => simp [Stored]
  | field variables nextId leading trailing parent className beforeFields afterFields name previous reference =>
    exact ⟨⟨className, beforeFields ++ (name, some reference) :: afterFields⟩, by simp, by simp⟩

theorem Write.previous (written : Write before place reference after) :
    ∃ previous, Stored before place previous ∧
      (reference :: Owners before).Perm (previous.toList ++ Owners after) := by
  cases written with
  | «variable» objects nextId leading trailing name previous reference =>
    refine ⟨previous, by simp [Stored], ?_⟩
    apply List.perm_iff_count.mpr
    intro r
    cases previous <;> simp [Owners, List.count_append, List.count_cons, List.filterMap_append] <;> omega
  | field variables nextId leading trailing parent className beforeFields afterFields name previous reference =>
    refine ⟨previous, ⟨⟨className, beforeFields ++ (name, previous) :: afterFields⟩, by simp, by simp⟩, ?_⟩
    apply List.perm_iff_count.mpr
    intro r
    cases previous <;> simp [Owners, List.count_append, List.count_cons, List.filterMap_append, List.flatMap_append] <;> omega

-- A unique route to the parent cannot pass through the field being replaced.
theorem Write.parent_route (wf : WellFormedWith classes before pending)
    (written : Write before (.field parent name) incoming after)
    (cut : Route before pending (.variable root) cutPath (.owned parent))
    (route : Route before pending (.variable root) path reference)
    (short : path.length ≤ cutPath.length) :
    Route after otherPending (.variable root) path reference := by
  induction route with
  | root owner =>
    cases owner with
    | «variable» stored =>
      exact .root (.variable (written.stored_unchanged (place := .variable root) (by simp) stored))
  | @field oldPath parentRef data field child previousRoute obj stored ih =>
    have smaller : oldPath.length ≤ cutPath.length := by simp only [List.length_append, List.length_singleton] at short; omega
    have different : StoragePlace.field parentRef.object field ≠ .field parent name := by
      intro same
      have ids := (StoragePlace.field.inj same).1
      have paths := (cut.unique wf rfl previousRoute ids).2.1
      have lengths := congrArg List.length paths
      simp only [List.length_append, List.length_singleton] at short
      omega
    obtain ⟨newData, newObj, newField⟩ := written.stored_unchanged different ⟨data,obj,stored⟩
    exact .field (ih smaller) newObj newField

-- Only observations that actually cross the changed field can differ.
theorem write_readPath_frame (wf : WellFormedWith classes before pending)
    (afterWf : WellFormedWith classes after afterPending)
    (written : Write before (.field parent name) incoming after)
    (cut : Route before pending cutSite cutPath (.owned parent))
    (route : Route before pending site initial reference)
    (read : readPath before reference path = some slot)
    (separate : ∀ pre post, path = pre ++ name :: post →
      ¬ (site = cutSite ∧ initial ++ pre = cutPath)) :
    readPath after reference path = some slot := by
  induction path generalizing initial reference with
  | nil =>
    cases found : before.objects.lookup reference.object <;> simp [readPath, found] at read
    subst slot
    apply readPath_nil_of_allocated afterWf
    simpa [Allocated, written.objectKeys] using route.allocated wf
  | cons field rest ih =>
    obtain ⟨data, fieldSlot, stored, atField, final | ⟨child, same, more⟩⟩ := readPath_cons read
    all_goals
      have different : StoragePlace.field reference.object field ≠ .field parent name := by
        intro sameSource
        obtain ⟨sameObject, rfl⟩ := StoragePlace.field.inj sameSource
        obtain ⟨sameSite, samePath, _⟩ := cut.unique wf rfl route sameObject
        exact separate [] rest rfl ⟨sameSite.symm, by simpa using samePath.symm⟩
      have firstRead := readPath_singleton_of_stored afterWf
        (written.stored_unchanged different (show Stored before (.field reference.object field) fieldSlot from
          ⟨data, stored, atField⟩))
    · rcases final with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
      exact firstRead
    · subst fieldSlot
      have remaining := ih (.field route stored atField) more (by
        intro pre post eq same
        apply separate (field :: pre) post (by simp [eq])
        exact ⟨same.1, by simpa [List.append_assoc] using same.2⟩)
      exact (readPath_append afterWf firstRead rest).trans remaining

theorem write_readPath_back_frame (wf : WellFormedWith classes before pending)
    (afterWf : WellFormedWith classes after afterPending)
    (written : Write before (.field parent name) incoming after)
    (cut : Route after afterPending cutSite cutPath (.owned parent))
    (route : Route after afterPending site initial reference)
    (read : readPath after reference path = some slot)
    (separate : ∀ pre post, path = pre ++ name :: post →
      ¬ (site = cutSite ∧ initial ++ pre = cutPath)) :
    readPath before reference path = some slot := by
  induction path generalizing initial reference with
  | nil =>
    cases found : after.objects.lookup reference.object <;> simp [readPath, found] at read
    subst slot
    apply readPath_nil_of_allocated wf
    simpa [Allocated, written.objectKeys] using route.allocated afterWf
  | cons field rest ih =>
    obtain ⟨data, fieldSlot, stored, atField, final | ⟨child, same, more⟩⟩ := readPath_cons read
    all_goals
      have different : StoragePlace.field reference.object field ≠ .field parent name := by
        intro sameSource
        obtain ⟨sameObject, rfl⟩ := StoragePlace.field.inj sameSource
        obtain ⟨sameSite, samePath, _⟩ := cut.unique afterWf rfl route sameObject
        exact separate [] rest rfl ⟨sameSite.symm, by simpa using samePath.symm⟩
      have firstRead := readPath_singleton_of_stored wf
        (written.stored_back_unchanged different (show Stored after (.field reference.object field) fieldSlot from
          ⟨data, stored, atField⟩))
    · rcases final with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
      exact firstRead
    · subst fieldSlot
      have remaining := ih (.field route stored atField) more (by
        intro pre post eq same
        apply separate (field :: pre) post (by simp [eq])
        exact ⟨same.1, by simpa [List.append_assoc] using same.2⟩)
      exact (readPath_append wf firstRead rest).trans remaining

theorem write_readPath_other (wf : WellFormedWith classes before pending)
    (afterWf : WellFormedWith classes after afterPending)
    (written : Write before (.field parent name) incoming after)
    (cut : Route before pending cutSite cutPath (.owned parent))
    (route : Route before pending site initial reference)
    (different : site ≠ cutSite) (read : readPath before reference path = some slot) :
    readPath after reference path = some slot :=
  write_readPath_frame wf afterWf written cut route read (fun _ _ _ both => different both.1)

theorem write_readPath_descendant (wf : WellFormedWith classes before pending)
    (afterWf : WellFormedWith classes after afterPending)
    (written : Write before (.field parent name) incoming after)
    (cut : Route before pending cutSite cutPath (.owned parent))
    (route : Route before pending site initial reference)
    (longer : cutPath.length < initial.length) (read : readPath before reference path = some slot) :
    readPath after reference path = some slot := by
  apply write_readPath_frame wf afterWf written cut route read
  intro pre post _ both
  have lengths := congrArg List.length both.2
  simp only [List.length_append] at lengths
  omega

theorem readPath_eq_of_success
    (forward : ∀ slot, readPath before reference path = some slot → readPath after reference path = some slot)
    (backward : ∀ slot, readPath after reference path = some slot → readPath before reference path = some slot) :
    readPath after reference path = readPath before reference path := by
  cases b : readPath before reference path with
  | some slot => exact forward slot b
  | none =>
    cases a : readPath after reference path with
    | none => rfl
    | some slot => have impossible := backward slot a; simp [b] at impossible

end Dada.Assignment

import Assignment.WriteEffects

namespace Dada.Assignment
open Shared Shared.Typing

-- A writable destination identifies its current slot even when it is empty.
theorem Writable.stored (writable : Writable state place source previous) :
    Stored state source previous := by
  cases writable with
  | «variable» member => exact member
  | field _ stored field => exact ⟨_, stored, field⟩

-- A store changes neither the nominal class nor the set of field names.
theorem Write.new_object_data (written : Write before source incoming after)
    {id : ObjectId} {data : Object}
    (stored : (id, data) ∈ after.objects) :
    ∃ oldData, (id, oldData) ∈ before.objects ∧ oldData.className = data.className ∧
      oldData.fields.map Prod.fst = data.fields.map Prod.fst := by
  cases written with
  | «variable» => exact ⟨data, stored, rfl, rfl⟩
  | field variables nextId leading trailing parent className beforeFields afterFields name previous incoming =>
    simp only [List.mem_append, List.mem_cons] at stored
    rcases stored with member | same | member
    · exact ⟨data, List.mem_append_left _ member, rfl, rfl⟩
    · cases same
      exact ⟨⟨className, beforeFields ++ (name, previous) :: afterFields⟩, by simp, rfl, by simp⟩
    · exact ⟨data, List.mem_append_right _ (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ member), rfl, rfl⟩

private theorem route_live (route : Route state pending site path reference) :
    LiveWith state pending reference.object := by
  induction route with
  | root root =>
    cases root with
    | «variable» member => exact .variable member
    | pending member => exact .pending member
  | @field path parent data name reference _ stored field ih =>
    exact (show LiveWith state pending reference.object from .field ih stored field)

-- The incoming root becomes reachable through the slot. A field destination's
-- unique parent route cannot cross that destination and therefore survives.
theorem Write.incoming_live {previous : Slot} (wf : WellFormedWith classes before pending)
    (writable : Writable before place source previous)
    (written : Write before source incoming after) :
    LiveWith after otherPending incoming.object := by
  cases writable with
  | «variable» member => exact .variable written.installed
  | @field base source parent data name previous resolved stored field =>
    have cut : Route before pending (.variable (splitPlace base).1) (splitPlace base).2
        (.owned parent) := route_of_resolve resolved
    have survives := written.parent_route (otherPending := otherPending) wf cut cut (Nat.le_refl _)
    obtain ⟨newData, newStored, newField⟩ := written.installed
    exact .field (route_live survives) newStored newField

-- Every old path survives either through its old edge or through the displaced
-- reference, now held as an additional pending root.
theorem Write.liveWith {previous : Slot} (wf : WellFormedWith classes before (incoming :: pending))
    (writable : Writable before place source previous)
    (written : Write before source incoming after)
    (live : LiveWith before (incoming :: pending) object) :
    LiveWith after (previous.toList ++ pending) object := by
  have displaced : ∀ reference, Stored before source (some reference) →
      LiveWith after (previous.toList ++ pending) reference.object := by
    intro reference stored
    have same := stored_value_unique wf writable.stored stored
    subst previous
    exact .pending (by simp)
  apply live.transport
  · intro reference member
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp member with rfl | member
    · exact written.incoming_live wf writable
    · exact .pending (List.mem_append_right _ member)
  · intro name reference member
    by_cases same : StoragePlace.variable name = source
    · exact displaced reference (same ▸ member)
    · exact .variable (written.stored_unchanged same member)
  · intro parent data name reference stored field parentLive
    by_cases same : StoragePlace.field parent name = source
    · exact displaced reference (same ▸ (show Stored before (.field parent name) (some reference) from
        ⟨data, stored, field⟩))
    · obtain ⟨newData, newStored, newField⟩ :=
        written.stored_unchanged same ⟨data, stored, field⟩
      exact .field parentLive newStored newField

private theorem owners_targets (state : State) :
    (Owners state).map Reference.object = References state := by
  simp [Owners, References, List.map_filterMap, List.map_flatMap]

private theorem compatible_symm {first second : Reference} (h : Compatible first second) :
    Compatible second first := by
  rcases h with different | shared
  · exact Or.inl (Ne.symm different)
  · exact Or.inr ⟨shared.2, shared.1⟩

-- Store transfers the incoming reference to the destination and transfers the
-- displaced reference to the pending roots; ownership occurrences are conserved.
theorem Write.owners_pending {previous : Slot} (wf : WellFormedWith classes before pending)
    (writable : Writable before place source previous)
    (written : Write before source incoming after) (other : List Reference) :
    ((incoming :: other) ++ Owners before).Perm
      ((previous.toList ++ other) ++ Owners after) := by
  obtain ⟨old, stored, permutation⟩ := written.previous
  have same := stored_value_unique wf writable.stored stored
  subst old
  have first : ((incoming :: other) ++ Owners before).Perm
      (other ++ incoming :: Owners before) :=
    (List.perm_middle (a := incoming) (l₁ := other) (l₂ := Owners before)).symm
  have middle := permutation.append_left other
  have last : (other ++ (previous.toList ++ Owners after)).Perm
      ((previous.toList ++ other) ++ Owners after) := by
    simpa only [List.append_assoc] using
      (show (other ++ previous.toList).Perm (previous.toList ++ other) from
        List.perm_append_comm).append_right (Owners after)
  exact first.trans (middle.trans last)

theorem Write.preserves_pending {previous : Slot} (wf : WellFormedWith classes before (incoming :: pending))
    (writable : Writable before place source previous)
    (written : Write before source incoming after) :
    WellFormedWith classes after (previous.toList ++ pending) := by
  have owners := written.owners_pending wf writable pending
  constructor
  · simpa only [written.objectKeys] using wf.objectKeys
  · simpa only [written.variableKeys] using wf.variableKeys
  · intro id data stored
    obtain ⟨oldData, oldStored, sameClass, sameFields⟩ := written.new_object_data stored
    obtain ⟨declaration, declared, shape, unique⟩ := wf.shapes id oldData oldStored
    exact ⟨declaration, sameClass ▸ declared, sameFields ▸ shape, unique⟩
  · intro id data stored
    obtain ⟨oldData, oldStored, _, _⟩ := written.new_object_data stored
    simpa only [written.nextId] using wf.bounds id oldData oldStored
  · intro id allocated
    have oldAllocated : Allocated before id := by
      simpa only [Allocated, written.objectKeys] using allocated
    exact written.liveWith wf writable (wf.rooted id oldAllocated)
  · exact owners.pairwise wf.ownersCompatible compatible_symm
  · intro id
    have targets := (owners.map Reference.object).mem_iff (a := id)
    simp only [List.map_append, owners_targets] at targets
    have allocation : Allocated before id ↔ Allocated after id := by
      simp only [Allocated, written.objectKeys]
    simpa only [List.map_append] using
      targets.symm.trans ((wf.referencesComplete id).trans allocation)

end Dada.Assignment

-- A finite ordered list of entries with no duplicate keys.
structure FiniteMap (Key Value : Type) where
  entries : List (Key × Value)
  uniqueKeys : (entries.map Prod.fst).Nodup

def FiniteMap.empty : FiniteMap Key Value where
  entries := []
  uniqueKeys := List.nodup_nil

theorem FiniteMap.value_unique (map : FiniteMap Key Value)
    {key : Key} {value value' : Value}
    (member : (key, value) ∈ map.entries)
    (member' : (key, value') ∈ map.entries) : value = value' := by
  obtain ⟨i, hi, entry⟩ := List.getElem_of_mem member
  obtain ⟨j, hj, entry'⟩ := List.getElem_of_mem member'
  have same_index : i = j := map.uniqueKeys.eq_of_getElem_eq
    (by simpa using hi) (by simpa using hj) (by simp [entry, entry'])
  subst j
  have same_entry : (key, value) = (key, value') := entry.symm.trans entry'
  exact (Prod.mk.inj same_entry).2

end Dada.Common

-- A graph is rooted when a node is reached from a root by finitely many edges.
inductive Rooted {Node : Type} (root : Node → Prop) (edge : Node → Node → Prop) :
    Node → Prop where
  | root (atRoot : root node) : Rooted root edge node
  | field (parent : Rooted root edge node) (stored : edge node target) :
      Rooted root edge target

-- If every allocated node has an owner, following owners backwards must reach a
-- root: each backwards field edge strictly increases a bounded allocation rank.
theorem rooted_of_covered {Node : Type} {root : Node → Prop}
    {edge : Node → Node → Prop} {allocated : Node → Prop}
    (rank : Node → Nat) (bound : Nat)
    (bounded : ∀ node, allocated node → rank node < bound)
    (covered : ∀ node, allocated node →
      root node ∨ ∃ parent, allocated parent ∧ edge parent node)
    (descending : ∀ parent node, allocated parent → edge parent node →
      rank node < rank parent) :
    ∀ node, allocated node → Rooted root edge node := by
  have byDistance : ∀ distance node, bound - rank node = distance →
      allocated node → Rooted root edge node := by
    intro distance
    induction distance using Nat.strongRecOn with
    | ind distance ih =>
      intro node measure live
      rcases covered node live with atRoot | ⟨parent, parentLive, stored⟩
      · exact .root atRoot
      · have parentBound := bounded parent parentLive
        have decrease := descending parent node parentLive stored
        have smaller : bound - rank parent < distance := by omega
        exact .field (ih (bound - rank parent) smaller parent rfl parentLive) stored
  intro node live
  exact byDistance (bound - rank node) node rfl live

end Dada.Common

namespace Dada.Correspondence.DestructorsAssignment

def statement : Destructors.Statement → Assignment.Statement
  | .local s => .local s
  | .call destination name arguments => .call destination name arguments
  | .dropStruct place => .dropStruct place

def body (source : Destructors.Body) : Assignment.Body :=
  ⟨source.statements.map statement, source.result⟩

def declaration (source : Destructors.Declaration) : Assignment.Declaration :=
  ⟨source.signature, body source.body⟩

def declarations (source : Destructors.Declarations) : Assignment.Declarations :=
  source.map fun (name, decl) => (name, declaration decl)

def frame (source : Destructors.Frame) : Assignment.Frame :=
  ⟨source.variables, body source.body, source.destination⟩

def configuration (source : Destructors.Configuration) : Assignment.Configuration :=
  ⟨source.objects, source.nextId, source.frames.map frame⟩

theorem running (state : Shared.State) (code : Destructors.Body) frames destination :
    configuration (.running state code frames destination) =
      .running state (body code) (frames.map frame) destination := rfl

theorem resultEval (h : Destructors.ResultEval classes before value after reference) :
    Assignment.ResultEval classes before value after reference := by
  cases h with
  | none => exact .none _
  | some evaluated => exact .some evaluated

theorem deliver (h : Destructors.Deliver before destination reference after) :
    Assignment.Deliver before destination reference after := by
  cases h with
  | none => exact .none _
  | some fresh => exact .some fresh

theorem raw_forward (h : Destructors.RawStep classes decls before after) :
    Assignment.RawStep classes (declarations decls) (configuration before) (configuration after) := by
  cases h with
  | «local» stepped => exact .local stepped
  | call declared shape fresh evaluated arity =>
    apply Assignment.RawStep.call (declaration := declaration _) _ shape fresh evaluated arity
    exact List.mem_map.mpr ⟨_, declared, rfl⟩
  | dropStruct evaluated structRef => exact .dropStruct evaluated structRef
  | @«return» before evaluated result reference caller frames destination variables evaluation delivered finished =>
    exact .return (evaluated := evaluated) (caller := frame caller)
      (resultEval evaluation) (deliver delivered) finished
  | exit finished => exact .exit finished

theorem collect (source : Destructors.Configuration) :
    configuration source.collect = (configuration source).collect := by
  have roots : (source.frames.map frame).flatMap Assignment.Frame.variables =
      source.frames.flatMap Destructors.Frame.variables := by
    simp [List.flatMap_map, frame]
  simp [configuration, Destructors.Configuration.collect, Assignment.Configuration.collect,
    Destructors.Configuration.rootState, Assignment.Configuration.rootState, roots]

theorem step_forward (h : Destructors.Step classes decls before after) :
    Assignment.Step classes (declarations decls) (configuration before) (configuration after) := by
  cases h with
  | collect raw => rw [collect]; exact .collect (raw_forward raw)

end Dada.Correspondence.DestructorsAssignment

namespace Dada.Correspondence.FunctionsDestructors
open Shared Shared.Typing

-- This embedding has no destructor declarations or drop statements. It isolates
-- inherited behavior; the new frame-completion obligations remain explicit.
def name : Functions.Name → Destructors.Name
  | .function n => .function n
  | .method owner n => .method owner n

def statement : Functions.Statement → Destructors.Statement
  | .local s => .local s
  | .call destination target arguments => .call destination (name target) arguments

def body (b : Functions.Body) : Destructors.Body := ⟨b.statements.map statement, b.result⟩
def declaration (d : Functions.Declaration) : Destructors.Declaration := ⟨d.signature, body d.body⟩
def declarations (ds : Functions.Declarations) : Destructors.Declarations :=
  ds.map fun (n,d) => (name n, declaration d)
def frame (f : Functions.Frame) : Destructors.Frame := ⟨f.variables, body f.body, f.destination⟩
def configuration (c : Functions.Configuration) : Destructors.Configuration :=
  ⟨c.objects,c.nextId,c.frames.map frame⟩

theorem collect (c : Functions.Configuration) :
    configuration c.collect = (configuration c).collect := by
  simp only [configuration, Functions.Configuration.collect, Destructors.Configuration.collect,
    Functions.Configuration.rootState, Destructors.Configuration.rootState, List.flatMap_map,
    frame]

theorem running (state : State) (b : Functions.Body) (fs : List Functions.Frame) (dest : Option VariableId) :
    configuration (.running state b fs dest) = .running state (body b) (fs.map frame) dest := rfl

theorem resultEval (evaluation : Functions.ResultEval classes before value after reference) :
    Destructors.ResultEval classes before value after reference := by
  cases evaluation with
  | none => exact .none _
  | some e => exact .some e

theorem deliver (delivery : Functions.Deliver before destination reference after) :
    Destructors.Deliver before destination reference after := by
  cases delivery with
  | none => exact .none _
  | some fresh => exact .some fresh

-- A boundary guard is supplied for every possible return evaluation. For local
-- statements and calls the condition is vacuous, so those steps are unchanged.
def ExitAllowed (classes : Classes) (c : Functions.Configuration) : Prop :=
  ∀ state result fs dest,
    c = .running state ⟨[],result⟩ fs dest →
    ∀ evaluated reference, Functions.ResultEval classes state result evaluated reference →
      Destructors.StoreFinished classes evaluated

theorem raw_forward
    (step : Functions.RawStep classes ds before after)
    (allowed : ExitAllowed classes before) :
    Destructors.RawStep classes (declarations ds) (configuration before) (configuration after) := by
  cases step with
  | «local» operation => exact .local operation
  | @call before evaluated destination target arguments rest result frames returnTo decl references declared shape fresh evaluation lengths =>
    exact .call (declaration := declaration decl) (evaluated := evaluated) (List.mem_map.mpr ⟨_,declared,rfl⟩) shape fresh evaluation lengths
  | @«return» before evaluated result reference caller frames destination variables evaluation delivered =>
    exact .return (evaluated := evaluated) (resultEval evaluation) (deliver delivered) (allowed _ _ _ _ rfl _ _ evaluation)
  | exit => exact .exit (allowed _ _ _ _ rfl _ _ (.none _))

theorem step_forward
    (step : Functions.Step classes ds before after)
    (allowed : ExitAllowed classes before) :
    Destructors.Step classes (declarations ds) (configuration before) (configuration after) := by
  cases step with
  | collect raw => rw [collect]; exact .collect (raw_forward raw allowed)

theorem resultEval_backward (evaluation : Destructors.ResultEval classes before value after reference) :
    Functions.ResultEval classes before value after reference := by
  cases evaluation with
  | none => exact .none _
  | some e => exact .some e

theorem deliver_backward (delivery : Destructors.Deliver before destination reference after) :
    Functions.Deliver before destination reference after := by
  cases delivery with
  | none => exact .none _
  | some fresh => exact .some fresh

theorem name_injective : Function.Injective name := by
  intro a b eq
  cases a <;> cases b <;> simp_all [name]

theorem raw_backward {before : Functions.Configuration}
    (step : Destructors.RawStep classes (declarations ds) (configuration before) after) :
    ∃ successor, Functions.RawStep classes ds before successor ∧ after = configuration successor := by
  rcases before with ⟨objects,nextId,frames⟩
  cases frames with
  | nil => cases step
  | cons active rest =>
    rcases active with ⟨variables,⟨code,result⟩,destination⟩
    cases code with
    | nil =>
      cases rest with
      | nil =>
        cases step with
        | exit _ => exact ⟨_, .exit, rfl⟩
      | cons caller rest =>
        cases step with
        | «return» evaluation delivery _ =>
          exact ⟨_, .return (resultEval_backward evaluation) (deliver_backward delivery), rfl⟩
    | cons first tail =>
      cases first with
      | «local» localStatement =>
        cases step with
        | «local» operation => exact ⟨_, .local operation, rfl⟩
      | call dest target args =>
        cases step with
        | call declared shape fresh evaluation lengths =>
          obtain ⟨⟨oldName,oldDeclaration⟩, oldMember, equal⟩ := List.mem_map.mp declared
          have names := name_injective (congrArg Prod.fst equal)
          subst oldName
          have bodies := congrArg Prod.snd equal
          dsimp at bodies
          subst bodies
          exact ⟨_, .call oldMember shape fresh evaluation lengths, rfl⟩

theorem step_backward
    (step : Destructors.Step classes (declarations ds) (configuration before) after) :
    ∃ successor, Functions.Step classes ds before successor ∧ after = configuration successor := by
  cases step with
  | collect raw =>
    obtain ⟨successor, original, rfl⟩ := raw_backward raw
    exact ⟨successor.collect, .collect original, (collect successor).symm⟩

theorem step_correspondence (allowed : ExitAllowed classes before) :
    Destructors.Step classes (declarations ds) (configuration before) after ↔
      ∃ successor, Functions.Step classes ds before successor ∧ after = configuration successor := by
  constructor
  · exact step_backward
  · rintro ⟨successor, step, rfl⟩
    exact step_forward step allowed

theorem steps_backward (steps : Destructors.Steps classes (declarations ds) start after) :
    ∀ before, start = configuration before →
      ∃ successor, Functions.Steps classes ds before successor ∧ after = configuration successor := by
  induction steps with
  | refl => intro before eq; exact ⟨before, .refl _, eq⟩
  | step first _ ih =>
    intro before eq
    subst eq
    obtain ⟨middle, original, rfl⟩ := step_backward first
    obtain ⟨last, rest, eq⟩ := ih middle rfl
    exact ⟨last, .step original rest, eq⟩

theorem finished (c : Functions.Configuration) :
    (configuration c).finished ↔ c.finished := by
  simp [Destructors.Configuration.finished, Functions.Configuration.finished, configuration]

end Dada.Correspondence.FunctionsDestructors

import Functions.Typing

namespace Dada.Correspondence.SharedFunctions

open Shared

def embed (configuration : Unpacking.Configuration) : Functions.Configuration :=
  .running configuration.state ⟨configuration.code.map Functions.Statement.local, none⟩

def terminal (configuration : Unpacking.Configuration) : Functions.Configuration :=
  ⟨[], configuration.state.nextId, []⟩

theorem collect_embed (wf : WellFormed classes configuration.state) :
    (embed configuration).collect = embed configuration := by
  apply Functions.Configuration.collect_eq_self
  intro id data member
  have live := wf.allocated_live (List.mem_map.mpr ⟨(id, data), member, rfl⟩)
  simpa [embed, Functions.Configuration.rootState, Functions.Configuration.running] using live

theorem raw_forward (step : Unpacking.Step classes before after) :
    Functions.RawStep classes declarations (embed before) (embed after) := by
  cases step with
  | letValue eval bind => exact .local (.letValue eval bind)

theorem raw_backward (step : Functions.RawStep classes declarations (embed before) after) :
    (∃ successor, Unpacking.Step classes before successor ∧ after = embed successor) ∨
    (before.finished ∧ after = ⟨before.state.objects, before.state.nextId, []⟩) := by
  rcases before with ⟨⟨objects, variables, nextId⟩, code⟩
  cases code with
  | nil =>
    cases step
    exact .inr ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
  | cons statement rest =>
    cases step with
    | «local» localStep =>
      cases localStep with
      | letValue eval bind => exact .inl ⟨_, .letValue eval bind, rfl⟩

theorem step_forward (classesWf : ClassesWellFormed classes)
    (wf : WellFormed classes before.state) (step : Unpacking.Step classes before after) :
    Functions.Step classes declarations (embed before) (embed after) := by
  have transition := Functions.Step.collect (raw_forward (declarations := declarations) step)
  rwa [collect_embed (step.preserves_wellFormed classesWf wf)] at transition

theorem exit_forward (finished : configuration.finished) :
    Functions.Step classes declarations (embed configuration) (terminal configuration) := by
  rcases configuration with ⟨⟨objects, variables, nextId⟩, code⟩
  cases finished
  simpa [embed, terminal] using
    (Functions.Step.collect (Functions.RawStep.exit (classes := classes)
      (declarations := declarations) (objects := objects) (variables := variables) (nextId := nextId)))

theorem step_backward (classesWf : ClassesWellFormed classes)
    (wf : WellFormed classes before.state)
    (step : Functions.Step classes declarations (embed before) after) :
    (∃ successor, Unpacking.Step classes before successor ∧ after = embed successor) ∨
      (before.finished ∧ after = terminal before) := by
  cases step with
  | collect raw =>
    rcases raw_backward raw with ⟨successor, oldStep, rfl⟩ | ⟨finished, rfl⟩
    · exact .inl ⟨successor, oldStep, collect_embed (oldStep.preserves_wellFormed classesWf wf)⟩
    · exact .inr ⟨finished, Functions.Configuration.collect_empty_frames _ _⟩

theorem step_correspondence (classesWf : ClassesWellFormed classes)
    (wf : WellFormed classes before.state) :
    Functions.Step classes declarations (embed before) after ↔
      (∃ successor, Unpacking.Step classes before successor ∧ after = embed successor) ∨
      (before.finished ∧ after = terminal before) := by
  constructor
  · exact step_backward classesWf wf
  · rintro (⟨successor, step, rfl⟩ | ⟨finished, rfl⟩)
    · exact step_forward classesWf wf step
    · exact exit_forward finished

theorem steps_forward (classesWf : ClassesWellFormed classes)
    (wf : WellFormed classes before.state) (steps : Unpacking.Steps classes before after) :
    Functions.Steps classes declarations (embed before) (embed after) := by
  induction steps with
  | refl => exact .refl _
  | step step _ ih =>
    exact .step (step_forward classesWf wf step) (ih (step.preserves_wellFormed classesWf wf))

theorem steps_backward (classesWf : ClassesWellFormed classes)
    (steps : Functions.Steps classes declarations start after) :
    ∀ before, WellFormed classes before.state → start = embed before →
      ∃ successor, Unpacking.Steps classes before successor ∧
        (after = embed successor ∨ (successor.finished ∧ after = terminal successor)) := by
  induction steps with
  | refl =>
    intro before _ equality
    exact ⟨before, .refl _, .inl equality⟩
  | step step rest ih =>
    intro before wf equality
    subst equality
    rcases step_backward classesWf wf step with ⟨middle, first, rfl⟩ | ⟨finished, rfl⟩
    · obtain ⟨last, trace, result⟩ := ih middle (first.preserves_wellFormed classesWf wf) rfl
      exact ⟨last, .step first trace, result⟩
    · cases rest with
      | refl => exact ⟨before, .refl _, .inr ⟨finished, rfl⟩⟩
      | step impossible _ => exact False.elim (Functions.finished_no_step (configuration := terminal before) rfl impossible)

theorem finished_correspondence :
    configuration.finished ↔
      Functions.Step classes declarations (embed configuration) (terminal configuration) := by
  constructor
  · exact exit_forward
  · intro step
    generalize equality : terminal configuration = target at step
    cases step with
    | collect raw =>
      rcases raw_backward raw with ⟨successor, _, rfl⟩ | ⟨finished, _⟩
      · have frames := congrArg Functions.Configuration.frames equality
        simp [embed, terminal, Functions.Configuration.running] at frames
      · exact finished

theorem stuck_correspondence (classesWf : ClassesWellFormed classes)
    (wf : WellFormed classes configuration.state) :
    Functions.Stuck classes declarations (embed configuration) ↔
      Unpacking.Stuck classes configuration := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨_, noStep⟩
    exact ⟨fun finished => noStep ⟨_, exit_forward finished⟩,
      fun ⟨after, step⟩ => noStep ⟨_, step_forward classesWf wf step⟩⟩
  · rintro ⟨unfinished, noStep⟩
    refine ⟨by simp [Functions.Configuration.finished, embed, Functions.Configuration.running], ?_⟩
    rintro ⟨after, step⟩
    rcases step_backward classesWf wf step with ⟨successor, oldStep, _⟩ | ⟨finished, _⟩
    · exact noStep ⟨successor, oldStep⟩
    · exact unfinished finished

theorem typing_forward
    (typed : Typing.SequenceTyped classes before code after) :
    Functions.SequenceTyped classes declarations before (code.map Functions.Statement.local) after := by
  induction typed with
  | nil wf => exact .nil wf
  | cons statement _ ih => exact .cons (.local statement) ih

theorem typing_backward
    (typed : Functions.SequenceTyped classes declarations before code after) :
    ∀ original, code = original.map Functions.Statement.local →
      Typing.SequenceTyped classes before original after := by
  induction typed with
  | nil wf =>
    intro original equality
    have : original = [] := by simpa using equality.symm
    subst original
    exact .nil wf
  | cons statement _ ih =>
    intro original equality
    cases original with
    | nil => simp at equality
    | cons first rest =>
      simp only [List.map_cons, List.cons.injEq] at equality
      obtain ⟨rfl, tail⟩ := equality
      cases statement with
      | «local» typed => exact .cons typed (ih rest tail)

theorem typing_correspondence :
    Functions.SequenceTyped classes declarations before (code.map Functions.Statement.local) after ↔
      Typing.SequenceTyped classes before code after :=
  ⟨fun typed => typing_backward typed code rfl, typing_forward⟩

end Dada.Correspondence.SharedFunctions

namespace Dada.Correspondence.SharedFunctions

open Shared

def embedFramed (configuration : Framed.Configuration Unpacking.Statement) : Functions.Configuration :=
  ⟨configuration.objects, configuration.nextId,
    match configuration.frame with
    | none => []
    | some frame => [⟨frame.variables, ⟨frame.code.map Functions.Statement.local, none⟩, none⟩]⟩

theorem embedFramed_collect (configuration : Framed.Configuration Unpacking.Statement) :
    embedFramed configuration.collect = (embedFramed configuration).collect := by
  rcases configuration with ⟨objects, nextId, frame⟩
  cases frame <;> simp [embedFramed, Framed.Configuration.collect, Framed.Configuration.state,
    Functions.Configuration.collect, Functions.Configuration.rootState]

theorem framed_step_forward
    (step : Framed.Step (Framed.patternOperation classes) before after) :
    Functions.Step classes declarations (embedFramed before) (embedFramed after) := by
  cases step with
  | «local» operation =>
    rw [embedFramed_collect]
    exact .collect (raw_forward operation)
  | @exit state =>
    rw [Framed.collect_popped]
    exact exit_forward (configuration := ⟨state, []⟩) rfl

theorem framed_step_backward
    (step : Functions.Step classes declarations (embedFramed before) after) :
    ∃ successor, Framed.Step (Framed.patternOperation classes) before successor ∧ after = embedFramed successor := by
  rcases before with ⟨objects, nextId, frame⟩
  cases frame with
  | none => exact False.elim (Functions.finished_no_step (configuration := embedFramed ⟨objects, nextId, none⟩) rfl step)
  | some frame =>
    rcases frame with ⟨variables, code⟩
    change Functions.Step classes declarations (embed ⟨⟨objects, variables, nextId⟩, code⟩) after at step
    cases step with
    | collect raw =>
      rcases raw_backward raw with ⟨successor, operation, rfl⟩ | ⟨finished, rfl⟩
      · exact ⟨(Framed.Configuration.running successor.state successor.code).collect,
          .local (before := ⟨objects, variables, nextId⟩) (code := code) operation,
          (embedFramed_collect (.running successor.state successor.code)).symm⟩
      · change code = [] at finished
        subst code
        exact ⟨_, Framed.exit_step ⟨objects, variables, nextId⟩,
          Functions.Configuration.collect_empty_frames _ _⟩

theorem framed_step_correspondence :
    Functions.Step classes declarations (embedFramed before) after ↔
      ∃ successor, Framed.Step (Framed.patternOperation classes) before successor ∧ after = embedFramed successor := by
  constructor
  · exact framed_step_backward
  · rintro ⟨successor, step, rfl⟩
    exact framed_step_forward step

theorem framed_steps_forward
    (steps : Framed.StepsExactly (Framed.patternOperation classes) before count after) :
    Functions.Steps classes declarations (embedFramed before) (embedFramed after) := by
  induction steps with
  | refl => exact .refl _
  | step first _ ih => exact .step (framed_step_forward first) ih

theorem framed_steps_backward (steps : Functions.Steps classes declarations start after) :
    ∀ before, start = embedFramed before →
      ∃ successor, Framed.Steps (Framed.patternOperation classes) before successor ∧ after = embedFramed successor := by
  induction steps with
  | refl => intro before equality; exact ⟨before, ⟨0, .refl _⟩, equality⟩
  | step first _ ih =>
    intro before equality
    subst equality
    obtain ⟨middle, original, rfl⟩ := framed_step_backward first
    obtain ⟨last, ⟨count, rest⟩, equality⟩ := ih middle rfl
    exact ⟨last, ⟨count + 1, .step original rest⟩, equality⟩

theorem framed_finished_correspondence :
    (embedFramed configuration).finished ↔ configuration.finished := by
  rcases configuration with ⟨objects, nextId, frame⟩
  cases frame <;> simp [embedFramed, Functions.Configuration.finished, Framed.Configuration.finished]

theorem framed_stuck_correspondence :
    Functions.Stuck classes declarations (embedFramed configuration) ↔
      Framed.Stuck (Framed.patternOperation classes) configuration := by
  simp only [Functions.Stuck, Framed.Stuck, framed_finished_correspondence]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨unfinished, noStep⟩
    exact ⟨unfinished, fun ⟨after, step⟩ => noStep ⟨_, framed_step_forward step⟩⟩
  · rintro ⟨unfinished, noStep⟩
    refine ⟨unfinished, ?_⟩
    rintro ⟨after, step⟩
    obtain ⟨successor, original, _⟩ := framed_step_backward step
    exact noStep ⟨successor, original⟩

end Dada.Correspondence.SharedFunctions

namespace Dada.Correspondence

def embedId (object : Unique.ObjectId) : Shared.ObjectId := ⟨object.index⟩
def eraseId (object : Shared.ObjectId) : Unique.ObjectId := ⟨object.index⟩

@[simp] theorem erase_embed_id (object : Unique.ObjectId) : eraseId (embedId object) = object := rfl
@[simp] theorem embed_erase_id (object : Shared.ObjectId) : embedId (eraseId object) = object := rfl
@[simp] theorem embed_id_inj {a b : Unique.ObjectId} : embedId a = embedId b ↔ a = b := by
  constructor
  · exact fun h => congrArg eraseId h
  · exact congrArg embedId

def embedReference (object : Unique.ObjectId) : Shared.Reference := .owned (embedId object)
def eraseReference (reference : Shared.Reference) : Unique.ObjectId := eraseId reference.object

@[simp] theorem erase_embed_reference (object : Unique.ObjectId) :
    eraseReference (embedReference object) = object := rfl

def embedSlots {Key : Type} (slots : List (Key × Unique.Slot)) : List (Key × Shared.Slot) :=
  slots.map (fun entry => (entry.1, entry.2.map embedReference))

def eraseSlots {Key : Type} (slots : List (Key × Shared.Slot)) : List (Key × Unique.Slot) :=
  slots.map (fun entry => (entry.1, entry.2.map eraseReference))

def embedObject (object : Unique.Object) : Shared.Object :=
  ⟨object.className, embedSlots object.fields⟩

def eraseObject (object : Shared.Object) : Unique.Object :=
  ⟨object.className, eraseSlots object.fields⟩

def embedState (state : Unique.State) : Shared.State :=
  ⟨state.objects.map (fun entry => (embedId entry.1, embedObject entry.2)),
    embedSlots state.variables, state.nextId⟩

def eraseState (state : Shared.State) : Unique.State :=
  ⟨state.objects.map (fun entry => (eraseId entry.1, eraseObject entry.2)),
    eraseSlots state.variables, state.nextId⟩

def embedPlace : Unique.Place → Shared.Place
  | .variable name => .variable name
  | .field base name => .field (embedPlace base) name

def erasePlace : Shared.Place → Unique.Place
  | .variable name => .variable name
  | .field base name => .field (erasePlace base) name

def embedStorage : Unique.StoragePlace → Shared.StoragePlace
  | .variable name => .variable name
  | .field object name => .field (embedId object) name

def eraseStorage : Shared.StoragePlace → Unique.StoragePlace
  | .variable name => .variable name
  | .field object name => .field (eraseId object) name

def embedValue : Unique.Value → Shared.Value
  | .give source => .give (embedPlace source)
  | .new name arguments => .new name (arguments.map embedValue)

def embedStatement (statement : Unique.Statement) : Shared.Statement :=
  ⟨statement.destination, embedValue statement.value⟩

def embedClasses (classes : Unique.Classes) : Shared.Classes :=
  classes.map (fun entry => (entry.1, ⟨entry.2.fields, .classType⟩))

def embedProgram (program : Unique.Program) : Shared.Program :=
  ⟨embedClasses program.classes, program.body.map embedStatement⟩

def embedConfiguration (configuration : Unique.Configuration) : Shared.Configuration :=
  ⟨embedState configuration.state, configuration.code.map embedStatement⟩

section Proofs

@[simp] theorem erase_embed_slots {Key : Type} (slots : List (Key × Unique.Slot)) :
    eraseSlots (embedSlots slots) = slots := by
  induction slots with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons entry rest ih =>
    rcases entry with ⟨key, slot⟩
    cases slot <;> simpa [embedSlots, eraseSlots, embedReference, eraseReference, embedId, eraseId, Shared.Reference.owned] using ih

@[simp] theorem erase_embed_state (state : Unique.State) : eraseState (embedState state) = state := by
  cases state
  simp [eraseState, embedState, eraseObject, embedObject, List.map_map, Function.comp_def]

@[simp] theorem erase_embed_place (place : Unique.Place) : erasePlace (embedPlace place) = place := by
  induction place with
  | «variable» => rfl
  | field base name ih => simp [embedPlace, erasePlace, ih]

@[simp] theorem erase_embed_storage (place : Unique.StoragePlace) :
    eraseStorage (embedStorage place) = place := by cases place <;> rfl

def PureSlots {Key : Type} (slots : List (Key × Shared.Slot)) : Prop :=
  ∀ key reference, (key, some reference) ∈ slots → reference.mode = .unique

def Pure (state : Shared.State) : Prop :=
  PureSlots state.variables ∧
    ∀ object data, (object, data) ∈ state.objects → PureSlots data.fields

@[simp] theorem pure_slots_append {Key : Type} (left right : List (Key × Shared.Slot)) :
    PureSlots (left ++ right) ↔ PureSlots left ∧ PureSlots right := by
  simp [PureSlots, List.mem_append, or_imp, forall_and]

@[simp] theorem pure_slots_cons {Key : Type} (key : Key) (slot : Shared.Slot)
    (rest : List (Key × Shared.Slot)) :
    PureSlots ((key, slot) :: rest) ↔
      (∀ reference, slot = some reference → reference.mode = .unique) ∧ PureSlots rest := by
  simp only [PureSlots, List.mem_cons, Prod.mk.injEq]
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact ⟨fun reference equal => h key reference (Or.inl ⟨rfl, equal.symm⟩),
      fun key reference member => h key reference (Or.inr member)⟩
  · rintro ⟨head, tail⟩ key reference (⟨rfl, equal⟩ | member)
    · exact head reference equal.symm
    · exact tail key reference member

theorem embed_slots_pure {Key : Type} (slots : List (Key × Unique.Slot)) :
    PureSlots (embedSlots slots) := by
  intro key reference member
  obtain ⟨⟨oldKey, oldSlot⟩, _, equal⟩ := List.mem_map.mp member
  cases oldSlot <;> simp_all [embedReference, Shared.Reference.owned]
  grind

theorem embed_pure (state : Unique.State) : Pure (embedState state) := by
  constructor
  · exact embed_slots_pure _
  · intro object data member
    obtain ⟨⟨id, old⟩, _, equal⟩ := List.mem_map.mp member
    cases equal
    exact embed_slots_pure _

theorem pure_slots_roundtrip {Key : Type} {slots : List (Key × Shared.Slot)} (pure : PureSlots slots) :
    embedSlots (eraseSlots slots) = slots := by
  induction slots with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons entry rest ih =>
    rcases entry with ⟨key, slot⟩
    have parts := (pure_slots_cons key slot rest).mp pure
    cases slot with
    | none => simpa [embedSlots, eraseSlots] using ih parts.2
    | some reference =>
      cases reference with
      | reference mode object =>
        have modeEq := parts.1 ⟨mode, object⟩ rfl
        cases modeEq
        simpa [embedSlots, eraseSlots, embedReference, eraseReference, embedId, eraseId, Shared.Reference.owned] using ih parts.2

theorem pure_roundtrip (pure : Pure state) : embedState (eraseState state) = state := by
  cases state with
  | mk objects variables next =>
    simp only [embedState, eraseState, List.map_map, Function.comp_def]
    congr 1
    · conv => rhs; rw [← List.map_id objects]
      apply List.map_congr_left
      intro entry member
      have roundtrip := pure_slots_roundtrip (pure.2 entry.1 entry.2 member)
      rcases entry with ⟨id, ⟨name, fields⟩⟩
      simpa [embedObject, eraseObject] using congrArg (fun fs => (id, Shared.Object.mk name fs)) roundtrip
    · exact pure_slots_roundtrip pure.1

theorem resolve_erase (resolved : Shared.Resolve state path source object mode) :
    Unique.Resolve (eraseState state) (erasePlace path) (eraseStorage source) (eraseId object) := by
  induction resolved with
  | «variable» stored =>
    apply Unique.Resolve.variable
    exact List.mem_map.mpr ⟨(_, _), stored, rfl⟩
  | field base allocated stored ih =>
    apply Unique.Resolve.field ih (data := eraseObject _)
    · exact List.mem_map.mpr ⟨(_, _), allocated, rfl⟩
    · exact List.mem_map.mpr ⟨(_, _), stored, rfl⟩

theorem resolve_pure (pure : Pure state)
    (resolved : Shared.Resolve state path source object mode) : mode = .unique := by
  induction resolved with
  | «variable» stored => exact pure.1 _ _ stored
  | field base allocated stored ih =>
    rw [ih, pure.2 _ _ allocated _ _ stored]
    rfl

theorem take_erase (taken : Shared.Take before source object after) :
    Unique.Take (eraseState before) (eraseStorage source) (eraseId object) (eraseState after) := by
  cases taken with
  | «variable» objects next leading suffix name object =>
    simpa [eraseState, eraseSlots, eraseStorage, eraseReference, Shared.Reference.owned] using
      Unique.Take.variable (objects.map (fun e => (eraseId e.1, eraseObject e.2))) next
        (eraseSlots leading) (eraseSlots suffix) name (eraseId object)
  | field variables next before after parent className leading suffix name object =>
    simpa [eraseState, eraseSlots, eraseObject, eraseStorage, eraseReference, Shared.Reference.owned] using
      Unique.Take.field (eraseSlots variables) next
        (before.map (fun e => (eraseId e.1, eraseObject e.2)))
        (after.map (fun e => (eraseId e.1, eraseObject e.2))) (eraseId parent) className
        (eraseSlots leading) (eraseSlots suffix) name (eraseId object)

theorem take_pure (pure : Pure before) (taken : Shared.Take before source object after) :
    Pure after := by
  cases taken <;> simp_all [Pure, PureSlots, List.mem_append, List.mem_cons,
    Shared.Reference.owned, or_imp, forall_and] <;> grind

theorem resolve_forward (resolved : Unique.Resolve state path source object) :
    Shared.Resolve (embedState state) (embedPlace path) (embedStorage source) (embedId object) .unique := by
  induction resolved with
  | «variable» stored =>
    exact Shared.Resolve.variable (reference := embedReference _) (List.mem_map.mpr ⟨(_, _), stored, rfl⟩)
  | field base allocated stored ih =>
    exact Shared.Resolve.field (reference := embedReference _) ih
      (List.mem_map.mpr ⟨(_, _), allocated, rfl⟩) (List.mem_map.mpr ⟨(_, _), stored, rfl⟩)

theorem take_forward (taken : Unique.Take before source object after) :
    Shared.Take (embedState before) (embedStorage source) (embedId object) (embedState after) := by
  cases taken with
  | «variable» objects next leading suffix name object =>
    simpa [embedState, embedSlots, embedStorage, embedReference] using
      Shared.Take.variable (objects.map (fun e => (embedId e.1, embedObject e.2))) next
        (embedSlots leading) (embedSlots suffix) name (embedId object)
  | field variables next before after parent className leading suffix name object =>
    simpa [embedState, embedSlots, embedObject, embedStorage, embedReference] using
      Shared.Take.field (embedSlots variables) next
        (before.map (fun e => (embedId e.1, embedObject e.2)))
        (after.map (fun e => (embedId e.1, embedObject e.2))) (embedId parent) className
        (embedSlots leading) (embedSlots suffix) name (embedId object)

@[simp] theorem embed_slots_keys {Key : Type} (slots : List (Key × Unique.Slot)) :
    (embedSlots slots).map Prod.fst = slots.map Prod.fst := by
  simp [embedSlots, List.map_map, Function.comp_def]

@[simp] theorem embed_bind (state : Unique.State) (name : Unique.VariableId) (object : Unique.ObjectId) :
    embedState (state.bind name object) = (embedState state).bind name (embedReference object) := by
  rfl

@[simp] theorem erase_bind (state : Shared.State) (name : Shared.VariableId) (reference : Shared.Reference) :
    eraseState (state.bind name reference) = (eraseState state).bind name (eraseReference reference) := by
  rfl

theorem embed_fields (fields : List String) (objects : List Unique.ObjectId) :
    embedSlots (fields.zip (objects.map some)) =
      fields.zip ((objects.map embedReference).map some) := by
  induction fields generalizing objects with
  | nil => simp [embedSlots]
  | cons field fields ih =>
    cases objects with
    | nil => simp [embedSlots]
    | cons object objects => simpa [embedSlots] using ih objects

@[simp] theorem embed_allocate (state : Unique.State) (className : String)
    (fields : List String) (objects : List Unique.ObjectId) :
    embedState (state.allocate className fields objects) =
      (embedState state).allocate className fields (objects.map embedReference) := by
  simp [embedState, Unique.State.allocate, Shared.State.allocate, embedObject, embed_fields, embedId]

@[simp] theorem embed_nextId (state : Unique.State) :
    (embedState state).nextId = state.nextId := rfl

@[simp] theorem embed_object_fresh (state : Unique.State) :
    Shared.ObjectId.mk state.nextId ∉ (embedState state).objects.map Prod.fst ↔
      Unique.ObjectId.mk state.nextId ∉ state.objects.map Prod.fst := by
  have keys : (embedState state).objects.map Prod.fst =
      (state.objects.map Prod.fst).map embedId := by
    simp [embedState, List.map_map, Function.comp_def]
  change embedId ⟨state.nextId⟩ ∉ _ ↔ _
  rw [keys]
  simp only [List.mem_map, embed_id_inj, exists_eq_right]

-- Giving from an embedded graph cannot take either shared-copy case.
theorem give_backward (given : Shared.Give (embedState state) (embedPlace path) reference after) :
    ∃ source object, Unique.Resolve state path source object ∧
      Unique.Take state source object (eraseState after) ∧
      reference = embedReference object ∧ embedState (eraseState after) = after := by
  cases given with
  | move resolved taken =>
    exact ⟨_, _, by simpa using resolve_erase resolved,
      by simpa using take_erase taken, rfl, pure_roundtrip (take_pure (embed_pure _) taken)⟩
  | copy resolved stored => cases resolve_pure (embed_pure _) resolved
  | promote resolved promoted => cases resolve_pure (embed_pure _) resolved

theorem eval_forward (evaluated : Unique.Eval classes before value after object) :
    Shared.Eval (embedClasses classes) (embedState before) (embedValue value)
      (embedState after) (embedReference object) := by
  induction evaluated using Unique.Eval.rec
      (motive_2 := fun before values after objects _ =>
        Shared.EvalArgs (embedClasses classes) (embedState before) (values.map embedValue)
          (embedState after) (objects.map embedReference)) with
  | give resolved taken =>
    simpa only [embedValue, embedReference] using
      Shared.Eval.give (classes := embedClasses classes)
        (Shared.Give.move (resolve_forward resolved) (take_forward taken))
  | @new state evaluated className declaration arguments objects declared args lengths fresh ih =>
    simpa only [embedValue, embed_allocate, embedReference, embedId, embedClasses, embed_nextId, Shared.Kind.mode, Shared.Reference.owned] using
      Shared.Eval.new (declaration := ⟨declaration.fields, .classType⟩)
        (List.mem_map.mpr ⟨(_, _), declared, rfl⟩)
        ih (by simpa using lengths) ((embed_object_fresh evaluated).mpr fresh) (by simp [Shared.StructArguments, Shared.Kind.isStruct])
  | nil state => exact Shared.EvalArgs.nil (embedState state)
  | cons first rest firstIH restIH => exact Shared.EvalArgs.cons firstIH restIH

theorem eval_args_forward (evaluated : Unique.EvalArgs classes before values after objects) :
    Shared.EvalArgs (embedClasses classes) (embedState before) (values.map embedValue)
      (embedState after) (objects.map embedReference) := by
  induction values generalizing before after objects with
  | nil => cases evaluated; exact Shared.EvalArgs.nil _
  | cons argument arguments ih =>
    cases evaluated with
    | cons first rest => exact Shared.EvalArgs.cons (eval_forward first) (ih rest)

-- Reflection starts with an arbitrary Shared result. Pure input syntax and
-- storage force both its value and its resulting storage back into the image.
private theorem eval_backward_aux
    (evaluated : Shared.Eval (embedClasses classes) before value after reference) :
    ∀ original expression, before = embedState original → value = embedValue expression →
      ∃ result object, Unique.Eval classes original expression result object ∧
        after = embedState result ∧ reference = embedReference object := by
  induction evaluated using Shared.Eval.rec
      (motive_2 := fun before values after references _ =>
        ∀ original expressions, before = embedState original → values = expressions.map embedValue →
          ∃ result objects, Unique.EvalArgs classes original expressions result objects ∧
            after = embedState result ∧ references = objects.map embedReference) with
  | give given =>
    intro original expression beforeEq valueEq
    subst beforeEq
    cases expression with
    | give path =>
      simp only [embedValue, Shared.Value.give.injEq] at valueEq
      subst valueEq
      obtain ⟨source, object, resolved, taken, resultEq, roundtrip⟩ := give_backward given
      exact ⟨_, object, Unique.Eval.give resolved taken, roundtrip.symm, resultEq⟩
    | new name arguments => simp [embedValue] at valueEq
  | giveShare given _ =>
    intro original expression beforeEq valueEq
    cases expression <;> simp [embedValue] at valueEq
  | @new state evaluated className declaration arguments references declared args lengths fresh _ ih =>
    intro original expression beforeEq valueEq
    cases expression with
    | give path => simp [embedValue] at valueEq
    | new originalName originalArguments =>
      simp only [embedValue, Shared.Value.new.injEq] at valueEq
      obtain ⟨nameEq, argumentsEq⟩ := valueEq
      subst nameEq
      obtain ⟨result, objects, originalArgs, resultEq, referencesEq⟩ :=
        ih original originalArguments beforeEq argumentsEq
      subst resultEq
      subst referencesEq
      obtain ⟨⟨oldName, oldDeclaration⟩, originalDeclared, same⟩ := List.mem_map.mp declared
      simp only [Prod.mk.injEq] at same
      rcases same with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨result.allocate oldName oldDeclaration.fields objects, ⟨result.nextId⟩,
        Unique.Eval.new originalDeclared originalArgs (by simpa using lengths)
          ((embed_object_fresh result).mp fresh), ?_, rfl⟩
      exact (embed_allocate result oldName oldDeclaration.fields objects).symm
  | nil state =>
    rename_i original expressions beforeEq valuesEq
    cases expressions with
    | nil => exact ⟨original, [], Unique.EvalArgs.nil original, beforeEq, rfl⟩
    | cons head tail => simp at valuesEq
  | cons first rest firstIH restIH =>
    rename_i original expressions beforeEq valuesEq
    cases expressions with
    | nil => simp at valuesEq
    | cons expression expressions =>
      simp only [List.map_cons, List.cons.injEq] at valuesEq
      obtain ⟨middle, object, originalFirst, middleEq, objectEq⟩ :=
        firstIH original expression beforeEq valuesEq.1
      obtain ⟨result, objects, originalRest, resultEq, objectsEq⟩ :=
        restIH middle expressions middleEq valuesEq.2
      exact ⟨result, object :: objects, Unique.EvalArgs.cons originalFirst originalRest,
        resultEq, by simp [objectEq, objectsEq]⟩

theorem eval_backward
    (evaluated : Shared.Eval (embedClasses classes) (embedState before)
      (embedValue value) after reference) :
    ∃ result object, Unique.Eval classes before value result object ∧
      after = embedState result ∧ reference = embedReference object :=
  eval_backward_aux evaluated before value rfl rfl

theorem eval_args_backward
    (evaluated : Shared.EvalArgs (embedClasses classes) (embedState before)
      (values.map embedValue) after references) :
    ∃ result objects, Unique.EvalArgs classes before values result objects ∧
      after = embedState result ∧ references = objects.map embedReference := by
  induction values generalizing before after references with
  | nil =>
    cases evaluated
    exact ⟨before, [], Unique.EvalArgs.nil before, rfl, rfl⟩
  | cons argument arguments ih =>
    cases evaluated with
    | cons first rest =>
      obtain ⟨middle, object, originalFirst, middleEq, referenceEq⟩ := eval_backward first
      rw [middleEq] at rest
      obtain ⟨result, objects, originalRest, resultEq, referencesEq⟩ := ih rest
      exact ⟨result, object :: objects, Unique.EvalArgs.cons originalFirst originalRest,
        resultEq, by simp [referenceEq, referencesEq]⟩

theorem eval_correspondence :
    Shared.Eval (embedClasses classes) (embedState before) (embedValue value) after reference ↔
      ∃ result object, Unique.Eval classes before value result object ∧
        after = embedState result ∧ reference = embedReference object := by
  constructor
  · exact eval_backward
  · rintro ⟨result, object, evaluated, rfl, rfl⟩
    exact eval_forward evaluated

theorem eval_args_correspondence :
    Shared.EvalArgs (embedClasses classes) (embedState before) (values.map embedValue) after references ↔
      ∃ result objects, Unique.EvalArgs classes before values result objects ∧
        after = embedState result ∧ references = objects.map embedReference := by
  constructor
  · exact eval_args_backward
  · rintro ⟨result, objects, evaluated, rfl, rfl⟩
    exact eval_args_forward evaluated

theorem step_forward (step : Unique.Step classes before after) :
    Shared.Step (embedClasses classes) (embedConfiguration before) (embedConfiguration after) := by
  cases step with
  | letValue fresh evaluated =>
    simpa only [embedConfiguration, List.map_cons, embedStatement, embed_bind] using
      Shared.Step.letValue (by simpa only [embedState, embed_slots_keys] using fresh)
        (eval_forward evaluated)

-- The quantified successor is arbitrary, not assumed to be an embedding.
theorem step_backward (step : Shared.Step (embedClasses classes) (embedConfiguration before) after) :
    ∃ successor, Unique.Step classes before successor ∧ after = embedConfiguration successor := by
  rcases before with ⟨state, code⟩
  cases code with
  | nil => cases step
  | cons statement rest =>
    rcases statement with ⟨destination, value⟩
    change Shared.Step _ ⟨embedState state,
      ⟨destination, embedValue value⟩ :: rest.map embedStatement⟩ after at step
    cases step with
    | letValue fresh evaluated =>
      obtain ⟨result, object, original, resultEq, referenceEq⟩ := eval_backward evaluated
      subst resultEq
      subst referenceEq
      refine ⟨⟨result.bind destination object, rest⟩,
        Unique.Step.letValue (by simpa only [embedState, embed_slots_keys] using fresh) original, ?_⟩
      simp only [embedConfiguration, embed_bind]

-- The embedding preserves the complete program, including its remaining code.
theorem initial_correspondence (program : Unique.Program) :
    embedConfiguration (Unique.Configuration.initial program) =
      Shared.Configuration.initial (embedProgram program) := by rfl

theorem finished_correspondence (configuration : Unique.Configuration) :
    (embedConfiguration configuration).finished ↔ configuration.finished := by
  simp [Shared.Configuration.finished, Unique.Configuration.finished, embedConfiguration]


theorem stuck_correspondence (classes : Unique.Classes) (configuration : Unique.Configuration) :
    Shared.Stuck (embedClasses classes) (embedConfiguration configuration) ↔
