theorem ResultTyped.exists_eval (typed : ResultTyped classes environment value result final)
    (realized : Realizes classes environment state pending) :
    ∃ evaluated reference, ResultEval classes.erase state value evaluated reference ∧
      reference.isSome = result.isSome := by
  cases typed with
  | none _ => exact ⟨state,Option.none,.none _,rfl⟩
  | some expression =>
    obtain ⟨evaluated,reference,evaluation⟩ := (expression.sound _ _ realized).1
    exact ⟨evaluated,Option.some reference,.some evaluation,rfl⟩

theorem DestinationTyped.exists_deliver
    (typed : DestinationTyped classes environment destination result after)
    (slots : Slots environment variables roots)
    (shape : reference.isSome = result.isSome) :
    ∃ delivered, Deliver variables destination reference delivered := by
  cases typed with
  | none _ => cases reference <;> simp at shape; exact ⟨variables,.none _⟩
  | some binding =>
    cases reference with
    | none => cases shape
    | some reference =>
      cases binding with
      | «variable» _ _ fresh =>
        exact ⟨_,.some (slots.keys ▸ fresh)⟩

theorem binding_keys (typed : BindingTyped classes before pattern ty after)
    (operation : Unpacking.Bind classes.erase state reference pattern result)
    (keys : before.map Prod.fst = state.variables.map Prod.fst) :
    after.map Prod.fst = result.variables.map Prod.fst := by
  cases typed with
  | «variable» _ _ _ => cases operation; simp [State.bind, keys]
  | unpack _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ fields _ =>
    cases operation with
    | unpack _ _ _ _ _ transfer => simp [List.map_append, fields.keys, transfer.keys, keys]

theorem Slots.parameters (parameters : List Parameter) (references : List Reference)
    (lengths : references.length = parameters.length) :
    Slots (Signature.environment ⟨parameters,result⟩) (parameterStore parameters references)
      (references.zip (parameters.map (fun p => p.type.toType))) := by
  induction parameters generalizing references with
  | nil => have : references = [] := List.length_eq_zero_iff.mp lengths; subst references; exact .nil
  | cons parameter parameters ih =>
    cases references with
    | nil => simp at lengths
    | cons reference references =>
      exact .value parameter.name reference parameter.type.toType (ih references (Nat.succ.inj lengths))

def resultRoots (reference : Option Reference) (result : Option FieldType) : PendingValues :=
  reference.toList.zip (result.toList.map FieldType.toType)

theorem ResultTyped.preserves (typed : ResultTyped classes before value result after)
    (realized : Realizes classes before state pending)
    (evaluation : ResultEval classes.erase state value evaluated reference) :
    Realizes classes after evaluated (resultRoots reference result ++ pending) ∧
      after.map Prod.fst = before.map Prod.fst ∧ evaluated.variables.map Prod.fst = state.variables.map Prod.fst := by
  cases typed with
  | none _ => cases evaluation; exact ⟨realized,rfl,rfl⟩
  | some expression =>
    cases evaluation with
    | some evaluation => exact ⟨(expression.sound _ _ realized).2 _ _ evaluation,expression.keys,evaluation.variable_keys⟩

theorem DestinationTyped.preserves (typed : DestinationTyped classes before destination result after)
    (realized : Realizes classes before ⟨objects,variables,nextId⟩ (resultRoots reference result ++ pending))
    (keys : before.map Prod.fst = variables.map Prod.fst)
    (delivery : Deliver variables destination reference delivered) :
    Realizes classes after ⟨objects,delivered,nextId⟩ pending ∧ after.map Prod.fst = delivered.map Prod.fst := by
  cases typed with
  | none _ => cases delivery; exact ⟨realized,keys⟩
  | some binding =>
    cases delivery with
    | some fresh =>
      exact ⟨binding.preserves_realization_pending realized (.variable fresh),
        by simpa [State.bind] using (binding_keys (state := ⟨objects,variables,nextId⟩)
          (reference := .owned 0) binding (.variable fresh) keys)⟩

theorem ConfigurationTyped.progress {configuration : Configuration}
    (typed : ConfigurationTyped classes declarations configuration) :
    configuration.finished ∨ ∃ after, Step classes.erase declarations configuration after := by
  rcases configuration with ⟨objects,nextId,frames⟩
  obtain ⟨classesWf,declarationsWf,roots,shape,heap⟩ := typed
  cases shape with
  | done => exact .inl rfl
  | @active frame rest environment localRoots laterRoots result slots envWf body continuation =>
    have realized := from_heap heap slots envWf
    rcases frame with ⟨variables,frameBody,destination⟩
    rcases frameBody with ⟨code,returnValue⟩
    obtain ⟨middle,final,sequence,returned⟩ := body
    right
    cases code with
    | cons first restCode =>
      cases sequence with
      | cons firstTyped tail =>
        cases firstTyped with
        | «local» localTyped =>
          cases localTyped with
          | letValue expression binding =>
            obtain ⟨evaluated,reference,evaluation⟩ := (expression.sound _ _ realized).1
            have evaluatedRealized := (expression.sound _ _ realized).2 _ _ evaluation
            obtain ⟨after,operation⟩ := binding.exists_bind_pending evaluatedRealized
            exact ⟨_,.collect (.local (.letValue evaluation operation))⟩
        | call declared fresh args dest =>
          obtain ⟨evaluated,references,evaluation⟩ := (args.sound _ _ realized).1
          exact ⟨_,.collect (.call declared dest.shape
            (fun x member occupied => fresh x member ((realized.variableDomain x).mpr occupied))
            evaluation (by simpa using evaluation.length.trans args.length))⟩
    | nil =>
      cases sequence with
      | nil _ =>
        obtain ⟨evaluated,reference,evaluation,resultShape⟩ := returned.exists_eval realized
        cases continuation with
        | done =>
          cases returned with
          | none _ => exact ⟨_,.collect .exit⟩
        | caller callerSlots _ delivery _ _ =>
          obtain ⟨variables,delivered⟩ := delivery.exists_deliver callerSlots resultShape
          exact ⟨_,.collect (.return evaluation delivered)⟩

theorem evalArgs_keys (evaluation : EvalArgs classes before arguments after references) :
    after.variables.map Prod.fst = before.variables.map Prod.fst := by
  induction evaluation using EvalArgs.rec (motive_1 := fun _ _ _ _ _ => True) with
  | give => trivial
  | giveShare => trivial
  | new => trivial
  | nil => rfl
  | cons first _ _ ih => exact ih.trans first.variable_keys

theorem RawStep.preserves {before after : Configuration}
    (typed : ConfigurationTyped classes declarations before)
    (step : RawStep classes.erase declarations before after) :
    ConfigurationTyped classes declarations after.collect := by
  obtain ⟨classesWf,declarationsWf,roots,shape,heap⟩ := typed
  cases step with
  | @«local» beforeState afterState statement rest result frames destination operation =>
    cases shape with
    | active slots envWf body continuation =>
      obtain ⟨middle,final,sequence,returned⟩ := body
      cases sequence with
      | cons first tail =>
        cases first with
        | «local» localTyped =>
          cases localTyped with
          | letValue expression binding =>
            cases operation with
            | letValue evaluation bound =>
              have realized := from_heap heap slots envWf
              have evaluated := (expression.sound _ _ realized).2 _ _ evaluation
              have afterRealized := binding.preserves_realization_pending evaluated bound
              have keys := binding_keys binding bound
                (expression.keys.trans (slots.keys.trans evaluation.variable_keys.symm))
              obtain ⟨afterRoots,afterSlots⟩ := realized_slots afterRealized keys
              have afterHeap := to_heap afterRealized afterSlots
              apply collect_typed (garbage := []) classesWf declarationsWf
                (.active (frame := ⟨afterState.variables,⟨rest,result⟩,destination⟩) afterSlots afterRealized.environmentWellFormed ⟨middle,final,tail,returned⟩ continuation)
              simpa only [List.append_nil,heapState,Configuration.rootState,Configuration.running] using afterHeap
  | @call beforeState evaluated destination name arguments rest result frames returnTo declaration references
      declared resultShape fresh evaluation lengths =>
    cases shape with
    | active slots envWf body continuation =>
      obtain ⟨middle,final,sequence,returned⟩ := body
      cases sequence with
      | cons first tail =>
        cases first with
        | call expectedMember _ args delivery =>
          have same := member_value_unique declarationsWf.1 expectedMember declared
          cases same
          have realized := from_heap heap slots envWf
          have evaluatedRealized := (args.sound _ _ realized).2 _ _ evaluation
          have keys := args.keys.trans (slots.keys.trans (evalArgs_keys evaluation).symm)
          obtain ⟨callerRoots,callerSlots⟩ := realized_slots evaluatedRealized keys
          have callerHeap := to_heap evaluatedRealized callerSlots
          obtain ⟨signatureWf,calleeBody⟩ := declarationsWf.2 _ declared
          have calleeSlots := Slots.parameters (result := declaration.signature.result) declaration.signature.parameters references lengths
          have calleeWf := (BodyFrom.of_declaration calleeBody).sequence_wf
          apply collect_typed (garbage := []) classesWf declarationsWf
            (.active (frame := ⟨parameterStore declaration.signature.parameters references,declaration.body,destination⟩) calleeSlots calleeWf calleeBody
              (.caller (caller := ⟨evaluated.variables,⟨rest,result⟩,returnTo⟩) callerSlots evaluatedRealized.environmentWellFormed delivery
                ⟨middle,final,tail,returned⟩ continuation))
          apply callerHeap.perm
          simp only [List.map_map, Function.comp_def, List.append_nil]
          apply List.Perm.trans (List.Perm.of_eq (List.append_assoc _ _ _).symm)
          apply List.Perm.trans (List.perm_append_comm.append_right _)
          exact List.Perm.of_eq (List.append_assoc _ _ _)
  | @«return» beforeState evaluated result reference caller frames destination variables evaluation delivered =>
    cases shape with
    | active slots envWf body continuation =>
      obtain ⟨middle,final,sequence,returned⟩ := body
      cases sequence with
      | nil _ =>
        cases continuation with
        | @caller _ _ _ _ callerEnvironment resumed callerRoots laterRoots callerResult callerSlots callerWf delivery callerBody rest =>
          have realized := from_heap heap slots envWf
          obtain ⟨evaluatedRealized,staticKeys,runtimeKeys⟩ := returned.preserves realized evaluation
          obtain ⟨discarded,discardedSlots⟩ := realized_slots evaluatedRealized
            (staticKeys.trans (slots.keys.trans runtimeKeys.symm))
          have calleeHeap := to_heap evaluatedRealized discardedSlots
          have callerHeap := calleeHeap.perm (show
              (discarded ++ (resultRoots reference _ ++ (callerRoots ++ laterRoots))).Perm
              (callerRoots ++ (resultRoots reference _ ++ (laterRoots ++ discarded))) from by
            exact List.perm_append_comm.trans (by
              simpa only [List.append_assoc] using
                (List.perm_append_comm (l₁ := resultRoots reference _) (l₂ := callerRoots)).append_right (laterRoots ++ discarded)))
          have callerRealized := from_heap callerHeap callerSlots callerWf
          obtain ⟨resumedRealized,resumedKeys⟩ := delivery.preserves callerRealized callerSlots.keys delivered
          obtain ⟨resumedRoots,resumedSlots⟩ := realized_slots resumedRealized resumedKeys
          have resumedHeap := to_heap resumedRealized resumedSlots
          apply collect_typed classesWf declarationsWf (.active (frame := ⟨variables,caller.body,caller.destination⟩) resumedSlots resumedRealized.environmentWellFormed callerBody rest)
          simpa only [List.append_assoc,heapState,Configuration.rootState,Configuration.running] using resumedHeap
  | exit =>
    apply collect_typed (roots := []) classesWf declarationsWf .done
    exact heap

theorem ConfigurationTyped.preservation {before after : Configuration}
    (typed : ConfigurationTyped classes declarations before)
    (step : Step classes.erase declarations before after) :
    ConfigurationTyped classes declarations after := by
  cases step with
  | collect raw => exact raw.preserves typed

theorem ConfigurationTyped.trace {before after : Configuration}
    (typed : ConfigurationTyped classes declarations before)
    (trace : Steps classes.erase declarations before after) :
    ConfigurationTyped classes declarations after := by
  induction trace with
  | refl => exact typed
  | step first _ ih => exact ih (typed.preservation first)

theorem ConfigurationTyped.finished_heap_empty {configuration : Configuration}
    (typed : ConfigurationTyped classes declarations configuration)
    (finished : configuration.finished) : configuration.objects = [] := by
  rcases configuration with ⟨objects,nextId,frames⟩
  change frames = [] at finished
  subst frames
  obtain ⟨_,_,roots,shape,heap⟩ := typed
  cases shape
  have same := State.collect_eq_self heap.ownership.no_pending
  rw [heapState,State.collect_no_variables] at same
  exact (congrArg State.objects same).symm

-- Owners retain their multiplicity: two distinct slots holding the same
-- shared reference count twice. Frame-local names need not be globally unique.
theorem ConfigurationTyped.ownership {configuration : Configuration}
    (typed : ConfigurationTyped classes declarations configuration) :
    (Owners configuration.rootState).Pairwise Compatible ∧
    (∀ id, id ∈ References configuration.rootState ↔ Allocated configuration.rootState id) := by
  obtain ⟨_,_,roots,shape,heap⟩ := typed
  have refs := shape.references
  constructor
  · simpa only [Owners,heapState,List.filterMap_nil,List.nil_append,refs,
      Configuration.rootState] using heap.ownership.ownersCompatible
  · intro id
    have complete := heap.ownership.referencesComplete id
    simpa only [heapState,References,List.filterMap_nil,List.nil_append,refs,
      Configuration.rootState,Allocated,List.map_append,List.map_filterMap,Function.comp_def] using complete

theorem program_safety (typed : ProgramTyped program)
    (trace : Steps program.classes.erase program.declarations (.initial program) configuration) :
    ConfigurationTyped program.classes program.declarations configuration ∧
    (configuration.finished ∨ ∃ after, Step program.classes.erase program.declarations configuration after) ∧
    ¬ Stuck program.classes.erase program.declarations configuration := by
  have preserved := (ConfigurationTyped.initial typed).trace trace
  have progress := preserved.progress
  refine ⟨preserved,progress,?_⟩
  intro stuck
  rcases progress with finished | successor
  · exact stuck.1 finished
  · exact stuck.2 successor

end Dada.Functions

-- ANCHOR: nested_safety
example :
    (∀ configuration, Steps classes.erase nestedTable (.initial nestedProgram) configuration →
      ConfigurationTyped classes nestedTable configuration ∧ ¬ Stuck classes.erase nestedTable configuration) ∧
    ConfigurationTyped classes nestedTable nestedReturned ∧
    ConfigurationTyped classes nestedTable ⟨[],1,[]⟩ := by
  refine ⟨fun configuration trace => ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have safe := program_safety nested_typed trace
    exact ⟨safe.1,safe.2.2⟩
  · exact (program_safety nested_typed nested_execution).1
  · have exit : RawStep classes.erase nestedTable nestedReturned ⟨nestedReturned.objects,1,[]⟩ := .exit
    have collected := Step.collect exit
    simp only [Configuration.collect_empty_frames] at collected
    exact (program_safety nested_typed nested_execution).1.preservation collected
-- ANCHOR_END: nested_safety

private theorem recursion_typed : ProgramTyped recursionProgram := by
  have statement : StatementTyped classes recursionTable [] (.call none (.function "recur") []) [] :=
    .call (declaration := recur) (by simp [recursionTable]) (by simp)
      (.nil (by decide)) (.none (by decide))
  refine ⟨by decide, ⟨by decide, ?_⟩, [], .cons statement (.nil (by decide))⟩
  intro entry member
  have : entry = (.function "recur", recur) := by simpa [recursionProgram,recursionTable] using member
  subst entry
  exact ⟨by decide, [], [], .cons statement (.nil (by decide)), .none (by decide)⟩

-- ANCHOR: recursion_safety
example : ∀ depth,
    ConfigurationTyped classes recursionTable (recursionState depth) ∧
    ¬ Stuck classes.erase recursionTable (recursionState depth) ∧
    Step classes.erase recursionTable (recursionState depth) (recursionState (depth+1)) := by
  intro depth
  have safe := program_safety recursion_typed (recursion_reachable depth)
  exact ⟨safe.1,safe.2.2,recursive_step depth⟩
-- ANCHOR_END: recursion_safety

end Dada.Functions.Checks

import Functions.Realization

namespace Dada.Functions
open Shared Shared.Typing

-- The active body's final expression has this result type; no termination
-- condition is imposed on recursive calls.
def BodyFrom (classes : ClassTable) (declarations : Declarations) (environment : Environment)
    (body : Body) (result : Option FieldType) : Prop :=
  ∃ middle final, SequenceTyped classes declarations environment body.statements middle ∧
    ResultTyped classes middle body.result result final

-- A suspended caller is checked starting with the environment that delivery
-- will produce, while its stored locals realize the environment before delivery.
inductive ContinuationTyped (classes : ClassTable) (declarations : Declarations) : Option VariableId → Option FieldType → List Frame → PendingValues → Prop where
  | done : ContinuationTyped classes declarations none none [] []
  | caller {destination result caller rest environment resumed roots laterRoots callerResult} :
      Slots environment caller.variables roots → environment.WellFormed classes →
      DestinationTyped classes environment destination result resumed →
      BodyFrom classes declarations resumed caller.body callerResult →
      ContinuationTyped classes declarations caller.destination callerResult rest laterRoots →
      ContinuationTyped classes declarations destination result (caller :: rest) (roots ++ laterRoots)

inductive StackShape (classes : ClassTable) (declarations : Declarations) : List Frame → PendingValues → Prop where
  | done : StackShape classes declarations [] []
  | active {frame rest environment roots laterRoots result} :
      Slots environment frame.variables roots → environment.WellFormed classes →
      BodyFrom classes declarations environment frame.body result →
      ContinuationTyped classes declarations frame.destination result rest laterRoots →
      StackShape classes declarations (frame :: rest) (roots ++ laterRoots)

def ConfigurationTyped (classes : ClassTable) (declarations : Declarations) (configuration : Configuration) : Prop :=
  classes.WellFormed ∧ DeclarationsTyped classes declarations ∧
  ∃ roots, StackShape classes declarations configuration.frames roots ∧
    Realizes classes [] (heapState configuration.rootState) roots

theorem ContinuationTyped.references (typed : ContinuationTyped classes declarations destination result frames roots) :
    roots.map Prod.fst = (frames.flatMap Frame.variables).filterMap Prod.snd := by
  induction typed with
  | done => rfl
  | caller slots _ _ _ _ ih => simp [List.filterMap_append, slots.references, ih]

theorem StackShape.references (typed : StackShape classes declarations frames roots) :
    roots.map Prod.fst = (frames.flatMap Frame.variables).filterMap Prod.snd := by
  cases typed with
  | done => rfl
  | active slots _ _ continuation => simp [List.filterMap_append, slots.references, continuation.references]

theorem reachable_iff_live (state : State) (roots : List Reference)
    (same : roots = state.variables.filterMap Prod.snd) :
    Reachable state.objects roots object ↔ Live state object := by
  constructor
  · intro reached
    induction reached with
    | root member =>
      rw [same] at member
      obtain ⟨⟨name,slot⟩,stored,value⟩ := List.mem_filterMap.mp member
      change slot = some _ at value
      subst slot; exact .variable stored
    | field _ stored field ih => exact .field ih stored field
  · intro live
    induction live with
    | «variable» stored => exact .root (same ▸ List.mem_filterMap.mpr ⟨_,stored,rfl⟩)
    | field _ stored field ih => exact .field ih stored field

theorem collect_heap {configuration : Configuration} (shape : StackShape classes declarations configuration.frames roots) :
    collectPending (heapState configuration.rootState) roots = heapState configuration.collect.rootState := by
  classical
  have live (id : ObjectId) :
      Reachable configuration.objects (roots.map Prod.fst) id ↔ Live configuration.rootState id :=
    reachable_iff_live (object := id) configuration.rootState (roots.map Prod.fst) shape.references
  simp only [collectPending, heapState, rootReferences, List.filterMap_nil, List.append_nil,
    Configuration.collect, Configuration.rootState, State.collect]
  congr 1
  apply List.filter_congr
  intro entry member
  exact propext (live entry.1) ▸ rfl

theorem collect_typed {configuration : Configuration} (classesWf : classes.WellFormed) (declarationsWf : DeclarationsTyped classes declarations)
    (shape : StackShape classes declarations configuration.frames roots)
    (realized : Realizes classes [] (heapState configuration.rootState) (roots ++ garbage)) :
    ConfigurationTyped classes declarations configuration.collect := by
  refine ⟨classesWf,declarationsWf,roots,?_,?_⟩
  · simpa using shape
  · have kept := realized.collect_pending (List.sublist_append_left roots garbage)
    rwa [collect_heap shape] at kept

theorem BodyFrom.of_declaration (typed : BodyTyped classes declarations signature body) :
    BodyFrom classes declarations signature.environment body signature.result := typed

theorem SequenceTyped.wellFormed (typed : SequenceTyped classes declarations before code after) :
    before.WellFormed classes ∧ after.WellFormed classes := by
  induction typed with
  | nil wf => exact ⟨wf,wf⟩
  | cons first _ ih =>
    constructor
    · cases first with
      | «local» t => exact t.wellFormed.1
      | call _ _ args _ => exact args.wellFormed.1
    · exact ih.2

theorem BodyFrom.sequence_wf (typed : BodyFrom classes declarations environment body result) :
    environment.WellFormed classes := by
  obtain ⟨middle,final,sequence,_⟩ := typed
  exact sequence.wellFormed.1

theorem ConfigurationTyped.initial (typed : ProgramTyped program) :
    ConfigurationTyped program.classes program.declarations (.initial program) := by
  obtain ⟨classesWf,declarationsWf,final,sequence⟩ := typed
  have finalWf := sequence.wellFormed.2
  refine ⟨classesWf,declarationsWf,[],?_,Realizes.empty classesWf⟩
  exact .active (frame := ⟨[], ⟨program.main,none⟩,none⟩) .nil (by simp [Environment.WellFormed])
    ⟨final,final,sequence,.none finalWf⟩ .done

end Dada.Functions

namespace Dada.Functions

open Shared

abbrev Store := List (VariableId × Slot)

structure Frame where
  variables : Store
  body : Body
  destination : Option VariableId
  deriving Repr

structure Configuration where
  objects : List (ObjectId × Object)
  nextId : Nat
  frames : List Frame
  deriving Repr

def Configuration.running (state : State) (body : Body)
    (frames : List Frame := []) (destination : Option VariableId := none) : Configuration :=
  ⟨state.objects, state.nextId, ⟨state.variables, body, destination⟩ :: frames⟩

def Configuration.initial (program : Program) : Configuration :=
  .running State.empty ⟨program.main, none⟩

def Configuration.finished (configuration : Configuration) : Prop :=
  configuration.frames = []

-- Flattening is only for reachability; evaluation uses the top frame alone.
def Configuration.rootState (configuration : Configuration) : State :=
  ⟨configuration.objects, configuration.frames.flatMap Frame.variables, configuration.nextId⟩

def Configuration.roots (configuration : Configuration) : List Reference :=
  configuration.rootState.variables.filterMap Prod.snd

-- A mathematical collector, not an executable graph-traversal algorithm.
def Configuration.collect (configuration : Configuration) : Configuration := by
  exact { configuration with objects := configuration.rootState.collect.objects }

theorem Configuration.collect_frames (configuration : Configuration) :
    configuration.collect.frames = configuration.frames := rfl

theorem Configuration.collect_nextId (configuration : Configuration) :
    configuration.collect.nextId = configuration.nextId := rfl

theorem Configuration.collect_eq_self (configuration : Configuration)
    (rooted : ∀ id data, (id, data) ∈ configuration.objects → Live configuration.rootState id) :
    configuration.collect = configuration := by
  classical
  have same : configuration.objects.filter (fun entry => decide (Live configuration.rootState entry.1)) =
      configuration.objects := List.filter_eq_self.mpr (by
    intro entry member
    simpa using rooted entry.1 entry.2 member)
  change { configuration with objects := (configuration.objects.filter
    (fun entry => decide (Live configuration.rootState entry.1))) } = configuration
  rw [same]

theorem live_has_root (live : Live state object) : ∃ name reference,
    (name, some reference) ∈ state.variables := by
  induction live with
  | «variable» member => exact ⟨_, _, member⟩
  | field _ _ _ ih => exact ih

theorem no_roots_not_live (objects : List (ObjectId × Object)) (nextId : Nat) (object : ObjectId) :
    ¬ Live ⟨objects, [], nextId⟩ object := by
  intro live
  obtain ⟨_, _, member⟩ := live_has_root live
  simp at member

theorem Configuration.collect_empty_frames (objects : List (ObjectId × Object)) (nextId : Nat) :
    (Configuration.mk objects nextId []).collect = ⟨[], nextId, []⟩ := by
  simp [Configuration.collect, State.collect, Configuration.rootState, no_roots_not_live]

theorem Configuration.collect_empty_heap (nextId : Nat) (frames : List Frame) :
    (Configuration.mk [] nextId frames).collect = ⟨[], nextId, frames⟩ := by
  simp [Configuration.collect, State.collect, Configuration.rootState]

def parameterStore (parameters : List Parameter) (references : List Reference) : Store :=
  (parameters.map Parameter.name).zip (references.map some)

inductive ResultEval (classes : Classes) : State → Option Value → State → Option Reference → Prop where
  | none (state : State) : ResultEval classes state none state none
  | some {before after value reference} :
      Eval classes before value after reference →
      ResultEval classes before (some value) after (some reference)

inductive Deliver : Store → Option VariableId → Option Reference → Store → Prop where
  | none (variables : Store) : Deliver variables none none variables
  | some {variables name reference} :
      name ∉ variables.map Prod.fst →
      Deliver variables (some name) (some reference) ((name, some reference) :: variables)

def DestinationMatches (destination : Option VariableId)
    (result : Option Shared.Typing.FieldType) : Prop :=
  destination.isSome = result.isSome

-- Raw transitions transfer all temporary values before collection.
inductive RawStep (classes : Classes) (declarations : Declarations) : Configuration → Configuration → Prop where
  | local {before after statement rest result frames destination} :
      Unpacking.Step classes ⟨before, [statement]⟩ ⟨after, []⟩ →
      RawStep classes declarations
        (.running before ⟨.local statement :: rest, result⟩ frames destination)
        (.running after ⟨rest, result⟩ frames destination)
  | call {before evaluated destination name arguments rest result frames returnTo
      declaration references} :
      (name, declaration) ∈ declarations →
      DestinationMatches destination declaration.signature.result →
      (∀ x ∈ destination, x ∉ before.variables.map Prod.fst) →
      EvalArgs classes before arguments evaluated references →
      references.length = declaration.signature.parameters.length →
      RawStep classes declarations
        (.running before ⟨.call destination name arguments :: rest, result⟩ frames returnTo)
        (.running { evaluated with variables := parameterStore declaration.signature.parameters references }
          declaration.body (⟨evaluated.variables, ⟨rest, result⟩, returnTo⟩ :: frames) destination)
  | «return» {before evaluated result reference caller frames destination variables} :
      ResultEval classes before result evaluated reference →
      Deliver caller.variables destination reference variables →
      RawStep classes declarations
        (.running before ⟨[], result⟩ (caller :: frames) destination)
        (.running { evaluated with variables := variables } caller.body frames caller.destination)
  | exit {objects nextId variables} :
      RawStep classes declarations
        (.running ⟨objects, variables, nextId⟩ ⟨[], none⟩) ⟨objects, nextId, []⟩

inductive Step (classes : Classes) (declarations : Declarations) : Configuration → Configuration → Prop where
  | collect {before raw} : RawStep classes declarations before raw →
      Step classes declarations before raw.collect

inductive Steps (classes : Classes) (declarations : Declarations) : Configuration → Configuration → Prop where
  | refl (configuration : Configuration) : Steps classes declarations configuration configuration
  | step {before middle after} :
      Step classes declarations before middle → Steps classes declarations middle after →
      Steps classes declarations before after

def Stuck (classes : Classes) (declarations : Declarations) (configuration : Configuration) : Prop :=
  ¬ configuration.finished ∧ ¬ ∃ after, Step classes declarations configuration after

theorem finished_no_step (finished : configuration.finished) :
    ¬ Step classes declarations configuration after := by
  intro step
  cases step with
  | collect raw => cases raw <;> simp_all [Configuration.finished, Configuration.running]

theorem terminal_heap_empty (step : Step classes declarations before after)
    (finished : after.finished) : after.objects = [] := by
  cases step with
  | collect raw =>
    cases raw <;> simp_all [Configuration.finished, Configuration.running,
      Configuration.collect_frames, Configuration.collect_empty_frames]

theorem Steps.trans (first : Steps classes declarations before middle)
    (second : Steps classes declarations middle after) : Steps classes declarations before after := by
  induction first with
  | refl => exact second
  | step step _ ih => exact .step step (ih second)

end Dada.Functions

attribute [simp] Dada.Functions.Configuration.collect_frames
  Dada.Functions.Configuration.collect_nextId Dada.Functions.no_roots_not_live
  Dada.Functions.Configuration.collect_empty_frames Dada.Functions.Configuration.collect_empty_heap

end

namespace Dada.Functions

open Shared Shared.Typing

-- Call-free values and nominal storage are the explicitly inherited Shared
-- sublanguage. Calls have their own syntax, machine, and typing judgments.
inductive Name where
  | function (name : String)
  | method (owner : ClassName) (name : String)
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

structure Parameter where
  name : VariableId
  type : FieldType
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

structure Signature where
  parameters : List Parameter
  result : Option FieldType
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

-- Surface receiver prefixes expand only the receiver parameter, not a call.
def receiver (owner : ClassName) (permission : Perm) : Parameter :=
  ⟨"self", ⟨permission, owner⟩⟩

def Signature.environment (signature : Signature) : Environment :=
  signature.parameters.map fun p => (p.name, some p.type.toType)

def Signature.WellFormed (classes : ClassTable) (name : Name)
    (signature : Signature) : Prop :=
  (signature.parameters.map Parameter.name).Nodup ∧
  (∀ p ∈ signature.parameters, Admissible classes p.type.toType) ∧
  (∀ ty ∈ signature.result, Admissible classes ty.toType) ∧
  match name with
  | .function _ => "self" ∉ signature.parameters.map Parameter.name
  | .method owner _ => match signature.parameters with
    | [] => False
    | first :: rest => first.name = "self" ∧ first.type.className = owner ∧
        "self" ∉ rest.map Parameter.name

instance (classes : ClassTable) (name : Name) (signature : Signature) :
    Decidable (signature.WellFormed classes name) := by
  unfold Signature.WellFormed
  cases name <;> cases signature.parameters <;> dsimp only <;> infer_instance

inductive Statement where
  | local (statement : Unpacking.Statement)
  | call (destination : Option VariableId) (name : Name) (arguments : List Value)
  deriving Repr

structure Body where
  statements : List Statement
  result : Option Value
  deriving Repr

structure Declaration where
  signature : Signature
  body : Body
  deriving Repr

abbrev Declarations := List (Name × Declaration)

structure Program where
  classes : ClassTable
  declarations : Declarations
  main : List Statement
  deriving Repr

end Dada.Functions

namespace Dada.Functions

open Shared Shared.Typing

inductive ResultTyped (classes : ClassTable) : Environment → Option Value → Option FieldType → Environment → Prop where
  | none {environment} :
      environment.WellFormed classes → ResultTyped classes environment none none environment
  | some {before after value type} :
      ExprTyped classes before value type.toType after →
      ResultTyped classes before (some value) (some type) after

inductive DestinationTyped (classes : ClassTable) : Environment → Option VariableId → Option FieldType → Environment → Prop where
  | none {environment} :
      environment.WellFormed classes → DestinationTyped classes environment none none environment
  | some {before after name type} :
      BindingTyped classes before (.variable name) type.toType after →
      DestinationTyped classes before (some name) (some type) after

inductive StatementTyped (classes : ClassTable) (declarations : Declarations) : Environment → Statement → Environment → Prop where
  | local {before after statement} :
      Shared.Typing.StatementTyped classes before statement after →
      StatementTyped classes declarations before (.local statement) after
  | call {before middle after destination name arguments declaration} :
      (name, declaration) ∈ declarations →
      (∀ x ∈ destination, x ∉ before.map Prod.fst) →
      ArgsTyped classes before arguments (declaration.signature.parameters.map Parameter.type) middle →
      DestinationTyped classes middle destination declaration.signature.result after →
      StatementTyped classes declarations before (.call destination name arguments) after

inductive SequenceTyped (classes : ClassTable) (declarations : Declarations) : Environment → List Statement → Environment → Prop where
  | nil {environment} :
      environment.WellFormed classes → SequenceTyped classes declarations environment [] environment
  | cons {before middle after statement rest} :
      StatementTyped classes declarations before statement middle →
      SequenceTyped classes declarations middle rest after →
      SequenceTyped classes declarations before (statement :: rest) after

def BodyTyped (classes : ClassTable) (declarations : Declarations) (signature : Signature)
    (body : Body) : Prop :=
  ∃ middle after,
    SequenceTyped classes declarations signature.environment body.statements middle ∧
    ResultTyped classes middle body.result signature.result after

def DeclarationsTyped (classes : ClassTable) (declarations : Declarations) : Prop :=
  (declarations.map Prod.fst).Nodup ∧
    ∀ entry ∈ declarations,
      entry.2.signature.WellFormed classes entry.1 ∧
      BodyTyped classes declarations entry.2.signature entry.2.body

def ProgramTyped (program : Program) : Prop :=
  program.classes.WellFormed ∧ DeclarationsTyped program.classes program.declarations ∧
    ∃ finalEnvironment,
      SequenceTyped program.classes program.declarations [] program.main finalEnvironment

theorem DestinationTyped.shape
    (typed : DestinationTyped classes before destination result after) :
    DestinationMatches destination result := by
  cases typed <;> rfl

theorem call_arity
    (typed : StatementTyped classes declarations before (.call destination name arguments) after) :
    ∃ declaration, (name, declaration) ∈ declarations ∧
      arguments.length = declaration.signature.parameters.length ∧
      DestinationMatches destination declaration.signature.result := by
  cases typed with
  | call declared _ args dest =>
    exact ⟨_, declared, by simpa using args.length, dest.shape⟩

end Dada.Functions

-- Taking a reference never changes an object's class or field domain. Every
-- owner remaining in a field was already present in that same field.
theorem Take.object_data {before after : State} {place : StoragePlace} {object : ObjectId}
    (taken : Take before place object after) (id : ObjectId) (data : Object)
    (stored : (id, data) ∈ after.objects) :
    ∃ oldData, (id, oldData) ∈ before.objects ∧
      data.className = oldData.className ∧
      data.fields.map Prod.fst = oldData.fields.map Prod.fst ∧
      ∀ name target, (name, some target) ∈ data.fields →
        (name, some target) ∈ oldData.fields := by
  cases taken with
  | «variable» objects nextId leading suffix name object =>
    exact ⟨data, stored, rfl, rfl, fun _ _ member => member⟩
  | field variables nextId leadingObjects trailingObjects parent className
      leadingFields trailingFields fieldName object =>
    simp only [List.mem_append, List.mem_cons] at stored
    rcases stored with unchanged | changed | unchanged
    · exact ⟨data, List.mem_append_left _ unchanged, rfl, rfl, fun _ _ member => member⟩
    · cases changed
      refine ⟨⟨className, leadingFields ++ (fieldName, some (.owned object)) :: trailingFields⟩,
        ?_, rfl, ?_, ?_⟩
      · simp
      · simp
      · intro name target member
        simp only [List.mem_append, List.mem_cons] at member ⊢
        rcases member with member | impossible | member
        · exact Or.inl member
        · have : some target = none := congrArg Prod.snd impossible
          contradiction
        · exact Or.inr (Or.inr member)
    · exact ⟨data, List.mem_append_right _ (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ unchanged),
        rfl, rfl, fun _ _ member => member⟩

-- Promotion preserves every field target, while changing a unique final
-- reference into shared ownership at the same slot.
theorem Promote.object_data {before after : State} {place : StoragePlace} {object : ObjectId}
    (promoted : Promote before place object after) (id : ObjectId) (data : Object)
    (stored : (id, data) ∈ after.objects) :
    ∃ oldData, (id, oldData) ∈ before.objects ∧
      data.className = oldData.className ∧
      data.fields.map Prod.fst = oldData.fields.map Prod.fst ∧
      ∀ name target, (name, some target) ∈ data.fields →
        ∃ oldTarget, (name, some oldTarget) ∈ oldData.fields ∧ target.object = oldTarget.object := by
  cases promoted with
  | «variable» objects nextId leading suffix name object =>
    exact ⟨data, stored, rfl, rfl, fun _ target member => ⟨target, member, rfl⟩⟩
  | field variables nextId leadingObjects trailingObjects parent className
      leadingFields trailingFields fieldName object =>
    simp only [List.mem_append, List.mem_cons] at stored
    rcases stored with unchanged | changed | unchanged
    · exact ⟨data, List.mem_append_left _ unchanged, rfl, rfl,
        fun _ target member => ⟨target, member, rfl⟩⟩
    · cases changed
      refine ⟨⟨className, leadingFields ++ (fieldName, some (.owned object)) :: trailingFields⟩,
        ?_, rfl, ?_, ?_⟩
      · simp
      · simp
      · intro name target member
        simp only [List.mem_append, List.mem_cons] at member
        rcases member with member | promotedField | member
        · exact ⟨target, List.mem_append_left _ member, rfl⟩
        · cases promotedField
          exact ⟨.owned object, by simp, rfl⟩
        · exact ⟨target, List.mem_append_right _ (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ member), rfl⟩
    · exact ⟨data, List.mem_append_right _ (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ unchanged),
        rfl, rfl, fun _ target member => ⟨target, member, rfl⟩⟩

end Dada.Shared

namespace Dada.Shared

def exampleClasses : Classes :=
  [("Token", ⟨[], .structType⟩), ("Box", ⟨["value"], .structType⟩)]

def tokenState : State :=
  ⟨[(0, ⟨"Token", []⟩)], [("t", some (.owned 0))], 1⟩

def boxState : State :=
  ⟨[(1, ⟨"Box", [("value", some (.owned 0))]⟩), (0, ⟨"Token", []⟩)],
    [("b", some (.owned 1)), ("t", none)], 2⟩

def sharedBoxState : State :=
  ⟨boxState.objects, [("s", some (.shared 1)), ("b", none), ("t", none)], 2⟩

def copiedState : State :=
  ⟨[(1, ⟨"Box", [("value", some (.shared 0))]⟩), (0, ⟨"Token", []⟩)],
    [("u", some (.shared 0)), ("s", some (.shared 1)), ("b", none), ("t", none)], 2⟩

def twiceCopiedState : State := copiedState.bind "v" (.shared 0)

def sharingCode : List Statement :=
  [⟨"t", .new "Token" []⟩, ⟨"b", .new "Box" [.give (.variable "t")]⟩,
    ⟨"s", .giveShare (.variable "b")⟩,
    ⟨"u", .give (.field (.variable "s") "value")⟩,
    ⟨"v", .give (.field (.variable "s") "value")⟩]

theorem example_create_token (rest : List Statement) :
    Step exampleClasses ⟨State.empty, ⟨"t", .new "Token" []⟩ :: rest⟩ ⟨tokenState, rest⟩ := by
  apply Step.letValue (reference := .owned 0)
    (evaluated := State.empty.allocate "Token" [] [])
  · simp [State.empty, State.allocate]
  · apply Eval.new (declaration := ⟨[], .structType⟩) (references := [])
    · simp [exampleClasses]
    · exact EvalArgs.nil _
    · rfl
    · simp [State.empty]
    · simp [StructArguments]

theorem example_create_box (rest : List Statement) :
    Step exampleClasses
      ⟨tokenState, ⟨"b", .new "Box" [.give (.variable "t")]⟩ :: rest⟩ ⟨boxState, rest⟩ := by
  apply Step.letValue (reference := .owned 1)
    (evaluated := (State.mk tokenState.objects [("t", none)] 1).allocate "Box" ["value"] [.owned 0])
  · simp [State.allocate]
  · apply Eval.new (declaration := ⟨["value"], .structType⟩) (references := [.owned 0])
    · simp [exampleClasses]
    · apply EvalArgs.cons (reference := .owned 0)
      · apply Eval.give
        apply Give.move (source := .variable "t")
        · exact Resolve.variable (reference := .owned 0) (by simp [tokenState])
        · exact Take.variable tokenState.objects 1 [] [] "t" 0
      · exact EvalArgs.nil _
    · rfl
    · decide
    · simp [StructArguments, StructReference, tokenState, exampleClasses, Reference.owned, Kind.isStruct]

theorem example_share_box (rest : List Statement) :
    Step exampleClasses ⟨boxState, ⟨"s", .giveShare (.variable "b")⟩ :: rest⟩
      ⟨sharedBoxState, rest⟩ := by
  apply Step.letValue (reference := .shared 1)
    (evaluated := ⟨boxState.objects, [("b", none), ("t", none)], 2⟩)
  · simp
  · apply Eval.giveShare (reference := .owned 1)
    apply Give.move (source := .variable "b")
    · exact Resolve.variable (reference := .owned 1) (by simp [boxState])
    · exact Take.variable boxState.objects 2 [] [("t", none)] "b" 1
    all_goals simp [StructReference, boxState, exampleClasses, Reference.owned, Kind.isStruct]

theorem example_copy_field (rest : List Statement) :
    Step exampleClasses
      ⟨sharedBoxState, ⟨"u", .give (.field (.variable "s") "value")⟩ :: rest⟩
      ⟨copiedState, rest⟩ := by
  apply Step.letValue (reference := .shared 0)
    (evaluated := ⟨copiedState.objects, sharedBoxState.variables, 2⟩)
  · simp [sharedBoxState]
  · apply Eval.give
    apply Give.promote (source := .field 1 "value")
    · apply Resolve.field (permission := .shared) (reference := .owned 0) (data := ⟨"Box", [("value", some (.owned 0))]⟩)
      · exact Resolve.variable (reference := .shared 1) (by simp [sharedBoxState])
      · simp [sharedBoxState, boxState]
      · simp
    · exact Promote.field sharedBoxState.variables 2 [] [(0, ⟨"Token", []⟩)]
        1 "Box" [] [] "value" 0

theorem example_copy_again (rest : List Statement) :
    Step exampleClasses
      ⟨copiedState, ⟨"v", .give (.field (.variable "s") "value")⟩ :: rest⟩
      ⟨twiceCopiedState, rest⟩ := by
  apply Step.letValue
  · simp [copiedState]
  · apply Eval.give

theorem terminal_kindCorrect (classes : Classes) (nextId : Nat) :
    KindCorrect classes (Configuration.terminal (Instruction := Statement) nextId).state [] := by

theorem base_kind_preservation (classesWf : ClassesWellFormed classes)
    (wf : WellFormedState classes before.state)
    (step : Step (baseOperation classes) before after) : WellFormedState classes after.state := by
  cases step with
  | «local» operation =>

    exact ⟨next, operation.preserves_kinds classesWf wf.1 wf.2⟩
  | exit =>

    exact ⟨terminal_wellFormed _ _, terminal_kindCorrect _ _⟩

theorem base_soundness (classesWf : ClassesWellFormed classes)
    (trace : StepsExactly (baseOperation classes) (.initial code) count after) :
    WellFormedState classes after.state := by

      StepsExactly (baseOperation classes) start n finish → WellFormedState classes finish.state := by
    intro start n finish wf execution
    induction execution with
    | refl => exact wf
    | step next _ rest => exact rest (base_kind_preservation classesWf wf next)

open Typing

def ConfigurationTyped (classes : ClassTable) (configuration : Configuration Unpacking.Statement)
    (finalEnvironment : Environment) : Prop :=
  match configuration.frame with
  | none => configuration.objects = []
  | some frame => Typing.ConfigurationTyped classes ⟨configuration.state, frame.code⟩ finalEnvironment

theorem local_wellFormed (typed : Typing.ConfigurationTyped classes configuration finalEnvironment) :
    WellFormed classes.erase configuration.state := by
  obtain ⟨_, realized, _⟩ := typed
  exact realized.ownership.no_pending

theorem ConfigurationTyped.initial (classesWf : classes.WellFormed)
    (typed : SequenceTyped classes [] code finalEnvironment) :
    ConfigurationTyped classes (.initial code) finalEnvironment :=
  ⟨[], Realizes.empty classesWf, typed⟩

theorem ConfigurationTyped.progress
    (typed : ConfigurationTyped classes configuration finalEnvironment) :
    configuration.finished ∨ ∃ after, Step (patternOperation classes.erase) configuration after := by
  rcases configuration with ⟨objects, nextId, frame⟩
  cases frame with
  | none => exact .inl rfl
  | some frame =>
    rcases frame with ⟨variables, code⟩
    have localTyped : Typing.ConfigurationTyped classes ⟨⟨objects, variables, nextId⟩, code⟩ finalEnvironment := typed
    rcases localTyped.progress with finished | ⟨after, step⟩
    · change code = [] at finished
      subst code
      exact .inr ⟨_, exit_step ⟨objects, variables, nextId⟩⟩
    · exact .inr ⟨_, local_step (operation := patternOperation classes.erase)
        (before := ⟨objects, variables, nextId⟩) (code := code) (after := after.state)
        (rest := after.code) step (local_wellFormed (localTyped.preservation step))⟩

theorem ConfigurationTyped.preservation
    (typed : ConfigurationTyped classes before finalEnvironment)
    (step : Step (patternOperation classes.erase) before after) :
    ConfigurationTyped classes after finalEnvironment := by
  cases step with
  | «local» operation =>
    have next := Typing.ConfigurationTyped.preservation typed operation
    rw [collect_running (local_wellFormed next)]
    exact next
  | exit =>
    rw [collect_popped]
    rfl

theorem ConfigurationTyped.trace
    (typed : ConfigurationTyped classes before finalEnvironment)
    (trace : StepsExactly (patternOperation classes.erase) before count after) :
    ConfigurationTyped classes after finalEnvironment := by
  induction trace with
  | refl => exact typed
  | step first _ ih => exact ih (typed.preservation first)

theorem lift_local_trace
    (typed : Typing.ConfigurationTyped classes before finalEnvironment)
    (trace : Unpacking.StepsExactly classes.erase before count after) :
    StepsExactly (patternOperation classes.erase) (.running before.state before.code) count
      (.running after.state after.code) := by
  induction trace with
  | refl => exact .refl _
  | step first _ ih =>
    have next := typed.preservation first
    exact .step (local_step first (local_wellFormed next)) (ih next)

-- Keep the pre-exit state as a witness: it still realizes the final local environment.
theorem completion (typed : Typing.ConfigurationTyped classes before finalEnvironment) :
    ∃ observed,
      StepsExactly (patternOperation classes.erase) (.running before.state before.code)
        before.code.length (.running observed []) ∧
      Realizes classes finalEnvironment observed [] ∧
      StepsExactly (patternOperation classes.erase) (.running before.state before.code)
        (before.code.length + 1) (.terminal observed.nextId) := by
  obtain ⟨last, trace, finished, realized⟩ := typed.finishes
  have lifted := lift_local_trace typed trace
  change last.code = [] at finished
  rw [finished] at lifted
  exact ⟨last.state, lifted, realized, lifted.trans (.step (exit_step _) (.refl _))⟩

theorem ConfigurationTyped.finishes
    (typed : ConfigurationTyped classes configuration finalEnvironment) :
    ∃ nextId, StepsExactly (patternOperation classes.erase) configuration configuration.remaining
      (.terminal nextId) := by
  rcases configuration with ⟨objects, nextId, frame⟩
  cases frame with
  | none =>
    change objects = [] at typed
    subst objects
    exact ⟨nextId, .refl _⟩
  | some frame =>
    obtain ⟨observed, _, _, trace⟩ := completion typed
    exact ⟨observed.nextId, trace⟩

theorem program_safety (classesWf : classes.WellFormed)
    (typed : SequenceTyped classes [] code finalEnvironment)
    (execution : StepsExactly (patternOperation classes.erase) (.initial code) count configuration) :
    ¬ Stuck (patternOperation classes.erase) configuration ∧
    ConfigurationTyped classes configuration finalEnvironment ∧
    count + configuration.remaining = code.length + 1 ∧
    ∃ nextId,
      StepsExactly (patternOperation classes.erase) configuration configuration.remaining (.terminal nextId) ∧
      StepsExactly (patternOperation classes.erase) (.initial code) (code.length + 1) (.terminal nextId) := by
  have current := (ConfigurationTyped.initial classesWf typed).trace execution
  have length : count + configuration.remaining = code.length + 1 := by
    exact (execution.remaining (fun _ _ _ _ step => step.code_length)).symm
  obtain ⟨nextId, rest⟩ := current.finishes
  refine ⟨?_, current, length, nextId, rest, length ▸ execution.trans rest⟩
  intro stuck
  rcases current.progress with finished | next
  · exact stuck.1 finished
  · exact stuck.2 next

-- Collection is outside expression evaluation, after all temporary results transfer.
def State.collect (state : State) : State := by
  classical
  exact { state with objects := state.objects.filter (fun entry => decide (Live state entry.1)) }

theorem State.collect_eq_self (wf : WellFormed classes state) : state.collect = state := by
  classical
  have keep : state.objects.filter (fun entry => decide (Live state entry.1)) = state.objects :=
    List.filter_eq_self.mpr (by
      intro entry member
      simpa using wf.allocated_live (List.mem_map.mpr ⟨entry, member, rfl⟩))
  simp [State.collect, keep]

theorem Live.has_variable (live : Live state object) : ∃ name reference,
    (name, some reference) ∈ state.variables := by
  induction live with
  | «variable» member => exact ⟨_, _, member⟩
  | field _ _ _ ih => exact ih

theorem State.collect_no_variables (objects : List (ObjectId × Object)) (nextId : Nat) :
    (State.mk objects [] nextId).collect = ⟨[], [], nextId⟩ := by
  have dead : ∀ id, ¬ Live ⟨objects, [], nextId⟩ id := by
    intro id live
    obtain ⟨_, _, member⟩ := live.has_variable
    simp at member
  simp [State.collect, dead]

namespace Framed

structure Frame (Instruction : Type) where
  variables : List (VariableId × Slot)
  code : List Instruction
  deriving Repr

structure Configuration (Instruction : Type) where
  objects : List (ObjectId × Object)
  nextId : Nat
  frame : Option (Frame Instruction)
  deriving Repr

def Configuration.running (state : State) (code : List Instruction) : Configuration Instruction :=
  ⟨state.objects, state.nextId, some ⟨state.variables, code⟩⟩

def Configuration.terminal (nextId : Nat) : Configuration Instruction := ⟨[], nextId, none⟩

def Configuration.initial (code : List Instruction) : Configuration Instruction :=
  .running State.empty code

def Configuration.state (configuration : Configuration Instruction) : State :=
  ⟨configuration.objects, configuration.frame.map Frame.variables |>.getD [], configuration.nextId⟩

def Configuration.collect (configuration : Configuration Instruction) : Configuration Instruction :=
  { configuration with objects := configuration.state.collect.objects }

def Configuration.finished (configuration : Configuration Instruction) : Prop :=
  configuration.frame = none

def Configuration.remaining (configuration : Configuration Instruction) : Nat :=
  match configuration.frame with
  | none => 0
  | some frame => frame.code.length + 1

abbrev LocalStep (Instruction : Type) := State → List Instruction → State → List Instruction → Prop

def baseOperation (classes : Classes) : LocalStep Statement :=
  fun before code after rest => Dada.Shared.Step classes ⟨before, code⟩ ⟨after, rest⟩

def patternOperation (classes : Classes) : LocalStep Unpacking.Statement :=
  fun before code after rest => Unpacking.Step classes ⟨before, code⟩ ⟨after, rest⟩

-- The public machine always collects; local operations are auxiliary judgments.
inductive Step (operation : LocalStep Instruction) : Configuration Instruction → Configuration Instruction → Prop where
  | «local» {before after code rest} :
      operation before code after rest →
      Step operation (.running before code) (Configuration.running after rest).collect
  | exit {state} :
      Step operation (.running state []) (Configuration.mk state.objects state.nextId none).collect

inductive StepsExactly (operation : LocalStep Instruction) : Configuration Instruction → Nat → Configuration Instruction → Prop where
  | refl (configuration) : StepsExactly operation configuration 0 configuration
  | step {before middle after count} :
      Step operation before middle → StepsExactly operation middle count after →
      StepsExactly operation before (count + 1) after

def Steps (operation : LocalStep Instruction) (before after : Configuration Instruction) : Prop :=
  ∃ count, StepsExactly operation before count after

def Stuck (operation : LocalStep Instruction) (configuration : Configuration Instruction) : Prop :=
  ¬ configuration.finished ∧ ¬ ∃ after, Step operation configuration after

variable {Instruction : Type} {operation : LocalStep Instruction}

theorem collect_running (wf : WellFormed classes state) :
    (Configuration.running state code).collect = .running state code := by
  have same := congrArg State.objects (State.collect_eq_self wf)
  simpa [Configuration.collect, Configuration.running, Configuration.state] using
    congrArg (fun objects => Configuration.mk objects state.nextId (some ⟨state.variables, code⟩)) same

theorem collect_popped (objects : List (ObjectId × Object)) (nextId : Nat) :
    (Configuration.mk objects nextId (none : Option (Frame Instruction))).collect = .terminal nextId := by
  simp [Configuration.collect, Configuration.state, State.collect_no_variables, Configuration.terminal]

theorem local_step (step : operation before code after rest)
    (wf : WellFormed classes after) :
    Step operation (.running before code) (.running after rest) := by
  simpa only [collect_running wf] using Step.local step

theorem exit_step (state : State) :
    Step operation (Configuration.running state []) (.terminal state.nextId) := by
  simpa only [collect_popped] using (Step.exit (operation := operation) (state := state))

theorem finished_no_step (finished : configuration.finished) :
    ¬ Step operation configuration after := by
  intro step
  cases step <;> simp_all [Configuration.finished, Configuration.running]

theorem terminal_heap_empty (step : Step operation before after) (finished : after.finished) :
    after.objects = [] := by
  cases step with
  | «local» => simp [Configuration.finished, Configuration.collect, Configuration.running] at finished
  | exit => simp [collect_popped, Configuration.terminal]

theorem StepsExactly.trans (first : StepsExactly operation before count middle)
    (second : StepsExactly operation middle later after) :
    StepsExactly operation before (count + later) after := by
  induction first with
  | refl => simpa using second
  | step first _ ih => simpa [Nat.add_assoc, Nat.add_comm, Nat.add_left_comm] using
      StepsExactly.step first (ih second)

theorem step_remaining
    (decreases : ∀ before code after rest, operation before code after rest → code.length = rest.length + 1)
    (step : Step operation before after) : before.remaining = after.remaining + 1 := by
  cases step with
  | «local» localStep =>
    simpa [Configuration.remaining, Configuration.collect, Configuration.running]
      using decreases _ _ _ _ localStep
  | exit => simp [Configuration.remaining, Configuration.collect, Configuration.running]

theorem StepsExactly.remaining
    (decreases : ∀ before code after rest, operation before code after rest → code.length = rest.length + 1)
    (steps : StepsExactly operation before count after) : before.remaining = count + after.remaining := by
  induction steps with
  | refl => simp
  | step first _ ih => have := step_remaining decreases first; omega

theorem terminal_wellFormed (classes : Classes) (nextId : Nat) :
    WellFormed classes (Configuration.terminal (Instruction := Instruction) nextId).state := by
  constructor <;> simp [Configuration.terminal, Configuration.state, References, Allocated, Owners]

theorem Step.preserves
    (preserves : ∀ before code after rest, WellFormed classes before →
      operation before code after rest → WellFormed classes after)
    (wf : WellFormed classes before.state) (step : Step operation before after) :
    WellFormed classes after.state := by
  cases step with
  | «local» localStep =>
    have next := preserves _ _ _ _ wf localStep
    rw [collect_running next]
    exact next
  | exit =>
    rw [collect_popped]
    exact terminal_wellFormed _ _

theorem StepsExactly.preserves
    (preserves : ∀ before code after rest, WellFormed classes before →
      operation before code after rest → WellFormed classes after)
    (wf : WellFormed classes before.state) (steps : StepsExactly operation before count after) :
    WellFormed classes after.state := by
  induction steps with
  | refl => exact wf
  | step first _ ih => exact ih (first.preserves preserves wf)

theorem base_preservation (classesWf : ClassesWellFormed classes)
    (wf : WellFormed classes before.state) (step : Step (baseOperation classes) before after) :
    WellFormed classes after.state :=
  step.preserves (fun _ _ _ _ wf operation => operation.preserves_wellFormed classesWf wf) wf

theorem pattern_preservation (classesWf : ClassesWellFormed classes)
    (wf : WellFormed classes before.state) (step : Step (patternOperation classes) before after) :
    WellFormed classes after.state :=
  step.preserves (fun _ _ _ _ wf operation => operation.preserves_wellFormed classesWf wf) wf

def copied : State := constructed.bind "c" (.shared 1)
def promoted : State :=
  ⟨[(1, ⟨"SharedBox", [("value", some (.shared 0))]⟩), (0, ⟨"Token", []⟩)],
    copied.variables, 2⟩
def finalState : State := promoted.bind "t" (.shared 0)

theorem execution : Unpacking.Steps classes.erase ⟨State.empty, program⟩ ⟨finalState, []⟩ := by
  apply Unpacking.Steps.step (middle := ⟨constructed, program.tail⟩)
  · apply Unpacking.Step.letValue (evaluated := ⟨constructed.objects, [], 2⟩) (object := .shared 1)
    · apply Eval.new (declaration := ⟨["value"], .sharedStruct⟩)
        (evaluated := ⟨[(0, ⟨"Token", []⟩)], [], 1⟩) (references := [.owned 0])
      · decide
      · exact .cons (.new (declaration := ⟨[], .structType⟩) (by decide) (.nil _)
          rfl (by decide) (by simp [StructArguments])) (.nil _)
      · rfl
      · decide
      · simp [StructArguments, StructReference, classes, ClassTable.erase, Reference.owned, Kind.isStruct]
    · exact .variable (by decide)
  apply Unpacking.Steps.step (middle := ⟨copied, program.tail.tail⟩)
  · apply Unpacking.Step.letValue (evaluated := constructed) (object := .shared 1)
    · exact .give (.copy (Resolve.variable (reference := .shared 1) (by decide)) (by simp [Stored, constructed]))
    · exact .variable (by decide)
  apply Unpacking.Steps.step (middle := ⟨finalState, []⟩)
  · apply Unpacking.Step.letValue (evaluated := promoted) (object := .shared 0)
    · apply Eval.give
      apply Give.promote (source := .field 1 "value")
      · exact .field (permission := .shared) (reference := .owned 0)
          (data := ⟨"SharedBox", [("value", some (.owned 0))]⟩)
          (Resolve.variable (reference := .shared 1) (by decide)) (by decide) (by decide)
      · exact .field copied.variables 2 [] [(0, ⟨"Token", []⟩)]
          1 "SharedBox" [] [] "value" 0
    · exact .variable (by decide)
  exact .refl _

-- ANCHOR: immediately_shared
example : SequenceTyped classes [] program finalEnvironment ∧
    Unpacking.Steps classes.erase ⟨State.empty, program⟩ ⟨finalState, []⟩ ∧
    RawType.normalize classes (.nominal (.whole "SharedBox")) = sharedBox ∧
    ¬ Admissible classes (.whole "SharedBox") ∧
    ¬ Admissible classes (.whole "Resource" .shared) ∧
    ("b", some (.shared 1)) ∈ finalState.variables ∧
    ("c", some (.shared 1)) ∈ finalState.variables ∧
    ("t", some (.shared 0)) ∈ finalState.variables := by
  exact ⟨program_typed, execution, by decide, by decide, by decide,
    by decide, by decide, by decide⟩
-- ANCHOR_END: immediately_shared

theorem class_construction : ExprTyped classes [] (.new "Resource" [.new "Token" []])
    (.whole "Resource") [] := by
  apply ExprTyped.new (declaration := ⟨[("token", ⟨.given, "Token"⟩)], .classType⟩) (by decide)
  · exact .cons (.new (declaration := ⟨[], .structType⟩) (by decide)
      (.nil (by decide)) (by decide) (by decide)) (.nil (by decide))
  · decide
  · decide

theorem class_sharing_rejected :
    ¬ ExprTyped classes [("r", some (.whole "Resource"))] (.giveShare (.variable "r")) ty after := by
  intro typed
  obtain ⟨source, taken, structTy⟩ := typed.giveShare_requires_struct _ rfl
  have operation : give classes [("r", some (.whole "Resource"))] (.variable "r") =
      some (.whole "Resource", [("r", none)]) := by decide
  rw [operation] at taken
  have same := (Prod.mk.inj (Option.some.inj taken)).1
  subst source
  exact (by decide : ¬ StructType classes (.whole "Resource")) structTy

-- ANCHOR: class_boundary
example : ExprTyped classes [] (.new "Resource" [.new "Token" []]) (.whole "Resource") [] ∧
    (∀ ty after, ¬ ExprTyped classes [("r", some (.whole "Resource"))]
      (.giveShare (.variable "r")) ty after) ∧
    (∀ after, ¬ Unpacking.Bind classes.erase constructed (.shared 1)
      (.unpack "SharedBox" [("value", "v")]) after) ∧
    give classes [("r", some (.whole "Resource"))] (.variable "r") =
      some (.whole "Resource", [("r", none)]) := by
  exact ⟨class_construction, fun _ _ => class_sharing_rejected,
    (fun _ => Unpacking.shared_cannot_unpack), by decide⟩
-- ANCHOR_END: class_boundary
