namespace Dada.Shared.Typing

-- Empty slots remain allocated; absence is a separate outer Option at lookup.
abbrev SlotDescription := Option ValueType
abbrev Environment := List (VariableId × SlotDescription)

def Environment.WellFormed (environment : Environment) (classes : ClassTable) : Prop :=
  (environment.map Prod.fst).Nodup ∧
    environment.all (fun entry => match entry.2 with
      | none => true
      | some ty => decide (Admissible classes ty)) = true

instance (environment : Environment) (classes : ClassTable) :
    Decidable (environment.WellFormed classes) := by
  unfold Environment.WellFormed
  infer_instance

def Environment.lookup (environment : Environment) (name : VariableId) :
    Option SlotDescription :=
  (environment.find? fun entry => entry.1 == name).map Prod.snd

def Environment.replace (environment : Environment) (name : VariableId)
    (description : SlotDescription) : Environment :=
  environment.map fun entry => if entry.1 = name then (name, description) else entry

def splitPlace : Place → VariableId × Path
  | .variable name => (name, [])
  | .field base name =>
      let (root, path) := splitPlace base
      (root, path ++ [name])

def placeFrom (root : VariableId) (path : Path) : Place :=
  path.foldl Place.field (.variable root)

theorem placeFrom_splitPlace (place : Place) :
    placeFrom (splitPlace place).1 (splitPlace place).2 = place := by
  induction place with
  | «variable» name => rfl
  | field base name ih =>
    simpa [splitPlace, placeFrom, List.foldl_append] using
      congrArg (fun p => Place.field p name) ih

-- Giving is a static operation: it never consults the heap or evaluation.
def give (classes : ClassTable) (environment : Environment) (place : Place) :
    Option (ValueType × Environment) := do
  let (root, path) := splitPlace place
  let source ← environment.lookup root
  let source ← source
  let result ← focus classes source path
  if result.permission = .shared then
    return (result, environment)
  else if path = [] then
    return (result, environment.replace root none)
  else
    let remaining ← emptyPath classes source path
    return (result, environment.replace root (some remaining))

def fieldDescription (classes : ClassTable) (ty : ValueType) (name : FieldName) :
    Option SlotDescription :=
  if Unique.Typing.negative ty.nominal [name] then some none
  else (focus classes ty [name]).map some

-- The well-formedness premises make the chapter's global convention explicit.
-- They inspect only finite static descriptions, not operational success.
mutual
inductive ExprTyped (classes : ClassTable) : Environment → Value → ValueType → Environment → Prop where
  | give {before after : Environment} {place : Place} {ty : ValueType} :
      before.WellFormed classes →
      Typing.give classes before place = some (ty, after) →
      Admissible classes ty → after.WellFormed classes →
      ExprTyped classes before (.give place) ty after
  | giveShare {before after : Environment} {place : Place} {ty : ValueType} :
      before.WellFormed classes →
      Typing.give classes before place = some (ty, after) →
      Admissible classes ty → after.WellFormed classes →
      StructType classes ty →
      ExprTyped classes before (.giveShare place) ty.shared after
  | new {before after : Environment} {name : ClassName} {declaration : TypedClass}
      {arguments : List Value} :
      (name, declaration) ∈ classes →
      ArgsTyped classes before arguments (declaration.fields.map Prod.snd) after →
      Admissible classes (ValueType.whole name (initialPermission declaration.kind)) →
      (declaration.kind.isStruct = true →
        ∀ field ∈ declaration.fields, StructType classes field.2.toType) →
      ExprTyped classes before (.new name arguments)
        (ValueType.whole name (initialPermission declaration.kind)) after
  | weaken {before after : Environment} {value : Value} {ty other : ValueType} :
      ExprTyped classes before value ty after →
      Admissible classes other → Subtype classes ty other →
      ExprTyped classes before value other after

inductive ArgsTyped (classes : ClassTable) : Environment → List Value → List FieldType → Environment → Prop where
  | nil {environment : Environment} :
      environment.WellFormed classes → ArgsTyped classes environment [] [] environment
  | cons {before middle after : Environment} {value : Value} {values : List Value}
      {field : FieldType} {fields : List FieldType} :
      ExprTyped classes before value field.toType middle →
      ArgsTyped classes middle values fields after →
      ArgsTyped classes before (value :: values) (field :: fields) after
end

-- Pattern order determines binding order; all field names must still be present.
inductive FieldBindings (classes : ClassTable) (ty : ValueType) : List (FieldName × VariableId) → Environment → Prop where
  | nil : FieldBindings classes ty [] []
  | cons {field : FieldName} {destination : VariableId} {description : SlotDescription}
      {fields : List (FieldName × VariableId)} {bindings : Environment} :
      fieldDescription classes ty field = some description →
      FieldBindings classes ty fields bindings →
      FieldBindings classes ty ((field, destination) :: fields)
        ((destination, description) :: bindings)

inductive BindingTyped (classes : ClassTable) : Environment → Unpacking.Pattern → ValueType → Environment → Prop where
  | variable {environment : Environment} {name : VariableId} {ty : ValueType} :
      environment.WellFormed classes → Admissible classes ty →
      name ∉ environment.map Prod.fst →
      BindingTyped classes environment (.variable name) ty ((name, some ty) :: environment)
  | unpack {before : Environment} {ty : ValueType} {name : ClassName}
      {declaration : TypedClass} {fields : List (FieldName × VariableId)}
      {bindings : Environment} :
      before.WellFormed classes → Admissible classes ty →
      ty.permission = .given → ty.nominal.className = name → (name, declaration) ∈ classes →
      (fields.map Prod.fst).Perm (declaration.fields.map Prod.fst) →
      (fields.map Prod.snd).Nodup →
      (∀ destination ∈ fields.map Prod.snd, destination ∉ before.map Prod.fst) →
      FieldBindings classes ty fields bindings →
      (bindings ++ before).WellFormed classes →
      BindingTyped classes before (.unpack name fields) ty (bindings ++ before)

inductive StatementTyped (classes : ClassTable) : Environment → Unpacking.Statement → Environment → Prop where
  | letValue {before middle after : Environment} {pattern : Unpacking.Pattern}
      {value : Value} {ty : ValueType} :
      ExprTyped classes before value ty middle →
      BindingTyped classes middle pattern ty after →
      StatementTyped classes before ⟨pattern, value⟩ after

inductive SequenceTyped (classes : ClassTable) : Environment → List Unpacking.Statement → Environment → Prop where
  | nil {environment : Environment} :
      environment.WellFormed classes → SequenceTyped classes environment [] environment
  | cons {before middle after : Environment} {statement : Unpacking.Statement}
      {rest : List Unpacking.Statement} :
      StatementTyped classes before statement middle →
      SequenceTyped classes middle rest after →
      SequenceTyped classes before (statement :: rest) after

def ProgramTyped (classes : ClassTable) (code : List Unpacking.Statement) : Prop :=
  classes.WellFormed ∧ ∃ finalEnvironment, SequenceTyped classes [] code finalEnvironment

theorem ArgsTyped.length (typed : ArgsTyped classes before values fields after) :
    values.length = fields.length := by
  induction typed using ArgsTyped.rec (motive_1 := fun _ _ _ _ _ => True) with
  | give => trivial
  | giveShare => trivial
  | new => trivial
  | weaken => trivial
  | nil => rfl
  | cons _ _ _ rest => simpa using rest

theorem FieldBindings.keys (typed : FieldBindings classes ty fields bindings) :
    bindings.map Prod.fst = fields.map Prod.snd := by
  induction typed with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons _ _ ih => simp [ih]

-- Weakening cannot disguise an unsuccessful give as a typed give.
theorem ExprTyped.give_requires_operation
    (typed : ExprTyped classes before value ty after) :
    ∀ place, value = .give place → ∃ result, Typing.give classes before place = some (result, after) := by
  induction typed using ExprTyped.rec (motive_2 := fun _ _ _ _ _ => True) with
  | give _ taken _ _ =>
    intro place equality
    cases equality
    exact ⟨_, taken⟩
  | giveShare => intro place equality; cases equality
  | new => intro place equality; cases equality
  | weaken _ _ _ ih => exact ih
  | nil => trivial
  | cons => trivial

theorem failed_give_not_typed (failed : Typing.give classes environment place = none) :
    ¬ ExprTyped classes environment (.give place) ty after := by
  intro typed
  obtain ⟨result, succeeded⟩ := typed.give_requires_operation place rfl
  rw [failed] at succeeded
  contradiction

theorem ExprTyped.give_permission
    (typed : ExprTyped classes before value ty after) :
    ∀ place, value = .give place → ∃ result,
      Typing.give classes before place = some (result, after) ∧
      result.permission = ty.permission := by
  induction typed using ExprTyped.rec (motive_2 := fun _ _ _ _ _ => True) with
  | give _ taken _ _ =>
    intro place equality
    cases equality
    exact ⟨_, taken, rfl⟩
  | giveShare => intro place equality; cases equality
  | new => intro place equality; cases equality
  | weaken _ _ subtype ih =>
    intro place equality
    obtain ⟨result, taken, permission⟩ := ih place equality
    exact ⟨result, taken, permission.trans subtype.1⟩
  | nil => trivial
  | cons => trivial

theorem ExprTyped.new_requires_arguments
    (typed : ExprTyped classes before value ty after) :
    ∀ name arguments, value = .new name arguments →
      ∃ declaration, (name, declaration) ∈ classes ∧
        ArgsTyped classes before arguments (declaration.fields.map Prod.snd) after := by
  induction typed using ExprTyped.rec (motive_2 := fun _ _ _ _ _ => True) with
  | give => intro name arguments equality; cases equality
  | giveShare => intro name arguments equality; cases equality
  | new declared arguments _ _ _ =>
    intro name values equality
    cases equality
    exact ⟨_, declared, arguments⟩
  | weaken _ _ _ ih => exact ih
  | nil => trivial
  | cons => trivial

theorem ExprTyped.giveShare_requires_struct
    (typed : ExprTyped classes before value ty after) :
    ∀ place, value = .giveShare place → ∃ source,
      Typing.give classes before place = some (source, after) ∧ StructType classes source := by
  induction typed using ExprTyped.rec (motive_2 := fun _ _ _ _ _ => True) with
  | give => intro place equality; cases equality
  | giveShare _ taken _ _ structTy =>
    intro place equality
    cases equality
    exact ⟨_, taken, structTy⟩
  | new => intro place equality; cases equality
  | weaken _ _ _ ih => exact ih
  | nil => trivial
  | cons => trivial

end Dada.Shared.Typing

namespace Dada.Shared.Typing

-- Allocation adds a fresh object. Existing references cannot target its unused ID.
theorem readPath_allocate (wf : WellFormedWith layouts state pending)
    (older : reference.object.index < state.nextId) (path : Path) :
    readPath (state.allocate name fields arguments) reference path = readPath state reference path := by
  induction path generalizing reference with
  | nil =>
    have different : reference.object ≠ ObjectId.mk state.nextId := by
      intro equal; exact Nat.ne_of_lt older (congrArg ObjectId.index equal)
    simp [readPath, State.allocate, List.lookup_cons, beq_eq_false_iff_ne.mpr different]
  | cons field rest ih =>
    have different : reference.object ≠ ObjectId.mk state.nextId := by
      intro equal; exact Nat.ne_of_lt older (congrArg ObjectId.index equal)
    simp only [readPath, State.allocate, List.lookup_cons, beq_eq_false_iff_ne.mpr different]
    cases found : state.objects.lookup reference.object with
    | none => simp
    | some data =>
      dsimp only [Bind.bind, Option.bind]
      cases slot : data.fields.lookup field with
      | none => simp
      | some value =>
        dsimp only [Bind.bind, Option.bind]
        cases rest with
        | nil => rfl
        | cons next tail =>
          cases value with
          | none => rfl
          | some target =>
            have allocated := (wf.referencesComplete target.object).mp
              (List.mem_append_right _ (List.mem_append_right _
                (List.mem_flatMap.mpr ⟨(_, data), lookup_member found,
                  List.mem_filterMap.mpr ⟨(field, some target), lookup_member slot, rfl⟩⟩)))
            obtain ⟨⟨id, targetData⟩, member, same⟩ := List.mem_map.mp allocated
            dsimp at same
            subst id
            exact ih (reference := enter reference.mode target) (wf.bounds _ _ member)

theorem Satisfies.allocate (satisfied : Satisfies classes state reference ty)
    (wf : WellFormedWith layouts state pending) :
    Satisfies classes (state.allocate name fields arguments) reference ty := by
  obtain ⟨rootData, rootMember, rootClass⟩ := satisfied.root
  have bound := wf.bounds _ _ rootMember
  constructor
  · exact satisfied.mode
  · exact ⟨rootData, List.mem_cons_of_mem _ rootMember, rootClass⟩
  · intro path known
    obtain ⟨target, data, read, member, correct⟩ := satisfied.positive path known
    exact ⟨target, data, (readPath_allocate wf bound path).trans read,
      List.mem_cons_of_mem _ member, correct⟩
  · intro path known
    exact (readPath_allocate wf bound path).trans (satisfied.negative path known)
  · intro path target permission declared read
    rw [readPath_allocate wf bound path] at read
    exact satisfied.modes path target permission declared read

-- Constructor arguments are paired with fields in declaration order.
inductive ArgumentsSatisfy (classes : ClassTable) (state : State) : List (FieldName × FieldType) → List Reference → Prop where
  | nil : ArgumentsSatisfy classes state [] []
  | cons {entry : FieldName × FieldType} {object : Reference}
      {fields : List (FieldName × FieldType)} {objects : List Reference} :
      Satisfies classes state object entry.2.toType →
      ArgumentsSatisfy classes state fields objects →
      ArgumentsSatisfy classes state (entry :: fields) (object :: objects)

theorem ArgumentsSatisfy.reference {reference : Reference} (arguments : ArgumentsSatisfy classes state fields objects)
    (member : reference ∈ objects) :
    ∃ field ∈ fields, Satisfies classes state reference field.2.toType := by
  induction arguments with
  | nil => simp at member
  | @cons entry object fields objects head tail ih =>
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp member with same | rest
    · subst reference; exact ⟨entry, by simp, head⟩
    · obtain ⟨field, found, sat⟩ := ih rest
      exact ⟨field, List.mem_cons_of_mem _ found, sat⟩

theorem ArgumentsSatisfy.lookup (arguments : ArgumentsSatisfy classes state fields objects)
    (found : fields.lookup field = some targetClass) :
    ∃ object, ((fields.map Prod.fst).zip (objects.map some)).lookup field = some (some object) ∧
      Satisfies classes state object targetClass.toType := by
  induction arguments with
  | nil => simp at found
  | @cons entry object fields objects head tail ih =>
    rcases entry with ⟨name, target⟩
    by_cases same : field = name
    · subst name
      simp at found
      cases found
      exact ⟨object, by simp, head⟩
    · have different := beq_eq_false_iff_ne.mpr same
      simp only [List.lookup_cons, different] at found
      obtain ⟨result, lookup, satisfied⟩ := ih found
      exact ⟨result, by simpa [List.lookup_cons, different] using lookup, satisfied⟩

theorem ArgumentsSatisfy.member (arguments : ArgumentsSatisfy classes state fields objects)
    (stored : (field, some object) ∈ (fields.map Prod.fst).zip (objects.map some)) :
    ∃ targetClass, (field, targetClass) ∈ fields ∧
      Satisfies classes state object targetClass.toType := by
  induction arguments with
  | nil => simp at stored
  | @cons entry target fields objects head tail ih =>
    rcases entry with ⟨name, targetClass⟩
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp stored with equal | stored
    · cases equal
      exact ⟨targetClass, by simp, head⟩
    · obtain ⟨targetClass, member, satisfied⟩ := ih stored
      exact ⟨targetClass, List.mem_cons_of_mem _ member, satisfied⟩

private theorem allocated_read_cons
    (wf : WellFormedWith classes state pending)
    (root : (reference.object, data) ∈ state.objects)
    (fieldFound : (fields.zip (arguments.map some)).lookup field = some (some reference))
    (rest : Path) :
    readPath (state.allocate name fields arguments) (.owned ⟨state.nextId⟩) (field :: rest) =
      readPath (state.allocate name fields arguments) reference rest := by
  cases rest with
  | nil =>
    rw [readPath_allocate wf (wf.bounds _ _ root)]
    simp [readPath, State.allocate, Reference.owned, fieldFound,
      lookup_of_member wf.objectKeys root]
  | cons next tail => simp [readPath, State.allocate, Reference.owned, fieldFound]

theorem Satisfies.allocated_whole
    (classesWf : classes.WellFormed) (declared : (name, declaration) ∈ classes)
    (wf : WellFormedWith classes.erase state pending)
    (arguments : ArgumentsSatisfy classes state declaration.fields objects) :
    Satisfies classes
      (state.allocate name (declaration.fields.map Prod.fst) objects)
      (.owned ⟨state.nextId⟩) (.whole name) := by
  let allocated := state.allocate name (declaration.fields.map Prod.fst) objects
  have classLookup := lookup_of_member classesWf.1 declared
  constructor
  · rfl
  · exact ⟨⟨name, (declaration.fields.map Prod.fst).zip (objects.map some)⟩,
      by simp [State.allocate, Reference.owned], rfl⟩
  · intro path positive
    change Unique.Typing.Pos classes.nominal (.whole name) path at positive
    rw [Unique.Typing.Pos, Unique.Typing.positive_whole] at positive
    cases path with
    | nil =>
      exact ⟨.owned ⟨state.nextId⟩,
        ⟨name, (declaration.fields.map Prod.fst).zip (objects.map some)⟩,
        by simp [readPath, State.allocate, Reference.owned],
        by simp [State.allocate, Reference.owned], rfl⟩
    | cons field rest =>
      cases fieldClass : declaration.fields.lookup field with
      | none =>
        simp [Unique.Typing.classAt, ClassTable.nominal_lookup, nominal_field_lookup,
          classLookup, fieldClass] at positive
      | some targetClass =>
        obtain ⟨reference, fieldLookup, satisfies⟩ := arguments.lookup fieldClass
        have valid : Pos classes targetClass.toType rest := by
          simpa [Pos, FieldType.toType, ValueType.whole, Unique.Typing.Pos,
            Unique.Typing.positive_whole, Unique.Typing.classAt,
            ClassTable.nominal_lookup, nominal_field_lookup, classLookup, fieldClass] using positive
        have preservedSat : Satisfies classes allocated reference targetClass.toType :=
          satisfies.allocate wf
        obtain ⟨target, data, read, member, correct⟩ := preservedSat.positive rest valid
        obtain ⟨rootData, rootMember, _⟩ := satisfies.root
        refine ⟨target, data, ?_, member, ?_⟩
        · exact (allocated_read_cons wf rootMember fieldLookup rest).trans read
        · simpa [ValueType.whole, Unique.Typing.ViewType.whole, Unique.Typing.classAt,
            ClassTable.nominal_lookup, nominal_field_lookup, classLookup, fieldClass,
            FieldType.toType] using correct
  · intro path negative
    simp [Neg, ValueType.whole, Unique.Typing.Neg, Unique.Typing.negative_whole] at negative
  · intro path target permission declaredPath read
    cases path with
    | nil =>
      have samePermission : permission = .given := (Option.some.inj declaredPath).symm
      have sameTarget : target = .owned ⟨state.nextId⟩ := by
        simpa [readPath, State.allocate, Reference.owned] using read.symm
      subst target permission
      rfl
    | cons field rest =>
      cases fieldClass : declaration.fields.lookup field with
      | none => simp [declaredPermission, classLookup, fieldClass,
          ValueType.whole, Unique.Typing.ViewType.whole] at declaredPath
      | some targetClass =>
        have declaredRest : ∃ inner,
            declaredPermission classes targetClass.className rest = some inner ∧
            permission = targetClass.permission.comp inner := by
          have relation : (declaredPermission classes targetClass.className rest).bind
              (fun inner => some (targetClass.permission.comp inner)) = some permission := by
            simpa [declaredPermission, classLookup, fieldClass, ValueType.whole,
              Unique.Typing.ViewType.whole] using declaredPath
          obtain ⟨inner, found, same⟩ := Option.bind_eq_some_iff.mp relation
          exact ⟨inner, found, (Option.some.inj same).symm⟩
        obtain ⟨inner, declaredRest, rfl⟩ := declaredRest
        obtain ⟨reference, fieldLookup, satisfies⟩ := arguments.lookup fieldClass
        obtain ⟨rootData, rootMember, _⟩ := satisfies.root
        have childRead : readPath allocated reference rest = some (some target) :=
          (allocated_read_cons wf rootMember fieldLookup rest).symm.trans read
        have matched := (satisfies.allocate wf).modes rest target inner declaredRest childRead
        simpa [ValueType.whole, FieldType.toType, Perm.comp_given_left] using matched

theorem ArgumentsSatisfy.of_pending
    (lengths : objects.length = fields.length)
    (satisfied : ∀ object ty, (object, ty) ∈ objects.zip (fields.map fun field => field.2.toType) →
      Satisfies classes state object ty) : ArgumentsSatisfy classes state fields objects := by
  induction fields generalizing objects with
  | nil =>
    have : objects = [] := List.length_eq_zero_iff.mp lengths
    subst objects
    exact .nil
  | cons field fields ih =>
    cases objects with
    | nil => simp at lengths
    | cons object objects =>
      apply ArgumentsSatisfy.cons (satisfied object field.2.toType (by simp))
      apply ih (by simpa using lengths)
      intro object ty member
      exact satisfied object ty (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ member)

theorem FieldsMatchClasses.allocate (matched : FieldsMatchClasses classes state)
    (declared : (name, declaration) ∈ classes)
    (arguments : ArgumentsSatisfy classes state declaration.fields objects) :
    FieldsMatchClasses classes
      (state.allocate name (declaration.fields.map Prod.fst) objects) := by
  intro parent data field target member stored
  rcases List.mem_cons.mp member with same | old
  · cases same
    obtain ⟨targetClass, typedField, satisfied⟩ := arguments.member stored
    obtain ⟨targetData, targetMember, targetName⟩ := satisfied.root
    exact ⟨declaration, targetClass, targetData, declared, typedField,
      List.mem_cons_of_mem _ targetMember, targetName⟩
  · obtain ⟨decl, targetClass, targetData, declared, typedField, allocated, correct⟩ :=
      matched _ _ _ _ old stored
    exact ⟨decl, targetClass, targetData, declared, typedField,
      List.mem_cons_of_mem _ allocated, correct⟩

theorem Realizes.allocate
    (realized : Realizes classes environment state
      (objects.zip (declaration.fields.map fun field => field.2.toType) ++ pending))
    (declared : (name, declaration) ∈ classes)
    (admissible : Admissible classes (.whole name (initialPermission declaration.kind)))
    (lengths : objects.length = declaration.fields.length) :
    Realizes classes environment
      (state.allocate name (declaration.fields.map Prod.fst) objects)
      ((⟨declaration.kind.mode, ⟨state.nextId⟩⟩, .whole name (initialPermission declaration.kind)) :: pending) := by
  have argumentViews : ArgumentsSatisfy classes state declaration.fields objects :=
    ArgumentsSatisfy.of_pending lengths (fun object ty member =>
      realized.pendingValues object ty (List.mem_append_left _ member))
  have owners : WellFormedWith classes.erase state (objects ++ pending.map Prod.fst) := by
    have keys : (objects.zip (declaration.fields.map fun field => field.2.toType)).map Prod.fst = objects :=
      List.map_fst_zip (by simp [lengths])
    simpa only [List.map_append, keys] using realized.ownership
  have erased : (name, Class.mk (declaration.fields.map Prod.fst) declaration.kind) ∈ classes.erase :=
    List.mem_map.mpr ⟨(name, declaration), declared, rfl⟩
  constructor
  · exact realized.classesWellFormed
  · exact realized.environmentWellFormed
  · intro object ty member
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp member with same | old
    · cases same; exact admissible
    · exact realized.pendingTypes object ty (List.mem_append_right _ old)
  · have allocated := owners.allocate realized.classesWellFormed.erase erased (by simpa using lengths) realized.next_fresh
    cases declaration.kind with
    | classType => exact allocated
    | structType => exact allocated
    | sharedStruct => exact allocated.share_result
  · exact realized.fields.allocate declared argumentViews
  · exact realized.variableDomain
  · exact realized.emptyVariables
  · intro destination ty member
    obtain ⟨object, stored, satisfied⟩ := realized.initializedVariables destination ty member
    exact ⟨object, stored, satisfied.allocate realized.ownership⟩
  · intro object ty member
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp member with same | old
    · cases same
      have satisfied := Satisfies.allocated_whole realized.classesWellFormed declared realized.ownership argumentViews
      cases declaration.kind with
      | classType => exact satisfied
      | structType => exact satisfied
      | sharedStruct => exact satisfied.share
    · exact (realized.pendingValues object ty (List.mem_append_right _ old)).allocate realized.ownership

end Dada.Shared.Typing

import Shared.TypingBindingSoundness

namespace Dada.Shared.Unpacking

private theorem owners_targets (state : State) :
    (Owners state).map Reference.object = References state := by
  simp [Owners, References, List.map_filterMap, List.map_flatMap]

private theorem compatible_symm {first second : Reference} (h : Compatible first second) :
    Compatible second first := by
  rcases h with different | shared
  · exact Or.inl (Ne.symm different)
  · exact Or.inr ⟨shared.2, shared.1⟩

theorem Bind.preserves_pending
    (binding : Bind classes before reference pattern after)
    (wf : WellFormedWith classes before (reference :: pending)) : WellFormedWith classes after pending := by
  cases binding with
  | «variable» fresh =>
    refine ⟨wf.objectKeys, ?_, wf.shapes, wf.bounds, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simpa [State.bind] using List.nodup_cons.mpr ⟨fresh, wf.variableKeys⟩
    · intro id allocated
      have live := wf.rooted id allocated
      clear allocated
      induction live with
      | pending member =>
        rcases List.mem_cons.mp member with rfl | member
        · exact .variable (List.mem_cons_self ..)
        · exact .pending member
      | «variable» member => exact .variable (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ member)
      | field _ stored field ih => exact .field ih stored field
    · simpa [State.bind, Owners] using (List.perm_middle (a := reference) (l₁ := pending) (l₂ := Owners before)).symm.pairwise wf.ownersCompatible compatible_symm
    · intro id
      have complete := wf.referencesComplete id
      simpa only [State.bind, References, Allocated, List.map_cons, List.filterMap_cons,
        Option.map_some, List.cons_append, List.mem_cons, List.mem_append,
        or_assoc, or_left_comm] using complete
  | @unpack before after variables nextId object className fields pattern bindings declaration
      declared shape uniqueFields uniqueNames fresh transfer =>
    have subset : ∀ entry ∈ before ++ after,
        entry ∈ before ++ (object, ⟨className, fields⟩) :: after := by
      intro entry member
      rcases List.mem_append.mp member with left | right
      · exact List.mem_append_left _ left
      · exact List.mem_append_right _ (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ right)
    have keys : (before.map Prod.fst ++ object :: after.map Prod.fst).Nodup := by
      simpa using wf.objectKeys
    have removedKeys : (before.map Prod.fst ++ after.map Prod.fst).Nodup :=
      List.Nodup.sublist
        ((List.Sublist.refl _).append (List.sublist_cons_self _ _)) keys
    have removedAbsent : object ∉ before.map Prod.fst ++ after.map Prod.fst := by
      have perm := List.perm_middle (a := object) (l₁ := before.map Prod.fst)
        (l₂ := after.map Prod.fst)
      exact (List.nodup_cons.mp (perm.nodup_iff.mp keys)).1
    have owners := unpack_owners transfer before after variables nextId object className
    have refs : (References
        ⟨before ++ (object, ⟨className, fields⟩) :: after, variables, nextId⟩).Perm
        (References ⟨before ++ after, bindings ++ variables, nextId⟩) := by
      simpa only [owners_targets] using owners.map Reference.object
    have compatible : (Reference.owned object :: pending ++ Owners
        ⟨before ++ after, bindings ++ variables, nextId⟩).Pairwise Compatible := by
      exact (List.Perm.cons _ (owners.append_left pending)).pairwise wf.ownersCompatible compatible_symm
    have absentReference : object ∉ pending.map Reference.object ++ References
        ⟨before ++ after, bindings ++ variables, nextId⟩ := by
      rw [← owners_targets, ← List.map_append]
      intro member
      obtain ⟨reference, member, same⟩ := List.mem_map.mp member
      rcases (List.pairwise_cons.mp compatible).1 reference member with different | shared
      · exact different same.symm
      · cases shared.1
    constructor
    · simpa using removedKeys
    · simp only [List.map_append, transfer.keys]
      apply List.nodup_append.mpr
      refine ⟨uniqueNames, wf.variableKeys, ?_⟩
      intro name member other otherMember equality
      subst other
      exact fresh name member otherMember
    · intro id data member
      exact wf.shapes id data (subset _ member)
    · intro id data member
      exact wf.bounds id data (subset _ member)
    · intro id allocated
      have notRemoved : id ≠ object := by
        intro same; subst id
        exact removedAbsent (by simpa [Allocated, List.map_append] using allocated)
      have oldAllocated : Allocated
          ⟨before ++ (object, ⟨className, fields⟩) :: after, variables, nextId⟩ id := by
        obtain ⟨entry, member, same⟩ := List.mem_map.mp allocated
        exact List.mem_map.mpr ⟨entry, subset _ member, same⟩
      exact (unpack_live transfer (by simpa using removedAbsent) (wf.rooted id oldAllocated)).resolve_left notRemoved
    · exact compatible.of_cons
    · intro id
      have complete := wf.referencesComplete id
      simp only [List.map_cons, List.mem_cons,
        Reference.owned, Allocated, List.map_append, List.mem_append] at complete
      change id ∈ pending.map Reference.object ++ References ⟨before ++ after, bindings ++ variables, nextId⟩ ↔
        id ∈ (before ++ after).map Prod.fst
      by_cases same : id = object
      · subst id
        simp [absentReference, List.map_append, removedAbsent]
      · rw [← (refs.append_left (pending.map Reference.object)).mem_iff]
        simpa [same, List.map_append] using complete

end Dada.Shared.Unpacking

namespace Dada.Shared.Typing

theorem Realizes.pending_head_unique (realized : Realizes classes environment state ((.owned object, ty) :: pending)) :
    object ∉ (pending.map Prod.fst).map Reference.object ++ References state := by
  have targets : (Owners state).map Reference.object = References state := by
    simp [Owners, References, List.map_filterMap, List.map_flatMap]
  rw [← targets, ← List.map_append]
  intro member
  obtain ⟨reference, member, same⟩ := List.mem_map.mp member
  have compatible := realized.ownership.ownersCompatible
  rcases (List.pairwise_cons.mp compatible).1 reference member with different | shared
  · exact different same.symm
  · cases shared.1

theorem Realizes.pending_head_not_reference
    (realized : Realizes classes environment state ((.owned object, ty) :: pending)) :
    object ∉ References state := fun h => realized.pending_head_unique (List.mem_append_right _ h)

theorem BindingTyped.exists_bind_pending
    (typed : BindingTyped classes environment pattern ty afterEnvironment)
    (realized : Realizes classes environment state ((reference, ty) :: pending)) :
    ∃ after, Unpacking.Bind classes.erase state reference pattern after := by
  cases typed with
  | «variable» _ _ fresh =>
    exact ⟨_, .variable (fun occupied => fresh ((realized.variableDomain _).mpr occupied))⟩
  | @unpack _ name declaration fields bindings _ _ given sameClass declared
      sameFields uniqueNames fresh _ _ =>
    have satisfied := realized.pendingValues reference ty (by simp)
    have unique : reference.mode = .unique := by rw [satisfied.mode, given]; rfl
    have owned : reference = .owned reference.object := by cases reference; cases unique; rfl
    rw [owned] at realized ⊢
    obtain ⟨data, stored, rootClass⟩ := satisfied.root
    obtain ⟨leading, trailing, objects⟩ := List.mem_iff_append.mp stored
    obtain ⟨untypedDeclaration, untypedDeclared, shape, _⟩ := realized.ownership.shapes _ _ stored
    have erasedDeclared : (name, ⟨declaration.fields.map Prod.fst, declaration.kind⟩) ∈ classes.erase :=
      List.mem_map.mpr ⟨(name, declaration), declared, rfl⟩
    have dataClass : data.className = name := rootClass.trans sameClass
    have declarationEq : untypedDeclaration = ⟨declaration.fields.map Prod.fst, declaration.kind⟩ :=
      member_value_unique realized.classesWellFormed.erase.1
        (dataClass ▸ untypedDeclared) erasedDeclared
    have actualFields : data.fields.map Prod.fst = declaration.fields.map Prod.fst := by
      simpa [declarationEq] using shape
    obtain ⟨runtimeBindings, transferred⟩ :=
      Unpacking.Transfer.exists_of_permutation (sameFields.trans (List.Perm.of_eq actualFields.symm))
    have fieldsUnique := (sameFields.nodup_iff).mpr
      ((realized.classesWellFormed.2 _ declared).1)
    rcases state with ⟨objectsList, variables, nextId⟩
    simp only at objects
    subst objectsList
    rcases data with ⟨dataName, dataFields⟩
    simp only at dataClass
    subst dataName
    exact ⟨_, .unpack erasedDeclared actualFields fieldsUnique uniqueNames
      (fun destination present occupied =>
        fresh destination present ((realized.variableDomain destination).mpr occupied)) transferred⟩

theorem Realizes.bind_variable_pending
    (realized : Realizes classes environment state ((reference, ty) :: pending))
    (fresh : name ∉ environment.map Prod.fst) :
    Realizes classes ((name, some ty) :: environment) (state.bind name reference) pending := by
  have freshState : name ∉ state.variables.map Prod.fst :=
    fun present => fresh ((realized.variableDomain name).mpr present)
  have admissible := realized.pendingTypes reference ty (by simp)
  constructor
  · exact realized.classesWellFormed
  · simpa [Environment.WellFormed, admissible, fresh] using realized.environmentWellFormed
  · intro root view member
    exact realized.pendingTypes root view (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ member)
  · exact Unpacking.Bind.preserves_pending (.variable freshState) realized.ownership
  · exact realized.fields
  · intro variableName
    simp only [List.map_cons, List.mem_cons, State.bind]
    exact or_congr Iff.rfl (realized.variableDomain variableName)
  · intro variableName member
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp member with impossible | old
    · cases impossible
    · exact List.mem_cons_of_mem _ (realized.emptyVariables _ old)
  · intro variableName variableType member
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp member with new | old
    · cases new
      exact ⟨reference, by simp [State.bind],
        (realized.pendingValues reference ty (by simp)).same_objects rfl⟩
    · obtain ⟨target, stored, satisfied⟩ := realized.initializedVariables _ _ old
      exact ⟨target, List.mem_cons_of_mem _ stored, satisfied.same_objects rfl⟩
  · intro root view member
    exact (realized.pendingValues root view (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ member)).same_objects rfl

theorem Realizes.unpack_of_field_matches_pending {fields : List (FieldName × Slot)}
    (realized : Realizes classes environment
      ⟨leading ++ (object, ⟨className, fields⟩) :: trailing, variables, nextId⟩ ((.owned object, ty) :: pending))
    (typed : FieldBindings classes ty pattern bindings)
    (transfer : Unpacking.Transfer pattern fields runtimeBindings)
    (afterWellFormed : (bindings ++ environment).WellFormed classes)
    (operation : Unpacking.Bind classes.erase
      ⟨leading ++ (object, ⟨className, fields⟩) :: trailing, variables, nextId⟩ (.owned object)
      (.unpack className pattern)
      ⟨leading ++ trailing, runtimeBindings ++ variables, nextId⟩)
    (fieldMatches : ∀ field slot description, (field, slot) ∈ fields →
      fieldDescription classes ty field = some description →
      SlotMatches classes
        ⟨leading ++ (object, ⟨className, fields⟩) :: trailing, variables, nextId⟩
        slot description) :
    Realizes classes (bindings ++ environment)
      ⟨leading ++ trailing, runtimeBindings ++ variables, nextId⟩ pending := by
  have noIncoming := realized.pending_head_not_reference
  have objectStored : (object, ⟨className, fields⟩) ∈
      leading ++ (object, ⟨className, fields⟩) :: trailing := by simp
  have subset : ∀ entry ∈ leading ++ trailing,
      entry ∈ leading ++ (object, ⟨className, fields⟩) :: trailing := by
    intro entry present
    rcases List.mem_append.mp present with left | right
    · exact List.mem_append_left _ left
    · exact List.mem_append_right _ (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ right)
  constructor
  · exact realized.classesWellFormed
  · exact afterWellFormed
  · intro root view member
    exact realized.pendingTypes root view (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ member)
  · exact operation.preserves_pending realized.ownership
  · intro parent data field target stored fieldStored
    have oldStored := subset _ stored
    obtain ⟨declaration, targetType, targetData, declared, declaredField, targetStored, correct⟩ :=
      realized.fields parent data field target oldStored fieldStored
    have different : target.object ≠ object := by
      intro same
      apply noIncoming
      have member := field_reference_mem (state := ⟨leading ++ (object, ⟨className, fields⟩) :: trailing, variables, nextId⟩) oldStored fieldStored
      exact same ▸ member
    exact ⟨declaration, targetType, targetData, declared, declaredField,
      member_remove_other _ _ _ _ _ _ different targetStored, correct⟩
  · intro name
    simp only [List.map_append, List.mem_append, typed.keys, transfer.keys]
    exact or_congr Iff.rfl (realized.variableDomain name)
  · intro name member
    rcases List.mem_append.mp member with new | old
    · obtain ⟨field, patternMember, description⟩ := typed.description_member new
      obtain ⟨slot, bound, stored⟩ := transfer.pattern_member patternMember
      have matched := fieldMatches field slot none stored description
      cases slot with
      | none => exact List.mem_append_left _ bound
      | some target => cases matched
    · exact List.mem_append_right _ (realized.emptyVariables name old)
  · intro name child member
    rcases List.mem_append.mp member with new | old
    · obtain ⟨field, patternMember, description⟩ := typed.description_member new
      obtain ⟨slot, bound, stored⟩ := transfer.pattern_member patternMember
      have matched := fieldMatches field slot (some child) stored description
      cases slot with
      | none => cases matched
      | some target =>
        have different : target.object ≠ object := by
          intro same
          apply noIncoming
          have member := field_reference_mem (state := ⟨leading ++ (object, ⟨className, fields⟩) :: trailing, variables, nextId⟩) (data := ⟨className, fields⟩) objectStored stored
          exact same ▸ member
        exact ⟨target, List.mem_append_left _ bound, matched.remove different noIncoming⟩
    · obtain ⟨target, stored, satisfied⟩ := realized.initializedVariables name child old
      have different : target.object ≠ object := by
        intro same
        apply noIncoming
        have member := variable_reference_mem (state := ⟨leading ++ (object, ⟨className, fields⟩) :: trailing, variables, nextId⟩) stored
        exact same ▸ member
      exact ⟨target, List.mem_append_right _ stored, satisfied.remove different noIncoming⟩
  · intro root view member
    have different : root.object ≠ object := by
      intro same
      apply realized.pending_head_unique
      exact List.mem_append_left _ (List.mem_map.mpr ⟨root, List.mem_map.mpr ⟨(root, view), member, rfl⟩, same⟩)
    exact (realized.pendingValues root view (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ member)).remove different noIncoming


theorem BindingTyped.preserves_realization_of_fields_pending
    (typed : BindingTyped classes environment pattern ty afterEnvironment)
    (realized : Realizes classes environment state ((reference, ty) :: pending))
    (operation : Unpacking.Bind classes.erase state reference pattern after)
    (fieldMatches : reference.mode = .unique →
      ∀ data, (reference.object, data) ∈ state.objects →
      ∀ field slot description, (field, slot) ∈ data.fields →
      fieldDescription classes ty field = some description →
      SlotMatches classes state slot description) :
    Realizes classes afterEnvironment after pending := by
  cases typed with
  | «variable» _ _ fresh =>
    cases operation with
    | «variable» _ => exact realized.bind_variable_pending fresh
  | @unpack _ name declaration pattern bindings _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ fieldTyped afterWf =>
    cases operation with
    | @unpack leading trailing variables nextId object className fields pattern runtimeBindings
        declaration _ _ _ _ _ transfer =>
      apply realized.unpack_of_field_matches_pending fieldTyped transfer afterWf
        (.unpack ‹_› ‹_› ‹_› ‹_› ‹_› transfer)
      exact fieldMatches rfl ⟨name, fields⟩ (by simp [Reference.owned])


theorem BindingTyped.preserves_realization_pending
    (typed : BindingTyped classes environment pattern ty afterEnvironment)
    (realized : Realizes classes environment state ((reference, ty) :: pending))
    (operation : Unpacking.Bind classes.erase state reference pattern after) :
    Realizes classes afterEnvironment after pending := by
  apply typed.preserves_realization_of_fields_pending realized operation
  intro unique data stored field slot description fieldStored described
  have satisfied := realized.pendingValues reference ty (by simp)
  apply satisfied.fieldDescription_of_focus unique realized.ownership stored fieldStored described
  intro child focused
  have normal := typed.wellFormed.2.1.2
  have observations := focus_observations realized.classesWellFormed normal focused
  obtain ⟨target, _, read, _, _⟩ := satisfied.positive [field] observations.positive
  exact ⟨target, read, satisfied.focus realized.classesWellFormed realized.ownership normal focused read⟩

theorem _root_.Dada.Shared.Unpacking.Transfer.exists_of_permutation
    (sameFields : (pattern.map Prod.fst).Perm (fields.map Prod.fst)) :
    ∃ bindings, Unpacking.Transfer pattern fields bindings := by
  induction pattern generalizing fields with
  | nil =>
    have : fields = [] := List.length_eq_zero_iff.mp (by simpa using sameFields.length_eq.symm)
    subst fields
    exact ⟨[], .nil⟩
  | cons pair rest ih =>
    rcases pair with ⟨field, destination⟩
    have present : field ∈ fields.map Prod.fst := sameFields.mem_iff.mp (by simp)
    obtain ⟨⟨actual, slot⟩, member, equality⟩ := List.mem_map.mp present
    simp only at equality
    subst actual
    obtain ⟨before, after, rfl⟩ := List.mem_iff_append.mp member
    have remaining : (rest.map Prod.fst).Perm ((before ++ after).map Prod.fst) := by
      apply List.Perm.cons_inv (a := field)
      exact sameFields.trans (by simp)
    obtain ⟨bindings, transferred⟩ := ih remaining
    exact ⟨(destination, slot) :: bindings, .cons transferred⟩

theorem readPath_same_objects (same : before.objects = after.objects) (reference : Reference)
    (path : Path) : readPath before reference path = readPath after reference path := by
  induction path generalizing reference with
  | nil => simp [readPath, same]
  | cons field rest ih =>
    cases rest with
    | nil => simp [readPath, same]
    | cons next rest => simp only [readPath, same]; congr 1; funext data; congr 1; funext slot
                        congr 1; funext target; simpa only [readPath, same] using ih (enter reference.mode target)

theorem Satisfies.same_objects (satisfied : Satisfies classes before reference ty)
    (same : before.objects = after.objects) : Satisfies classes after reference ty := by
  constructor
  · exact satisfied.mode
  · simpa [same] using satisfied.root
  · intro path positive
    obtain ⟨target, data, read, present, correctClass⟩ := satisfied.positive path positive
    exact ⟨target, data, (readPath_same_objects same _ _).symm.trans read,
      same ▸ present, correctClass⟩
  · intro path negative
    exact (readPath_same_objects same _ _).symm.trans (satisfied.negative path negative)
  · intro path target permission declared read
    exact satisfied.modes path target permission declared
      ((readPath_same_objects same _ _).trans read)

theorem lookup_remove_other {K V : Type} [BEq K] [LawfulBEq K]
    (leading trailing : List (K × V)) (removed key : K) (value : V)
    (different : key ≠ removed) :
    (leading ++ (removed, value) :: trailing).lookup key =
      (leading ++ trailing).lookup key := by
  simp only [List.lookup_append, List.lookup_cons]
  rw [show (key == removed) = false from beq_eq_false_iff_ne.mpr different]

theorem member_remove_other {K V : Type} (leading trailing : List (K × V))
    (removed key : K) (removedValue value : V) (different : key ≠ removed)
    (member : (key, value) ∈ leading ++ (removed, removedValue) :: trailing) :
    (key, value) ∈ leading ++ trailing := by
  simp only [List.mem_append, List.mem_cons, Prod.mk.injEq] at member ⊢
  rcases member with left | same | right
  · exact Or.inl left
  · exact False.elim (different same.1)
  · exact Or.inr right

theorem field_reference_mem (stored : (parent, data) ∈ state.objects)
    (field : (name, some target) ∈ data.fields) : target.object ∈ References state := by
  apply List.mem_append.mpr; right
  apply List.mem_flatMap.mpr
  refine ⟨(parent, data), stored, ?_⟩
  exact List.mem_filterMap.mpr ⟨(name, some target), field, rfl⟩

theorem variable_reference_mem (stored : (name, some target) ∈ state.variables) :
    target.object ∈ References state := by
  exact List.mem_append.mpr (.inl (List.mem_filterMap.mpr ⟨_, stored, rfl⟩))

theorem Realizes.pending_unique_not_reference
    (realized : Realizes classes environment state [(.owned object, ty)]) :
    object ∉ References state := by
  have targets : (Owners state).map Reference.object = References state := by
    simp [Owners, References, List.map_filterMap, List.map_flatMap]
  rw [← targets]
  intro member
  obtain ⟨reference, member, same⟩ := List.mem_map.mp member
  have compatible : (Reference.owned object :: Owners state).Pairwise Compatible :=
    realized.ownership.ownersCompatible
  rcases (List.pairwise_cons.mp compatible).1 reference member with different | shared
  · exact different same.symm
  · cases shared.1

theorem readPath_remove (leading trailing : List (ObjectId × Object))
    (removed : ObjectId) (removedData : Object)
    (beforeVariables afterVariables : List (VariableId × Slot))
    (beforeNext afterNext : Nat)
    (noIncoming : removed ∉ References
      ⟨leading ++ (removed, removedData) :: trailing, beforeVariables, beforeNext⟩)
    (reference : Reference) (different : reference.object ≠ removed) (path : Path) :
    readPath ⟨leading ++ (removed, removedData) :: trailing, beforeVariables, beforeNext⟩
      reference path =
    readPath ⟨leading ++ trailing, afterVariables, afterNext⟩ reference path := by
  induction path generalizing reference with
  | nil =>
    rw [readPath_nil, readPath_nil]
    exact congrArg (fun (found : Option Object) => found.map (fun _ => some reference))
      (lookup_remove_other leading trailing removed reference.object removedData different)
  | cons field rest ih =>
    cases rest with
    | nil =>
      simp only [readPath_singleton]
      rw [lookup_remove_other leading trailing removed reference.object removedData different]
    | cons next rest =>
      have lookupEq := lookup_remove_other leading trailing removed reference.object removedData different
      cases found : (leading ++ (removed, removedData) :: trailing).lookup reference.object with
      | none => simp [readPath, found, ← lookupEq]
      | some data =>
        have stored := lookup_member found
        cases fieldFound : data.fields.lookup field with
        | none => simp [readPath, found, ← lookupEq, fieldFound]
        | some slot =>
          cases slot with
          | none => simp [readPath, found, ← lookupEq, fieldFound]
          | some target =>
            have differentTarget : target.object ≠ removed := by
              intro same
              apply noIncoming
              have member := field_reference_mem (state := ⟨leading ++ (removed, removedData) :: trailing, beforeVariables, beforeNext⟩) stored (lookup_member fieldFound)
              exact same ▸ member
            simpa [readPath, found, ← lookupEq, fieldFound] using
              ih (enter reference.mode target) differentTarget

theorem readPath_target_ne (noIncoming : removed ∉ References state)
    (different : reference.object ≠ removed)
    (read : readPath state reference path = some (some target)) :
    target.object ≠ removed := by
  induction path generalizing reference with
  | nil =>
    cases found : state.objects.lookup reference.object <;> simp [readPath, found] at read
    subst target
    exact different
  | cons field rest ih =>
    obtain ⟨data, slot, stored, fieldStored, final | ⟨child, rfl, more⟩⟩ := readPath_cons read
    · obtain ⟨rfl, final⟩ := final
      obtain ⟨child, rfl, rfl⟩ := Option.map_eq_some_iff.mp final
      change child.object ≠ removed
      intro same
      exact noIncoming (same ▸ field_reference_mem stored fieldStored)
    · apply ih (reference := enter reference.mode child) _ more
      change child.object ≠ removed
      intro same
      exact noIncoming (same ▸ field_reference_mem stored fieldStored)

theorem Satisfies.remove (satisfied : Satisfies classes
      ⟨leading ++ (removed, removedData) :: trailing, variables, nextId⟩ reference ty)
    (different : reference.object ≠ removed)
    (noIncoming : removed ∉ References
      ⟨leading ++ (removed, removedData) :: trailing, variables, nextId⟩) :
    Satisfies classes ⟨leading ++ trailing, afterVariables, afterNext⟩ reference ty := by
  constructor
  · exact satisfied.mode
  · obtain ⟨data, stored, correctClass⟩ := satisfied.root
    exact ⟨data, member_remove_other _ _ _ _ _ _ different stored, correctClass⟩
  · intro path positive
    obtain ⟨target, data, read, stored, correctClass⟩ := satisfied.positive path positive
    refine ⟨target, data, ?_, ?_, correctClass⟩
    · exact (readPath_remove _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ noIncoming reference different path).symm.trans read
    · exact member_remove_other _ _ _ _ _ _
        (readPath_target_ne noIncoming different read) stored
  · intro path negative
    exact (readPath_remove _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ noIncoming reference different path).symm.trans
      (satisfied.negative path negative)
  · intro path target permission declared read
    exact satisfied.modes path target permission declared
      ((readPath_remove _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ noIncoming reference different path).trans read)

theorem _root_.Dada.Shared.Unpacking.Transfer.pattern_member
    (transfer : Unpacking.Transfer pattern fields bindings)
    (member : (field, destination) ∈ pattern) :
    ∃ slot, (destination, slot) ∈ bindings ∧ (field, slot) ∈ fields := by
  induction transfer with
  | nil => simp at member
  | @cons selected name slot pattern before after bindings rest ih =>
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp member with same | later
    · cases same
      exact ⟨slot, by simp, by simp⟩
    · obtain ⟨value, bound, stored⟩ := ih later
      refine ⟨value, List.mem_cons_of_mem _ bound, ?_⟩
      rcases List.mem_append.mp stored with left | right
      · exact List.mem_append_left _ left
      · exact List.mem_append_right _ (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ right)

def SlotMatches (classes : ClassTable) (state : State) : Slot → SlotDescription → Prop
  | none, none => True
  | some reference, some ty => Satisfies classes state reference ty
  | _, _ => False


theorem BindingTyped.exists_bind
    (typed : BindingTyped classes environment pattern ty afterEnvironment)
    (realized : Realizes classes environment state [(reference, ty)]) :
    ∃ after, Unpacking.Bind classes.erase state reference pattern after := by
  cases typed with
  | «variable» _ _ fresh =>
    exact ⟨_, .variable (fun occupied => fresh ((realized.variableDomain _).mpr occupied))⟩
  | @unpack _ name declaration fields bindings _ _ given sameClass declared
      sameFields uniqueNames fresh _ _ =>
    have satisfied := realized.pendingValues reference ty (by simp)
    have unique : reference.mode = .unique := by rw [satisfied.mode, given]; rfl
    have owned : reference = .owned reference.object := by cases reference; cases unique; rfl
    rw [owned] at realized ⊢
    obtain ⟨data, stored, rootClass⟩ := satisfied.root
    obtain ⟨leading, trailing, objects⟩ := List.mem_iff_append.mp stored
    obtain ⟨untypedDeclaration, untypedDeclared, shape, _⟩ := realized.ownership.shapes _ _ stored
    have erasedDeclared : (name, ⟨declaration.fields.map Prod.fst, declaration.kind⟩) ∈ classes.erase :=
      List.mem_map.mpr ⟨(name, declaration), declared, rfl⟩
    have dataClass : data.className = name := rootClass.trans sameClass
    have declarationEq : untypedDeclaration = ⟨declaration.fields.map Prod.fst, declaration.kind⟩ :=
      member_value_unique realized.classesWellFormed.erase.1
        (dataClass ▸ untypedDeclared) erasedDeclared
    have actualFields : data.fields.map Prod.fst = declaration.fields.map Prod.fst := by
      simpa [declarationEq] using shape
    obtain ⟨runtimeBindings, transferred⟩ :=
      Unpacking.Transfer.exists_of_permutation (sameFields.trans (List.Perm.of_eq actualFields.symm))
    have fieldsUnique := (sameFields.nodup_iff).mpr
      ((realized.classesWellFormed.2 _ declared).1)
    rcases state with ⟨objectsList, variables, nextId⟩
    simp only at objects
    subst objectsList
    rcases data with ⟨dataName, dataFields⟩
    simp only at dataClass
    subst dataName
    exact ⟨_, .unpack erasedDeclared actualFields fieldsUnique uniqueNames
      (fun destination present occupied =>
        fresh destination present ((realized.variableDomain destination).mpr occupied)) transferred⟩

theorem Realizes.bind_variable
    (realized : Realizes classes environment state [(reference, ty)])
    (fresh : name ∉ environment.map Prod.fst) :
    Realizes classes ((name, some ty) :: environment) (state.bind name reference) [] := by
  have freshState : name ∉ state.variables.map Prod.fst :=
    fun present => fresh ((realized.variableDomain name).mpr present)
  have admissible := realized.pendingTypes reference ty (by simp)
  constructor
  · exact realized.classesWellFormed
  · simpa [Environment.WellFormed, admissible, fresh] using realized.environmentWellFormed
  · simp
  · exact (Unpacking.Bind.preserves_wellFormed (.variable freshState) realized.ownership).with_pending
  · exact realized.fields
  · intro variableName
    simp only [List.map_cons, List.mem_cons, State.bind]
    exact or_congr Iff.rfl (realized.variableDomain variableName)
  · intro variableName member
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp member with impossible | old
    · cases impossible
    · exact List.mem_cons_of_mem _ (realized.emptyVariables _ old)
  · intro variableName variableType member
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp member with new | old
    · cases new
      exact ⟨reference, by simp [State.bind],
        (realized.pendingValues reference ty (by simp)).same_objects rfl⟩
    · obtain ⟨target, stored, satisfied⟩ := realized.initializedVariables _ _ old
      exact ⟨target, List.mem_cons_of_mem _ stored, satisfied.same_objects rfl⟩
  · simp

theorem FieldBindings.description_member
    (typed : FieldBindings classes ty pattern bindings)
    (member : (destination, description) ∈ bindings) :
    ∃ field, (field, destination) ∈ pattern ∧
      fieldDescription classes ty field = some description := by
  induction typed with
  | nil => simp at member
  | @cons field name desc fields bindings described rest ih =>
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp member with same | later
    · cases same
      exact ⟨field, by simp, described⟩
    · obtain ⟨field, present, described⟩ := ih later
      exact ⟨field, List.mem_cons_of_mem _ present, described⟩

theorem Realizes.unpack_of_field_matches {fields : List (FieldName × Slot)}
    (realized : Realizes classes environment
      ⟨leading ++ (object, ⟨className, fields⟩) :: trailing, variables, nextId⟩ [(.owned object, ty)])
    (typed : FieldBindings classes ty pattern bindings)
    (transfer : Unpacking.Transfer pattern fields runtimeBindings)
    (afterWellFormed : (bindings ++ environment).WellFormed classes)
    (operation : Unpacking.Bind classes.erase
      ⟨leading ++ (object, ⟨className, fields⟩) :: trailing, variables, nextId⟩ (.owned object)
      (.unpack className pattern)
      ⟨leading ++ trailing, runtimeBindings ++ variables, nextId⟩)
    (fieldMatches : ∀ field slot description, (field, slot) ∈ fields →
      fieldDescription classes ty field = some description →
      SlotMatches classes
        ⟨leading ++ (object, ⟨className, fields⟩) :: trailing, variables, nextId⟩
        slot description) :
    Realizes classes (bindings ++ environment)
      ⟨leading ++ trailing, runtimeBindings ++ variables, nextId⟩ [] := by
  have noIncoming := realized.pending_unique_not_reference
  have objectStored : (object, ⟨className, fields⟩) ∈
      leading ++ (object, ⟨className, fields⟩) :: trailing := by simp
  have subset : ∀ entry ∈ leading ++ trailing,
      entry ∈ leading ++ (object, ⟨className, fields⟩) :: trailing := by
    intro entry present
    rcases List.mem_append.mp present with left | right
    · exact List.mem_append_left _ left
    · exact List.mem_append_right _ (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ right)
  constructor
  · exact realized.classesWellFormed
  · exact afterWellFormed
  · simp
  · exact (operation.preserves_wellFormed realized.ownership).with_pending
  · intro parent data field target stored fieldStored
    have oldStored := subset _ stored
    obtain ⟨declaration, targetType, targetData, declared, declaredField, targetStored, correct⟩ :=
      realized.fields parent data field target oldStored fieldStored
    have different : target.object ≠ object := by
      intro same
      apply noIncoming
      have member := field_reference_mem (state := ⟨leading ++ (object, ⟨className, fields⟩) :: trailing, variables, nextId⟩) oldStored fieldStored
      exact same ▸ member
    exact ⟨declaration, targetType, targetData, declared, declaredField,
      member_remove_other _ _ _ _ _ _ different targetStored, correct⟩
  · intro name
    simp only [List.map_append, List.mem_append, typed.keys, transfer.keys]
    exact or_congr Iff.rfl (realized.variableDomain name)
  · intro name member
    rcases List.mem_append.mp member with new | old
    · obtain ⟨field, patternMember, description⟩ := typed.description_member new
      obtain ⟨slot, bound, stored⟩ := transfer.pattern_member patternMember
      have matched := fieldMatches field slot none stored description
      cases slot with
      | none => exact List.mem_append_left _ bound
      | some target => cases matched
    · exact List.mem_append_right _ (realized.emptyVariables name old)
  · intro name child member
    rcases List.mem_append.mp member with new | old
    · obtain ⟨field, patternMember, description⟩ := typed.description_member new
      obtain ⟨slot, bound, stored⟩ := transfer.pattern_member patternMember
      have matched := fieldMatches field slot (some child) stored description
      cases slot with
      | none => cases matched
      | some target =>
        have different : target.object ≠ object := by
          intro same
          apply noIncoming
          have member := field_reference_mem (state := ⟨leading ++ (object, ⟨className, fields⟩) :: trailing, variables, nextId⟩) (data := ⟨className, fields⟩) objectStored stored
          exact same ▸ member
        exact ⟨target, List.mem_append_left _ bound, matched.remove different noIncoming⟩
    · obtain ⟨target, stored, satisfied⟩ := realized.initializedVariables name child old
      have different : target.object ≠ object := by
        intro same
        apply noIncoming
        have member := variable_reference_mem (state := ⟨leading ++ (object, ⟨className, fields⟩) :: trailing, variables, nextId⟩) stored
        exact same ▸ member
      exact ⟨target, List.mem_append_right _ stored, satisfied.remove different noIncoming⟩
  · simp


theorem Satisfies.fieldDescription_of_focus
    (satisfied : Satisfies classes state reference ty)
    (unique : reference.mode = .unique)
    (wf : WellFormedWith classes.erase state pending)
    (dataStored : (reference.object, data) ∈ state.objects)
    (fieldStored : (field, slot) ∈ data.fields)
    (described : fieldDescription classes ty field = some description)
    (focusSound : ∀ child, Typing.focus classes ty [field] = some child →
      ∃ target, readPath state reference [field] = some (some target) ∧
        Satisfies classes state target child) :
    SlotMatches classes state slot description := by
  have dataLookup := lookup_of_member wf.objectKeys dataStored
  obtain ⟨declaration, _, shape, uniqueFields⟩ := wf.shapes _ _ dataStored
  have fieldLookup := lookup_of_member (shape ▸ uniqueFields) fieldStored
  have read : readPath state reference [field] = some slot := by
    cases slot <;> simp [readPath, dataLookup, fieldLookup, unique]
  unfold fieldDescription at described
  split at described
  next negative =>
    have empty := satisfied.negative [field] negative
    have slotEmpty : slot = none := Option.some.inj (read.symm.trans empty)
    have descEmpty : description = none := (Option.some.inj described).symm
    subst slot
    subst description
    trivial
  next notNegative =>
    cases description with
    | none => simp at described
    | some child =>
      have focused : Typing.focus classes ty [field] = some child := by simpa using described
      obtain ⟨target, readTarget, childSatisfied⟩ := focusSound child focused
      have slotTarget : slot = some target := Option.some.inj (read.symm.trans readTarget)
      subst slot
      exact childSatisfied

theorem BindingTyped.preserves_realization_of_fields
    (typed : BindingTyped classes environment pattern ty afterEnvironment)
    (realized : Realizes classes environment state [(reference, ty)])
    (operation : Unpacking.Bind classes.erase state reference pattern after)
    (fieldMatches : reference.mode = .unique →
      ∀ data, (reference.object, data) ∈ state.objects →
      ∀ field slot description, (field, slot) ∈ data.fields →
      fieldDescription classes ty field = some description →
      SlotMatches classes state slot description) :
    Realizes classes afterEnvironment after [] := by
  cases typed with
  | «variable» _ _ fresh =>
    cases operation with
    | «variable» _ => exact realized.bind_variable fresh
  | @unpack _ name declaration pattern bindings _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ fieldTyped afterWf =>
    cases operation with
    | @unpack leading trailing variables nextId object className fields pattern runtimeBindings
        declaration _ _ _ _ _ transfer =>
      apply realized.unpack_of_field_matches fieldTyped transfer afterWf
        (.unpack ‹_› ‹_› ‹_› ‹_› ‹_› transfer)
      exact fieldMatches rfl ⟨name, fields⟩ (by simp [Reference.owned])


theorem BindingTyped.preserves_realization
    (typed : BindingTyped classes environment pattern ty afterEnvironment)
    (realized : Realizes classes environment state [(reference, ty)])
    (operation : Unpacking.Bind classes.erase state reference pattern after) :
    Realizes classes afterEnvironment after [] := by
  apply typed.preserves_realization_of_fields realized operation
  intro unique data stored field slot description fieldStored described
  have satisfied := realized.pendingValues reference ty (by simp)
  apply satisfied.fieldDescription_of_focus unique realized.ownership stored fieldStored described
  intro child focused
  have normal := typed.wellFormed.2.1.2
  have observations := focus_observations realized.classesWellFormed normal focused
  obtain ⟨target, _, read, _, _⟩ := satisfied.positive [field] observations.positive
  exact ⟨target, read, satisfied.focus realized.classesWellFormed realized.ownership normal focused read⟩

theorem give_wrong_permission (taken : give classes environment place = some (result, computedAfter))
    (different : result.permission ≠ ty.permission) :
    ¬ ExprTyped classes environment (.give place) ty after := by
  intro typed
  obtain ⟨other, same, modes⟩ := typed.give_permission place rfl
  have equal := (Prod.mk.inj (Option.some.inj (taken.symm.trans same))).1
  exact different (equal ▸ modes)

  have same : declaration = ⟨[("item", ⟨.shared, "Token"⟩)], .structType⟩ := by
    simpa [classes] using declared
  subst declaration
  cases arguments with
  | cons first rest =>
    exact give_wrong_permission (result := token) (computedAfter := [("t", none)])
      (by decide) (by decide) first

  have same : declaration = ⟨[("item", ⟨.given, "Token"⟩)], .structType⟩ := by
    simpa [classes] using declared
  subst declaration
  cases arguments with
  | cons first rest =>
    exact give_wrong_permission (result := token.shared) (computedAfter := argumentFinal)
      (by decide) (by decide) first

inductive Reachable (objects : List (ObjectId × Object)) (roots : List Reference) : ObjectId → Prop where
  | root {reference} : reference ∈ roots → Reachable objects roots reference.object
  | field {parent data name reference} : Reachable objects roots parent →
      (parent, data) ∈ objects → (name, some reference) ∈ data.fields →
      Reachable objects roots reference.object

def rootReferences (state : State) (pending : PendingValues) : List Reference :=
  pending.map Prod.fst ++ state.variables.filterMap Prod.snd

def collectPending (state : State) (pending : PendingValues) : State := by
  classical
  exact { state with objects := state.objects.filter (fun entry => decide (Reachable state.objects (rootReferences state pending) entry.1)) }

theorem collectPending_member {id : ObjectId} {data : Object} : (id, data) ∈ (collectPending state pending).objects ↔
    (id, data) ∈ state.objects ∧ Reachable state.objects (rootReferences state pending) id := by
  classical
  simp [collectPending]

theorem lookup_filter_keep {K V : Type} [BEq K] [LawfulBEq K]
    (entries : List (K × V)) (keep : K → Bool) (key : K) (kept : keep key = true) :
    (entries.filter (fun entry => keep entry.1)).lookup key = entries.lookup key := by
  induction entries with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons entry rest ih =>
    rcases entry with ⟨k,v⟩
    by_cases same : key = k
    · subst k; simp [kept]
    · cases h : keep k <;> simp [h, List.lookup_cons, beq_eq_false_iff_ne.mpr same, ih]

theorem readPath_collectPending (live : Reachable state.objects (rootReferences state pending) reference.object)
    (path : Path) : readPath (collectPending state pending) reference path = readPath state reference path := by
  classical
  have lookup (reference : Reference) (h : Reachable state.objects (rootReferences state pending) reference.object) :
      (collectPending state pending).objects.lookup reference.object = state.objects.lookup reference.object :=
    lookup_filter_keep state.objects (fun id => decide (Reachable state.objects (rootReferences state pending) id)) reference.object (by simpa using h)
  induction path generalizing reference with
  | nil => simp only [readPath_nil, lookup reference live]
  | cons field rest ih =>
    cases rest with
    | nil => simp only [readPath_singleton, lookup reference live]
    | cons next rest =>
      cases found : state.objects.lookup reference.object with
      | none => simp [readPath, lookup reference live, found]
      | some data =>
        cases slot : data.fields.lookup field with
        | none => simp [readPath, lookup reference live, found, slot]
        | some slotValue =>
          cases slotValue with
          | none => simp [readPath, lookup reference live, found, slot]
          | some child =>
            have childLive := Reachable.field live (lookup_member found) (lookup_member slot)
            simpa [readPath, lookup reference live, found, slot] using ih (reference := enter reference.mode child) childLive

theorem readPath_reachable (live : Reachable state.objects roots reference.object)
    (read : readPath state reference path = some (some target)) : Reachable state.objects roots target.object := by
  induction path generalizing reference with
  | nil =>
    cases found : state.objects.lookup reference.object <;> simp [readPath, found] at read
    subst target; exact live
  | cons field rest ih =>
    obtain ⟨data, slot, stored, fieldStored, final | ⟨child, rfl, more⟩⟩ := readPath_cons read
    · obtain ⟨rfl, final⟩ := final
      obtain ⟨child, rfl, rfl⟩ := Option.map_eq_some_iff.mp final
      exact Reachable.field (reference := child) live stored fieldStored
    · exact ih (reference := enter reference.mode child) (Reachable.field (reference := child) live stored fieldStored) more

theorem Satisfies.collect_pending (satisfied : Satisfies classes state reference ty)
    (live : Reachable state.objects (rootReferences state pending) reference.object) :
    Satisfies classes (collectPending state pending) reference ty := by
  constructor
  · exact satisfied.mode
  · obtain ⟨data, member, name⟩ := satisfied.root
    exact ⟨data, collectPending_member.mpr ⟨member, live⟩, name⟩
  · intro path positive
    obtain ⟨target, data, read, member, name⟩ := satisfied.positive path positive
    exact ⟨target, data, (readPath_collectPending live _).trans read,
      collectPending_member.mpr ⟨member, readPath_reachable live read⟩, name⟩
  · intro path negative
    exact (readPath_collectPending live _).trans (satisfied.negative path negative)
  · intro path target permission declared read
    exact satisfied.modes path target permission declared ((readPath_collectPending live _).symm.trans read)

private theorem owners_targets (state : State) :
    (Owners state).map Reference.object = References state := by
  simp [Owners, References, List.map_filterMap, List.map_flatMap]

private theorem flatMap_filter_sublist {A B : Type} (xs : List A) (test : A → Bool) (f : A → List B) :
    ((xs.filter test).flatMap f).Sublist (xs.flatMap f) := by
  induction xs with
  | nil => exact .refl _
  | cons x xs ih =>
    cases h : test x
    · simp only [List.filter_cons, h, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, List.flatMap_cons]
      exact ih.trans (List.sublist_append_right _ _)
    · simpa only [List.filter_cons, h, ↓reduceIte, List.flatMap_cons] using
        (List.Sublist.refl (f x)).append ih

theorem Realizes.collect_pending (realized : Realizes classes environment state pending)
    (subset : kept.Sublist pending) : Realizes classes environment (collectPending state kept) kept := by
  classical
  let roots := rootReferences state kept
  have oldMember {id data} (h : (id, data) ∈ (collectPending state kept).objects) :
      (id, data) ∈ state.objects := (collectPending_member.mp h).1
  have variableLive {name reference} (h : (name, some reference) ∈ state.variables) :
      Reachable state.objects roots reference.object :=
    .root (List.mem_append_right _ (List.mem_filterMap.mpr ⟨_, h, rfl⟩))
  have pendingLive {reference ty} (h : (reference, ty) ∈ kept) :
      Reachable state.objects roots reference.object :=
    .root (List.mem_append_left _ (List.mem_map.mpr ⟨_, h, rfl⟩))
  have liveAllocated {id} (live : Reachable state.objects roots id) : Allocated state id := by
    apply (realized.ownership.referencesComplete id).mp
    cases live with
    | root member =>
      change _ ∈ kept.map Prod.fst ++ state.variables.filterMap Prod.snd at member
      rcases List.mem_append.mp member with p | v
      · obtain ⟨pair, pairMember, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp p
        exact List.mem_append_left _ (List.mem_map.mpr ⟨pair.1,
          List.mem_map.mpr ⟨pair, subset.subset pairMember, rfl⟩, rfl⟩)
      · obtain ⟨⟨name, slot⟩, slotMember, value⟩ := List.mem_filterMap.mp v
        change slot = some _ at value
        subst slot
        exact List.mem_append_right _ (variable_reference_mem slotMember)
    | field _ stored field => exact List.mem_append_right _ (field_reference_mem stored field)
  have retained {id} (live : Reachable state.objects roots id) :
      Allocated (collectPending state kept) id := by
    obtain ⟨⟨_,data⟩, member, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp (liveAllocated live)
    exact List.mem_map.mpr ⟨(_,data), collectPending_member.mpr ⟨member, live⟩, rfl⟩
  constructor
  · exact realized.classesWellFormed
  · exact realized.environmentWellFormed
  · intro reference ty member; exact realized.pendingTypes _ _ (subset.subset member)
  · constructor
    · exact realized.ownership.objectKeys.sublist (List.filter_sublist.map Prod.fst)
    · exact realized.ownership.variableKeys
    · intro id data member; exact realized.ownership.shapes _ _ (oldMember member)
    · intro id data member; exact realized.ownership.bounds _ _ (oldMember member)
    · intro id allocated
      obtain ⟨⟨_, data⟩, member, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp allocated
      have live := (collectPending_member.mp member).2
      clear member allocated
      induction live with
      | root member =>
        rcases List.mem_append.mp member with p | v
        · exact .pending p
        · obtain ⟨⟨name, slot⟩, stored, value⟩ := List.mem_filterMap.mp v
          change slot = some _ at value
          subst slot
          exact .variable stored
      | field live stored field ih =>
        exact .field ih (collectPending_member.mpr ⟨stored, live⟩) field
    · apply List.Pairwise.sublist _ realized.ownership.ownersCompatible
      apply List.Sublist.append (subset.map Prod.fst)
      apply List.Sublist.append (List.Sublist.refl _)
      exact flatMap_filter_sublist _ _ _
    · intro id
      constructor
      · intro member
        rw [← owners_targets, ← List.map_append] at member
        obtain ⟨reference, refMember, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp member
        rcases List.mem_append.mp refMember with pendingMember | owner
        · obtain ⟨pair, pairMember, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp pendingMember
          exact retained (pendingLive pairMember)
        · rcases List.mem_append.mp owner with variableMember | field
          · obtain ⟨⟨name, slot⟩, slotMember, value⟩ := List.mem_filterMap.mp variableMember
            change slot = some _ at value
            subst slot
            exact retained (variableLive slotMember)
          · obtain ⟨⟨parent,data⟩, member, fieldMember⟩ := List.mem_flatMap.mp field
            obtain ⟨⟨name, slot⟩, slotMember, value⟩ := List.mem_filterMap.mp fieldMember
            change slot = some _ at value
            subst slot
            have live := (collectPending_member.mp member).2
            exact retained (.field live (oldMember member) slotMember)
      · intro allocated
        obtain ⟨⟨id',data⟩, member, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp allocated
        have live := (collectPending_member.mp member).2
        cases live with
        | root rootMember =>
          change _ ∈ kept.map Prod.fst ++ state.variables.filterMap Prod.snd at rootMember
          rcases List.mem_append.mp rootMember with p | v
          · exact List.mem_append_left _ (List.mem_map.mpr ⟨_, p, rfl⟩)
          · exact List.mem_append_right _ (by
              rw [← owners_targets]
              exact List.mem_map.mpr ⟨_, List.mem_append_left _ v, rfl⟩)
        | @field parent data name reference live stored field =>
          exact List.mem_append_right _ (field_reference_mem
            (collectPending_member.mpr ⟨stored, live⟩) field)
  · intro parent data field target stored fieldStored
    obtain ⟨decl, ty, targetData, declared, described, targetStored, name⟩ :=
      realized.fields _ _ _ _ (oldMember stored) fieldStored
    exact ⟨decl, ty, targetData, declared, described,
      collectPending_member.mpr ⟨targetStored, .field (collectPending_member.mp stored).2 (oldMember stored) fieldStored⟩, name⟩
  · exact realized.variableDomain
  · exact realized.emptyVariables
  · intro name ty member
    obtain ⟨reference, stored, satisfied⟩ := realized.initializedVariables _ _ member
    exact ⟨reference, stored, satisfied.collect_pending (variableLive stored)⟩
  · intro reference ty member
    exact (realized.pendingValues _ _ (subset.subset member)).collect_pending (pendingLive member)
