theorem ClassTable.WellFormed.erase {classes : ClassTable} (wf : classes.WellFormed) :
    ClassesWellFormed classes.erase := by
  constructor
  · simpa [ClassTable.erase, List.map_map, Function.comp_def] using wf.1
  · intro name declaration member
    obtain ⟨⟨originalName, original⟩, present, equality⟩ := List.mem_map.mp member
    cases equality
    exact (wf.2 _ present).1

-- A move updates an existing slot's description; it never allocates a name.
theorem Environment.replace_keys (environment : Environment) (name : VariableId)
    (description : SlotDescription) :
    (environment.replace name description).map Prod.fst = environment.map Prod.fst := by
  simp only [Environment.replace, List.map_map]
  apply List.map_congr_left
  intro entry _
  by_cases same : entry.1 = name <;> simp [same]

theorem give_keys (taken : Typing.give classes before place = some (ty, after)) :
    after.map Prod.fst = before.map Prod.fst := by
  unfold give at taken
  obtain ⟨sourceSlot, _, taken⟩ := Option.bind_eq_some_iff.mp taken
  obtain ⟨source, _, taken⟩ := Option.bind_eq_some_iff.mp taken
  obtain ⟨result, _, taken⟩ := Option.bind_eq_some_iff.mp taken
  by_cases shared : result.permission = .shared
  · simp [shared] at taken
    exact congrArg (List.map Prod.fst) taken.2.symm
  · simp only [shared, ↓reduceIte] at taken
    by_cases empty : (splitPlace place).2 = []
    · simp [empty] at taken
      rcases taken with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
      exact Environment.replace_keys _ _ _
    · simp only [empty, ↓reduceIte] at taken
      obtain ⟨remaining, _, taken⟩ := Option.bind_eq_some_iff.mp taken
      simp only [pure, Option.some.injEq, Prod.mk.injEq] at taken
      rcases taken with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
      exact Environment.replace_keys _ _ _

theorem ExprTyped.keys (typed : ExprTyped classes before value ty after) :
    after.map Prod.fst = before.map Prod.fst := by
  induction typed using ExprTyped.rec
    (motive_2 := fun before _ _ after _ => after.map Prod.fst = before.map Prod.fst) with
  | give _ taken _ _ => exact give_keys taken
  | giveShare _ taken _ _ => exact give_keys taken
  | new _ _ _ _ ih => exact ih
  | weaken _ _ _ ih => exact ih
  | nil => rfl
  | cons _ _ first rest => exact rest.trans first

theorem ArgsTyped.keys (typed : ArgsTyped classes before values names after) :
    after.map Prod.fst = before.map Prod.fst := by
  induction typed using ArgsTyped.rec (motive_1 := fun _ _ _ _ _ => True) with
  | give => trivial
  | giveShare => trivial
  | new => trivial
  | weaken => trivial
  | nil => rfl
  | cons first _ _ rest => exact rest.trans first.keys

theorem ExprTyped.wellFormed (typed : ExprTyped classes before value ty after) :
    before.WellFormed classes ∧ Admissible classes ty ∧ after.WellFormed classes := by
  induction typed using ExprTyped.rec
    (motive_2 := fun before _ _ after _ =>
      before.WellFormed classes ∧ after.WellFormed classes) with
  | give beforeWf _ admissible afterWf => exact ⟨beforeWf, admissible, afterWf⟩
  | giveShare beforeWf _ admissible afterWf structTy =>
    exact ⟨beforeWf, admissible.share structTy, afterWf⟩
  | new _ _ admissible _ ih => exact ⟨ih.1, admissible, ih.2⟩
  | weaken _ admissible _ ih => exact ⟨ih.1, admissible, ih.2.2⟩
  | nil wf => exact ⟨wf, wf⟩
  | cons _ _ first rest => exact ⟨first.1, rest.2⟩

theorem ArgsTyped.wellFormed (typed : ArgsTyped classes before values names after) :
    before.WellFormed classes ∧ after.WellFormed classes := by
  induction typed using ArgsTyped.rec (motive_1 := fun _ _ _ _ _ => True) with
  | give => trivial
  | giveShare => trivial
  | new => trivial
  | weaken => trivial
  | nil wf => exact ⟨wf, wf⟩
  | cons first _ _ rest => exact ⟨first.wellFormed.1, rest.2⟩

theorem BindingTyped.wellFormed (typed : BindingTyped classes before pattern ty after) :
    before.WellFormed classes ∧ Admissible classes ty ∧ after.WellFormed classes := by
  cases typed with
  | «variable» beforeWf admissible fresh =>
    refine ⟨beforeWf, admissible, ?_⟩
    simpa [Environment.WellFormed, admissible, fresh] using beforeWf
  | unpack beforeWf admissible _ _ _ _ _ _ _ afterWf =>
    exact ⟨beforeWf, admissible, afterWf⟩

theorem StatementTyped.wellFormed (typed : StatementTyped classes before statement after) :
    before.WellFormed classes ∧ after.WellFormed classes := by
  cases typed with
  | letValue expression binding => exact ⟨expression.wellFormed.1, binding.wellFormed.2.2⟩

theorem SequenceTyped.wellFormed (typed : SequenceTyped classes before statements after) :
    before.WellFormed classes ∧ after.WellFormed classes := by
  induction typed with
  | nil wf => exact ⟨wf, wf⟩
  | cons first _ rest => exact ⟨first.wellFormed.1, rest.2⟩

end Dada.Shared.Typing

-- These statements quantify over arbitrary heaps realizing the static input,
-- including previously evaluated arguments held outside the variable store.
def ExpressionSound (classes : ClassTable) (before : Environment) (value : Value)
    (ty : ValueType) (after : Environment) : Prop :=
  ∀ state pending, Realizes classes before state pending →
    (∃ result object, Eval classes.erase state value result object) ∧
    (∀ result object, Eval classes.erase state value result object →
      Realizes classes after result ((object, ty) :: pending))

def ArgumentsSound (classes : ClassTable) (before : Environment) (values : List Value)
    (fields : List FieldType) (after : Environment) : Prop :=
  ∀ state pending, Realizes classes before state pending →
    (∃ result objects, EvalArgs classes.erase state values result objects) ∧
    (∀ result objects, EvalArgs classes.erase state values result objects →
      Realizes classes after result (objects.zip (fields.map FieldType.toType) ++ pending))

-- The induction isolates the move lemma: construction and weakening need no
-- additional assumptions about how a place is represented or traversed.
theorem ExprTyped.sound_of_give
    (giveSound : ∀ before place ty after, before.WellFormed classes →
      Typing.give classes before place = some (ty, after) → Admissible classes ty →
      after.WellFormed classes → ExpressionSound classes before (.give place) ty after)
    (typed : ExprTyped classes before value ty after) :
    ExpressionSound classes before value ty after := by
  induction typed using ExprTyped.rec
    (motive_2 := fun before values fields after _ => ArgumentsSound classes before values fields after) with
  | give wf taken admissible afterWf => exact giveSound _ _ _ _ wf taken admissible afterWf
  | @giveShare before after place ty wf taken admissible afterWf structTy =>
    intro state pending realized
    obtain ⟨existsGive, allGive⟩ := giveSound _ _ _ _ wf taken admissible afterWf state pending realized
    constructor
    · obtain ⟨result, reference, evaluated⟩ := existsGive
      cases evaluated with
      | give given =>
        have sat := (allGive result reference (.give given)).pendingValues reference ty (by simp)
        obtain ⟨data, stored, name⟩ := sat.root
        obtain ⟨declaration, declared, kind⟩ := structTy.declaration
        exact ⟨result, .shared reference.object, .giveShare given
          ⟨data, ⟨declaration.fields.map Prod.fst, declaration.kind⟩, stored,
            List.mem_map.mpr ⟨(ty.base, declaration), lookup_member declared, by simp [ValueType.base, name]⟩,
            kind⟩⟩
    · intro result reference evaluation
      cases evaluation with
      | giveShare given _ =>
        exact (allGive result _ (.give given)).share_pending structTy
  | @new before after name declaration arguments declared args admissible structFields ih =>
    intro state pending realized
    have erased : (name, Class.mk (declaration.fields.map Prod.fst) declaration.kind) ∈ classes.erase :=
      List.mem_map.mpr ⟨(name, declaration), declared, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨existsArgs, allArgs⟩ := ih state pending realized
    constructor
    · obtain ⟨evaluated, objects, evaluatedArgs⟩ := existsArgs
      have current := allArgs evaluated objects evaluatedArgs
      have lengths : objects.length = declaration.fields.length := by
        have argumentLengths := args.length
        have resultLengths := evaluatedArgs.length
        simpa using resultLengths.trans argumentLengths
      exact ⟨_, _, .new erased evaluatedArgs (by simpa using lengths) current.next_fresh (by
        intro isStruct reference member
        have views : ArgumentsSatisfy classes evaluated declaration.fields objects :=
          ArgumentsSatisfy.of_pending lengths (fun object ty pair =>
            current.pendingValues object ty (List.mem_append_left _ (by
              simpa only [List.map_map, Function.comp_def] using pair)))
        obtain ⟨entry, entryMember, sat⟩ := views.reference member
        obtain ⟨data, stored, nameEq⟩ := sat.root
        obtain ⟨target, targetDeclared, targetKind⟩ := (structFields isStruct entry entryMember).declaration
        exact ⟨data, ⟨target.fields.map Prod.fst, target.kind⟩, stored,
          List.mem_map.mpr ⟨(_, target), lookup_member targetDeclared, by simp [ValueType.base, FieldType.toType, ValueType.whole] at nameEq ⊢; exact nameEq.symm⟩,
          targetKind⟩)⟩
    · intro result object evaluation
      cases evaluation with
      | new runtimeDeclared evaluatedArgs lengths _ _ =>
        have same := member_value_unique realized.classesWellFormed.erase.1 runtimeDeclared erased
        cases same
        have current := allArgs _ _ evaluatedArgs
        simp only [List.map_map, Function.comp_def] at current
        exact current.allocate declared admissible (by simpa using lengths)
  | @weaken before after value ty other typed admissible subtype ih =>
    intro state pending realized
    obtain ⟨existsEval, allEval⟩ := ih state pending realized
    exact ⟨existsEval, fun result object evaluated =>
      (allEval result object evaluated).weaken_pending admissible subtype⟩
  | nil wf =>
    intro state pending realized
    refine ⟨⟨state, [], .nil state⟩, ?_⟩
    intro result objects evaluation
    cases evaluation
    exact realized
  | @cons before middle after value values field fields typed args first rest =>
    intro state pending realized
    obtain ⟨existsFirst, allFirst⟩ := first state pending realized
    constructor
    · obtain ⟨middleState, object, evaluatedFirst⟩ := existsFirst
      obtain ⟨⟨result, objects, evaluatedRest⟩, _⟩ :=
        rest middleState ((object, field.toType) :: pending)
          (allFirst middleState object evaluatedFirst)
      exact ⟨result, object :: objects, .cons evaluatedFirst evaluatedRest⟩
    · intro result objects evaluation
      cases evaluation with
      | cons evaluatedFirst evaluatedRest =>
        have firstRealized := allFirst _ _ evaluatedFirst
        have restRealized := (rest _ _ firstRealized).2 _ _ evaluatedRest
        exact restRealized.perm List.perm_middle

theorem Satisfies.focus (satisfied : Satisfies classes state reference source)
    (classesWf : classes.WellFormed) (wf : WellFormedWith classes.erase state pending)
    (normal : Normalized classes source)
    (focused : focus classes source path = some result)
    (read : readPath state reference path = some (some target)) :
    Satisfies classes state target result := by
  have observations := focus_observations classesWf normal focused
  obtain ⟨permission, declared, samePermission⟩ := focus_permission focused
  constructor
  · rw [samePermission]
    exact satisfied.modes path target permission declared read
  · obtain ⟨target', data, read', member, correct⟩ := satisfied.positive path observations.positive
    have same : target' = target := by simpa [read] using read'.symm
    subst target'
    exact ⟨data, member, by simpa [observations.className] using correct.symm⟩
  · intro suffix known
    obtain ⟨resultReference, data, completeRead, member, correct⟩ :=
      satisfied.positive _ (observations.positives suffix known)
    refine ⟨resultReference, data, (readPath_append wf read suffix).symm.trans completeRead, member, ?_⟩
    simpa [Unique.Typing.classAt_append, observations.className] using correct
  · intro suffix known
    exact (readPath_append wf read suffix).symm.trans
      (satisfied.negative _ (observations.negatives suffix known))
  · intro suffix reached tailPermission tailDeclared tailRead
    have completeDeclared : declaredPermission classes source.nominal.className (path ++ suffix) =
        some (permission.comp tailPermission) := by
      rw [declaredPermission_append observations.className]
      change declaredPermission classes source.nominal.className path = some permission at declared
      simp [declared, tailDeclared]
    have completeRead := (readPath_append wf read suffix).trans tailRead
    have mode := satisfied.modes _ _ _ completeDeclared completeRead
    simpa [samePermission, Perm.comp_assoc] using mode

theorem Environment.lookup_member {environment : Environment} (found : environment.lookup name = some description) :
    (name, description) ∈ environment := by
  unfold Environment.lookup at found
  obtain ⟨entry, present, equal⟩ := Option.map_eq_some_iff.mp found
  have member := List.mem_of_find?_eq_some present
  have key := List.find?_some present
  have same : entry.1 = name := by simpa using key
  cases entry
  simp only at same equal
  subst_vars
  exact member

theorem Environment.admissible {environment : Environment} (wf : environment.WellFormed classes)
    (member : (name, some ty) ∈ environment) : Admissible classes ty := by
  have all := List.all_eq_true.mp wf.2
  simpa using all (name, some ty) member

theorem give_description (given : give classes before place = some (ty, after)) :
    ∃ source,
      before.lookup (splitPlace place).1 = some (some source) ∧
      focus classes source (splitPlace place).2 = some ty ∧
      ((ty.permission = .shared ∧ after = before) ∨
       (ty.permission = .given ∧
        (((splitPlace place).2 = [] ∧ after = before.replace (splitPlace place).1 none) ∨
         ∃ remaining, (splitPlace place).2 ≠ [] ∧
           emptyPath classes source (splitPlace place).2 = some remaining ∧
           after = before.replace (splitPlace place).1 (some remaining)))) := by
  unfold give at given
  obtain ⟨slot, found, slotBind⟩ := Option.bind_eq_some_iff.mp given
  obtain ⟨source, value, resultBind⟩ := Option.bind_eq_some_iff.mp slotBind
  rw [value] at found
  obtain ⟨result, focused, body⟩ := Option.bind_eq_some_iff.mp resultBind
  by_cases shared : result.permission = .shared
  · simp [shared] at body
    rcases body with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨source, found, focused, Or.inl ⟨shared, rfl⟩⟩
  · have unique : result.permission = .given := by
      cases h : result.permission <;> simp_all
    simp only [shared, ↓reduceIte] at body
    by_cases empty : (splitPlace place).2 = []
    · simp [empty] at body
      rcases body with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨source, found, focused, Or.inr ⟨unique, Or.inl ⟨empty, rfl⟩⟩⟩
    · simp only [empty, ↓reduceIte] at body
      obtain ⟨remaining, emptied, finalBind⟩ := Option.bind_eq_some_iff.mp body
      simp only [pure, Option.some.injEq, Prod.mk.injEq] at finalBind
      rcases finalBind with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨source, found, focused,
        Or.inr ⟨unique, Or.inr ⟨remaining, empty, emptied, rfl⟩⟩⟩

theorem give_evaluates (given : give classes before place = some (ty, after))
    (realized : Realizes classes before state pending) :
    ∃ result reference, Eval classes.erase state (.give place) result reference := by
  obtain ⟨source, found, focused, _⟩ := give_description given
  have member := Environment.lookup_member found
  have admissible := Environment.admissible realized.environmentWellFormed member
  obtain ⟨reference, stored, satisfied⟩ := realized.initializedVariables _ _ member
  have facts := focus_observations realized.classesWellFormed admissible.2 focused
  obtain ⟨target, data, read, _, _⟩ := satisfied.positive _ facts.positive
  obtain ⟨destination, resolved⟩ := resolve_from_readPath stored read
  change Resolve state (placeFrom (splitPlace place).1 (splitPlace place).2) _ _ _ at resolved
  rw [placeFrom_splitPlace] at resolved
  obtain ⟨result, given⟩ := resolved.give_exists
  exact ⟨result, target, .give given⟩

theorem Environment.replace_member {environment : Environment}
    (member : (name, description) ∈ environment.replace root replacement) :
    (name = root ∧ description = replacement) ∨
      (name ≠ root ∧ (name, description) ∈ environment) := by
  obtain ⟨⟨key, value⟩, old, changed⟩ := List.mem_map.mp member
  by_cases same : key = root
  · simp [same] at changed
    exact Or.inl ⟨changed.1.symm, changed.2.symm⟩
  · simp [same] at changed
    rcases changed with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
    exact Or.inr ⟨same, old⟩

theorem resolve_source_nonempty (resolved : Resolve state place source object permission)
    (nonempty : (splitPlace place).2 ≠ []) : ∃ parent field, source = .field parent field := by
  cases resolved with
  | «variable» _ => exact False.elim (nonempty rfl)
  | field _ _ _ => exact ⟨_, _, rfl⟩

theorem resolve_source_empty (resolved : Resolve state place source object permission)
    (empty : (splitPlace place).2 = []) : source = .variable (splitPlace place).1 := by
  cases resolved with
  | «variable» _ => rfl
  | field _ _ _ => simp [splitPlace] at empty

theorem take_preserves_other_variable
    (resolved : Resolve before place source object permission) (taken : Take before source object after)
    (different : name ≠ (splitPlace place).1) (stored : (name, slot) ∈ before.variables) :
    (name, slot) ∈ after.variables := by
  apply taken.stored_unchanged (place := .variable name) _ stored
  intro same
  cases resolved with
  | «variable» _ => cases same; exact different rfl
  | field _ _ _ => cases same

theorem take_preserves_variable_field (resolved : Resolve before place source object permission)
    (taken : Take before source object after) (nonempty : (splitPlace place).2 ≠ [])
    (stored : (name, slot) ∈ before.variables) : (name, slot) ∈ after.variables := by
  obtain ⟨parent, field, rfl⟩ := resolve_source_nonempty resolved nonempty
  exact taken.stored_unchanged (place := .variable name) (by intro impossible; cases impossible) stored

theorem FieldsMatchClasses.take (fields : FieldsMatchClasses classes before)
    (taken : Take before place object after) : FieldsMatchClasses classes after := by
  intro parent data field target stored atField
  obtain ⟨oldData, oldStored, sameClass, _, remaining⟩ := taken.object_data parent data stored
  obtain ⟨declaration, targetClass, targetData, declared, fieldDeclared, targetStored, targetName⟩ :=
    fields parent oldData field target oldStored (remaining field target atField)
  obtain ⟨newData, newStored, newClass⟩ := taken.old_object_data target.object targetData targetStored
  exact ⟨declaration, targetClass, newData, sameClass ▸ declared, fieldDeclared,
    newStored, newClass.trans targetName⟩

theorem FieldsMatchClasses.promote (fields : FieldsMatchClasses classes before)
    (promoted : Promote before place object after) : FieldsMatchClasses classes after := by
  intro parent data field target stored atField
  obtain ⟨oldData, oldStored, sameClass, _, remaining⟩ := promoted.object_data parent data stored
  obtain ⟨oldReference, oldField, sameTarget⟩ := remaining field target atField
  obtain ⟨declaration, targetClass, targetData, declared, fieldDeclared, targetStored, targetName⟩ :=
    fields parent oldData field oldReference oldStored oldField
  obtain ⟨newData, newStored, newClass⟩ := promoted.old_object_data oldReference.object targetData targetStored
  exact ⟨declaration, targetClass, newData, sameClass ▸ declared, fieldDeclared,
    sameTarget ▸ newStored, newClass.trans targetName⟩

theorem Satisfies.take_taken (wf : WellFormedWith classes.erase before pending)
    (afterWf : WellFormedWith classes.erase after afterPending)
    (taken : Take before source reference.object after)
    (cut : Route before pending site cutPath reference) (unique : reference.mode = .unique)
    (satisfied : Satisfies classes before reference ty) :
    Satisfies classes after reference ty := by
  constructor
  · exact satisfied.mode
  · obtain ⟨data, stored, same⟩ := satisfied.root
    obtain ⟨newData, newStored, newSame⟩ := taken.old_object_data reference.object data stored
    exact ⟨newData, newStored, newSame.trans same⟩
  · intro path positive
    obtain ⟨target, data, read, stored, correctClass⟩ := satisfied.positive path positive
    obtain ⟨newData, newStored, sameClass⟩ := taken.old_object_data target.object data stored
    exact ⟨target, newData, take_readPath_taken wf afterWf taken cut unique read, newStored, sameClass ▸ correctClass⟩
  · intro path negative
    exact take_readPath_taken wf afterWf taken cut unique (satisfied.negative path negative)

  · intro path target permission declared read
    exact satisfied.modes path target permission declared (take_readPath_back wf taken read)

theorem Satisfies.take_frame (wf : WellFormedWith classes.erase before pending)
    (afterWf : WellFormedWith classes.erase after afterPending)
    (taken : Take before source removed after)
    (cut : Route before pending cutSite cutPath (.owned removed))
    (route : Route before pending site initial reference)
    (satisfied : Satisfies classes before reference ty)
    (separate : ∀ path, Pos classes ty path ∨ Neg ty path →
      ¬ (site = cutSite ∧ cutPath.IsPrefix (initial ++ path))) :
    Satisfies classes after reference ty := by
  constructor
  · exact satisfied.mode
  · obtain ⟨data, stored, same⟩ := satisfied.root
    obtain ⟨newData, newStored, newSame⟩ := taken.old_object_data reference.object data stored
    exact ⟨newData, newStored, newSame.trans same⟩
  · intro path positive
    obtain ⟨target, data, read, stored, correctClass⟩ := satisfied.positive path positive
    obtain ⟨newData, newStored, sameClass⟩ := taken.old_object_data target.object data stored
    exact ⟨target, newData,
      take_readPath_frame wf afterWf taken cut route read (separate path (Or.inl positive)),
      newStored, sameClass ▸ correctClass⟩
  · intro path negative
    exact take_readPath_frame wf afterWf taken cut route (satisfied.negative path negative)
      (separate path (Or.inr negative))

  · intro path target permission declared read
    exact satisfied.modes path target permission declared (take_readPath_back wf taken read)

theorem Satisfies.take_other_root (wf : WellFormedWith classes.erase before pending)
    (afterWf : WellFormedWith classes.erase after afterPending)
    (resolved : Resolve before place source removed .unique) (taken : Take before source removed after)
    (owner : RootOwns before pending site reference)
    (different : site ≠ .variable (splitPlace place).1)
    (satisfied : Satisfies classes before reference ty) : Satisfies classes after reference ty := by
  apply satisfied.take_frame wf afterWf taken (route_of_resolve resolved) (.root owner)
  intro path _ same
  exact different same.1

theorem Satisfies.emptyPath (wf : WellFormedWith classes.erase before pending)
    (afterWf : WellFormedWith classes.erase after afterPending)
    (classesWf : classes.WellFormed) (normal : Normalized classes ty)
    (satisfied : Satisfies classes before reference ty)
    (root : RootOwns before pending site reference)
    (cut : Route before pending site path (.owned removed))
    (taken : Take before source removed after)
    (read : readPath before reference path = some (some (.owned removed)))
    (emptied : emptyPath classes ty path = some remaining) :
    Satisfies classes after reference remaining := by
  have facts := Unique.Typing.emptyPath_observations classesWf.nominal normal (emptyPath_nominal emptied)
  constructor
  · simpa [emptyPath_permission emptied] using satisfied.mode
  · obtain ⟨data, stored, correct⟩ := satisfied.root
    obtain ⟨newData, newStored, same⟩ := taken.old_object_data reference.object data stored
    exact ⟨newData, newStored, same.trans (correct.trans facts.className.symm)⟩
  · intro query positive
    obtain ⟨wasPositive, outside⟩ := facts.positives query positive
    obtain ⟨target, data, oldRead, stored, correct⟩ := satisfied.positive query wasPositive
    obtain ⟨newData, newStored, same⟩ := taken.old_object_data target.object data stored
    refine ⟨target, newData,
      take_readPath_frame wf afterWf taken cut (.root root) oldRead (fun both => outside both.2),
      newStored, ?_⟩
    simpa [facts.className, same] using correct
  · intro query negative
    rcases facts.negatives query negative with rfl | ⟨wasNegative, outside⟩
    · exact take_readPath_cleared wf afterWf taken cut facts.nonempty read rfl
    · exact take_readPath_frame wf afterWf taken cut (.root root) (satisfied.negative query wasNegative)
        (fun both => outside both.2)

  · intro query target permission declared read
    rw [facts.className] at declared
    rw [emptyPath_permission emptied]
    exact satisfied.modes query target permission declared (take_readPath_back wf taken read)

-- All unrelated variables and pending roots retain their descriptions. The
-- moved root is added to the pending results and only its source variable's
-- description is replaced.
theorem Realizes.give_replace (realized : Realizes classes environment before pending)
    (resolved : Resolve before place source object .unique) (taken : Take before source object after)
    (admissible : Admissible classes ty)
    (target : Satisfies classes after (.owned object) ty)
    (afterWf : (environment.replace (splitPlace place).1 replacement).WellFormed classes)
    (changed : match replacement with
      | none => ((splitPlace place).1, none) ∈ after.variables
      | some remaining => ∃ root, ((splitPlace place).1, some root) ∈ after.variables ∧
          Satisfies classes after root remaining) :
    Realizes classes (environment.replace (splitPlace place).1 replacement) after
      ((Reference.owned object, ty) :: pending) := by
  have afterOwnership := (Give.move resolved taken).preserves_pending realized.ownership
  constructor
  · exact realized.classesWellFormed
  · exact afterWf
  · intro id view member
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp member with same | member
    · cases same; exact admissible
    · exact realized.pendingTypes id view member
  · exact afterOwnership
  · exact realized.fields.take taken
  · intro name
    rw [Environment.replace_keys, taken.variable_keys]
    exact realized.variableDomain name
  · intro name member
    rcases Environment.replace_member member with ⟨rfl, same⟩ | ⟨different, old⟩
    · subst replacement
      exact changed
    · exact take_preserves_other_variable resolved taken different (realized.emptyVariables name old)
  · intro name view member
    rcases Environment.replace_member member with ⟨rfl, same⟩ | ⟨different, old⟩
    · subst replacement
      exact changed
    · obtain ⟨root, atRoot, satisfied⟩ := realized.initializedVariables name view old
      exact ⟨root, take_preserves_other_variable resolved taken different atRoot,
        satisfied.take_other_root realized.ownership afterOwnership resolved taken (.variable atRoot)
          (by intro same; exact different (RootSite.variable.inj same))⟩
  · intro id view member
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp member with same | member
    · cases same; exact target
    · exact (realized.pendingValues id view member).take_other_root realized.ownership afterOwnership
        resolved taken (.pending (List.mem_map.mpr ⟨(id, view), member, rfl⟩))
        (by intro impossible; cases impossible)

theorem give_sound (beforeWf : before.WellFormed classes)
    (given : give classes before place = some (ty, after)) (admissible : Admissible classes ty)
    (afterWf : after.WellFormed classes) : ExpressionSound classes before (.give place) ty after := by
  intro state pending realized
  refine ⟨give_evaluates given realized, ?_⟩
  intro result reference evaluation
  cases evaluation with
  | give operation =>
    obtain ⟨sourceTy, found, focused, effect⟩ := give_description given
    have sourceMember := Environment.lookup_member found
    have sourceAdmissible := Environment.admissible beforeWf sourceMember
    obtain ⟨root, atRoot, satisfied⟩ := realized.initializedVariables _ _ sourceMember
    have observations := focus_observations realized.classesWellFormed sourceAdmissible.2 focused
    obtain ⟨targetReference, targetData, read, _, _⟩ := satisfied.positive _ observations.positive
    obtain ⟨destination, expectedResolve⟩ := resolve_from_readPath atRoot read
    change Resolve state (placeFrom (splitPlace place).1 (splitPlace place).2) _ _ _ at expectedResolve
    rw [placeFrom_splitPlace] at expectedResolve
    obtain ⟨actualSource, actualResolve⟩ := operation.resolved
    obtain ⟨_, sameObject, sameMode⟩ :=
      resolve_deterministic realized.ownership expectedResolve actualResolve
    have sameReference : targetReference = reference := by
      cases targetReference; cases reference; simp_all
    subst targetReference
    have targetSatisfied := satisfied.focus realized.classesWellFormed realized.ownership
      sourceAdmissible.2 focused read
    have afterOwnership := operation.preserves_pending realized.ownership
    cases operation with
    | move resolved cleared =>
      have unique : ty.permission = .given := by
        exact Perm.toMode_injective targetSatisfied.mode.symm
      rcases effect with ⟨shared, _⟩ | ⟨_, effect⟩
      · simp [unique] at shared
      · have targetAfter := targetSatisfied.take_taken realized.ownership afterOwnership cleared (route_of_resolve resolved) rfl
        rcases effect with ⟨empty, rfl⟩ | ⟨remaining, nonempty, emptied, rfl⟩
        · apply realized.give_replace resolved cleared admissible targetAfter afterWf
          have sourceIsVariable := resolve_source_empty resolved empty
          change Stored result (.variable (splitPlace place).1) none
          exact sourceIsVariable ▸ cleared.cleared
        · apply realized.give_replace resolved cleared admissible targetAfter afterWf
          exact ⟨root, take_preserves_variable_field resolved cleared nonempty atRoot,
            satisfied.emptyPath realized.ownership afterOwnership realized.classesWellFormed
              sourceAdmissible.2 (.variable atRoot) (route_of_resolve resolved) cleared read emptied⟩
    | copy resolved stored =>
      have shared : ty.permission = .shared := by
        exact Perm.toMode_injective targetSatisfied.mode.symm
      rcases effect with ⟨_, rfl⟩ | ⟨unique, _⟩
      · exact realized.copy resolved stored admissible targetSatisfied
      · simp [shared] at unique
    | promote resolved promoted =>
      have shared : ty.permission = .shared := by
        exact Perm.toMode_injective targetSatisfied.mode.symm
      rcases effect with ⟨_, rfl⟩ | ⟨unique, _⟩
      · exact realized.promote resolved promoted admissible
          (targetSatisfied.promote_target realized.ownership afterOwnership promoted (route_of_resolve resolved) rfl)
      · simp [shared] at unique

theorem ExprTyped.sound (typed : ExprTyped classes before value ty after) :
    ExpressionSound classes before value ty after :=
  typed.sound_of_give (fun _ _ _ _ => give_sound)

theorem ArgsTyped.sound (typed : ArgsTyped classes before values fields after) :
    ArgumentsSound classes before values fields after := by
  induction typed using ArgsTyped.rec (motive_1 := fun _ _ _ _ _ => True) with
  | give => trivial
  | giveShare => trivial
  | new => trivial
  | weaken => trivial
  | nil wf =>
    intro state pending realized
    refine ⟨⟨state, [], .nil state⟩, ?_⟩
    intro result objects evaluated
    cases evaluated
    exact realized
  | @cons before middle after value values field fields first rest _ ih =>
    intro state pending realized
    obtain ⟨firstExists, allFirst⟩ := first.sound state pending realized
    constructor
    · obtain ⟨middleState, object, firstEvaluation⟩ := firstExists
      obtain ⟨⟨result, objects, restEvaluation⟩, _⟩ :=
        ih middleState ((object, field.toType) :: pending)
          (allFirst middleState object firstEvaluation)
      exact ⟨result, object :: objects, .cons firstEvaluation restEvaluation⟩
    · intro result objects evaluated
      cases evaluated with
      | cons firstEvaluation restEvaluation =>
        have firstRealized := allFirst _ _ firstEvaluation
        exact ((ih _ _ firstRealized).2 _ _ restEvaluation).perm List.perm_middle
