namespace Dada.Unique

-- Class layouts are fixed, and every field name identifies one slot.
def ClassesWellFormed (classes : Classes) : Prop :=
  (classes.map Prod.fst).Nodup ∧
    ∀ name declaration, (name, declaration) ∈ classes → declaration.fields.Nodup

-- These conditions describe arbitrary finite graphs independently of execution.
-- Rootedness records reachability directly; object IDs are allocation identities.
structure WellFormed (classes : Classes) (state : State) : Prop where
  objectKeys : (state.objects.map Prod.fst).Nodup
  variableKeys : (state.variables.map Prod.fst).Nodup
  shapes : ∀ id data, (id, data) ∈ state.objects →
    ∃ declaration, (data.className, declaration) ∈ classes ∧
      data.fields.map Prod.fst = declaration.fields ∧ declaration.fields.Nodup
  bounds : ∀ id data, (id, data) ∈ state.objects → id.index < state.nextId
  rooted : ∀ object, Allocated state object → Live state object
  referencesUnique : (References state).Nodup
  referencesComplete : ∀ id, id ∈ References state ↔ Allocated state id

-- Expression results are temporary owning roots until the surrounding constructor
-- or statement stores them. The empty-root case is the statement invariant.
structure WellFormedWith (classes : Classes) (state : State) (pending : List ObjectId) : Prop where
  objectKeys : (state.objects.map Prod.fst).Nodup
  variableKeys : (state.variables.map Prod.fst).Nodup
  shapes : ∀ id data, (id, data) ∈ state.objects →
    ∃ declaration, (data.className, declaration) ∈ classes ∧
      data.fields.map Prod.fst = declaration.fields ∧ declaration.fields.Nodup
  bounds : ∀ id data, (id, data) ∈ state.objects → id.index < state.nextId
  rooted : ∀ object, Allocated state object → LiveWith state pending object
  referencesUnique : (pending ++ References state).Nodup
  referencesComplete : ∀ id, id ∈ pending ++ References state ↔ Allocated state id

private abbrev slotReferences {K : Type} (slots : List (K × Slot)) : List ObjectId :=
  slots.filterMap (fun entry => entry.2)

-- Taking an owner changes neither object allocation nor slot identities.
theorem Take.object_keys (take : Take before place object after) :
    after.objects.map Prod.fst = before.objects.map Prod.fst := by
  cases take <;> simp

theorem Take.variable_keys (take : Take before place object after) :
    after.variables.map Prod.fst = before.variables.map Prod.fst := by
  cases take <;> simp

theorem Take.next_id (take : Take before place object after) :
    after.nextId = before.nextId := by
  cases take <;> rfl

-- One occurrence leaves the source graph and becomes the expression's result.
theorem Take.references (take : Take before place object after) :
    (References before).Perm (object :: References after) := by
  cases take with
  | «variable» objects next leading suffix name object =>
    simp only [References, List.filterMap_append, List.filterMap_cons]
    simpa only [List.append_assoc, List.cons_append] using
      (List.perm_middle (a := object)
        (l₁ := leading.filterMap (fun binding => binding.2))
        (l₂ := suffix.filterMap (fun binding => binding.2) ++
          objects.flatMap (fun entry => entry.2.fields.filterMap (fun field => field.2))))
  | field variables next before after parent className leading suffix name object =>
    simp only [References, List.flatMap_append, List.flatMap_cons, List.filterMap_append,
      List.filterMap_cons]
    simpa only [List.append_assoc, List.cons_append] using
      (List.perm_middle (a := object)
        (l₁ := variables.filterMap (fun binding => binding.2) ++
          before.flatMap (fun entry => entry.2.fields.filterMap (fun field => field.2)) ++
          leading.filterMap (fun field => field.2))
        (l₂ := suffix.filterMap (fun field => field.2) ++
          after.flatMap (fun entry => entry.2.fields.filterMap (fun field => field.2))))

private theorem zipped_field_names (fields : List FieldName) (objects : List ObjectId)
    (lengths : objects.length = fields.length) :
    (fields.zip (objects.map some)).map Prod.fst = fields := by
  apply List.map_fst_zip
  simp [lengths]

private theorem zipped_field_references (fields : List FieldName) (objects : List ObjectId)
    (lengths : objects.length = fields.length) :
    slotReferences (fields.zip (objects.map some)) = objects := by
  have seconds := List.map_snd_zip (l₁ := fields) (l₂ := objects.map some)
    (by simp [lengths])
  have filtered := congrArg (List.filterMap id) seconds
  simpa [List.filterMap_map, Function.comp_def, slotReferences] using filtered


theorem WellFormed.empty (classes : Classes) : WellFormed classes State.empty := by
  constructor <;> simp [State.empty, References, Allocated]

theorem WellFormed.with_empty (wf : WellFormed classes state) :
    WellFormedWith classes state [] := by
  exact ⟨wf.objectKeys, wf.variableKeys, wf.shapes, wf.bounds, fun object allocated => (wf.rooted object allocated).with_pending,
    by simpa using wf.referencesUnique, by simpa using wf.referencesComplete⟩

theorem WellFormedWith.without_pending (wf : WellFormedWith classes state []) :
    WellFormed classes state := by
  exact ⟨wf.objectKeys, wf.variableKeys, wf.shapes, wf.bounds, fun object allocated => (wf.rooted object allocated).without_pending,
    by simpa using wf.referencesUnique, by simpa using wf.referencesComplete⟩

theorem WellFormedWith.perm (wf : WellFormedWith classes state pending)
    (permutation : pending.Perm other) : WellFormedWith classes state other := by
  have refs := permutation.append_right (References state)
  exact ⟨wf.objectKeys, wf.variableKeys, wf.shapes, wf.bounds, fun object allocated => (wf.rooted object allocated).mono (fun _ h => permutation.mem_iff.mp h),
    refs.nodup_iff.mp wf.referencesUnique,
    fun id => refs.mem_iff.symm.trans (wf.referencesComplete id)⟩

theorem Take.preserves_pending (wf : WellFormedWith classes before pending)
    (take : Take before place object after) :
    WellFormedWith classes after (object :: pending) := by
  have references : (pending ++ References before).Perm
      ((object :: pending) ++ References after) :=
    (take.references.append_left pending).trans List.perm_middle
  constructor
  · simpa [take.object_keys] using wf.objectKeys
  · simpa [take.variable_keys] using wf.variableKeys
  · intro id data member
    obtain ⟨oldData, oldMember, sameClass, sameFields, _⟩ := take.object_data id data member
    obtain ⟨declaration, declared, fields, distinct⟩ := wf.shapes id oldData oldMember
    exact ⟨declaration, sameClass ▸ declared, sameFields.trans fields, distinct⟩
  · intro id data member
    obtain ⟨oldData, oldMember, _, _, _⟩ := take.object_data id data member
    simpa [take.next_id] using wf.bounds id oldData oldMember
  · intro object allocated
    exact take.liveWith (wf.rooted object (by simpa [Allocated, take.object_keys] using allocated))
  · exact references.nodup_iff.mp wf.referencesUnique
  · intro id
    simpa [Allocated, take.object_keys] using
      references.mem_iff.symm.trans (wf.referencesComplete id)

theorem WellFormedWith.bind (wf : WellFormedWith classes state [object])
    (fresh : destination ∉ state.variables.map Prod.fst) :
    WellFormed classes (state.bind destination object) := by
  constructor
  · exact wf.objectKeys
  · simpa [State.bind] using List.nodup_cons.mpr ⟨fresh, wf.variableKeys⟩
  · exact wf.shapes
  · exact wf.bounds
  · intro id allocated
    have live := wf.rooted id allocated
    clear allocated
    induction live with
    | @pending current member =>
      have same : current = object := by simpa using member
      subst_vars
      exact .variable (name := destination) (by simp [State.bind])
    | «variable» member => exact .variable (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ member)
    | field _ member field ih => exact .field ih member field
  · simpa [State.bind, References] using wf.referencesUnique
  · simpa [State.bind, References, Allocated] using wf.referencesComplete

theorem Take.bind_preserves (wf : WellFormed classes before)
    (take : Take before place object after)
    (fresh : destination ∉ before.variables.map Prod.fst) :
    WellFormed classes (after.bind destination object) := by
  apply (take.preserves_pending wf.with_empty).bind
  simpa [take.variable_keys] using fresh

private theorem allocation_references (state : State)
    (lengths : objects.length = fields.length) :
    References (state.allocate className fields objects) =
      slotReferences state.variables ++ objects ++
        state.objects.flatMap (fun entry => slotReferences entry.2.fields) := by
  simp [State.allocate, References, slotReferences, List.append_assoc,
    zipped_field_references fields objects lengths]

theorem WellFormedWith.allocate (classesWf : ClassesWellFormed classes)
    (wf : WellFormedWith classes state (objects ++ pending))
    (declared : (className, declaration) ∈ classes)
    (lengths : objects.length = declaration.fields.length) :
    WellFormedWith classes (state.allocate className declaration.fields objects)
      (ObjectId.mk state.nextId :: pending) := by
  have freshObject : ObjectId.mk state.nextId ∉ state.objects.map Prod.fst := by
    intro member
    obtain ⟨⟨id, data⟩, allocated, same⟩ := List.mem_map.mp member
    simp only at same
    subst id
    exact Nat.lt_irrefl _ (wf.bounds _ _ allocated)
  have freshReference : ObjectId.mk state.nextId ∉ (objects ++ pending) ++ References state := by
    intro member
    exact freshObject ((wf.referencesComplete _).mp member)
  have references : (ObjectId.mk state.nextId :: ((objects ++ pending) ++ References state)).Perm
      ((ObjectId.mk state.nextId :: pending) ++
        References (state.allocate className declaration.fields objects)) := by
    apply List.Perm.cons
    rw [allocation_references state lengths]
    apply List.perm_iff_count.mpr
    intro id
    simp only [List.append_eq, References, slotReferences, List.count_append]
    omega
  constructor
  · simpa [State.allocate] using List.nodup_cons.mpr ⟨freshObject, wf.objectKeys⟩
  · exact wf.variableKeys
  · intro id data member
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp member with same | old
    · cases same
      exact ⟨declaration, declared, zipped_field_names _ _ lengths,
        classesWf.2 _ _ declared⟩
    · exact wf.shapes id data old
  · intro id data member
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp member with same | old
    · cases same
      exact Nat.lt_succ_self _
    · exact Nat.lt_succ_of_lt (wf.bounds id data old)
  · intro id allocated
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp allocated with same | oldAllocated
    · subst id
      exact .pending (by simp)
    · have live := wf.rooted id oldAllocated
      clear allocated oldAllocated
      induction live with
      | @pending current member =>
        rcases List.mem_append.mp member with argument | pending
        · have fieldMember : current ∈ slotReferences (declaration.fields.zip (objects.map some)) := by
            rwa [zipped_field_references _ _ lengths]
          obtain ⟨⟨name, slot⟩, field, value⟩ := List.mem_filterMap.mp fieldMember
          dsimp at value
          subst slot
          exact .field (parent := ⟨state.nextId⟩) (data := ⟨className, declaration.fields.zip (objects.map some)⟩) (.pending (by simp)) (by simp [State.allocate]) field
        · exact .pending (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ pending)
      | «variable» member => exact .variable member
      | field _ member field ih => exact .field ih (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ member) field
  · exact references.nodup_iff.mp (List.nodup_cons.mpr ⟨freshReference, wf.referencesUnique⟩)
  · intro id
    rw [← references.mem_iff]
    simp only [List.mem_cons, wf.referencesComplete, Allocated, State.allocate, List.map_cons]

theorem Eval.preserves_pending (classesWf : ClassesWellFormed classes)
    (evaluation : Eval classes before value after object) :
    ∀ pending, WellFormedWith classes before pending →
      WellFormedWith classes after (object :: pending) := by
  induction evaluation using Eval.rec
    (motive_2 := fun before _ after objects _ => ∀ pending,
      WellFormedWith classes before pending →
        WellFormedWith classes after (objects ++ pending)) with
  | give _ take => exact fun _ wf => take.preserves_pending wf
  | new declared _ lengths _ ih =>
    exact fun pending wf => (ih pending wf).allocate classesWf declared lengths
  | nil => assumption
  | cons _ _ first rest =>
    rename_i pending wf
    have result := rest _ (first pending wf)
    exact result.perm List.perm_middle

theorem Eval.variable_keys (evaluation : Eval classes before value after object) :
    after.variables.map Prod.fst = before.variables.map Prod.fst := by
  induction evaluation using Eval.rec
    (motive_2 := fun before _ after _ _ =>
      after.variables.map Prod.fst = before.variables.map Prod.fst) with
  | give _ take => exact take.variable_keys
  | new _ _ _ _ ih => exact ih
  | nil => rfl
  | cons _ _ first rest => exact rest.trans first

theorem EvalArgs.length (evaluation : EvalArgs classes before arguments after objects) :
    objects.length = arguments.length := by
  induction evaluation using EvalArgs.rec
    (motive_1 := fun _ _ _ _ _ => True) with
  | give => trivial
  | new => trivial
  | nil => rfl
  | cons _ _ _ rest => simpa using rest

theorem Step.preserves_wellFormed (classesWf : ClassesWellFormed classes)
    (wf : WellFormed classes before.state) (step : Step classes before after) :
    WellFormed classes after.state := by
  cases step with
  | letValue fresh evaluation =>
    exact (evaluation.preserves_pending classesWf [] wf.with_empty).bind fresh

theorem Steps.preserves_wellFormed (classesWf : ClassesWellFormed classes)
    (wf : WellFormed classes before.state) (steps : Steps classes before after) :
    WellFormed classes after.state := by
  induction steps with
  | refl => exact wf
  | step first _ ih => exact ih (first.preserves_wellFormed classesWf wf)

theorem Steps.from_initial (classesWf : ClassesWellFormed program.classes)
    (steps : Steps program.classes (Configuration.initial program) after) :
    WellFormed program.classes after.state :=
  steps.preserves_wellFormed classesWf (WellFormed.empty _)

end Dada.Unique

import Unique.Syntax

namespace Dada.Unique

-- A slot is allocated even when it no longer contains an owner.
abbrev Slot := Option ObjectId

structure Object where
  className : ClassName
  fields : List (FieldName × Slot)
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

structure State where
  objects : List (ObjectId × Object)
  variables : List (VariableId × Slot)
  nextId : Nat
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

def State.empty : State := ⟨[], [], 0⟩

inductive StoragePlace where
  | variable (name : VariableId)
  | field (object : ObjectId) (name : FieldName)
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

def Stored (state : State) (place : StoragePlace) (slot : Slot) : Prop :=
  match place with
  | .variable name => (name, slot) ∈ state.variables
  | .field object name =>
      ∃ data, (object, data) ∈ state.objects ∧ (name, slot) ∈ data.fields

-- Updating a place replaces an existing slot; it neither creates a variable
-- nor adds an object's field. Empty slots remain present.
inductive Updated : State → StoragePlace → Slot → State → Prop where
  | variable (objects : List (ObjectId × Object)) (nextId : Nat)
      (leading suffix : List (VariableId × Slot)) (name : VariableId) (old new : Slot) :
      Updated ⟨objects, leading ++ (name, old) :: suffix, nextId⟩ (.variable name) new
        ⟨objects, leading ++ (name, new) :: suffix, nextId⟩
  | field (variables : List (VariableId × Slot)) (nextId : Nat)
      (before after : List (ObjectId × Object)) (parent : ObjectId) (className : ClassName)
      (leading suffix : List (FieldName × Slot)) (name : FieldName) (old new : Slot) :
      Updated ⟨before ++ (parent, ⟨className, leading ++ (name, old) :: suffix⟩) :: after,
          variables, nextId⟩ (.field parent name) new
        ⟨before ++ (parent, ⟨className, leading ++ (name, new) :: suffix⟩) :: after,
          variables, nextId⟩

def References (state : State) : List ObjectId :=
  state.variables.filterMap (fun binding => binding.2) ++
    state.objects.flatMap (fun entry => entry.2.fields.filterMap (fun field => field.2))

def Allocated (state : State) (object : ObjectId) : Prop :=
  object ∈ state.objects.map Prod.fst

-- Liveness follows owners from a variable, then through initialized fields.
inductive Live (state : State) : ObjectId → Prop where
  | variable {name object} : (name, some object) ∈ state.variables → Live state object
  | field {parent object data name} :
      Live state parent → (parent, data) ∈ state.objects →
      (name, some object) ∈ data.fields → Live state object

-- Reachability includes expression results while they await binding.
inductive LiveWith (state : State) (pending : List ObjectId) : ObjectId → Prop where
  | pending {object} : object ∈ pending → LiveWith state pending object
  | variable {name object} : (name, some object) ∈ state.variables → LiveWith state pending object
  | field {parent object data name} :
      LiveWith state pending parent → (parent, data) ∈ state.objects →
      (name, some object) ∈ data.fields → LiveWith state pending object

theorem Live.with_pending (live : Live state object) : LiveWith state pending object := by
  induction live with
  | «variable» member => exact .variable member
  | field _ member field ih => exact .field ih member field

theorem LiveWith.without_pending (live : LiveWith state [] object) : Live state object := by
  induction live with
  | pending member => simp at member
  | «variable» member => exact .variable member
  | field _ member field ih => exact .field ih member field

theorem LiveWith.mono {pending other : List ObjectId} (live : LiveWith state pending object)
    (roots : ∀ id ∈ pending, id ∈ other) : LiveWith state other object := by
  induction live with
  | pending member => exact .pending (roots _ member)
  | «variable» member => exact .variable member
  | field _ member field ih => exact .field ih member field

-- Auxiliary local-frame observation. The program lifetime is defined in Frames.
structure Configuration where
  state : State
  code : List Statement
  deriving Repr

def Configuration.initial (program : Program) : Configuration :=
  ⟨State.empty, program.body⟩

-- Local code exhaustion; Framed.Configuration.finished means the frame is absent.
def Configuration.finished (configuration : Configuration) : Prop :=
  configuration.code = []

end Dada.Unique

import Unique.State

namespace Dada.Unique

-- Resolving a place reads the graph without changing any slot.
inductive Resolve (state : State) : Place → StoragePlace → ObjectId → Prop where
  | variable {name object} :
      (name, some object) ∈ state.variables →
      Resolve state (.variable name) (.variable name) object
  | field {base source parent data name object} :
      Resolve state base source parent →
      (parent, data) ∈ state.objects →
      (name, some object) ∈ data.fields →
      Resolve state (.field base name) (.field parent name) object

-- Removing an owner leaves precisely that allocated slot uninitialized.
-- The list decompositions specify exact effects even on arbitrary raw states.
inductive Take : State → StoragePlace → ObjectId → State → Prop where
  | variable (objects : List (ObjectId × Object)) (nextId : Nat)
      (leading suffix : List (VariableId × Slot)) (name : VariableId) (object : ObjectId) :
      Take ⟨objects, leading ++ (name, some object) :: suffix, nextId⟩
        (.variable name) object
        ⟨objects, leading ++ (name, none) :: suffix, nextId⟩
  | field (variables : List (VariableId × Slot)) (nextId : Nat)
      (before after : List (ObjectId × Object)) (parent : ObjectId) (className : ClassName)
      (leading suffix : List (FieldName × Slot)) (name : FieldName) (object : ObjectId) :
      Take ⟨before ++ (parent, ⟨className, leading ++ (name, some object) :: suffix⟩) :: after,
          variables, nextId⟩
        (.field parent name) object
        ⟨before ++ (parent, ⟨className, leading ++ (name, none) :: suffix⟩) :: after,
          variables, nextId⟩

def State.bind (state : State) (name : VariableId) (object : ObjectId) : State :=
  { state with variables := (name, some object) :: state.variables }

def State.allocate (state : State) (className : ClassName) (fields : List FieldName)
    (arguments : List ObjectId) : State :=
  ⟨(⟨state.nextId⟩, ⟨className, fields.zip (arguments.map some)⟩) :: state.objects,
    state.variables, state.nextId + 1⟩

-- Results are held by the surrounding expression until construction or binding.
-- No invariant is a premise of evaluation; preservation is proved separately.
mutual
inductive Eval (classes : Classes) : State → Value → State → ObjectId → Prop where
  | give {state cleared : State} {path : Place} {source : StoragePlace} {object : ObjectId} :
      Resolve state path source object →
      Take state source object cleared →
      Eval classes state (.give path) cleared object
  | new {state evaluated : State} {className : ClassName} {declaration : Class}
      {arguments : List Value} {objects : List ObjectId} :
      (className, declaration) ∈ classes →
      EvalArgs classes state arguments evaluated objects →
      objects.length = declaration.fields.length →
      ObjectId.mk evaluated.nextId ∉ evaluated.objects.map Prod.fst →
      Eval classes state (.new className arguments)
        (evaluated.allocate className declaration.fields objects) ⟨evaluated.nextId⟩

inductive EvalArgs (classes : Classes) : State → List Value → State → List ObjectId → Prop where
  | nil (state : State) : EvalArgs classes state [] state []
  | cons {before middle after : State} {argument : Value} {arguments : List Value}
      {object : ObjectId} {objects : List ObjectId} :
      Eval classes before argument middle object →
      EvalArgs classes middle arguments after objects →
      EvalArgs classes before (argument :: arguments) after (object :: objects)
end

inductive Step (classes : Classes) : Configuration → Configuration → Prop where
  | letValue {state evaluated : State} {destination : VariableId} {value : Value}
      {object : ObjectId} {rest : List Statement} :
      destination ∉ evaluated.variables.map Prod.fst →
      Eval classes state value evaluated object →
      Step classes ⟨state, ⟨destination, value⟩ :: rest⟩
        ⟨evaluated.bind destination object, rest⟩

inductive Steps (classes : Classes) : Configuration → Configuration → Prop where
  | refl (configuration : Configuration) : Steps classes configuration configuration
  | step {before middle after} :
      Step classes before middle → Steps classes middle after → Steps classes before after

def Stuck (classes : Classes) (configuration : Configuration) : Prop :=
  ¬ configuration.finished ∧ ¬ ∃ after, Step classes configuration after

end Dada.Unique

namespace Dada.Unique

structure ObjectId where
  index : Nat
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

instance (n : Nat) : OfNat ObjectId n := ⟨⟨n⟩⟩
abbrev VariableId := String
abbrev FieldName := String
abbrev ClassName := String

structure Class where
  fields : List FieldName
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

abbrev Classes := List (ClassName × Class)

-- Places name storage; evaluating a place alone does not produce a value.
inductive Place where
  | variable (name : VariableId)
  | field (base : Place) (name : FieldName)
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

-- Constructor operands are expressions, evaluated from left to right.
-- The distinct syntax keeps places separate from values.
inductive Value where
  | give (source : Place)
  | new (className : ClassName) (arguments : List Value)
  deriving Repr

structure Statement where
  letValue ::
  destination : VariableId
  value : Value
  deriving Repr

structure Program where
  classes : Classes
  body : List Statement
  deriving Repr

namespace Dada.Unique.Typing

def ConfigurationTyped (classes : ClassTable) (configuration : Unpacking.Configuration)
    (finalEnvironment : Environment) : Prop :=
  ∃ current, Realizes classes current configuration.state [] ∧
    SequenceTyped classes current configuration.code finalEnvironment

theorem ConfigurationTyped.initial
    (typed : ProgramTyped classes code) :
    ∃ finalEnvironment, ConfigurationTyped classes ⟨State.empty, code⟩ finalEnvironment := by
  obtain ⟨classesWf, finalEnvironment, sequence⟩ := typed
  exact ⟨finalEnvironment, [], Realizes.empty classesWf, sequence⟩

theorem ConfigurationTyped.finished
    (typed : ConfigurationTyped classes configuration finalEnvironment)
    (finished : configuration.finished) :
    Realizes classes finalEnvironment configuration.state [] := by
  obtain ⟨current, realized, sequence⟩ := typed
  change configuration.code = [] at finished
  rw [finished] at sequence
  cases sequence
  exact realized

end Dada.Unique.Typing

import Unique.Views
import Unique.Unpacking

namespace Dada.Unique.Typing

-- Empty slots remain allocated; absence is a separate outer Option at lookup.
abbrev SlotDescription := Option ViewType
abbrev Environment := List (VariableId × SlotDescription)

def Admissible (classes : ClassTable) (ty : ViewType) : Prop :=
  ty.WellFormed classes ∧ Normalized classes ty

instance (classes : ClassTable) (ty : ViewType) : Decidable (Admissible classes ty) := by
  unfold Admissible Normalized
  infer_instance

def Environment.WellFormed (environment : Environment) (classes : ClassTable) : Prop :=
  (environment.map Prod.fst).Nodup ∧
    environment.all (fun entry => match entry.2 with
      | none => true
      | some ty => decide (Admissible classes ty)) = true

instance (environment : Environment) (classes : ClassTable) :
    Decidable (environment.WellFormed classes) := by
  unfold Environment.WellFormed
  infer_instance

def Environment.lookup (environment : Environment) (name : VariableId) :
    Option SlotDescription :=
  (environment.find? fun entry => entry.1 == name).map Prod.snd

def Environment.replace (environment : Environment) (name : VariableId)
    (description : SlotDescription) : Environment :=
  environment.map fun entry => if entry.1 = name then (name, description) else entry

def splitPlace : Place → VariableId × Path
  | .variable name => (name, [])
  | .field base name =>
      let (root, path) := splitPlace base
      (root, path ++ [name])

def placeFrom (root : VariableId) (path : Path) : Place :=
  path.foldl Place.field (.variable root)

theorem placeFrom_splitPlace (place : Place) :
    placeFrom (splitPlace place).1 (splitPlace place).2 = place := by
  induction place with
  | «variable» name => rfl
  | field base name ih =>
    simpa [splitPlace, placeFrom, List.foldl_append] using
      congrArg (fun p => Place.field p name) ih

-- Taking is a static operation: it never consults the heap or evaluation.
def take (classes : ClassTable) (environment : Environment) (place : Place) :
    Option (ViewType × Environment) := do
  let (root, path) := splitPlace place
  let source ← environment.lookup root
  let source ← source
  let result ← focus classes source path
  if path = [] then
    return (result, environment.replace root none)
  else
    let remaining ← emptyPath classes source path
    return (result, environment.replace root (some remaining))

def fieldDescription (classes : ClassTable) (ty : ViewType) (name : FieldName) :
    Option SlotDescription :=
  if negative ty [name] then some none
  else (focus classes ty [name]).map some

-- The well-formedness premises make the chapter's global convention explicit.
-- They inspect only finite static descriptions, not operational success.
mutual
inductive ExprTyped (classes : ClassTable) : Environment → Value → ViewType → Environment → Prop where
  | give {before after : Environment} {place : Place} {ty : ViewType} :
      before.WellFormed classes →
      take classes before place = some (ty, after) →
      Admissible classes ty → after.WellFormed classes →
      ExprTyped classes before (.give place) ty after
  | new {before after : Environment} {name : ClassName} {declaration : TypedClass}
      {arguments : List Value} :
      (name, declaration) ∈ classes →
      ArgsTyped classes before arguments (declaration.fields.map Prod.snd) after →
      Admissible classes (ViewType.whole name) →
      ExprTyped classes before (.new name arguments) (ViewType.whole name) after
  | weaken {before after : Environment} {value : Value} {ty other : ViewType} :
      ExprTyped classes before value ty after →
      Admissible classes other → Subtype classes ty other →
      ExprTyped classes before value other after

inductive ArgsTyped (classes : ClassTable) : Environment → List Value → List ClassName → Environment → Prop where
  | nil {environment : Environment} :
      environment.WellFormed classes → ArgsTyped classes environment [] [] environment
  | cons {before middle after : Environment} {value : Value} {values : List Value}
      {name : ClassName} {names : List ClassName} :
      ExprTyped classes before value (ViewType.whole name) middle →
      ArgsTyped classes middle values names after →
      ArgsTyped classes before (value :: values) (name :: names) after
end

-- Pattern order determines binding order; all field names must still be present.
inductive FieldBindings (classes : ClassTable) (ty : ViewType) : List (FieldName × VariableId) → Environment → Prop where
  | nil : FieldBindings classes ty [] []
  | cons {field : FieldName} {destination : VariableId} {description : SlotDescription}
      {fields : List (FieldName × VariableId)} {bindings : Environment} :
      fieldDescription classes ty field = some description →
      FieldBindings classes ty fields bindings →
      FieldBindings classes ty ((field, destination) :: fields)
        ((destination, description) :: bindings)

inductive BindingTyped (classes : ClassTable) : Environment → Unpacking.Pattern → ViewType → Environment → Prop where
  | variable {environment : Environment} {name : VariableId} {ty : ViewType} :
      environment.WellFormed classes → Admissible classes ty →
      name ∉ environment.map Prod.fst →
      BindingTyped classes environment (.variable name) ty ((name, some ty) :: environment)
  | unpack {before : Environment} {ty : ViewType} {name : ClassName}
      {declaration : TypedClass} {fields : List (FieldName × VariableId)}
      {bindings : Environment} :
      before.WellFormed classes → Admissible classes ty →
      ty.className = name → (name, declaration) ∈ classes →
      (fields.map Prod.fst).Perm (declaration.fields.map Prod.fst) →
      (fields.map Prod.snd).Nodup →
      (∀ destination ∈ fields.map Prod.snd, destination ∉ before.map Prod.fst) →
      FieldBindings classes ty fields bindings →
      (bindings ++ before).WellFormed classes →
      BindingTyped classes before (.unpack name fields) ty (bindings ++ before)

inductive StatementTyped (classes : ClassTable) : Environment → Unpacking.Statement → Environment → Prop where
  | letValue {before middle after : Environment} {pattern : Unpacking.Pattern}
      {value : Value} {ty : ViewType} :
      ExprTyped classes before value ty middle →
      BindingTyped classes middle pattern ty after →
      StatementTyped classes before ⟨pattern, value⟩ after

inductive SequenceTyped (classes : ClassTable) : Environment → List Unpacking.Statement → Environment → Prop where
  | nil {environment : Environment} :
      environment.WellFormed classes → SequenceTyped classes environment [] environment
  | cons {before middle after : Environment} {statement : Unpacking.Statement}
      {rest : List Unpacking.Statement} :
      StatementTyped classes before statement middle →
      SequenceTyped classes middle rest after →
      SequenceTyped classes before (statement :: rest) after

def ProgramTyped (classes : ClassTable) (code : List Unpacking.Statement) : Prop :=
  classes.WellFormed ∧ ∃ finalEnvironment, SequenceTyped classes [] code finalEnvironment

theorem ArgsTyped.length (typed : ArgsTyped classes before values names after) :
    values.length = names.length := by
  induction typed using ArgsTyped.rec (motive_1 := fun _ _ _ _ _ => True) with
  | give => trivial
  | new => trivial
  | weaken => trivial
  | nil => rfl
  | cons _ _ _ rest => simpa using rest

theorem FieldBindings.keys (typed : FieldBindings classes ty fields bindings) :
    bindings.map Prod.fst = fields.map Prod.snd := by
  induction typed with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons _ _ ih => simp [ih]

-- Weakening cannot disguise an unsuccessful take as a typed give.
theorem ExprTyped.give_requires_take
    (typed : ExprTyped classes before value ty after) :
    ∀ place, value = .give place → ∃ result, take classes before place = some (result, after) := by
  induction typed using ExprTyped.rec (motive_2 := fun _ _ _ _ _ => True) with
  | give _ taken _ _ =>
    intro place equality
    cases equality
    exact ⟨_, taken⟩
  | new => intro place equality; cases equality
  | weaken _ _ _ ih => exact ih
  | nil => trivial
  | cons => trivial

theorem failed_take_not_typed (failed : take classes environment place = none) :
    ¬ ExprTyped classes environment (.give place) ty after := by
  intro typed
  obtain ⟨result, succeeded⟩ := typed.give_requires_take place rfl
  rw [failed] at succeeded
  contradiction

end Dada.Unique.Typing

import Unique.TypingHeap
import Unique.TypingEffects

namespace Dada.Unique.Typing

-- Allocation adds a fresh, younger object. Every old path still reads the same slot.
theorem readPath_allocate (wf : WellFormedWith layouts state pending)
    (older : object.index < state.nextId) (path : Path) :
    readPath (state.allocate name fields arguments) object path = readPath state object path := by
  induction path generalizing object with
  | nil =>
    have different : object ≠ ObjectId.mk state.nextId := by
      intro equal; cases equal; exact Nat.lt_irrefl _ older
    simp [readPath, State.allocate, List.lookup_cons, beq_eq_false_iff_ne.mpr different]
  | cons field rest ih =>
    have different : object ≠ ObjectId.mk state.nextId := by
      intro equal; cases equal; exact Nat.lt_irrefl _ older
    simp only [readPath, State.allocate, List.lookup_cons, beq_eq_false_iff_ne.mpr different]
    cases found : state.objects.lookup object with
    | none => simp
    | some data =>
      dsimp only [Bind.bind, Option.bind]
      cases slot : data.fields.lookup field with
      | none => simp
      | some value =>
        dsimp only [Bind.bind, Option.bind]
        cases rest with
        | nil => rfl
        | cons next tail =>
          cases value with
          | none => rfl
          | some target =>
            have allocated := WellFormedWith.field_allocated wf (lookup_member found) (lookup_member slot)
            obtain ⟨⟨_, targetData⟩, targetStored, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp allocated
            exact ih (wf.bounds _ targetData targetStored)

theorem Satisfies.allocate (satisfied : Satisfies classes state object ty)
    (wf : WellFormedWith layouts state pending) :
    Satisfies classes (state.allocate name fields arguments) object ty := by
  obtain ⟨rootData, rootMember, rootClass⟩ := satisfied.root
  have bound := wf.bounds _ _ rootMember
  constructor
  · exact ⟨rootData, List.mem_cons_of_mem _ rootMember, rootClass⟩
  · intro path known
    obtain ⟨target, data, read, member, correct⟩ := satisfied.positive path known
    exact ⟨target, data, (readPath_allocate wf bound path).trans read,
      List.mem_cons_of_mem _ member, correct⟩
  · intro path known
    exact (readPath_allocate wf bound path).trans (satisfied.negative path known)

theorem Realizes.perm (realized : Realizes classes environment state pending)
    (permutation : pending.Perm other) : Realizes classes environment state other := by
  refine { realized with
    pendingTypes := ?_, ownership := realized.ownership.perm (permutation.map Prod.fst),
    pendingValues := ?_ }
  · intro object ty member
    exact realized.pendingTypes object ty (permutation.mem_iff.mpr member)
  · intro object ty member
    exact realized.pendingValues object ty (permutation.mem_iff.mpr member)

theorem Realizes.weaken_pending (realized : Realizes classes environment state ((object, ty) :: pending))
    (admissible : Admissible classes other) (subtype : Subtype classes ty other) :
    Realizes classes environment state ((object, other) :: pending) := by
  have original := realized.pendingTypes object ty (by simp)
  refine { realized with pendingTypes := ?_, pendingValues := ?_ }
  · intro root view member
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp member with equal | member
    · cases equal; exact admissible
    · exact realized.pendingTypes root view (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ member)
  · intro root view member
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp member with equal | member
    · cases equal
      exact (realized.pendingValues object ty (by simp)).weaken original.2 admissible.2 subtype
    · exact realized.pendingValues root view (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ member)

-- Constructor arguments are paired with fields in declaration order.
inductive ArgumentsSatisfy (classes : ClassTable) (state : State) : List (FieldName × ClassName) → List ObjectId → Prop where
  | nil : ArgumentsSatisfy classes state [] []
  | cons {entry : FieldName × ClassName} {object : ObjectId}
      {fields : List (FieldName × ClassName)} {objects : List ObjectId} :
      Satisfies classes state object (.whole entry.2) →
      ArgumentsSatisfy classes state fields objects →
      ArgumentsSatisfy classes state (entry :: fields) (object :: objects)

theorem ArgumentsSatisfy.lookup (arguments : ArgumentsSatisfy classes state fields objects)
    (found : fields.lookup field = some targetClass) :
    ∃ object, ((fields.map Prod.fst).zip (objects.map some)).lookup field = some (some object) ∧
      Satisfies classes state object (.whole targetClass) := by
  induction arguments with
  | nil => simp at found
  | @cons entry object fields objects head tail ih =>
    rcases entry with ⟨name, target⟩
    by_cases same : field = name
    · subst name
      simp at found
      cases found
      exact ⟨object, by simp, head⟩
    · have different := beq_eq_false_iff_ne.mpr same
      simp only [List.lookup_cons, different] at found
      obtain ⟨result, lookup, satisfied⟩ := ih found
      exact ⟨result, by simpa [List.lookup_cons, different] using lookup, satisfied⟩

theorem ArgumentsSatisfy.member (arguments : ArgumentsSatisfy classes state fields objects)
    (stored : (field, some object) ∈ (fields.map Prod.fst).zip (objects.map some)) :
    ∃ targetClass, (field, targetClass) ∈ fields ∧
      Satisfies classes state object (.whole targetClass) := by
  induction arguments with
  | nil => simp at stored
  | @cons entry target fields objects head tail ih =>
    rcases entry with ⟨name, targetClass⟩
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp stored with equal | stored
    · cases equal
      exact ⟨targetClass, by simp, head⟩
    · obtain ⟨targetClass, member, satisfied⟩ := ih stored
      exact ⟨targetClass, List.mem_cons_of_mem _ member, satisfied⟩

theorem Satisfies.allocated_whole
    (classesWf : classes.WellFormed) (declared : (name, declaration) ∈ classes)
    (wf : WellFormedWith classes.erase state pending)
    (arguments : ArgumentsSatisfy classes state declaration.fields objects) :
    Satisfies classes
      (state.allocate name (declaration.fields.map Prod.fst) objects)
      ⟨state.nextId⟩ (.whole name) := by
  let allocated := state.allocate name (declaration.fields.map Prod.fst) objects
  have classLookup := lookup_of_member classesWf.1 declared
  constructor
  · exact ⟨⟨name, (declaration.fields.map Prod.fst).zip (objects.map some)⟩, by simp [State.allocate], rfl⟩
  · intro path positive
    rw [Pos, positive_whole] at positive
    cases path with
    | nil =>
      exact ⟨⟨state.nextId⟩, ⟨name, (declaration.fields.map Prod.fst).zip (objects.map some)⟩, by simp [readPath, State.allocate],
        by simp [State.allocate], rfl⟩
    | cons field rest =>
      simp only [classAt, classLookup] at positive
      dsimp only [Bind.bind, Option.bind] at positive
      cases fieldClass : declaration.fields.lookup field with
      | none => simp [fieldClass] at positive
      | some targetClass =>
        obtain ⟨object, fieldLookup, satisfies⟩ := arguments.lookup fieldClass
        have valid : Pos classes (.whole targetClass) rest := by
          simpa [Pos, positive_whole, fieldClass] using positive
        have preservedSat : Satisfies classes allocated object (.whole targetClass) := satisfies.allocate wf
        have preserved := preservedSat.positive rest valid
        obtain ⟨target', data', read', member', correct'⟩ := preserved
        have result : readPath allocated ⟨state.nextId⟩ (field :: rest) = some (some target') := by
          cases rest with
          | nil =>
            have selfRead := readPath_nil allocated object
            rw [selfRead] at read'
            have equal : target' = object := by
              cases found : allocated.objects.lookup object <;> simp [found] at read'
              exact read'.symm
            subst target'
            simpa [allocated, readPath, State.allocate] using fieldLookup
          | cons next tail =>
            simpa [allocated, readPath, State.allocate, fieldLookup] using read'
        exact ⟨target', data', result, member', by
          simpa [ViewType.whole, classAt, classLookup, fieldClass] using correct'⟩
  · intro path negative
    simp [Neg, negative_whole] at negative

theorem ArgumentsSatisfy.of_pending
    (lengths : objects.length = fields.length)
    (satisfied : ∀ object ty, (object, ty) ∈ objects.zip (fields.map fun field => ViewType.whole field.2) →
      Satisfies classes state object ty) : ArgumentsSatisfy classes state fields objects := by
  induction fields generalizing objects with
  | nil =>
    have : objects = [] := List.length_eq_zero_iff.mp lengths
    subst objects
    exact .nil
  | cons field fields ih =>
    cases objects with
    | nil => simp at lengths
    | cons object objects =>
      apply ArgumentsSatisfy.cons (satisfied object (.whole field.2) (by simp))
      apply ih (by simpa using lengths)
      intro object ty member
      exact satisfied object ty (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ member)

theorem FieldsMatchClasses.allocate (matched : FieldsMatchClasses classes state)
    (declared : (name, declaration) ∈ classes)
    (arguments : ArgumentsSatisfy classes state declaration.fields objects) :
    FieldsMatchClasses classes
      (state.allocate name (declaration.fields.map Prod.fst) objects) := by
  intro parent data field target member stored
  rcases List.mem_cons.mp member with same | old
  · cases same
    obtain ⟨targetClass, typedField, satisfied⟩ := arguments.member stored
    obtain ⟨targetData, targetMember, targetName⟩ := satisfied.root
    exact ⟨declaration, targetClass, targetData, declared, typedField,
      List.mem_cons_of_mem _ targetMember, targetName⟩
  · obtain ⟨decl, targetClass, targetData, declared, typedField, allocated, correct⟩ :=
      matched _ _ _ _ old stored
    exact ⟨decl, targetClass, targetData, declared, typedField,
      List.mem_cons_of_mem _ allocated, correct⟩

theorem Realizes.allocate
    (realized : Realizes classes environment state
      (objects.zip (declaration.fields.map fun field => ViewType.whole field.2) ++ pending))
    (declared : (name, declaration) ∈ classes)
    (admissible : Admissible classes (.whole name))
    (lengths : objects.length = declaration.fields.length) :
    Realizes classes environment
      (state.allocate name (declaration.fields.map Prod.fst) objects)
      ((ObjectId.mk state.nextId, .whole name) :: pending) := by
  have argumentViews : ArgumentsSatisfy classes state declaration.fields objects :=
    ArgumentsSatisfy.of_pending lengths (fun object ty member =>
      realized.pendingValues object ty (List.mem_append_left _ member))
  have owners : WellFormedWith classes.erase state (objects ++ pending.map Prod.fst) := by
    have keys : (objects.zip (declaration.fields.map fun field => ViewType.whole field.2)).map Prod.fst = objects :=
      List.map_fst_zip (by simp [lengths])
    simpa only [List.map_append, keys] using realized.ownership
  have erased : (name, Class.mk (declaration.fields.map Prod.fst)) ∈ classes.erase :=
    List.mem_map.mpr ⟨(name, declaration), declared, rfl⟩
  constructor
  · exact realized.classesWellFormed
  · exact realized.environmentWellFormed
  · intro object ty member
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp member with same | old
    · cases same; exact admissible
    · exact realized.pendingTypes object ty (List.mem_append_right _ old)
  · exact owners.allocate realized.classesWellFormed.erase erased (by simpa using lengths)
  · exact realized.fields.allocate declared argumentViews
  · exact realized.variableDomain
  · exact realized.emptyVariables
  · intro destination ty member
    obtain ⟨object, stored, satisfied⟩ := realized.initializedVariables destination ty member
    exact ⟨object, stored, satisfied.allocate realized.ownership⟩
  · intro object ty member
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp member with same | old
    · cases same
      exact Satisfies.allocated_whole realized.classesWellFormed declared realized.ownership argumentViews
    · exact (realized.pendingValues object ty (List.mem_append_right _ old)).allocate realized.ownership

theorem Realizes.next_fresh (realized : Realizes classes environment state pending) :
    ObjectId.mk state.nextId ∉ state.objects.map Prod.fst := by
  intro member
  obtain ⟨⟨object, data⟩, stored, same⟩ := List.mem_map.mp member
  dsimp at same
  subst object
  exact Nat.lt_irrefl _ (realized.ownership.bounds _ _ stored)

theorem lookup_of_unique_member {K V : Type} [BEq K] [LawfulBEq K]
    {entries : List (K × V)} {key : K} {value : V} (unique : (entries.map Prod.fst).Nodup)
    (member : (key, value) ∈ entries) : entries.lookup key = some value := by
  induction entries with
  | nil => simp at member
  | cons entry rest ih =>
    rcases entry with ⟨head, data⟩
    simp only [List.map_cons, List.nodup_cons] at unique
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp member with same | later
    · cases same
      simp
    · have different : key ≠ head := by
        intro same
        apply unique.1
        exact List.mem_map.mpr ⟨(key, value), later, same⟩
      rw [List.lookup_cons, show (key == head) = false from beq_eq_false_iff_ne.mpr different]
      exact ih unique.2 later

theorem member_of_lookup {K V : Type} [BEq K] [LawfulBEq K]
    {entries : List (K × V)} {key : K} {value : V} (found : entries.lookup key = some value) :
    (key, value) ∈ entries := by
  obtain ⟨before, after, rfl, _⟩ := List.lookup_eq_some_iff.mp found
  simp

theorem same_value_of_unique_members {K V : Type} [BEq K] [LawfulBEq K]
    {entries : List (K × V)} {key : K} {value other : V} (unique : (entries.map Prod.fst).Nodup)
    (first : (key, value) ∈ entries) (second : (key, other) ∈ entries) : value = other := by
  exact Option.some.inj ((lookup_of_unique_member unique first).symm.trans
    (lookup_of_unique_member unique second))

theorem _root_.Dada.Unique.Unpacking.Transfer.exists_of_permutation
    (sameFields : (pattern.map Prod.fst).Perm (fields.map Prod.fst)) :
    ∃ bindings, Unpacking.Transfer pattern fields bindings := by
  induction pattern generalizing fields with
  | nil =>
    have : fields = [] := List.length_eq_zero_iff.mp (by simpa using sameFields.length_eq.symm)
    subst fields
    exact ⟨[], .nil⟩
  | cons pair rest ih =>
    rcases pair with ⟨field, destination⟩
    have present : field ∈ fields.map Prod.fst := sameFields.mem_iff.mp (by simp)
    obtain ⟨⟨actual, slot⟩, member, equality⟩ := List.mem_map.mp present
    simp only at equality
    subst actual
    obtain ⟨before, after, rfl⟩ := List.mem_iff_append.mp member
    have remaining : (rest.map Prod.fst).Perm ((before ++ after).map Prod.fst) := by
      apply List.Perm.cons_inv (a := field)
      exact sameFields.trans (by simp)
    obtain ⟨bindings, transferred⟩ := ih remaining
    exact ⟨(destination, slot) :: bindings, .cons transferred⟩

theorem BindingTyped.exists_bind
    (typed : BindingTyped classes environment pattern ty afterEnvironment)
    (realized : Realizes classes environment state [(object, ty)]) :
    ∃ after, Unpacking.Bind classes.erase state object pattern after := by
  cases typed with
  | «variable» _ _ fresh =>
    exact ⟨_, .variable (fun occupied => fresh ((realized.variableDomain _).mpr occupied))⟩
  | @unpack _ name declaration fields bindings _ _ sameClass declared
      sameFields uniqueNames fresh _ _ =>
    obtain ⟨data, stored, rootClass⟩ := (realized.pendingValues object ty (by simp)).root
    obtain ⟨leading, trailing, objects⟩ := List.mem_iff_append.mp stored
    obtain ⟨untypedDeclaration, untypedDeclared, shape, _⟩ := realized.ownership.shapes _ _ stored
    have erasedDeclared : (name, ⟨declaration.fields.map Prod.fst⟩) ∈ classes.erase :=
      List.mem_map.mpr ⟨(name, declaration), declared, rfl⟩
    have dataClass : data.className = name := rootClass.trans sameClass
    have declarationEq : untypedDeclaration = ⟨declaration.fields.map Prod.fst⟩ :=
      same_value_of_unique_members realized.classesWellFormed.erase.1
        (dataClass ▸ untypedDeclared) erasedDeclared
    have actualFields : data.fields.map Prod.fst = declaration.fields.map Prod.fst := by
      simpa [declarationEq] using shape
    obtain ⟨runtimeBindings, transferred⟩ :=
      Unpacking.Transfer.exists_of_permutation (sameFields.trans (List.Perm.of_eq actualFields.symm))
    have fieldsUnique := (sameFields.nodup_iff).mpr
      ((realized.classesWellFormed.2 _ declared).1)
    rcases state with ⟨objectsList, variables, nextId⟩
    simp only at objects
    subst objectsList
    rcases data with ⟨dataName, dataFields⟩
    simp only at dataClass
    subst dataName
    exact ⟨_, .unpack erasedDeclared actualFields fieldsUnique uniqueNames
      (fun destination present occupied =>
        fresh destination present ((realized.variableDomain destination).mpr occupied)) transferred⟩

theorem readPath_same_objects (same : before.objects = after.objects) (object : ObjectId)
    (path : Path) : readPath before object path = readPath after object path := by
  induction path generalizing object with
  | nil => simp [readPath, same]
  | cons field rest ih =>
    cases rest with
    | nil => simp [readPath, same]
    | cons next rest => simp only [readPath, same]; congr 1; funext data; congr 1; funext slot
                        congr 1; funext target; simpa only [readPath, same] using ih target

theorem Satisfies.same_objects (satisfied : Satisfies classes before object ty)
    (same : before.objects = after.objects) : Satisfies classes after object ty := by
  constructor
  · simpa [same] using satisfied.root
  · intro path positive
    obtain ⟨target, data, read, present, correctClass⟩ := satisfied.positive path positive
    exact ⟨target, data, (readPath_same_objects same _ _).symm.trans read,
      same ▸ present, correctClass⟩
  · intro path negative
    exact (readPath_same_objects same _ _).symm.trans (satisfied.negative path negative)

theorem Realizes.bind_variable
    (realized : Realizes classes environment state [(object, ty)])
    (fresh : name ∉ environment.map Prod.fst) :
    Realizes classes ((name, some ty) :: environment) (state.bind name object) [] := by
  have freshState : name ∉ state.variables.map Prod.fst :=
    fun present => fresh ((realized.variableDomain name).mpr present)
  have admissible := realized.pendingTypes object ty (by simp)
  constructor
  · exact realized.classesWellFormed
  · simpa [Environment.WellFormed, admissible, fresh] using realized.environmentWellFormed
  · simp
  · exact (realized.ownership.bind freshState).with_empty
  · exact realized.fields
  · intro variableName
    simp only [List.map_cons, List.mem_cons, State.bind]
    exact or_congr Iff.rfl (realized.variableDomain variableName)
  · intro variableName member
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp member with impossible | old
    · cases impossible
    · exact List.mem_cons_of_mem _ (realized.emptyVariables _ old)
  · intro variableName variableType member
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp member with new | old
    · cases new
      exact ⟨object, by simp [State.bind],
        (realized.pendingValues object ty (by simp)).same_objects rfl⟩
    · obtain ⟨target, stored, satisfied⟩ := realized.initializedVariables _ _ old
      exact ⟨target, List.mem_cons_of_mem _ stored, satisfied.same_objects rfl⟩
  · simp

theorem lookup_remove_other {K V : Type} [BEq K] [LawfulBEq K]
    (leading trailing : List (K × V)) (removed key : K) (value : V)
    (different : key ≠ removed) :
    (leading ++ (removed, value) :: trailing).lookup key =
      (leading ++ trailing).lookup key := by
  simp only [List.lookup_append, List.lookup_cons]
  rw [show (key == removed) = false from beq_eq_false_iff_ne.mpr different]

theorem member_remove_other {K V : Type} (leading trailing : List (K × V))
    (removed key : K) (removedValue value : V) (different : key ≠ removed)
    (member : (key, value) ∈ leading ++ (removed, removedValue) :: trailing) :
    (key, value) ∈ leading ++ trailing := by
  simp only [List.mem_append, List.mem_cons, Prod.mk.injEq] at member ⊢
  rcases member with left | same | right
  · exact Or.inl left
  · exact False.elim (different same.1)
  · exact Or.inr right

theorem field_reference_mem (stored : (parent, data) ∈ state.objects)
    (field : (name, some target) ∈ data.fields) : target ∈ References state := by
  apply List.mem_append.mpr; right
  apply List.mem_flatMap.mpr
  refine ⟨(parent, data), stored, ?_⟩
  exact List.mem_filterMap.mpr ⟨(name, some target), field, rfl⟩

theorem variable_reference_mem (stored : (name, some target) ∈ state.variables) :
    target ∈ References state := by
  exact List.mem_append.mpr (.inl (List.mem_filterMap.mpr ⟨_, stored, rfl⟩))

theorem Realizes.pending_not_reference
    (realized : Realizes classes environment state [(object, ty)]) :
    object ∉ References state := by
  exact (List.nodup_cons.mp realized.ownership.referencesUnique).1

theorem readPath_remove (leading trailing : List (ObjectId × Object))
    (removed : ObjectId) (removedData : Object)
    (beforeVariables afterVariables : List (VariableId × Slot))
    (beforeNext afterNext : Nat)
    (noIncoming : removed ∉ References
      ⟨leading ++ (removed, removedData) :: trailing, beforeVariables, beforeNext⟩)
    (object : ObjectId) (different : object ≠ removed) (path : Path) :
    readPath ⟨leading ++ (removed, removedData) :: trailing, beforeVariables, beforeNext⟩
      object path =
    readPath ⟨leading ++ trailing, afterVariables, afterNext⟩ object path := by
  induction path generalizing object with
  | nil =>
    rw [readPath_nil, readPath_nil]
    exact congrArg (fun (found : Option Object) => found.map (fun _ => some object))
      (lookup_remove_other leading trailing removed object removedData different)
  | cons field rest ih =>
    cases rest with
    | nil =>
      simp only [readPath_singleton]
      rw [lookup_remove_other leading trailing removed object removedData different]
    | cons next rest =>
      have lookupEq := lookup_remove_other leading trailing removed object removedData different
      cases found : (leading ++ (removed, removedData) :: trailing).lookup object with
      | none => simp [readPath, found, ← lookupEq]
      | some data =>
        have stored := member_of_lookup found
        cases fieldFound : data.fields.lookup field with
        | none => simp [readPath, found, ← lookupEq, fieldFound]
        | some slot =>
          cases slot with
          | none => simp [readPath, found, ← lookupEq, fieldFound]
          | some target =>
            have differentTarget : target ≠ removed := by
              intro same
              apply noIncoming
              subst target
              exact field_reference_mem stored (member_of_lookup fieldFound)
            simpa [readPath, found, ← lookupEq, fieldFound] using
              ih target differentTarget

theorem readPath_target_ne (noIncoming : removed ∉ References state)
    (different : object ≠ removed) (read : readPath state object path = some (some target)) :
    target ≠ removed := by
  induction path generalizing object with
  | nil =>
    cases found : state.objects.lookup object <;> simp [readPath, found] at read
    subst target
    exact different
  | cons field rest ih =>
    cases found : state.objects.lookup object with
    | none => simp [readPath, found] at read
    | some data =>
      have stored := member_of_lookup found
      cases fieldFound : data.fields.lookup field with
      | none => simp [readPath, found, fieldFound] at read
      | some slot =>
        cases slot with
        | none => cases rest <;> simp [readPath, found, fieldFound] at read
        | some next =>
          have differentNext : next ≠ removed := by
            intro same
            apply noIncoming
            subst next
            exact field_reference_mem stored (member_of_lookup fieldFound)
          cases rest with
          | nil =>
            simp [readPath, found, fieldFound] at read
            subst target
            exact differentNext
          | cons field rest =>
            apply ih differentNext
            simpa [readPath, found, fieldFound] using read

theorem Satisfies.remove (satisfied : Satisfies classes
      ⟨leading ++ (removed, removedData) :: trailing, variables, nextId⟩ object ty)
    (different : object ≠ removed)
    (noIncoming : removed ∉ References
      ⟨leading ++ (removed, removedData) :: trailing, variables, nextId⟩) :
    Satisfies classes ⟨leading ++ trailing, afterVariables, afterNext⟩ object ty := by
  constructor
  · obtain ⟨data, stored, correctClass⟩ := satisfied.root
    exact ⟨data, member_remove_other _ _ _ _ _ _ different stored, correctClass⟩
  · intro path positive
    obtain ⟨target, data, read, stored, correctClass⟩ := satisfied.positive path positive
    refine ⟨target, data, ?_, ?_, correctClass⟩
    · exact (readPath_remove _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ noIncoming object different path).symm.trans read
    · exact member_remove_other _ _ _ _ _ _
        (readPath_target_ne noIncoming different read) stored
  · intro path negative
    exact (readPath_remove _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ noIncoming object different path).symm.trans
      (satisfied.negative path negative)

theorem FieldBindings.description_member
    (typed : FieldBindings classes ty pattern bindings)
    (member : (destination, description) ∈ bindings) :
    ∃ field, (field, destination) ∈ pattern ∧
      fieldDescription classes ty field = some description := by
  induction typed with
  | nil => simp at member
  | @cons field name desc fields bindings described rest ih =>
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp member with same | later
    · cases same
      exact ⟨field, by simp, described⟩
    · obtain ⟨field, present, described⟩ := ih later
      exact ⟨field, List.mem_cons_of_mem _ present, described⟩

theorem _root_.Dada.Unique.Unpacking.Transfer.pattern_member
    (transfer : Unpacking.Transfer pattern fields bindings)
    (member : (field, destination) ∈ pattern) :
    ∃ slot, (destination, slot) ∈ bindings ∧ (field, slot) ∈ fields := by
  induction transfer with
  | nil => simp at member
  | @cons selected name slot pattern before after bindings rest ih =>
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp member with same | later
    · cases same
      exact ⟨slot, by simp, by simp⟩
    · obtain ⟨value, bound, stored⟩ := ih later
      refine ⟨value, List.mem_cons_of_mem _ bound, ?_⟩
      rcases List.mem_append.mp stored with left | right
      · exact List.mem_append_left _ left
      · exact List.mem_append_right _ (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ right)

theorem readPath_descend
    (rootLookup : state.objects.lookup object = some data)
    (fieldLookup : data.fields.lookup field = some (some target))
    (targetLookup : state.objects.lookup target = some targetData)
    (path : Path) : readPath state object (field :: path) = readPath state target path := by
  cases path <;> simp [readPath, rootLookup, fieldLookup, targetLookup]

theorem Satisfies.field_of_observations
    (satisfied : Satisfies classes state object ty)
    (unique : (state.objects.map Prod.fst).Nodup)
    (rootPositive : Pos classes ty [field])
    (classAgreement : classAt classes ty.className [field] = some child.className)
    (positive : ∀ path, Pos classes child path → Pos classes ty (field :: path))
    (negative : ∀ path, Neg child path → Neg ty (field :: path))
    (classesCompose : ∀ path, classAt classes ty.className (field :: path) =
      classAt classes child.className path) :
    ∃ target, readPath state object [field] = some (some target) ∧
      Satisfies classes state target child := by
  obtain ⟨target, targetData, readField, storedTarget, targetClass⟩ :=
    satisfied.positive [field] rootPositive
  have targetLookup := lookup_of_unique_member unique storedTarget
  obtain ⟨data, storedRoot, _⟩ := satisfied.root
  have rootLookup := lookup_of_unique_member unique storedRoot
  have fieldLookup : data.fields.lookup field = some (some target) := by
    simpa [readPath, rootLookup] using readField
  refine ⟨target, readField, ?_⟩
  constructor
  · exact ⟨targetData, storedTarget, Option.some.inj (targetClass.symm.trans classAgreement)⟩
  · intro path known
    obtain ⟨result, resultData, read, stored, correctClass⟩ :=
      satisfied.positive (field :: path) (positive path known)
    refine ⟨result, resultData, ?_, stored, ?_⟩
    · exact (readPath_descend rootLookup fieldLookup targetLookup path).symm.trans read
    · exact (classesCompose path).symm.trans correctClass
  · intro path empty
    exact (readPath_descend rootLookup fieldLookup targetLookup path).symm.trans
      (satisfied.negative (field :: path) (negative path empty))

def SlotMatches (classes : ClassTable) (state : State) : Slot → SlotDescription → Prop
  | none, none => True
  | some object, some ty => Satisfies classes state object ty
  | _, _ => False

theorem Realizes.unpack_of_field_matches {fields : List (FieldName × Slot)}
    (realized : Realizes classes environment
      ⟨leading ++ (object, ⟨className, fields⟩) :: trailing, variables, nextId⟩ [(object, ty)])
    (typed : FieldBindings classes ty pattern bindings)
    (transfer : Unpacking.Transfer pattern fields runtimeBindings)
    (afterWellFormed : (bindings ++ environment).WellFormed classes)
    (operation : Unpacking.Bind classes.erase
      ⟨leading ++ (object, ⟨className, fields⟩) :: trailing, variables, nextId⟩ object
      (.unpack className pattern)
      ⟨leading ++ trailing, runtimeBindings ++ variables, nextId⟩)
    (fieldMatches : ∀ field slot description, (field, slot) ∈ fields →
      fieldDescription classes ty field = some description →
      SlotMatches classes
        ⟨leading ++ (object, ⟨className, fields⟩) :: trailing, variables, nextId⟩
        slot description) :
    Realizes classes (bindings ++ environment)
      ⟨leading ++ trailing, runtimeBindings ++ variables, nextId⟩ [] := by
  have noIncoming := realized.pending_not_reference
  have objectStored : (object, ⟨className, fields⟩) ∈
      leading ++ (object, ⟨className, fields⟩) :: trailing := by simp
  have subset : ∀ entry ∈ leading ++ trailing,
      entry ∈ leading ++ (object, ⟨className, fields⟩) :: trailing := by
    intro entry present
    rcases List.mem_append.mp present with left | right
    · exact List.mem_append_left _ left
    · exact List.mem_append_right _ (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ right)
  constructor
  · exact realized.classesWellFormed
  · exact afterWellFormed
  · simp
  · exact (operation.preserves_wellFormed realized.ownership).with_empty
  · intro parent data field target stored fieldStored
    have oldStored := subset _ stored
    obtain ⟨declaration, targetClass, targetData, declared, declaredField, targetStored, correct⟩ :=
      realized.fields parent data field target oldStored fieldStored
    have different : target ≠ object := by
      intro same
      apply noIncoming
      subst target
      exact field_reference_mem oldStored fieldStored
    exact ⟨declaration, targetClass, targetData, declared, declaredField,
      member_remove_other _ _ _ _ _ _ different targetStored, correct⟩
  · intro name
    simp only [List.map_append, List.mem_append, typed.keys, transfer.keys]
    exact or_congr Iff.rfl (realized.variableDomain name)
  · intro name member
    rcases List.mem_append.mp member with new | old
    · obtain ⟨field, patternMember, description⟩ := typed.description_member new
      obtain ⟨slot, bound, stored⟩ := transfer.pattern_member patternMember
      have matched := fieldMatches field slot none stored description
      cases slot with
      | none => exact List.mem_append_left _ bound
      | some target => cases matched
    · exact List.mem_append_right _ (realized.emptyVariables name old)
  · intro name child member
    rcases List.mem_append.mp member with new | old
    · obtain ⟨field, patternMember, description⟩ := typed.description_member new
      obtain ⟨slot, bound, stored⟩ := transfer.pattern_member patternMember
      have matched := fieldMatches field slot (some child) stored description
      cases slot with
      | none => cases matched
      | some target =>
        have different : target ≠ object := by
          intro same
          apply noIncoming
          subst target
          exact field_reference_mem objectStored stored
        exact ⟨target, List.mem_append_left _ bound, matched.remove different noIncoming⟩
    · obtain ⟨target, stored, satisfied⟩ := realized.initializedVariables name child old
      have different : target ≠ object := by
        intro same
        apply noIncoming
        subst target
        exact variable_reference_mem stored
      exact ⟨target, List.mem_append_right _ stored, satisfied.remove different noIncoming⟩
  · simp

theorem classAt_field_suffix
    (found : classAt classes base [field] = some target) (path : Path) :
    classAt classes base (field :: path) = classAt classes target path := by
  cases declarationFound : classes.lookup base with
  | none => simp [classAt, declarationFound] at found
  | some declaration =>
    cases fieldFound : declaration.fields.lookup field with
    | none => simp [classAt, declarationFound, fieldFound] at found
    | some name =>
      simp [classAt, declarationFound, fieldFound] at found
      subst name
      simp [classAt, declarationFound, fieldFound]

theorem Satisfies.fieldDescription_of_focus
    (satisfied : Satisfies classes state object ty)
    (wf : WellFormedWith classes.erase state pending)
    (dataStored : (object, data) ∈ state.objects)
    (fieldStored : (field, slot) ∈ data.fields)
    (described : fieldDescription classes ty field = some description)
    (focusSound : ∀ child, focus classes ty [field] = some child →
      ∃ target, readPath state object [field] = some (some target) ∧
        Satisfies classes state target child) :
    SlotMatches classes state slot description := by
  have dataLookup := lookup_of_unique_member wf.objectKeys dataStored
  obtain ⟨declaration, _, shape, uniqueFields⟩ := wf.shapes _ _ dataStored
  have fieldLookup := lookup_of_unique_member (shape ▸ uniqueFields) fieldStored
  have read : readPath state object [field] = some slot := by
    simpa [readPath, dataLookup] using fieldLookup
  unfold fieldDescription at described
  split at described
  next negative =>
    have empty := satisfied.negative [field] negative
    have slotEmpty : slot = none := Option.some.inj (read.symm.trans empty)
    have descEmpty : description = none := (Option.some.inj described).symm
    subst slot
    subst description
    trivial
  next notNegative =>
    cases description with
    | none => simp at described
    | some child =>
      have focused : focus classes ty [field] = some child := by simpa using described
      obtain ⟨target, readTarget, childSatisfied⟩ := focusSound child focused
      have slotTarget : slot = some target := Option.some.inj (read.symm.trans readTarget)
      subst slot
      exact childSatisfied

theorem BindingTyped.preserves_realization_of_fields
    (typed : BindingTyped classes environment pattern ty afterEnvironment)
    (realized : Realizes classes environment state [(object, ty)])
    (operation : Unpacking.Bind classes.erase state object pattern after)
    (fieldMatches : ∀ data, (object, data) ∈ state.objects →
      ∀ field slot description, (field, slot) ∈ data.fields →
      fieldDescription classes ty field = some description →
      SlotMatches classes state slot description) :
    Realizes classes afterEnvironment after [] := by
  cases typed with
  | «variable» _ _ fresh =>
    cases operation with
    | «variable» _ => exact realized.bind_variable fresh
  | @unpack _ name declaration pattern bindings _ _ _ _ _ _ _ fieldTyped afterWf =>
    cases operation with
    | @unpack leading trailing variables nextId object className fields pattern runtimeBindings
        declaration _ _ _ _ _ transfer =>
      apply realized.unpack_of_field_matches fieldTyped transfer afterWf
        (.unpack ‹_› ‹_› ‹_› ‹_› ‹_› transfer)
      exact fieldMatches ⟨name, fields⟩ (by simp)

theorem Satisfies.focus_field
    (satisfied : Satisfies classes state object ty)
    (wf : WellFormedWith classes.erase state pending)
    (classesWF : classes.WellFormed) (normal : Normalized classes ty)
    (focused : focus classes ty [field] = some child) :
    ∃ target, readPath state object [field] = some (some target) ∧
      Satisfies classes state target child := by
  have observations := focus_observations classesWF normal focused
  apply satisfied.field_of_observations wf.objectKeys observations.positive observations.className
  · intro path positive
    exact observations.positives path positive
  · intro path negative
    exact observations.negatives path negative
  · exact classAt_field_suffix observations.className

theorem BindingTyped.preserves_realization
    (typed : BindingTyped classes environment pattern ty afterEnvironment)
    (realized : Realizes classes environment state [(object, ty)])
    (operation : Unpacking.Bind classes.erase state object pattern after) :
    Realizes classes afterEnvironment after [] := by
  apply typed.preserves_realization_of_fields realized operation
  intro data stored field slot description fieldStored described
  apply (realized.pendingValues object ty (by simp)).fieldDescription_of_focus
    realized.ownership stored fieldStored described
  intro child focused
  exact (realized.pendingValues object ty (by simp)).focus_field realized.ownership
    realized.classesWellFormed typed.wellFormed.2.1.2 focused

end Dada.Unique.Typing

private theorem token_typed : ExprTyped classes [] (.new "Token" []) token [] := by

theorem construct_typed : StatementTyped classes [] (program[0]'(by decide)) afterConstruct := by

          (by decide)
        · exact .cons token_typed (.cons token_typed (.nil (by decide)))
        · decide
      · exact .nil (by decide)
    · decide
  · exact .variable (by decide) (by decide) (by decide)

theorem left_typed : StatementTyped classes afterConstruct (program[1]'(by decide)) afterLeft := by
  apply StatementTyped.letValue (ty := token) (middle := [("b", some partialBox)])
  · exact .give (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide)
  · exact .variable (by decide) (by decide) (by decide)

theorem item_typed : StatementTyped classes afterLeft (program[2]'(by decide)) afterItem := by
  apply StatementTyped.letValue (ty := partialPair)
    (middle := [("taken", some token), ("b", some emptyBox)])
  · exact .give (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide)
  · exact .variable (by decide) (by decide) (by decide)

theorem unpack_typed : StatementTyped classes afterItem (program[3]'(by decide)) afterUnpack := by

    · decide
    · rfl
    · decide
    · exact .refl _
    · decide
    · decide
    · exact .cons (by decide) (.cons (by decide) .nil)
    · decide

theorem program_typed : SequenceTyped classes [] program afterUnpack := by
  exact .cons construct_typed (.cons left_typed (.cons item_typed

theorem classes_wellFormed : classes.WellFormed := by

namespace Dada.Unique.Typing

theorem ClassTable.WellFormed.erase {classes : ClassTable} (wf : classes.WellFormed) :
    ClassesWellFormed classes.erase := by
  constructor
  · simpa [ClassTable.erase, List.map_map, Function.comp_def] using wf.1
  · intro name declaration member
    obtain ⟨⟨originalName, original⟩, present, equality⟩ := List.mem_map.mp member
    cases equality
    exact (wf.2 _ present).1

-- A move updates an existing slot's description; it never allocates a name.
theorem Environment.replace_keys (environment : Environment) (name : VariableId)
    (description : SlotDescription) :
    (environment.replace name description).map Prod.fst = environment.map Prod.fst := by
  simp only [Environment.replace, List.map_map]
  apply List.map_congr_left
  intro entry _
  by_cases same : entry.1 = name <;> simp [same]

theorem take_keys (taken : take classes before place = some (ty, after)) :
    after.map Prod.fst = before.map Prod.fst := by
  unfold take at taken
  obtain ⟨sourceSlot, _, taken⟩ := Option.bind_eq_some_iff.mp taken
  obtain ⟨source, _, taken⟩ := Option.bind_eq_some_iff.mp taken
  obtain ⟨result, _, taken⟩ := Option.bind_eq_some_iff.mp taken
  by_cases empty : (splitPlace place).2 = []
  · simp [empty] at taken
    rcases taken with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
    exact Environment.replace_keys _ _ _
  · simp only [empty, ↓reduceIte] at taken
    obtain ⟨remaining, _, taken⟩ := Option.bind_eq_some_iff.mp taken
    simp only [pure, Option.some.injEq, Prod.mk.injEq] at taken
    rcases taken with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
    exact Environment.replace_keys _ _ _

theorem ExprTyped.keys (typed : ExprTyped classes before value ty after) :
    after.map Prod.fst = before.map Prod.fst := by
  induction typed using ExprTyped.rec
    (motive_2 := fun before _ _ after _ => after.map Prod.fst = before.map Prod.fst) with
  | give _ taken _ _ => exact take_keys taken
  | new _ _ _ ih => exact ih
  | weaken _ _ _ ih => exact ih
  | nil => rfl
  | cons _ _ first rest => exact rest.trans first

theorem ArgsTyped.keys (typed : ArgsTyped classes before values names after) :
    after.map Prod.fst = before.map Prod.fst := by
  induction typed using ArgsTyped.rec (motive_1 := fun _ _ _ _ _ => True) with
  | give => trivial
  | new => trivial
  | weaken => trivial
  | nil => rfl
  | cons first _ _ rest => exact rest.trans first.keys

theorem ExprTyped.wellFormed (typed : ExprTyped classes before value ty after) :
    before.WellFormed classes ∧ Admissible classes ty ∧ after.WellFormed classes := by
  induction typed using ExprTyped.rec
    (motive_2 := fun before _ _ after _ =>
      before.WellFormed classes ∧ after.WellFormed classes) with
  | give beforeWf _ admissible afterWf => exact ⟨beforeWf, admissible, afterWf⟩
  | new _ _ admissible ih => exact ⟨ih.1, admissible, ih.2⟩
  | weaken _ admissible _ ih => exact ⟨ih.1, admissible, ih.2.2⟩
  | nil wf => exact ⟨wf, wf⟩
  | cons _ _ first rest => exact ⟨first.1, rest.2⟩

theorem ArgsTyped.wellFormed (typed : ArgsTyped classes before values names after) :
    before.WellFormed classes ∧ after.WellFormed classes := by
  induction typed using ArgsTyped.rec (motive_1 := fun _ _ _ _ _ => True) with
  | give => trivial
  | new => trivial
  | weaken => trivial
  | nil wf => exact ⟨wf, wf⟩
  | cons first _ _ rest => exact ⟨first.wellFormed.1, rest.2⟩

theorem BindingTyped.wellFormed (typed : BindingTyped classes before pattern ty after) :
    before.WellFormed classes ∧ Admissible classes ty ∧ after.WellFormed classes := by
  cases typed with
  | «variable» beforeWf admissible fresh =>
    refine ⟨beforeWf, admissible, ?_⟩
    simpa [Environment.WellFormed, admissible, fresh] using beforeWf
  | unpack beforeWf admissible _ _ _ _ _ _ afterWf =>
    exact ⟨beforeWf, admissible, afterWf⟩

theorem StatementTyped.wellFormed (typed : StatementTyped classes before statement after) :
    before.WellFormed classes ∧ after.WellFormed classes := by
  cases typed with
  | letValue expression binding => exact ⟨expression.wellFormed.1, binding.wellFormed.2.2⟩

theorem SequenceTyped.wellFormed (typed : SequenceTyped classes before statements after) :
    before.WellFormed classes ∧ after.WellFormed classes := by
  induction typed with
  | nil wf => exact ⟨wf, wf⟩
  | cons first _ rest => exact ⟨first.wellFormed.1, rest.2⟩

end Dada.Unique.Typing
