def runtimeTokens : List (ObjectId × Object) :=
  [(1, ⟨"Token", []⟩), (0, ⟨"Token", []⟩)]
def runtimePair : Object := ⟨"Pair", [("left", some 0), ("right", some 1)]⟩
def runtimePartialPair : Object := ⟨"Pair", [("left", none), ("right", some 1)]⟩
def runtimeBox : Object := ⟨"Box", [("item", some 2)]⟩
def runtimeEmptyBox : Object := ⟨"Box", [("item", none)]⟩

def runtimeConstructed : State :=
  ⟨(3, runtimeBox) :: (2, runtimePair) :: runtimeTokens, [("b", some 3)], 4⟩
def runtimeLeft : State :=
  ⟨(3, runtimeBox) :: (2, runtimePartialPair) :: runtimeTokens,
    [("taken", some 0), ("b", some 3)], 4⟩
def runtimeItem : State :=
  ⟨(3, runtimeEmptyBox) :: (2, runtimePartialPair) :: runtimeTokens,
    [("p", some 2), ("taken", some 0), ("b", some 3)], 4⟩
def runtimeTakenPair : State :=
  { runtimeItem with variables := [("p", none), ("taken", some 0), ("b", some 3)] }
def runtimeFinal : State :=
  ⟨(3, runtimeEmptyBox) :: runtimeTokens,
    [("left", none), ("right", some 1), ("p", none), ("taken", some 0), ("b", some 3)], 4⟩

private theorem construct_runtime : Eval classes.erase State.empty
    (.new "Box" [.new "Pair" [.new "Token" [], .new "Token" []]])
    ⟨(3, runtimeBox) :: (2, runtimePair) :: runtimeTokens, [], 4⟩ 3 := by
  let first := State.empty.allocate "Token" [] []
  let second := first.allocate "Token" [] []
  let third := second.allocate "Pair" ["left", "right"] [0, 1]
  apply Eval.new (declaration := ⟨["item"]⟩) (evaluated := third) (objects := [2])
  · decide
  · apply EvalArgs.cons (middle := third) (object := 2)
    · apply Eval.new (declaration := ⟨["left", "right"]⟩)
        (evaluated := second) (objects := [0, 1])
      · decide
      · apply EvalArgs.cons (middle := first) (object := 0)
        · exact Eval.new (by decide) (.nil _) rfl (by decide)
        · apply EvalArgs.cons (middle := second) (object := 1)
          · exact Eval.new (by decide) (.nil _) rfl (by decide)
          · exact .nil _
      · rfl
      · decide
    · exact .nil _
  · rfl
  · decide

private theorem left_runtime : Eval classes.erase runtimeConstructed (.give leftPlace)
    ⟨(3, runtimeBox) :: (2, runtimePartialPair) :: runtimeTokens, [("b", some 3)], 4⟩ 0 := by
  apply Eval.give (source := .field 2 "left")
  · apply Resolve.field (parent := 2) (data := runtimePair)
    · apply Resolve.field (parent := 3) (data := runtimeBox)
      · exact .variable (by decide)
      · decide
      · decide
    · decide
    · decide
  · exact Take.field [("b", some 3)] 4 [(3, runtimeBox)] runtimeTokens 2 "Pair"
      [] [("right", some 1)] "left" 0

private theorem item_runtime : Eval classes.erase runtimeLeft (.give itemPlace)
    ⟨(3, runtimeEmptyBox) :: (2, runtimePartialPair) :: runtimeTokens,
      [("taken", some 0), ("b", some 3)], 4⟩ 2 := by
  apply Eval.give (source := .field 3 "item")
  · apply Resolve.field (parent := 3) (data := runtimeBox)
    · exact .variable (by decide)
    · decide
    · decide
  · exact Take.field [("taken", some 0), ("b", some 3)] 4 []
      ((2, runtimePartialPair) :: runtimeTokens) 3 "Box" [] [] "item" 2

private theorem unpack_runtime : Unpacking.Step classes.erase
    ⟨runtimeItem, [program[3]'(by decide)]⟩ ⟨runtimeFinal, []⟩ := by
  apply Unpacking.Step.letValue (evaluated := runtimeTakenPair) (object := 2)
  · exact Eval.give (Resolve.variable (by decide))
      (Take.variable runtimeItem.objects 4 [] [("taken", some 0), ("b", some 3)] "p" 2)
  · apply Unpacking.Bind.unpack (before := [(3, runtimeEmptyBox)]) (after := runtimeTokens)
      (declaration := ⟨["left", "right"]⟩)
      (bindings := [("left", none), ("right", some 1)])
    · decide
    · rfl
    · decide
    · decide
    · decide
    · exact .cons (before := []) (.cons (before := []) .nil)

theorem program_executes : Unpacking.Steps classes.erase ⟨State.empty, program⟩
    ⟨runtimeFinal, []⟩ := by
  apply Unpacking.Steps.step (middle := ⟨runtimeConstructed, program.tail⟩)
  · exact .letValue construct_runtime (.variable (by decide))
  · apply Unpacking.Steps.step (middle := ⟨runtimeLeft, program.tail.tail⟩)

    · apply Unpacking.Steps.step (middle := ⟨runtimeItem, program.tail.tail.tail⟩)

import Unique.TypingAllocation

namespace Dada.Unique.Typing

-- These statements quantify over arbitrary heaps realizing the static input,
-- including previously evaluated arguments held outside the variable store.
def ExpressionSound (classes : ClassTable) (before : Environment) (value : Value)
    (ty : ViewType) (after : Environment) : Prop :=
  ∀ state pending, Realizes classes before state pending →
    (∃ result object, Eval classes.erase state value result object) ∧
    (∀ result object, Eval classes.erase state value result object →
      Realizes classes after result ((object, ty) :: pending))

def ArgumentsSound (classes : ClassTable) (before : Environment) (values : List Value)
    (names : List ClassName) (after : Environment) : Prop :=
  ∀ state pending, Realizes classes before state pending →
    (∃ result objects, EvalArgs classes.erase state values result objects) ∧
    (∀ result objects, EvalArgs classes.erase state values result objects →
      Realizes classes after result (objects.zip (names.map ViewType.whole) ++ pending))

-- The induction isolates the move lemma: construction and weakening need no
-- additional assumptions about how a place is represented or traversed.
theorem ExprTyped.sound_of_give
    (giveSound : ∀ before place ty after, before.WellFormed classes →
      take classes before place = some (ty, after) → Admissible classes ty →
      after.WellFormed classes → ExpressionSound classes before (.give place) ty after)
    (typed : ExprTyped classes before value ty after) :
    ExpressionSound classes before value ty after := by
  induction typed using ExprTyped.rec
    (motive_2 := fun before values names after _ => ArgumentsSound classes before values names after) with
  | give wf taken admissible afterWf => exact giveSound _ _ _ _ wf taken admissible afterWf
  | @new before after name declaration arguments declared args admissible ih =>
    intro state pending realized
    have erased : (name, Class.mk (declaration.fields.map Prod.fst)) ∈ classes.erase :=
      List.mem_map.mpr ⟨(name, declaration), declared, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨existsArgs, allArgs⟩ := ih state pending realized
    constructor
    · obtain ⟨evaluated, objects, evaluatedArgs⟩ := existsArgs
      have current := allArgs evaluated objects evaluatedArgs
      have lengths : objects.length = declaration.fields.length := by
        have argumentLengths := args.length
        have resultLengths := evaluatedArgs.length
        simpa using resultLengths.trans argumentLengths
      exact ⟨_, _, .new erased evaluatedArgs (by simpa using lengths) current.next_fresh⟩
    · intro result object evaluation
      cases evaluation with
      | new runtimeDeclared evaluatedArgs lengths _ =>
        have same := member_value_unique realized.classesWellFormed.erase.1 runtimeDeclared erased
        cases same
        have current := allArgs _ _ evaluatedArgs
        simp only [List.map_map, Function.comp_def] at current
        apply current.allocate declared admissible
        simpa using lengths
  | @weaken before after value ty other typed admissible subtype ih =>
    intro state pending realized
    obtain ⟨existsEval, allEval⟩ := ih state pending realized
    exact ⟨existsEval, fun result object evaluated =>
      (allEval result object evaluated).weaken_pending admissible subtype⟩
  | nil wf =>
    intro state pending realized
    refine ⟨⟨state, [], .nil state⟩, ?_⟩
    intro result objects evaluation
    cases evaluation
    exact realized
  | @cons before middle after value values name names typed args first rest =>
    intro state pending realized
    obtain ⟨existsFirst, allFirst⟩ := first state pending realized
    constructor
    · obtain ⟨middleState, object, evaluatedFirst⟩ := existsFirst
      obtain ⟨⟨result, objects, evaluatedRest⟩, _⟩ :=
        rest middleState ((object, .whole name) :: pending)
          (allFirst middleState object evaluatedFirst)
      exact ⟨result, object :: objects, .cons evaluatedFirst evaluatedRest⟩
    · intro result objects evaluation
      cases evaluation with
      | cons evaluatedFirst evaluatedRest =>
        have firstRealized := allFirst _ _ evaluatedFirst
        have restRealized := (rest _ _ firstRealized).2 _ _ evaluatedRest
        exact restRealized.perm List.perm_middle

end Dada.Unique.Typing

theorem Environment.lookup_member {environment : Environment} (found : environment.lookup name = some description) :
    (name, description) ∈ environment := by
  unfold Environment.lookup at found
  obtain ⟨entry, present, equal⟩ := Option.map_eq_some_iff.mp found
  have member := List.mem_of_find?_eq_some present
  have key := List.find?_some present
  have same : entry.1 = name := by simpa using key
  cases entry
  simp only at same equal
  subst_vars
  exact member

theorem Environment.admissible {environment : Environment} (wf : environment.WellFormed classes)
    (member : (name, some ty) ∈ environment) : Admissible classes ty := by
  have all := List.all_eq_true.mp wf.2
  simpa using all (name, some ty) member

-- Successful static taking identifies the owning variable, its current view,
-- the relative path, and exactly the one environment entry that is changed.
theorem take_description (taken : take classes before place = some (ty, after)) :
    ∃ source,
      before.lookup (splitPlace place).1 = some (some source) ∧
      focus classes source (splitPlace place).2 = some ty ∧
      (((splitPlace place).2 = [] ∧ after = before.replace (splitPlace place).1 none) ∨
       ∃ remaining, (splitPlace place).2 ≠ [] ∧
         emptyPath classes source (splitPlace place).2 = some remaining ∧
         after = before.replace (splitPlace place).1 (some remaining)) := by
  unfold take at taken
  obtain ⟨slot, found, slotBind⟩ := Option.bind_eq_some_iff.mp taken
  obtain ⟨source, value, resultBind⟩ := Option.bind_eq_some_iff.mp slotBind
  have foundSource : before.lookup (splitPlace place).1 = some (some source) := by
    rw [value] at found
    exact found
  obtain ⟨result, focused, resultBody⟩ := Option.bind_eq_some_iff.mp resultBind
  by_cases empty : (splitPlace place).2 = []
  · simp [empty] at resultBody
    rcases resultBody with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨source, foundSource, focused, Or.inl ⟨empty, rfl⟩⟩
  · simp only [empty, ↓reduceIte] at resultBody
    obtain ⟨remaining, emptied, finalBind⟩ := Option.bind_eq_some_iff.mp resultBody
    simp only [pure, Option.some.injEq, Prod.mk.injEq] at finalBind
    rcases finalBind with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨source, foundSource, focused, Or.inr ⟨remaining, empty, emptied, rfl⟩⟩

theorem take_evaluates (taken : take classes before place = some (ty, after))
    (realized : Realizes classes before state pending) :
    ∃ result object, Eval classes.erase state (.give place) result object := by
  obtain ⟨source, found, focused, _⟩ := take_description taken
  have member := Environment.lookup_member found
  have admissible := Environment.admissible realized.environmentWellFormed member
  obtain ⟨object, stored, satisfied⟩ := realized.initializedVariables _ _ member
  have facts := focus_observations realized.classesWellFormed admissible.2 focused
  obtain ⟨target, data, read, _, _⟩ := satisfied.positive _ facts.positive
  obtain ⟨destination, resolved⟩ := resolve_from_readPath stored read
  rw [placeFrom_splitPlace] at resolved
  obtain ⟨result, cleared⟩ := resolved.take_exists
  exact ⟨result, target, .give resolved cleared⟩

theorem Satisfies.focus (satisfied : Satisfies classes state object source)
    (classesWf : classes.WellFormed) (wf : WellFormedWith classes.erase state pending)
    (normal : Normalized classes source)
    (focused : focus classes source path = some result)
    (read : readPath state object path = some (some target)) :
    Satisfies classes state target result := by
  have observations := focus_observations classesWf normal focused
  constructor
  · obtain ⟨target', data, read', member, correct⟩ := satisfied.positive path observations.positive
    have same : target' = target := by simpa [read] using read'.symm
    subst target'
    exact ⟨data, member, by simpa [observations.className] using correct.symm⟩
  · intro suffix known
    obtain ⟨resultObject, data, completeRead, member, correct⟩ :=
      satisfied.positive _ (observations.positives suffix known)
    refine ⟨resultObject, data, (readPath_append wf read suffix).symm.trans completeRead, member, ?_⟩
    simpa [classAt_append, observations.className] using correct
  · intro suffix known
    exact (readPath_append wf read suffix).symm.trans
      (satisfied.negative _ (observations.negatives suffix known))

theorem Environment.replace_member {environment : Environment}
    (member : (name, description) ∈ environment.replace root replacement) :
    (name = root ∧ description = replacement) ∨
      (name ≠ root ∧ (name, description) ∈ environment) := by
  obtain ⟨⟨key, value⟩, old, changed⟩ := List.mem_map.mp member
  by_cases same : key = root
  · simp [same] at changed
    exact Or.inl ⟨changed.1.symm, changed.2.symm⟩
  · simp [same] at changed
    rcases changed with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
    exact Or.inr ⟨same, old⟩

theorem resolve_source_nonempty (resolved : Resolve state place source object)
    (nonempty : (splitPlace place).2 ≠ []) : ∃ parent field, source = .field parent field := by
  cases resolved with
  | «variable» _ => exact False.elim (nonempty rfl)
  | field _ _ _ => exact ⟨_, _, rfl⟩

theorem resolve_source_empty (resolved : Resolve state place source object)
    (empty : (splitPlace place).2 = []) : source = .variable (splitPlace place).1 := by
  cases resolved with
  | «variable» _ => rfl
  | field _ _ _ => simp [splitPlace] at empty

theorem take_preserves_other_variable
    (resolved : Resolve before place source object) (taken : Take before source object after)
    (different : name ≠ (splitPlace place).1) (stored : (name, slot) ∈ before.variables) :
    (name, slot) ∈ after.variables := by
  apply taken.stored_unchanged (place := .variable name) _ stored
  intro same
  cases resolved with
  | «variable» _ => cases same; exact different rfl
  | field _ _ _ => cases same

theorem take_preserves_variable_field (resolved : Resolve before place source object)
    (taken : Take before source object after) (nonempty : (splitPlace place).2 ≠ [])
    (stored : (name, slot) ∈ before.variables) : (name, slot) ∈ after.variables := by
  obtain ⟨parent, field, rfl⟩ := resolve_source_nonempty resolved nonempty
  exact taken.stored_unchanged (place := .variable name) (by intro impossible; cases impossible) stored

theorem Satisfies.take_other_root (wf : WellFormedWith classes.erase before pending)
    (resolved : Resolve before place source removed) (taken : Take before source removed after)
    (owner : RootOwns before pending site object)
    (different : site ≠ .variable (splitPlace place).1)
    (satisfied : Satisfies classes before object ty) : Satisfies classes after object ty := by
  apply satisfied.take_frame wf taken (route_of_resolve resolved) (.root owner)
  intro path _ same
  exact different same.1

theorem Satisfies.emptyPath (wf : WellFormedWith classes.erase before pending)
    (classesWf : classes.WellFormed) (normal : Normalized classes ty)
    (satisfied : Satisfies classes before object ty)
    (root : RootOwns before pending site object)
    (cut : Route before pending site path removed)
    (taken : Take before source removed after)
    (read : readPath before object path = some (some removed))
    (emptied : emptyPath classes ty path = some remaining) :
    Satisfies classes after object remaining := by
  have facts := emptyPath_observations classesWf normal emptied
  constructor
  · obtain ⟨data, stored, correct⟩ := satisfied.root
    obtain ⟨newData, newStored, same⟩ := taken.old_object_data object data stored
    exact ⟨newData, newStored, same.trans (correct.trans facts.className.symm)⟩
  · intro query positive
    obtain ⟨wasPositive, outside⟩ := facts.positives query positive
    obtain ⟨target, data, oldRead, stored, correct⟩ := satisfied.positive query wasPositive
    obtain ⟨newData, newStored, same⟩ := taken.old_object_data target data stored
    refine ⟨target, newData,
      take_readPath_frame wf taken cut (.root root) oldRead (fun both => outside both.2),
      newStored, ?_⟩
    simpa [facts.className, same] using correct
  · intro query negative
    rcases facts.negatives query negative with rfl | ⟨wasNegative, outside⟩
    · exact take_readPath_cleared wf taken facts.nonempty read
    · exact take_readPath_frame wf taken cut (.root root) (satisfied.negative query wasNegative)
        (fun both => outside both.2)

-- All unrelated variables and pending roots retain their descriptions. The
-- moved root is added to the pending results and only its source variable's
-- description is replaced.
theorem Realizes.give_replace (realized : Realizes classes environment before pending)
    (resolved : Resolve before place source object) (taken : Take before source object after)
    (admissible : Admissible classes ty)
    (target : Satisfies classes after object ty)
    (afterWf : (environment.replace (splitPlace place).1 replacement).WellFormed classes)
    (changed : match replacement with
      | none => ((splitPlace place).1, none) ∈ after.variables
      | some remaining => ∃ root, ((splitPlace place).1, some root) ∈ after.variables ∧
          Satisfies classes after root remaining) :
    Realizes classes (environment.replace (splitPlace place).1 replacement) after
      ((object, ty) :: pending) := by
  constructor
  · exact realized.classesWellFormed
  · exact afterWf
  · intro id view member
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp member with same | member
    · cases same; exact admissible
    · exact realized.pendingTypes id view member
  · exact taken.preserves_pending realized.ownership
  · exact realized.fields.take taken
  · intro name
    rw [Environment.replace_keys, taken.variable_keys]
    exact realized.variableDomain name
  · intro name member
    rcases Environment.replace_member member with ⟨rfl, same⟩ | ⟨different, old⟩
    · subst replacement
      exact changed
    · exact take_preserves_other_variable resolved taken different (realized.emptyVariables name old)
  · intro name view member
    rcases Environment.replace_member member with ⟨rfl, same⟩ | ⟨different, old⟩
    · subst replacement
      exact changed
    · obtain ⟨root, atRoot, satisfied⟩ := realized.initializedVariables name view old
      exact ⟨root, take_preserves_other_variable resolved taken different atRoot,
        satisfied.take_other_root realized.ownership resolved taken (.variable atRoot)
          (by intro same; exact different (RootSite.variable.inj same))⟩
  · intro id view member
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp member with same | member
    · cases same; exact target
    · exact (realized.pendingValues id view member).take_other_root realized.ownership
        resolved taken (.pending (List.mem_map.mpr ⟨(id, view), member, rfl⟩))
        (by intro impossible; cases impossible)

theorem give_sound (beforeWf : before.WellFormed classes)
    (taken : take classes before place = some (ty, after)) (admissible : Admissible classes ty)
    (afterWf : after.WellFormed classes) : ExpressionSound classes before (.give place) ty after := by
  intro state pending realized
  refine ⟨take_evaluates taken realized, ?_⟩
  intro result object evaluation
  cases evaluation with
  | give resolved cleared =>
    obtain ⟨sourceTy, found, focused, effect⟩ := take_description taken
    have sourceMember := Environment.lookup_member found
    have sourceAdmissible := Environment.admissible beforeWf sourceMember
    obtain ⟨root, atRoot, satisfied⟩ := realized.initializedVariables _ _ sourceMember
    have observations := focus_observations realized.classesWellFormed sourceAdmissible.2 focused
    obtain ⟨targetObject, targetData, read, _, _⟩ := satisfied.positive _ observations.positive
    obtain ⟨destination, expectedResolve⟩ := resolve_from_readPath atRoot read
    rw [placeFrom_splitPlace] at expectedResolve
    have sameObject := (resolve_deterministic realized.ownership expectedResolve resolved).2
    subst targetObject
    have targetSatisfied := (satisfied.focus realized.classesWellFormed realized.ownership
      sourceAdmissible.2 focused read).take_taken realized.ownership cleared
    rcases effect with ⟨empty, rfl⟩ | ⟨remaining, nonempty, emptied, rfl⟩
    · apply realized.give_replace resolved cleared admissible targetSatisfied afterWf
      have sourceIsVariable := resolve_source_empty resolved empty
      change ((splitPlace place).1, none) ∈ result.variables
      have atVariable : Stored result (.variable (splitPlace place).1) none :=
        sourceIsVariable ▸ cleared.cleared
      exact atVariable
    · apply realized.give_replace resolved cleared admissible targetSatisfied afterWf
      exact ⟨root, take_preserves_variable_field resolved cleared nonempty atRoot,
        satisfied.emptyPath realized.ownership realized.classesWellFormed sourceAdmissible.2
          (.variable atRoot) (route_of_resolve resolved) cleared read emptied⟩

theorem ExprTyped.sound (typed : ExprTyped classes before value ty after) :
    ExpressionSound classes before value ty after :=
  typed.sound_of_give (fun _ _ _ _ => give_sound)

theorem ArgsTyped.sound (typed : ArgsTyped classes before values names after) :
    ArgumentsSound classes before values names after := by
  induction typed using ArgsTyped.rec (motive_1 := fun _ _ _ _ _ => True) with
  | give => trivial
  | new => trivial
  | weaken => trivial
  | nil wf =>
    intro state pending realized
    refine ⟨⟨state, [], .nil state⟩, ?_⟩
    intro result objects evaluated
    cases evaluated
    exact realized
  | @cons before middle after value values name names first rest _ ih =>
    intro state pending realized
    obtain ⟨firstExists, allFirst⟩ := first.sound state pending realized
    constructor
    · obtain ⟨middleState, object, firstEvaluation⟩ := firstExists
      obtain ⟨⟨result, objects, restEvaluation⟩, _⟩ :=
        ih middleState ((object, .whole name) :: pending)
          (allFirst middleState object firstEvaluation)
      exact ⟨result, object :: objects, .cons firstEvaluation restEvaluation⟩
    · intro result objects evaluated
      cases evaluated with
      | cons firstEvaluation restEvaluation =>
        have firstRealized := allFirst _ _ firstEvaluation
        exact ((ih _ _ firstRealized).2 _ _ restEvaluation).perm List.perm_middle

end Dada.Unique.Typing

theorem lookup_member {Key Value : Type} [BEq Key] [LawfulBEq Key]
    {entries : List (Key × Value)} {key : Key} {value : Value}
    (found : entries.lookup key = some value) : (key, value) ∈ entries := by
  obtain ⟨before, after, rfl, _⟩ := List.lookup_eq_some_iff.mp found
  simp

theorem lookup_of_member {Key Value : Type} [BEq Key] [LawfulBEq Key]
    {entries : List (Key × Value)} {key : Key} {value : Value}
    (distinct : (entries.map Prod.fst).Nodup) (member : (key, value) ∈ entries) :
    entries.lookup key = some value := by
  induction entries with
  | nil => simp at member
  | cons entry entries ih =>
    rcases entry with ⟨entryKey, entryValue⟩
    rcases List.nodup_cons.mp distinct with ⟨fresh, distinct⟩
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp member with same | member
    · cases same
      simp
    · have different : key ≠ entryKey := by
        intro same
        exact fresh (same ▸ List.mem_map.mpr ⟨(key, value), member, rfl⟩)
      simpa [List.lookup_cons, show (key == entryKey) = false from beq_eq_false_iff_ne.mpr different] using ih distinct member

theorem member_value_unique {Key Value : Type} [BEq Key] [LawfulBEq Key]
    {entries : List (Key × Value)} {key : Key} {first second : Value}
    (distinct : (entries.map Prod.fst).Nodup)
    (left : (key, first) ∈ entries) (right : (key, second) ∈ entries) : first = second := by
  exact Option.some.inj ((lookup_of_member distinct left).symm.trans
    (lookup_of_member distinct right))

theorem readPath_root_allocated (read : readPath state object path = some slot) :
    ∃ data, (object, data) ∈ state.objects := by
  cases path <;> cases found : state.objects.lookup object <;>
    simp [readPath, found] at read
  all_goals exact ⟨_, lookup_member found⟩

theorem readPath_cons (read : readPath state object (field :: rest) = some slot) :
    ∃ data fieldSlot, (object, data) ∈ state.objects ∧
      (field, fieldSlot) ∈ data.fields ∧
      (rest = [] ∧ fieldSlot = slot ∨
        ∃ target, fieldSlot = some target ∧ readPath state target rest = some slot) := by
  cases objectFound : state.objects.lookup object with
  | none => simp [readPath, objectFound] at read
  | some data =>
    cases fieldFound : data.fields.lookup field with
    | none => simp [readPath, objectFound, fieldFound] at read
    | some fieldSlot =>
      refine ⟨data, fieldSlot, lookup_member objectFound, lookup_member fieldFound, ?_⟩
      cases rest with
      | nil => exact Or.inl ⟨rfl, by simpa [readPath, objectFound, fieldFound] using read⟩
      | cons next rest =>
        cases fieldSlot with
        | none => simp [readPath, objectFound, fieldFound] at read
        | some target =>
          exact Or.inr ⟨target, rfl, by simpa [readPath, objectFound, fieldFound] using read⟩

theorem resolve_follow (resolved : Resolve state base source object)
    (read : readPath state object path = some (some target)) :
    ∃ destination, Resolve state (path.foldl Place.field base) destination target := by
  induction path generalizing base source object with
  | nil =>
    cases found : state.objects.lookup object <;> simp [readPath, found] at read
    subst target
    exact ⟨source, resolved⟩
  | cons field rest ih =>
    obtain ⟨data, slot, stored, atField, final | ⟨next, rfl, more⟩⟩ := readPath_cons read
    · rcases final with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨.field object field, .field resolved stored atField⟩
    · exact ih (.field resolved stored atField) more

theorem resolve_from_readPath (root : (name, some object) ∈ state.variables)
    (read : readPath state object path = some (some target)) :
    ∃ destination, Resolve state (placeFrom name path) destination target :=
  resolve_follow (.variable root) read

theorem WellFormedWith.field_allocated (wf : WellFormedWith classes state pending)
    (stored : (parent, data) ∈ state.objects) (field : (name, some object) ∈ data.fields) :
    Allocated state object := by
  apply (wf.referencesComplete object).mp
  exact List.mem_append_right _ (List.mem_append_right _ (List.mem_flatMap.mpr
    ⟨(parent, data), stored, List.mem_filterMap.mpr ⟨(name, some object), field, rfl⟩⟩))

theorem readPath_target_allocated (wf : WellFormedWith classes state pending)
    (read : readPath state object path = some (some target)) : Allocated state target := by
  induction path generalizing object with
  | nil =>
    cases found : state.objects.lookup object <;> simp [readPath, found] at read
    subst target
    exact List.mem_map.mpr ⟨_, lookup_member found, rfl⟩
  | cons field rest ih =>
    obtain ⟨data, slot, stored, atField, final | ⟨next, rfl, more⟩⟩ := readPath_cons read
    · rcases final with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
      exact WellFormedWith.field_allocated wf stored atField
    · exact ih more

theorem readPath_nil_of_allocated (wf : WellFormedWith classes state pending)
    (allocated : Allocated state object) : readPath state object [] = some (some object) := by
  obtain ⟨⟨id, data⟩, stored, same⟩ := List.mem_map.mp allocated
  simp only at same
  subst id
  simp [readPath, lookup_of_member wf.objectKeys stored]

theorem readPath_append (wf : WellFormedWith classes state pending)
    (read : readPath state object path = some (some target)) (suffix : Path) :
    readPath state object (path ++ suffix) = readPath state target suffix := by
  induction path generalizing object with
  | nil =>
    cases found : state.objects.lookup object <;> simp [readPath, found] at read
    subst target
    rfl
  | cons field rest ih =>
    cases objectFound : state.objects.lookup object with
    | none => simp [readPath, objectFound] at read
    | some data =>
      cases fieldFound : data.fields.lookup field with
      | none => simp [readPath, objectFound, fieldFound] at read
      | some slot =>
        cases rest with
        | nil =>
          have same : slot = some target := by
            simpa [readPath, objectFound, fieldFound] using read
          subst slot
          cases suffix with
          | nil =>
            simpa using read.trans (readPath_nil_of_allocated wf
              (readPath_target_allocated wf read)).symm
          | cons next suffix => simp [readPath, objectFound, fieldFound]
        | cons next rest =>
          cases slot with
          | none => simp [readPath, objectFound, fieldFound] at read
          | some child =>
            have tailRead : readPath state child (next :: rest) = some (some target) := by
              simpa [readPath, objectFound, fieldFound] using read
            simpa [readPath, objectFound, fieldFound] using ih tailRead

theorem readPath_append_inv (wf : WellFormedWith classes state pending)
    (nonempty : suffix ≠ [])
    (read : readPath state object (path ++ suffix) = some slot) :
    ∃ target, readPath state object path = some (some target) ∧
      readPath state target suffix = some slot := by
  induction path generalizing object with
  | nil =>
    obtain ⟨data, stored⟩ := readPath_root_allocated read
    exact ⟨object, by simp [readPath, lookup_of_member wf.objectKeys stored], read⟩
  | cons field rest ih =>
    obtain ⟨data, fieldSlot, stored, atField, final | ⟨child, rfl, more⟩⟩ := readPath_cons read
    · have empty : rest = [] ∧ suffix = [] := by simpa using final.1
      have impossible : suffix = [] := empty.2
      exact False.elim (nonempty impossible)
    · obtain ⟨target, prefixRead, suffixRead⟩ := ih more
      have fieldKeys : (data.fields.map Prod.fst).Nodup := by
        obtain ⟨declaration, _, same, distinct⟩ := wf.shapes object data stored
        exact same ▸ distinct
      have firstRead : readPath state object [field] = some (some child) := by
        simp [readPath, lookup_of_member wf.objectKeys stored,
          lookup_of_member fieldKeys atField]
      exact ⟨target, (readPath_append wf firstRead rest).trans prefixRead, suffixRead⟩

end Dada.Unique.Typing

namespace Dada.Unique

theorem Resolve.stored (resolved : Resolve state place source object) :
    Stored state source (some object) := by
  cases resolved with
  | «variable» stored => exact stored
  | field _ stored field => exact ⟨_, stored, field⟩

theorem Stored.take_exists (stored : Stored state source (some object)) :
    ∃ after, Take state source object after := by
  cases state with
  | mk objects variables nextId =>
    cases source with
    | «variable» name =>
      obtain ⟨before, after, equality⟩ := List.mem_iff_append.mp stored
      dsimp at equality
      subst variables
      exact ⟨_, .variable ..⟩
    | field parent name =>
      obtain ⟨⟨className, fields⟩, stored, field⟩ := stored
      obtain ⟨before, after, equality⟩ := List.mem_iff_append.mp stored
      obtain ⟨leading, suffix, fieldsEquality⟩ := List.mem_iff_append.mp field
      dsimp at equality fieldsEquality
      subst objects fields
      exact ⟨_, .field ..⟩

theorem Resolve.take_exists (resolved : Resolve state place source object) :
    ∃ after, Take state source object after := resolved.stored.take_exists

theorem Take.stored (taken : Take before place object after) :
    Stored before place (some object) := by
  cases taken with
  | «variable» => simp [Stored]
  | field variables nextId leading trailing parent className beforeFields afterFields name object =>
    exact ⟨⟨className, beforeFields ++ (name, some object) :: afterFields⟩, by simp, by simp⟩

theorem Take.cleared (taken : Take before place object after) : Stored after place none := by
  cases taken with
  | «variable» => simp [Stored]
  | field variables nextId leading trailing parent className beforeFields afterFields name object =>
    exact ⟨⟨className, beforeFields ++ (name, none) :: afterFields⟩, by simp, by simp⟩

theorem Take.stored_unchanged (taken : Take before source object after)
    (different : place ≠ source) (stored : Stored before place slot) :
    Stored after place slot := by
  cases taken with
  | «variable» objects nextId leading trailing name object =>
    cases place with
    | «variable» other =>
      simp only [Stored, List.mem_append, List.mem_cons] at stored ⊢
      rcases stored with member | same | member
      · exact Or.inl member
      · cases same
        exact False.elim (different rfl)
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inr member)
    | field parent fieldName => exact stored
  | field variables nextId leading trailing parent className beforeFields afterFields name object =>
    cases place with
    | «variable» other => exact stored
    | field other otherField =>
      obtain ⟨data, atObject, atField⟩ := stored
      simp only [List.mem_append, List.mem_cons] at atObject
      rcases atObject with member | same | member
      · exact ⟨data, List.mem_append_left _ member, atField⟩
      · cases same
        refine ⟨⟨className, beforeFields ++ (name, none) :: afterFields⟩, by simp, ?_⟩
        simp only [List.mem_append, List.mem_cons] at atField ⊢
        rcases atField with member | same | member
        · exact Or.inl member
        · cases same
          exact False.elim (different rfl)
        · exact Or.inr (Or.inr member)
      · exact ⟨data, List.mem_append_right _ (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ member), atField⟩

-- Taking changes only one slot: the allocation identities and nominal classes
-- of all objects remain available, including the object just taken.
theorem Take.old_object_data (taken : Take before place object after)
    (id : ObjectId) (data : Object) (stored : (id, data) ∈ before.objects) :
    ∃ newData, (id, newData) ∈ after.objects ∧ newData.className = data.className := by
  cases taken with
  | «variable» => exact ⟨data, stored, rfl⟩
  | field variables nextId leading trailing parent className beforeFields afterFields name object =>
    simp only [List.mem_append, List.mem_cons] at stored
    rcases stored with member | same | member
    · exact ⟨data, List.mem_append_left _ member, rfl⟩
    · cases same
      exact ⟨⟨className, beforeFields ++ (name, none) :: afterFields⟩, by simp, rfl⟩
    · exact ⟨data, List.mem_append_right _ (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ member), rfl⟩

end Dada.Unique

namespace Dada.Unique.Typing

theorem stored_value_unique (wf : WellFormedWith classes state pending)
    (first : Stored state place left) (second : Stored state place right) : left = right := by
  cases place with
  | «variable» name => exact member_value_unique wf.variableKeys first second
  | field parent name =>
    obtain ⟨firstData, firstObject, firstField⟩ := first
    obtain ⟨secondData, secondObject, secondField⟩ := second
    have same := member_value_unique wf.objectKeys firstObject secondObject
    subst secondData
    obtain ⟨declaration, _, sameFields, distinct⟩ := wf.shapes parent firstData firstObject
    exact member_value_unique (sameFields ▸ distinct) firstField secondField

theorem readPath_singleton_of_stored (wf : WellFormedWith classes state pending)
    (stored : Stored state (.field parent name) slot) : readPath state parent [name] = some slot := by
  obtain ⟨data, atObject, atField⟩ := stored
  obtain ⟨declaration, _, sameFields, distinct⟩ := wf.shapes parent data atObject
  simp [readPath, lookup_of_member wf.objectKeys atObject,
    lookup_of_member (sameFields ▸ distinct) atField]

theorem FieldsMatchClasses.take (fields : FieldsMatchClasses classes before)
    (taken : Take before place object after) : FieldsMatchClasses classes after := by
  intro parent data field target stored atField
  obtain ⟨oldData, oldStored, sameClass, _, remaining⟩ := taken.object_data parent data stored
  obtain ⟨declaration, targetClass, targetData, declared, fieldDeclared, targetStored, targetName⟩ :=
    fields parent oldData field target oldStored (remaining field target atField)
  obtain ⟨newData, newStored, newClass⟩ := taken.old_object_data target targetData targetStored
  exact ⟨declaration, targetClass, newData, sameClass ▸ declared, fieldDeclared,
    newStored, newClass.trans targetName⟩

end Dada.Unique.Typing

import Unique.TypingHeap

namespace Dada.Unique.Typing

def ownerOccurrences (state : State) : List (StoragePlace × ObjectId) :=
  state.variables.filterMap (fun (name, slot) => slot.map fun object => (.variable name, object)) ++
  state.objects.flatMap (fun (parent, data) => data.fields.filterMap
    (fun (name, slot) => slot.map fun object => (.field parent name, object)))

theorem ownerOccurrences_targets (state : State) :
    (ownerOccurrences state).map Prod.snd = References state := by
  simp [ownerOccurrences, References, List.map_append, List.map_flatMap,
    List.map_filterMap, Function.comp_def, Option.map_map]

theorem stored_ownerOccurrence (stored : Stored state place (some object)) :
    (place, object) ∈ ownerOccurrences state := by
  cases place with
  | «variable» name =>
    exact List.mem_append_left _ (List.mem_filterMap.mpr
      ⟨(name, some object), stored, rfl⟩)
  | field parent name =>
    obtain ⟨data, atObject, atField⟩ := stored
    exact List.mem_append_right _ (List.mem_flatMap.mpr ⟨(parent, data), atObject,
      List.mem_filterMap.mpr ⟨(name, some object), atField, rfl⟩⟩)

private theorem unique_mapped {α β : Type} {f : α → β} {entries : List α}
    (distinct : (entries.map f).Nodup) {left right : α}
    (leftMem : left ∈ entries) (rightMem : right ∈ entries) (same : f left = f right) :
    left = right := by
  induction entries with
  | nil => simp at leftMem
  | cons head tail ih =>
    obtain ⟨fresh, distinct⟩ := List.nodup_cons.mp distinct
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp leftMem with rfl | leftTail
    · rcases List.mem_cons.mp rightMem with rfl | rightMem
      · rfl
      · exact False.elim (fresh (same ▸ List.mem_map.mpr ⟨right, rightMem, rfl⟩))
    · rcases List.mem_cons.mp rightMem with rfl | rightMem
      · exact False.elim (fresh (same ▸ List.mem_map.mpr ⟨left, leftTail, rfl⟩))
      · exact ih distinct leftTail rightMem

theorem unique_owner (wf : WellFormedWith classes state pending)
    (left : Stored state first (some object)) (right : Stored state second (some object)) :
    first = second := by
  have distinct : ((ownerOccurrences state).map Prod.snd).Nodup := by
    rw [ownerOccurrences_targets]
    exact (List.nodup_append.mp wf.referencesUnique).2.1
  exact congrArg Prod.fst (unique_mapped distinct
    (stored_ownerOccurrence left) (stored_ownerOccurrence right) rfl)

theorem pending_not_stored (wf : WellFormedWith classes state pending)
    (root : object ∈ pending) (stored : Stored state place (some object)) : False := by
  have member : object ∈ References state := by
    rw [← ownerOccurrences_targets]
    exact List.mem_map.mpr ⟨(place, object), stored_ownerOccurrence stored, rfl⟩
  exact (List.nodup_append.mp wf.referencesUnique).2.2 object root object member rfl

inductive RootSite where
  | variable (name : VariableId)
  | pending (object : ObjectId)
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

inductive RootOwns (state : State) (pending : List ObjectId) : RootSite → ObjectId → Prop where
  | variable : (name, some object) ∈ state.variables → RootOwns state pending (.variable name) object
  | pending : object ∈ pending → RootOwns state pending (.pending object) object

inductive Route (state : State) (pending : List ObjectId) : RootSite → Path → ObjectId → Prop where
  | root : RootOwns state pending site object → Route state pending site [] object
  | field : Route state pending site path parent → (parent, data) ∈ state.objects →
      (name, some object) ∈ data.fields → Route state pending site (path ++ [name]) object

theorem RootOwns.unique {pending : List ObjectId} (wf : WellFormedWith classes state pending)
    (left : RootOwns state pending first object) (right : RootOwns state pending second object) :
    first = second := by
  cases left with
  | «variable» left =>
    cases right with
    | «variable» right =>
      have same := unique_owner wf (show Stored state (.variable _) _ from left)
        (show Stored state (.variable _) _ from right)
      cases same
      rfl
    | pending right => exact False.elim (pending_not_stored wf right (show Stored state (.variable _) _ from left))
  | pending left =>
    cases right with
    | «variable» right => exact False.elim (pending_not_stored wf left (show Stored state (.variable _) _ from right))
    | pending _ => rfl

theorem RootOwns.not_field {pending : List ObjectId} (wf : WellFormedWith classes state pending)
    (root : RootOwns state pending site object)
    (stored : Stored state (.field parent name) (some object)) : False := by
  cases root with
  | «variable» atRoot =>
    have same := unique_owner wf (show Stored state (.variable _) _ from atRoot) stored
    cases same
  | pending atRoot => exact pending_not_stored wf atRoot stored

-- Distinct owning roots and distinct field routes cannot meet. This statement
-- counts pending expression values as roots as well as variables.
theorem Route.unique (wf : WellFormedWith classes state pending)
    (left : Route state pending first firstPath object)
    (right : Route state pending second secondPath object) :
    first = second ∧ firstPath = secondPath := by
  induction left generalizing second secondPath with
  | root atRoot =>
    cases right with
    | root otherRoot => exact ⟨atRoot.unique wf otherRoot, rfl⟩
    | field _ atObject atField => exact False.elim (atRoot.not_field wf ⟨_, atObject, atField⟩)
  | field parentRoute atObject atField ih =>
    cases right with
    | root atRoot => exact False.elim (atRoot.not_field wf ⟨_, atObject, atField⟩)
    | field otherPrefix otherObject otherField =>
      have same := unique_owner wf
        (show Stored state (.field _ _) _ from ⟨_, atObject, atField⟩)
        (show Stored state (.field _ _) _ from ⟨_, otherObject, otherField⟩)
      cases same
      obtain ⟨sites, paths⟩ := ih otherPrefix
      exact ⟨sites, congrArg (fun path => path ++ [_]) paths⟩

theorem Route.follow (route : Route state pending site initial object)
    (read : readPath state object path = some (some target)) :
    Route state pending site (initial ++ path) target := by
  induction path generalizing initial object with
  | nil =>
    cases found : state.objects.lookup object <;> simp [readPath, found] at read
    subst target
    simpa using route
  | cons field rest ih =>
    obtain ⟨data, slot, stored, atField, final | ⟨child, rfl, more⟩⟩ := readPath_cons read
    · rcases final with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
      exact .field route stored atField
    · simpa [List.append_assoc] using ih (.field route stored atField) more

theorem route_of_resolve (resolved : Resolve state place source object) :
    Route state pending (.variable (splitPlace place).1) (splitPlace place).2 object := by
  induction resolved with
  | «variable» stored => exact .root (.variable stored)
  | field _ stored atField ih => exact .field ih stored atField

theorem resolve_deterministic (wf : WellFormedWith classes state pending)
    (first : Resolve state place firstSource firstObject)
    (second : Resolve state place secondSource secondObject) :
    firstSource = secondSource ∧ firstObject = secondObject := by
  induction first generalizing secondSource secondObject with
  | «variable» first =>
    cases second with
    | «variable» second => exact ⟨rfl, Option.some.inj (member_value_unique wf.variableKeys first second)⟩
  | field _ firstObject firstField ih =>
    cases second with
    | field other otherObject otherField =>
      obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := ih other
      have sameData := member_value_unique wf.objectKeys firstObject otherObject
      subst_vars
      have same := stored_value_unique wf
        (show Stored state (.field _ _) _ from ⟨_, firstObject, firstField⟩)
        (show Stored state (.field _ _) _ from ⟨_, otherObject, otherField⟩)
      exact ⟨rfl, Option.some.inj same⟩

theorem resolve_readPath (wf : WellFormedWith classes state pending)
    (resolved : Resolve state place source object) :
    ∃ root, ((splitPlace place).1, some root) ∈ state.variables ∧
      readPath state root (splitPlace place).2 = some (some object) := by
  induction resolved with
  | «variable» stored =>
    refine ⟨_, stored, readPath_nil_of_allocated wf ?_⟩
    apply (wf.referencesComplete _).mp
    exact List.mem_append_right _ (List.mem_append_left _
      (List.mem_filterMap.mpr ⟨(_, some _), stored, rfl⟩))
  | field previous stored atField ih =>
    obtain ⟨root, atRoot, read⟩ := ih
    exact ⟨root, atRoot, (readPath_append wf read [_]).trans
      (readPath_singleton_of_stored wf ⟨_, stored, atField⟩)⟩

theorem Route.allocated (wf : WellFormedWith classes state pending)
    (route : Route state pending site path object) : Allocated state object := by
  cases route with
  | root owner =>
    apply (wf.referencesComplete object).mp
    cases owner with
    | «variable» stored =>
      exact List.mem_append_right _ (List.mem_append_left _
        (List.mem_filterMap.mpr ⟨(_, some object), stored, rfl⟩))
    | pending member => exact List.mem_append_left _ member
  | field _ stored atField => exact WellFormedWith.field_allocated wf stored atField

-- A successful observation is unchanged unless the removed owner's route is a
-- prefix of the observed route. The observation may end at an empty slot.
theorem take_readPath_frame (wf : WellFormedWith classes before pending)
    (taken : Take before source removed after)
    (cut : Route before pending cutSite cutPath removed)
    (route : Route before pending site initial object)
    (read : readPath before object path = some slot)
    (separate : ¬ (site = cutSite ∧ cutPath.IsPrefix (initial ++ path))) :
    readPath after object path = some slot := by
  have afterWf := taken.preserves_pending wf
  induction path generalizing initial object with
  | nil =>
    cases found : before.objects.lookup object <;> simp [readPath, found] at read
    subst slot
    apply readPath_nil_of_allocated afterWf
    simpa [Allocated, taken.object_keys] using route.allocated wf
  | cons field rest ih =>
    obtain ⟨data, fieldSlot, stored, atField, final | ⟨child, same, more⟩⟩ := readPath_cons read
    all_goals
      have different : StoragePlace.field object field ≠ source := by
        intro equalSource
        have sameSlot : fieldSlot = some removed := stored_value_unique wf
          (show Stored before (.field object field) fieldSlot from ⟨data, stored, atField⟩)
          (equalSource ▸ taken.stored)
        have crossing : Route before pending site (initial ++ [field]) removed :=
          .field route stored (sameSlot ▸ atField)
        obtain ⟨sameSite, samePath⟩ := crossing.unique wf cut
        apply separate
        refine ⟨sameSite, ?_⟩
        rw [← samePath]
        exact ⟨rest, by simp [List.append_assoc]⟩
      have firstRead := readPath_singleton_of_stored afterWf
        (taken.stored_unchanged different (show Stored before (.field object field) fieldSlot from
          ⟨data, stored, atField⟩))
    · rcases final with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
      exact firstRead
    · subst fieldSlot
      have remaining := ih (.field route stored atField) more (by
        simpa [List.append_assoc] using separate)
      exact (readPath_append afterWf firstRead rest).trans remaining

theorem route_of_liveWith (live : LiveWith state pending object) :
    ∃ site path, Route state pending site path object := by
  induction live with
  | pending member => exact ⟨_, [], .root (.pending member)⟩
  | «variable» member => exact ⟨_, [], .root (.variable member)⟩
  | field _ member field ih =>
    obtain ⟨site, path, route⟩ := ih
    exact ⟨site, _, .field route member field⟩

theorem readPath_no_cycle (wf : WellFormedWith classes state pending)
    (nonempty : path ≠ []) (read : readPath state object path = some (some object)) : False := by
  obtain ⟨data, member⟩ := readPath_root_allocated read
  obtain ⟨site, rootPath, route⟩ := route_of_liveWith (wf.rooted object (List.mem_map.mpr ⟨_, member, rfl⟩))
  have same := ((route.follow read).unique wf route).2
  have lengths := congrArg List.length same
  have : path.length = 0 := by simp only [List.length_append] at lengths; omega
  exact nonempty (List.length_eq_zero_iff.mp this)

-- An owner's interior cannot lead back to its incoming slot: otherwise two
-- distinct root routes would own the same object.
theorem take_readPath_descendant (wf : WellFormedWith classes before pending)
    (taken : Take before source removed after)
    (cut : Route before pending site cutPath removed)
    (route : Route before pending site initial object)
    (below : cutPath.length ≤ initial.length)
    (read : readPath before object path = some slot) : readPath after object path = some slot := by
  have afterWf := taken.preserves_pending wf
  induction path generalizing initial object with
  | nil =>
    cases found : before.objects.lookup object <;> simp [readPath, found] at read
    subst slot
    apply readPath_nil_of_allocated afterWf
    rw [Allocated, taken.object_keys]
    exact List.mem_map.mpr ⟨_, lookup_member found, rfl⟩
  | cons field rest ih =>
    obtain ⟨data, fieldSlot, stored, atField, final | ⟨child, same, more⟩⟩ := readPath_cons read
    all_goals
      have different : StoragePlace.field object field ≠ source := by
        intro sameSource
        have sourceField : Stored before (.field object field) (some removed) := sameSource ▸ taken.stored
        have sameSlot := stored_value_unique wf
          (show Stored before (.field object field) fieldSlot from ⟨_, stored, atField⟩) sourceField
        have crossing := Route.field route stored (sameSlot ▸ atField)
        have samePath := (crossing.unique wf cut).2
        have lengths := congrArg List.length samePath
        simp only [List.length_append, List.length_singleton] at lengths
        omega
      have firstRead := readPath_singleton_of_stored afterWf
        (taken.stored_unchanged different (show Stored before (.field object field) fieldSlot from
          ⟨data, stored, atField⟩))
    · rcases final with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
      exact firstRead
    · subst fieldSlot
      exact (readPath_append afterWf firstRead rest).trans
        (ih (.field route stored atField) (by simp only [List.length_append, List.length_singleton]; omega) more)

theorem take_readPath_taken (wf : WellFormedWith classes before pending)
    (taken : Take before source object after)
    (read : readPath before object path = some slot) : readPath after object path = some slot := by
  obtain ⟨data, member⟩ := readPath_root_allocated read
  obtain ⟨site, rootPath, route⟩ := route_of_liveWith (wf.rooted object (List.mem_map.mpr ⟨_, member, rfl⟩))
  exact take_readPath_descendant wf taken route route (Nat.le_refl _) read

theorem take_readPath_cleared (wf : WellFormedWith classes before pending)
    (taken : Take before source removed after) (nonempty : path ≠ [])
    (read : readPath before object path = some (some removed)) :
    readPath after object path = some none := by
  have afterWf := taken.preserves_pending wf
  induction path generalizing object with
  | nil => exact False.elim (nonempty rfl)
  | cons field rest ih =>
    obtain ⟨data, fieldSlot, stored, atField, final | ⟨child, rfl, more⟩⟩ := readPath_cons read
    · rcases final with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
      have same := unique_owner wf
        (show Stored before (.field object field) (some removed) from ⟨data, stored, atField⟩)
        taken.stored
      exact readPath_singleton_of_stored afterWf (same ▸ taken.cleared)
    · by_cases empty : rest = []
      · subst rest
        cases found : before.objects.lookup child <;> simp [readPath, found] at more
        subst child
        have same := unique_owner wf
          (show Stored before (.field object field) (some removed) from ⟨data, stored, atField⟩)
          taken.stored
        exact readPath_singleton_of_stored afterWf (same ▸ taken.cleared)
      · have different : StoragePlace.field object field ≠ source := by
          intro same
          have equalSlot := stored_value_unique wf
            (show Stored before (.field object field) (some child) from ⟨data, stored, atField⟩)
            (same ▸ taken.stored)
          have equalObject := Option.some.inj equalSlot
          subst child
          exact readPath_no_cycle wf empty more
        have firstRead := readPath_singleton_of_stored afterWf
          (taken.stored_unchanged different
            (show Stored before (.field object field) (some child) from ⟨data, stored, atField⟩))
        exact (readPath_append afterWf firstRead rest).trans (ih empty more)

theorem Satisfies.take_taken (wf : WellFormedWith classes.erase before pending)
    (taken : Take before source object after) (satisfied : Satisfies classes before object ty) :
    Satisfies classes after object ty := by
  constructor
  · obtain ⟨data, stored, same⟩ := satisfied.root
    obtain ⟨newData, newStored, newSame⟩ := taken.old_object_data object data stored
    exact ⟨newData, newStored, newSame.trans same⟩
  · intro path positive
    obtain ⟨target, data, read, stored, correctClass⟩ := satisfied.positive path positive
    obtain ⟨newData, newStored, sameClass⟩ := taken.old_object_data target data stored
    exact ⟨target, newData, take_readPath_taken wf taken read, newStored, sameClass ▸ correctClass⟩
  · intro path negative
    exact take_readPath_taken wf taken (satisfied.negative path negative)

theorem Satisfies.take_frame (wf : WellFormedWith classes.erase before pending)
    (taken : Take before source removed after)
    (cut : Route before pending cutSite cutPath removed)
    (route : Route before pending site initial object)
    (satisfied : Satisfies classes before object ty)
    (separate : ∀ path, Pos classes ty path ∨ Neg ty path →
      ¬ (site = cutSite ∧ cutPath.IsPrefix (initial ++ path))) :
    Satisfies classes after object ty := by
  constructor
  · obtain ⟨data, stored, same⟩ := satisfied.root
    obtain ⟨newData, newStored, newSame⟩ := taken.old_object_data object data stored
    exact ⟨newData, newStored, newSame.trans same⟩
  · intro path positive
    obtain ⟨target, data, read, stored, correctClass⟩ := satisfied.positive path positive
    obtain ⟨newData, newStored, sameClass⟩ := taken.old_object_data target data stored
    exact ⟨target, newData,
      take_readPath_frame wf taken cut route read (separate path (Or.inl positive)),
      newStored, sameClass ▸ correctClass⟩
  · intro path negative
    exact take_readPath_frame wf taken cut route (satisfied.negative path negative)
      (separate path (Or.inr negative))

end Dada.Unique.Typing

import Unique.Typing

namespace Dada.Unique.Typing

-- An outer none means failed lookup. A final empty slot is some none.
-- Only a nonempty remaining path requires the selected slot to hold an object.
def readPath (state : State) (object : ObjectId) : Path → Option Slot
  | [] => do
      let _ ← state.objects.lookup object
      return some object
  | field :: rest => do
      let data ← state.objects.lookup object
      let slot ← data.fields.lookup field
      match rest with
      | [] => return slot
      | _ :: _ => do
          let target ← slot
          readPath state target rest

-- Views constrain known paths, while unlisted paths impose no local condition.
-- Positive paths require allocated objects of the declared nominal class.
structure Satisfies (classes : ClassTable) (state : State) (object : ObjectId) (ty : ViewType) : Prop where
  root : ∃ data, (object, data) ∈ state.objects ∧ data.className = ty.className
  positive : ∀ path, Pos classes ty path →
    ∃ target data, readPath state object path = some (some target) ∧
      (target, data) ∈ state.objects ∧
      classAt classes ty.className path = some data.className
  negative : ∀ path, Neg ty path → readPath state object path = some none

-- This nominal condition includes occupied fields hidden by a view.
def FieldsMatchClasses (classes : ClassTable) (state : State) : Prop :=
  ∀ parent data field target, (parent, data) ∈ state.objects →
    (field, some target) ∈ data.fields →
    ∃ declaration targetClass targetData,
      (data.className, declaration) ∈ classes ∧
      (field, targetClass) ∈ declaration.fields ∧
      (target, targetData) ∈ state.objects ∧ targetData.className = targetClass

abbrev PendingValues := List (ObjectId × ViewType)

-- Exact domain equality is extensional: list order does not affect realization.
-- Hidden owners and pending expression results remain in ownership accounting.
structure Realizes (classes : ClassTable) (environment : Environment) (state : State) (pending : PendingValues) : Prop where
  classesWellFormed : classes.WellFormed
  environmentWellFormed : environment.WellFormed classes
  pendingTypes : ∀ object ty, (object, ty) ∈ pending → Admissible classes ty
  ownership : WellFormedWith classes.erase state (pending.map Prod.fst)
  fields : FieldsMatchClasses classes state
  variableDomain : ∀ name,
    name ∈ environment.map Prod.fst ↔ name ∈ state.variables.map Prod.fst
  emptyVariables : ∀ name, (name, none) ∈ environment → (name, none) ∈ state.variables
  initializedVariables : ∀ name ty, (name, some ty) ∈ environment →
    ∃ object, (name, some object) ∈ state.variables ∧ Satisfies classes state object ty
  pendingValues : ∀ object ty, (object, ty) ∈ pending → Satisfies classes state object ty

theorem readPath_nil (state : State) (object : ObjectId) :
    readPath state object [] = (state.objects.lookup object).map (fun _ => some object) := by
  cases found : state.objects.lookup object <;> simp [readPath, found]

theorem readPath_singleton (state : State) (object : ObjectId) (field : FieldName) :
    readPath state object [field] =
      (state.objects.lookup object).bind (fun data => data.fields.lookup field) := by
  simp [readPath]

theorem readPath_empty (object : ObjectId) (path : Path) :
    readPath State.empty object path = none := by
  cases path <;> simp [readPath, State.empty]

theorem Satisfies.weaken (satisfied : Satisfies classes state object source)
    (sourceNormal : Normalized classes source) (targetNormal : Normalized classes target)
    (subtype : Subtype classes source target) : Satisfies classes state object target := by
  obtain ⟨sameClass, positives, negatives⟩ := subtype
  unfold Normalized at sourceNormal targetNormal
  rw [sourceNormal, targetNormal] at positives negatives
  constructor
  · obtain ⟨data, stored, correctClass⟩ := satisfied.root
    exact ⟨data, stored, correctClass.trans sameClass⟩
  · intro path positive
    obtain ⟨result, data, read, stored, correctClass⟩ :=
      satisfied.positive path (positives path positive)
    exact ⟨result, data, read, stored, sameClass ▸ correctClass⟩
  · intro path negative
    exact satisfied.negative path (negatives path negative)

theorem Realizes.empty {classes : ClassTable} (classesWellFormed : classes.WellFormed) :
    Realizes classes [] State.empty [] := by
  constructor
  · exact classesWellFormed
  · simp [Environment.WellFormed]
  · simp
  · exact (WellFormed.empty classes.erase).with_empty
  · simp [FieldsMatchClasses, State.empty]
  · simp [State.empty]
  · simp
  · simp
  · simp

end Dada.Unique.Typing

open Checks

def hiddenPair : ViewType := ⟨"Pair", [.positive ["right"]]⟩
def partialEnvironment : Environment := [("p", some partialPair)]
def hiddenEnvironment : Environment := [("p", some hiddenPair)]
def left : Place := .field (.variable "p") "left"
def root : Place := .variable "p"

private theorem give_result (typed : ExprTyped table before value ty after) :
    ∀ place, value = .give place →
      ∃ source, take table before place = some (source, after) ∧ Subtype table source ty := by
  induction typed using ExprTyped.rec (motive_2 := fun _ _ _ _ _ => True) with
  | give _ taken _ _ =>
    intro place equality
    cases equality
    exact ⟨_, taken, .refl _ _⟩
  | new => intro place equality; cases equality
  | weaken _ _ subtype ih =>
    intro place equality
    obtain ⟨source, taken, previous⟩ := ih place equality
    exact ⟨source, taken, previous.trans subtype⟩
  | nil => trivial
  | cons => trivial

private theorem new_arguments (typed : ExprTyped table before value ty after) :
    ∀ name arguments, value = .new name arguments →
      ∃ declaration, (name, declaration) ∈ table ∧
        ArgsTyped table before arguments (declaration.fields.map Prod.snd) after := by
  induction typed using ExprTyped.rec (motive_2 := fun _ _ _ _ _ => True) with
  | give => intro name arguments equality; cases equality
  | new declared typed _ _ =>
    intro name arguments equality
    cases equality
    exact ⟨_, declared, typed⟩
  | weaken _ _ _ ih => exact ih
  | nil => trivial
  | cons => trivial

theorem partial_give : ExprTyped classes partialEnvironment (.give root) partialPair [("p", none)] :=
  .give (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide)

theorem partial_not_whole : ¬ ExprTyped classes partialEnvironment (.give root) pair after := by
  intro typed
  obtain ⟨source, taken, subtype⟩ := give_result typed root rfl
  have actual : take classes partialEnvironment root = some (partialPair, [("p", none)]) := by decide
  rw [actual] at taken
  cases taken
  have positive : Pos classes (normalize classes pair) ["left"] := by decide
  have impossible := subtype.2.1 ["left"] positive
  have absent : ¬ Pos classes (normalize classes partialPair) ["left"] := by decide
  exact absent impossible

theorem partial_constructor_rejected :
    ¬ ExprTyped classes partialEnvironment (.new "Box" [.give root]) ty after := by
  intro typed
  obtain ⟨declaration, declared, arguments⟩ := new_arguments typed "Box" [.give root] rfl
  have actual : declaration = ⟨[("item", "Pair")]⟩ := by
    simpa [classes] using declared
  subst declaration
  cases arguments with
  | cons first _ => exact partial_not_whole first

private theorem description_for_pattern
    (typed : FieldBindings table ty pattern bindings) (member : (field, name) ∈ pattern) :
    ∃ description, fieldDescription table ty field = some description := by
  induction typed with
  | nil => simp at member
  | cons described _ ih =>
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp member with same | later
    · cases same; exact ⟨_, described⟩
    · exact ih later

theorem hidden_unpack_rejected :
    ¬ BindingTyped classes before (.unpack "Pair" pattern) hiddenPair after := by
  intro typed
  cases typed with
  | @unpack _ _ declaration _ _ _ _ _ declared fields _ _ descriptions _ =>
    have actual : declaration = (⟨[("left", "Token"), ("right", "Token")]⟩ : TypedClass) := by
      simpa [classes] using declared
    subst actual
    have present : "left" ∈ pattern.map Prod.fst := fields.mem_iff.mpr (by simp)
    obtain ⟨⟨_, destination⟩, member, equal⟩ := List.mem_map.mp present
    simp only at equal
    subst equal
    obtain ⟨description, described⟩ := description_for_pattern descriptions member
    have absent : fieldDescription classes hiddenPair "left" = none := by decide
    rw [absent] at described
    contradiction

def runtimePartial : State :=
  ⟨(2, runtimePartialPair) :: runtimeTokens, [("p", some 2), ("taken", some 0)], 3⟩
def runtimeAfterTake : State :=
  { runtimePartial with variables := [("p", none), ("taken", some 0)] }

theorem partial_constructor_executes :
    Eval classes.erase runtimePartial (.new "Box" [.give root])
      (runtimeAfterTake.allocate "Box" ["item"] [2]) 3 := by
  apply Eval.new (declaration := ⟨["item"]⟩) (evaluated := runtimeAfterTake) (objects := [2])
  · decide
  · apply EvalArgs.cons (middle := runtimeAfterTake) (object := 2)
    · exact Eval.give (.variable (by decide))
        (Take.variable runtimePartial.objects 3 [] [("taken", some 0)] "p" 2)
    · exact .nil _
  · rfl
  · decide

def twoClasses : ClassTable := [("Two", ⟨[("a", "Token"), ("b", "Token")]⟩)] ++ classes
def tokenEnvironment : Environment := [("t", some token)]
def tokenGive : Value := .give (.variable "t")

theorem first_argument_moves :
    ExprTyped twoClasses tokenEnvironment tokenGive token [("t", none)] :=
  .give (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide)

theorem repeated_argument_rejected :
    ¬ ExprTyped twoClasses tokenEnvironment (.new "Two" [tokenGive, tokenGive]) ty after := by
  intro typed
  obtain ⟨declaration, declared, arguments⟩ :=
    new_arguments typed "Two" [tokenGive, tokenGive] rfl
  have actual : declaration = ⟨[("a", "Token"), ("b", "Token")]⟩ := by
    simpa [twoClasses, classes] using declared
  subst declaration
  cases arguments with
  | cons first rest =>
    obtain ⟨source, taken⟩ := first.give_requires_take (.variable "t") rfl
    have actual : take twoClasses tokenEnvironment (.variable "t") =
        some (token, [("t", none)]) := by decide
    rw [actual] at taken
    cases taken
    cases rest with
    | cons second _ => exact failed_take_not_typed (by decide) second

private theorem hidden_positive_paths (known : Pos classes hiddenPair path) :
    path = [] ∨ path = ["right"] := by
  cases path with
  | nil => exact Or.inl rfl
  | cons field rest =>
    have valid := known.valid
    have right : field = "right" := by
      simp [Pos, positive, hiddenPair, Entry.path, List.isPrefixOf_cons_cons] at known
      exact known.2.symm
    subst field
    cases rest with
    | nil => exact Or.inr rfl
    | cons next rest => simp [classAt, classes, hiddenPair, List.lookup] at valid

def runtimeFull : State :=
  ⟨(2, runtimePair) :: runtimeTokens, [("p", some 2)], 3⟩
def runtimeGivenLeft : State :=
  { runtimeFull with objects := (2, runtimePartialPair) :: runtimeTokens }

theorem initialized_hidden_field : Satisfies classes runtimeFull 2 hiddenPair ∧
    Eval classes.erase runtimeFull (.give left) runtimeGivenLeft 0 := by
  constructor
  · constructor
    · exact ⟨runtimePair, by decide, rfl⟩
    · intro path positive
      rcases hidden_positive_paths positive with rfl | rfl
      · exact ⟨2, runtimePair, by decide, by decide, rfl⟩
      · exact ⟨1, ⟨"Token", []⟩, by decide, by decide, by decide⟩
    · intro path negative
      change false = true at negative
      contradiction
  · exact Eval.give (.field (parent := 2) (data := runtimePair)
      (.variable (by decide)) (by decide) (by decide))
      (Take.field [("p", some 2)] 3 [] runtimeTokens 2 "Pair" []
        [("right", some 1)] "left" 0)

-- ANCHOR: rejected_moves
example :
    (∀ ty after, ¬ ExprTyped classes partialEnvironment (.give left) ty after) ∧
    (∀ ty after, ¬ ExprTyped classes hiddenEnvironment (.give left) ty after) ∧
    Satisfies classes runtimeFull 2 hiddenPair ∧
    Eval classes.erase runtimeFull (.give left) runtimeGivenLeft 0 ∧
    ExprTyped classes partialEnvironment (.give root) partialPair [("p", none)] ∧
    (∀ after, ¬ ExprTyped classes partialEnvironment (.give root) pair after) ∧
    (∀ ty after, ¬ ExprTyped classes partialEnvironment (.new "Box" [.give root]) ty after) ∧
    Eval classes.erase runtimePartial (.new "Box" [.give root])
      (runtimeAfterTake.allocate "Box" ["item"] [2]) 3 ∧
    (∀ before pattern after, ¬ BindingTyped classes before
      (.unpack "Pair" pattern) hiddenPair after) ∧
    ExprTyped twoClasses tokenEnvironment tokenGive token [("t", none)] ∧
    (∀ ty after, ¬ ExprTyped twoClasses [("t", none)] tokenGive ty after) ∧
    (∀ ty after, ¬ ExprTyped twoClasses tokenEnvironment
      (.new "Two" [tokenGive, tokenGive]) ty after) := by
  exact ⟨fun _ _ => failed_take_not_typed (by decide),
    fun _ _ => failed_take_not_typed (by decide), initialized_hidden_field.1,
    initialized_hidden_field.2, partial_give, fun _ => partial_not_whole,
    fun _ _ => partial_constructor_rejected, partial_constructor_executes,
    fun _ _ _ => hidden_unpack_rejected, first_argument_moves,
    fun _ _ => failed_take_not_typed (by decide), fun _ _ => repeated_argument_rejected⟩
-- ANCHOR_END: rejected_moves

-- A counted trace records the number of statement transitions.
inductive StepsExactly (classes : Classes) : Configuration → Nat → Configuration → Prop where
  | refl (configuration : Configuration) : StepsExactly classes configuration 0 configuration
  | step {before middle after : Configuration} {count : Nat} :
      Step classes before middle → StepsExactly classes middle count after →
      StepsExactly classes before (count + 1) after

theorem StepsExactly.steps (trace : StepsExactly classes before count after) :
    Steps classes before after := by
  induction trace with
  | refl => exact .refl _
  | step first _ rest => exact .step first rest

theorem StepsExactly.length (trace : StepsExactly classes before count after) :
    before.code.length = count + after.code.length := by
  induction trace with
  | refl => simp
  | step first _ rest => have shorter := first.code_length; omega

theorem StepsExactly.trans (first : StepsExactly classes before count middle)
    (second : StepsExactly classes middle later after) :
    StepsExactly classes before (count + later) after := by
  induction first with
  | refl => simpa using second
  | step firstStep _ rest =>
    simpa [Nat.add_assoc, Nat.add_comm, Nat.add_left_comm] using
      (StepsExactly.step firstStep (rest second))

theorem Steps.counted (trace : Steps classes before after) :
    ∃ count, StepsExactly classes before count after := by
  induction trace with
  | refl => exact ⟨0, .refl _⟩
  | step first _ rest =>
    obtain ⟨count, trace⟩ := rest
    exact ⟨count + 1, .step first trace⟩

end Dada.Unique.Unpacking

namespace Dada.Unique.Typing

section FromExpressionSoundness

variable {classes : ClassTable}
variable (expressionSound : ∀ before value ty after,
  ExprTyped classes before value ty after → ExpressionSound classes before value ty after)

include expressionSound

theorem ConfigurationTyped.progress_of_expression
    (typed : ConfigurationTyped classes configuration finalEnvironment) :
    configuration.finished ∨ ∃ after, Unpacking.Step classes.erase configuration after := by
  obtain ⟨current, realized, sequence⟩ := typed
  rcases configuration with ⟨state, code⟩
  cases code with
  | nil => exact Or.inl rfl
  | cons statement rest =>
    cases sequence with
    | cons first remaining =>
      cases first with
      | letValue expression binding =>
        have sound := expressionSound _ _ _ _ expression state [] realized
        obtain ⟨evaluated, object, evaluation⟩ := sound.1
        have current := sound.2 evaluated object evaluation
        obtain ⟨after, operation⟩ := binding.exists_bind current
        exact Or.inr ⟨⟨after, rest⟩, .letValue evaluation operation⟩

theorem ConfigurationTyped.preservation_of_expression
    (typed : ConfigurationTyped classes before finalEnvironment)
    (step : Unpacking.Step classes.erase before after) :
    ConfigurationTyped classes after finalEnvironment := by
  obtain ⟨current, realized, sequence⟩ := typed
  cases step with
  | letValue evaluation operation =>
    cases sequence with
    | cons first rest =>
      cases first with
      | letValue expression binding =>
        have evaluated := (expressionSound _ _ _ _ expression _ [] realized).2 _ _ evaluation
        exact ⟨_, binding.preserves_realization evaluated operation, rest⟩

theorem ConfigurationTyped.trace_of_expression
    (typed : ConfigurationTyped classes before finalEnvironment)
    (trace : Unpacking.Steps classes.erase before after) :
    ConfigurationTyped classes after finalEnvironment := by
  induction trace with
  | refl => exact typed
  | step first _ rest =>
    exact rest (typed.preservation_of_expression expressionSound first)

theorem ConfigurationTyped.finishes_of_expression
    (typed : ConfigurationTyped classes configuration finalEnvironment) :
    ∃ final, Unpacking.StepsExactly classes.erase configuration configuration.code.length final ∧
      final.finished ∧ Realizes classes finalEnvironment final.state [] := by
  have decreasing : ∀ (count : Nat) (configuration : Unpacking.Configuration), configuration.code.length = count →
      ConfigurationTyped classes configuration finalEnvironment →
      ∃ final, Unpacking.StepsExactly classes.erase configuration count final ∧
        final.finished ∧ Realizes classes finalEnvironment final.state [] := by
    intro count
    induction count with
    | zero =>
      intro configuration empty typed
      have finished : configuration.finished := List.length_eq_zero_iff.mp empty
      exact ⟨configuration, .refl _, finished, typed.finished finished⟩
    | succ count ih =>
      intro configuration length typed
      rcases typed.progress_of_expression expressionSound with finished | ⟨after, step⟩
      · have empty : configuration.code = [] := finished
        simp [empty] at length
      · have shorter := step.code_length
        have nextLength : after.code.length = count := by omega
        obtain ⟨final, rest, finished, realized⟩ := ih after nextLength
          (typed.preservation_of_expression expressionSound step)
        exact ⟨final, .step step rest, finished, realized⟩
  exact decreasing _ configuration rfl typed

end FromExpressionSoundness

-- The public results discharge the expression premise with the proved static
-- soundness theorem; no operational-success assumption appears here.
theorem expression_soundness
    (typed : ExprTyped classes before value ty after)
    (realized : Realizes classes before state pending) :
    (∃ result object, Eval classes.erase state value result object) ∧
    (∀ result object, Eval classes.erase state value result object →
      Realizes classes after result (pending ++ [(object, ty)])) := by
  have sound := typed.sound state pending realized
  refine ⟨sound.1, fun result object evaluated => ?_⟩
  exact (sound.2 result object evaluated).perm (by simpa using (List.perm_middle (a := (object, ty)) (l₁ := pending) (l₂ := [])).symm)

theorem ConfigurationTyped.progress
    (typed : ConfigurationTyped classes configuration finalEnvironment) :
    configuration.finished ∨ ∃ after, Unpacking.Step classes.erase configuration after :=
  typed.progress_of_expression (fun _ _ _ _ expression => expression.sound)

theorem ConfigurationTyped.preservation
    (typed : ConfigurationTyped classes before finalEnvironment)
    (step : Unpacking.Step classes.erase before after) :
    ConfigurationTyped classes after finalEnvironment :=
  typed.preservation_of_expression (fun _ _ _ _ expression => expression.sound) step

theorem ConfigurationTyped.trace
    (typed : ConfigurationTyped classes before finalEnvironment)
    (steps : Unpacking.Steps classes.erase before after) :
    ConfigurationTyped classes after finalEnvironment :=
  typed.trace_of_expression (fun _ _ _ _ expression => expression.sound) steps

theorem ConfigurationTyped.finishes
    (typed : ConfigurationTyped classes configuration finalEnvironment) :
    ∃ final, Unpacking.StepsExactly classes.erase configuration configuration.code.length final ∧
      final.finished ∧ Realizes classes finalEnvironment final.state [] :=
  typed.finishes_of_expression (fun _ _ _ _ expression => expression.sound)

-- Every finite execution prefix remains safe and can be completed. The counted
-- continuation gives exactly one transition per original statement overall.
theorem program_safety (classesWf : classes.WellFormed)
    (typed : SequenceTyped classes [] code finalEnvironment)
    (execution : Unpacking.Steps classes.erase ⟨State.empty, code⟩ configuration) :
    ¬ Unpacking.Stuck classes.erase configuration ∧
    (configuration.finished ∨ ∃ next, Unpacking.Step classes.erase configuration next) ∧
    ∃ final prefixLength,
      Unpacking.StepsExactly classes.erase ⟨State.empty, code⟩ prefixLength configuration ∧
      Unpacking.StepsExactly classes.erase configuration configuration.code.length final ∧
      prefixLength + configuration.code.length = code.length ∧
      Unpacking.StepsExactly classes.erase ⟨State.empty, code⟩ code.length final ∧
      final.finished ∧ Realizes classes finalEnvironment final.state [] := by
  have initial : ConfigurationTyped classes ⟨State.empty, code⟩ finalEnvironment :=
    ⟨[], Realizes.empty classesWf, typed⟩
  have current := initial.trace execution
  have progress := current.progress
  refine ⟨?_, progress, ?_⟩
  · intro stuck
    rcases progress with finished | next
    · exact stuck.1 finished
    · exact stuck.2 next
  · obtain ⟨final, completion, finished, realized⟩ := current.finishes
    obtain ⟨count, counted⟩ := execution.counted
    have length : count + configuration.code.length = code.length := counted.length.symm
    exact ⟨final, count, counted, completion, length,
      length ▸ counted.trans completion, finished, realized⟩

end Dada.Unique.Typing
